### [1] [Zero-Shot Visualization: Exploring Text Corpora with User-Prompted Axes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06889)
*Arnau Bueno Tricas,Jose A. Rodríguez-Serrano*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了"零样本可视化"（ZSV）任务，利用大语言模型将文本语料映射到用户以自然语言定义的概念轴上以进行可视化探索。作者系统比较了基于检索、LLM判断和条件似然估计等打分方法，发现基于下一词概率的PZS打分方法在语义忠实度、分数保真度和计算成本之间提供了最佳平衡，并给出了端到端构建ZSV基线的实用指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM在数据探索中多作为对话式查询接口或外部推理引擎，而非直接构建用于探索的特征空间。传统的可视化方法（如t-SNE、UMAP）无法显式地将用户定义的概念映射到轴上；而verbalizer等LLM评分方法计算成本过高，embedding方法又存在分数标度差的问题。因此需要一个将LLM语义知识直接用于构建交互式文本探索特征空间的系统化框架。

Method: 方法包括三部分：（1）ZSV框架——给定文本语料X和用户定义的自然语言概念集C，将每个文本x映射为K维向量s(x)=(s(x,c1),...,s(x,cK))，其中s(x,ck)∈[0,1]为概念对齐分数；（2）打分方法分为两类：检索类打分器（SLR基于TF-IDF、DNR基于MiniLM、SNR基于SPLADE）和LLM打分器（DR直接评分、PZS基于下一词概率、EM基于解释边际化），并提供粗到精的混合策略；（3）在MMLU、Banking77等有标签语料上用AUROC、AP、Brier评估语义忠实度，在酒店评论和联合国演讲语料上进行无标签探索实验。

Result: 在MMLU和Banking77上，PZS在AUROC（0.93/0.95）、AP（0.42/0.55）和Brier（0.14/0.11）上均取得最优；DNR次之但Brier较差（0.22/0.21）；EM-Hybrid受限于弱第一阶段打分器表现不佳。PZS结果在Qwen-3B、Mistral-7B、Llama-8B、Gemma-9B四种模型上保持一致，Gemma-9B最佳（Brier 0.10/0.09）。时间开销方面，SLR仅68ms，PZS为2.9s，DR为3.0s，EM为54s。无标签探索中：（1）二元轴显示不同方法产生的几何结构差异显著，PZS提供最清晰的象限分离；（2）分级轴与二元相关性过滤配对可解决"未提及"与"中性"的歧义；（3）发现离题文档存在"组合情感偏差"（halo effect），即极端情感会传染至无关概念的评分。ScienceQA实验表明ZSV概念激活可作为浅层决策树的特征用于下游预测（surrogate准确率0.826）。

Conclusion: 本文形式化了ZSV任务，系统比较了多种零样本打分方法在交互式语料探索中的性能，提出PZS是语义忠实度与计算成本间最佳折中方案。分级轴配合二元相关性过滤能产生可解释的多轴可视化，但需警惕离题文档的情感偏差传播现象。该框架具有三大贡献：（a）形式化ZSV并识别满足需求的打分方法族；（b）可视化优先的基准与探索案例研究；（c）面向实践者的方法选择、LLM选择、缩放与预处理指南。局限性包括评估范围限于英语通用领域、EM-Hybrid表现不佳、分级轴的定量基准缺失以及概念措辞的鲁棒性未研究。

Abstract: We study the application of large language models (LLMs) to the visual exploration of textual corpora. We introduce zero-shot visualization (ZSV), a task in which users specify concepts in natural language and documents are mapped onto the corresponding concept axes for visualization. Building a ZSV system of practical value is non-trivial, as it requires choices at the intersection of feature functions, efficient implementation tradeoffs, and pre/post-processing decisions affecting visualization quality. To that end, we establish a benchmark that compares methods spanning embedding similarity, direct semantic judgments, and conditional likelihood estimation in this setting. Across multiple datasets and use cases we evaluate the properties of different scoring methods and design choices in terms of semantic faithfulness, score fidelity, and computational cost. Our results identify that scoring based on next-token probabilities offers the strongest practical trade-off among the evaluated methods. We further apply this approach to unlabeled corpora to examine its behavior in realistic exploratory settings. These experiments highlight additional design considerations, including the use of graded axes together with binary relevance filtering, and reveal a compositional sentiment bias in off-topic documents. Based on these findings, we provide practical guidelines for constructing end-to-end ZSV baselines.

</details>


### [2] [Component and Dimension Sparsity in Transformer Refusal Mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06903)
*Vincent Siu,Glenn Grant-Richards,Vlad Pavlovich,Yizhou Sun,Dawn Song,Chenguang Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统地分解了Transformer中拒绝行为(refusal)的激活引导机制，发现在四个开源模型中，28–48%的上游注意力/MLP组件即可恢复88–101%的引导效果，且仅约50%的残差流维度承载了大部分信号，呈现出两层稀疏性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有激活引导方法通常仅在残差流单个点进行干预，缺乏对哪些组件和维度真正负责组装拒绝方向的机制性理解。本文旨在揭示拒绝方向在Transformer内部的具体编码结构。

Method: 采用差分均值法(DIM)提取拒绝方向，通过两阶段贪心反向消除法（先基于投影后基于ASR）识别最少必要组件集，再使用基于范数解释的坐标掩码定位残差流内的关键维度，最后通过随机旋转和补集实验验证稀疏性的功能性。

Result: 在四个模型（Gemma2-2B-IT、Phi4-Mini、Qwen3-4B、Mistral-3.2-Small）上，28–48%的上游组件即可保留88–101%的引导效果；其中约50%的残差维度承载了85–98%的信号。稀疏机制在能力保留（MMLU、GSM8k、PPL）上显著优于全组件密集干预。

Conclusion: 拒绝行为并非弥散编码于Transformer中，而是由稀疏且结构化的可识别机制组装而成，具有两层稀疏性（组件级和维度级），为机制可解释性和定向干预提供了基础。

Abstract: Activation steering manipulates large language model behavior by intervening on internal activations, but the mechanistic basis of these interventions remains poorly understood. We decompose refusal steering into component-level interventions across four open-weight models, identifying the sparse subsets of attention and MLP components whose steering suffices to reproduce the full behavioral effect. We find that refusal directions concentrate in sparse component mechanisms comprising 28--48\% of upstream components, retaining 88--101\% of steering effectiveness. Within these mechanisms, effective steering further concentrates in approximately 50\% of residual stream dimensions, retaining 85--98\% of the component-mechanism baseline, consistent with a privileged basis structure. Sparsity thus operates at two levels: which components are steered, and which dimensions within those components carry the signal. Together these findings show that refusal is not diffusely encoded across a transformer but assembled by a structured, identifiable mechanism, providing a foundation for mechanistic understanding of how refusal behaviors are represented and steered. To facilitate reproducibility, we release all code and raw experimental results in this https URL .

</details>


### [3] [Verdicts Without Annotated Evidence: Rejection Sampling or Label-Only Post-Training for Evidence Recovery?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06962)
*Nishanth Nayakanti,Prasang Gupta,Ashutosh Bilthare,Kevin Paul*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究在仅有判定标签（verdict）、无证据标注（evidence annotation）的情况下，通过后训练（post-training）让小语言模型恢复证据质量的方法。对比了两种仅使用判定标签的微调方法：标签专属 SFT（Label-only SFT）和拒采样 SFT（RSFT，融合了源定位打分选择）。在 ContractNLI 数据集上，两种方法均能在不接触人工证据标注的前提下提升证据引用质量，且两者在证据指标上接近，但在判定准确率上差距明显（label-only 0.896 vs RSFT 0.797）。研究强调判定准确率与证据质量是两个解耦的维度，不能仅凭准确率选择模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在许多实际审查工作流中，仅保留判定结论（verdict），而未标注支撑结论的证据段落，因为证据标注成本远高于结论记录。如何在仅有判定标签可用的情况下，通过后训练恢复模型的证据质量（即引用段落与人工证据的一致性及可验证性），是一个尚未被充分探索的实践问题。此外，研究指出判定准确率与证据质量在系统间存在解耦，这对模型选择具有实践意义。

Method: 本文对比两种仅使用判定标签的后训练方法：(1) Label-only SFT——直接用裸判定标签对 9B 学生模型（Qwen3.5-9B，QLoRA 4-bit）做监督微调；(2) RSFT——由学生模型和 31B 采样器（Gemma-4-31B）生成候选推理链，经判定匹配过滤后，用自动源定位打分（verbatim/normalized/partial 三级阶梯）选择最佳候选，再做微调。两者均不接触人工证据标注。评估在 ContractNLI 测试集（123 份合同，2,091 行）上进行，对比六个系统（两个商用模型、一个采样器、学生模型基线、两种微调后的学生），采用一致解码、锁定 prompt，分别衡量判定准确率与证据质量（span F1、verbatim rate）。同时引入先验校准、假设查表等控制实验。

Result: 在 ContractNLI 测试集上：判定准确率——多数类基线 0.463、假设查表 0.659、未训练学生 0.747、sonnet-4.6 0.771、31B 采样器 0.786、RSFT 0.797、gpt-5.2 0.808、label-only 0.896。证据质量（span F1）——未训练学生 0.493、sonnet-4.6 0.594、31B 采样器 0.625、gpt-5.2 0.493、RSFT 0.556、label-only 0.564。Verbatim 引用率从 0.597 提升至 RSFT 0.701、label-only 0.729。两种微调方法在证据 F1 上的差异（+0.009，CI [-0.011, +0.028]）不显著，但在判定准确率上 label-only 比 RSFT 高 +0.099。六系统间判定准确率与证据 F1 仅弱相关（Pearson +0.12），且排名不一致——gpt-5.2 准确率最高却与未训练学生在证据上并列垫底。先验校准控制仅恢复 RSFT 准确率增量的 37%，2 epoch RSFT 复现 1 epoch 结果，排除训练不足的解释。两种方法通过不同路径达到接近证据质量：label-only 通过提升 E/C 类判定正确率间接带动证据，RSFT 在 E/C 行上判定略降但通过更好的引用质量直接提升证据。

Conclusion: 研究得出三点主要结论：(1) 在仅有判定标签可用的记录中，证据质量可以通过后训练恢复，无需人工证据标注；(2) 判定准确率与证据质量是两个解耦的维度，仅凭准确率无法预测证据表现，需证据可审查的工作流应同时评估两者；(3) 简单的标签专属 SFT 与复杂的拒采样 RSFT 在单次单数据集实验中证据表现相当，RSFT 的额外机制（候选生成、源定位选择）未被证实为必要。但单 seed 单语料的限制下，两种方法孰优尚无定论，研究建议扩展至多 seed、多模型、多数据集，并测试偏好优化、语义证据度量等后续方向。

Abstract: In many review workflows the verdict is the only thing retained. The passages behind it are not marked, because that annotation costs far more than recording the decision. We measure how much of that evidence a small language model can recover when it is post-trained on the verdicts alone, with no human evidence labels at any stage. On ContractNLI the human evidence spans are held out until evaluation. Matching the recorded verdict and agreeing with those spans are not the same thing: across six systems the two scores are only weakly related and rank the systems differently, so accuracy is a poor guide when the citations have to be reviewable. Label-only training on the bare verdict reaches accuracy 0.896 and span F1 0.564. Rejection sampling, which keeps a generated trace only when its verdict matches the record and then picks one by an automatic source-grounding score, reaches 0.797 and 0.556, against 0.747 and 0.493 before training. Verbatim citation rises from 0.597 to 0.729 under label-only training and to 0.701 under rejection sampling. One seed on one corpus cannot say which method is better, but both improve the evidence without anyone annotating it.

</details>


### [4] [Investigating Model Compression for Neural Machine Translation in the Biomedical Domain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07032)
*Maria Zafar,Souhail Bakkali,Rejwanul Haque*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对法-英生物医学领域低资源机器翻译任务，研究知识蒸馏（KD）与量化（Quantization）协同压缩方案。实验表明，联合优化的蒸馏+量化学生模型体积减少69%，推理速度提升98.21%，CO2排放减少98.46%，同时翻译质量接近甚至超越教师模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模预训练Transformer模型虽在多语言翻译任务中取得SOTA，但翻译服务提供商（TSPs）面临部署成本高、专业领域（如生物医学）平行语料稀缺等挑战。知识蒸馏受限于领域平行数据不足而难以有效迁移，量化在低比特精度下易造成性能下降。本研究旨在为受限预算下的TSPs提供兼顾效率与质量的压缩方案。

Method: 采用MarianMT框架，以Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-tc-big-fr-en（Big Transformer, BT）为教师、Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-fr-en（Small Transformer, ST）为学生，在ELRC-EMEA OPUS生物医学Fr-En语料（~76万句对）上进行实验。流程包括：(1) 教师模型标准微调与量化（FP32→FP16，使用CTranslate2）；(2) 用量化后的教师模型生成软标签蒸馏数据；(3) 学生模型在纯蒸馏数据（DD）或蒸馏+原始数据（DDOP）上微调；(4) 对学生模型进行量化以进一步压缩。比较了QLoRA与标准微调策略。使用SacreBLEU、chrF++、COMET、BERTScore、BLEURT评估质量，并记录推理时间、模型体积与CodeCarbon工具测算的CO2排放。

Result: 最佳学生模型（蒸馏数据微调+量化）在EMEA测试集上取得BLEU 69.28、chrF++ 82.61、COMET 90.61、BLEURT 58.67，与最佳教师模型（BLEU 70.36）性能相当甚至略优。模型体积从基准BT的461MB降至142.9MB（-69%），推理速度从2983.88秒降至53.25秒（+98.21%），CO2排放从0.0392kg降至0.0006kg（-98.46%）。实验发现：(1) QLoRA微调教师未带来提升，未被采用；(2) 量化后教师生成的软标签质量更高且速度更快；(3) 蒸馏数据叠加原始数据（DDOP）反而损害性能；(4) 量化教师+蒸馏学生组合是最佳协同策略。

Conclusion: 知识蒸馏与量化的联合应用能够在不损失翻译质量的前提下，实现模型体积、推理速度与碳排放的显著优化。该策略为资源受限的在线翻译服务提供商提供了可持续的部署方案。未来工作将扩展至多语言与更低资源语言对，并探索引入剪枝与自适应量化技术以进一步提升效率。

Abstract: Large-scale pretrained transformer models have achieved state-of-the-art performance across diverse machine translation tasks, including multilingual settings. Knowledge distillation has emerged as a sustainable approach for model compression, transferring knowledge from large teacher models to smaller, more efficient student models. Similarly, quantization, which reduces the numerical precision of model weights and activations (e.g., from 32-bit to 8-bit representations) is widely used to accelerate inference, enabling models to run several times faster during deployment. However, both techniques face limitations when applied to specialized domain data, particularly under low-resource conditions. In knowledge distillation, the effectiveness of transfer is often constrained by the scarcity of domain-specific parallel data, while quantization can lead to performance degradation as bit precision decreases. In this work, we investigate the combined application of knowledge distillation and quantization for French-to-English biomedical translation, a domain characterized by specialized terminology and limited parallel resources. We develop and compare multiple fine-tuning strategies to adapt compressed student models to this challenging setting. Our experiments demonstrate that a collaboratively distilled and quantized student model achieves a 69% reduction in size, a 98.21% increase in inference speed, and a 98.46% reduction in CO2 emissions compared to the original baseline all without sacrificing translation quality. These results indicate that jointly optimized compression techniques can yield efficient, high-performance models suitable for translation service providers operating under resource constraints.

</details>


### [5] [CroissantMiner: Automated Extraction and Validation of Croissant Metadata for ML Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07132)
*Berke Arda,Ahmetcan Yavuz,Paul Gerry,Sebastian Lobentanzer,Nobin Sarwar,Joan Giner-Miguelez,Kongtao Chen,Luyao Zhang,Mrinmaya Sachan,Mubashara Akhtar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CroissantMiner提出首个面向ML数据集的Croissant 元数据(30字段,含RAI)端到端抽取基准(102篇人工金标+500篇LLM银标,共602篇),系统评估24套系统。核心发现:单次全上下文抽取一致优于四种智能体分解架构(Parallel Specialists、Triage+Critique、Locator-Extractor、ReAct);长篇RAI字段需跨节综合是最大难点;最佳系统Claude Sonnet 4.6单遍抽取综合得分仅0.709。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ML数据集文档碎片化、互操作性差,人工撰写Croissant元数据(已被NeurIPS 2026强制要求)不可扩展;Hugging Face等平台只能自动生成结构字段,上下文与RAI字段仍需从论文中人工抽取,亟需可扩展的自动化方案与系统级基准。

Method: 构建流程含四步:语料选取→LLM预填30字段→22名标注员对102篇金标论文按三档评分(Correct/Partially Correct/Not Correct)+失败模式标签→多数投票+资深作者裁决得金标。评估采用两层级评分:规则匹配(枚举字段exact-match、短文本3类字段token-F1)+LLM法官(GLM-5,经60+200单元人工审计选定,κ=0.663-0.708)评判20个RAI字段。比较5种架构(单次Pass+4种智能体)×多骨干模型(前沿与开源权重),并含PDF解析器消融、Qwen3规模缩放、鲁棒性检验。

Result: 1)最佳单遍系统Sonnet 4.6综合0.709、Opus 4.7 0.699、GPT-5.4 0.665;开源Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B 0.634、GLM-5.1 0.625具竞争力。2)在Sonnet 4.6骨干下,四种智能体均低于单次:ReAct 0.652、Parallel Specialists 0.647、Triage+Critique 0.624、Locator-Extractor 0.566(q<0.001);跨GPT-5.4/Gemini骨干结论一致。3)智能体在文档化RAI单元格上漏填率达10.9%-14.8%,为单次Pass(2.4%)的4-6倍;Locator-Extractor因仅看选取片段损失最大。4)智能体成本为单次的1.2-7.8×且准确率更低。5)长篇RAI字段(如rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis、rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol)需跨节综合,标注一致性最低、系统错误最大;长篇RAI得分差是核心因素。7)限制:102篇金标偏小、部分RAI字段支持数极少、仅英文、单一法官、金标源自Sonnet 4.5预填存在锚定偏差(已排除并重评验证)。

Conclusion: CroissantMiner确立Croissant元数据端到端抽取基准,揭示单次全上下文抽取在Schema完整抽取任务上一致优于任务分解式智能体架构,核心瓶颈在于跨节综合而非文档长度;最佳系统得分约0.71,长篇RAI字段仍是难点。建议作为auto-启发的作者审核工具,非完全自动化;明确留空(避免幻觉)是任务重要组成,模糊Schema定义(如publisher)需先在标准层面解决。开源代码、基准、法官审计、demo与排行榜。

Abstract: Croissant has emerged as a standard for machine-readable dataset metadata, yet populating its fields remains labor-intensive and requires careful reading of accompanying dataset documentation. We present the first benchmark enabling end-to-end evaluation of metadata extraction aligned with a community-standard schema. The benchmark comprises 602 papers, including 102 with human-validated gold annotations and 500 with LLM-generated silver annotations, covering the full Croissant schema with both core and Responsible AI (RAI) fields. Using this benchmark, we evaluate a range of extraction systems spanning frontier models, open-weight models, and agentic architectures, under a two-tier evaluation framework that combines rule-based scoring with an LLM judge selected via human audit. We find that single-pass extraction consistently outperforms the four agentic architectures we evaluate: across backbones, these decomposed variants achieve lower accuracy than a single full-context pass. The largest gap appears on long-form RAI fields, which require synthesizing and interpreting information scattered across a paper rather than copying it from a single location, a setting where current systems remain far from reliable. We release the benchmark, evaluation code, judge audit, a live demo, and a leaderboard open to new systems.

</details>


### [6] [TIDE 2.0: an open, model-agnostic engine for keyed de-identification of clinical notes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07224)
*Jose D. Posada,Somalee Datta,Priya Desai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TIDE 2.0是一个开源、模型无关的临床文本去标识化引擎，采用两阶段架构：可互换的识别器（recognizer）和基于密钥的匿名化器（anonymizer）。其核心创新在于检测到的PHI会被替换为真实但保留格式的代理值（surrogate），而非简单遮蔽或随机替换，从而保留日期间隔和跨笔记的患者关联。引擎在机构内部硬件上运行，密钥无需存储链接表，支持按研究/租户密钥隔离。在SHIELD和i2b2 2014两个金标语料上，默认配置（TIDE2-Sentry+regex）分别达到0.88和0.77的span级召回率，精度分别为0.88和0.87。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床去标识化研究主要将其视为检测问题，但仅检测存在三个根本缺陷：(1)遮蔽会删除PHI周围的临床内容；(2)日期空白化或粗化破坏了纵向分析所需的时间间隔；(3)每次出现使用新随机代理会破坏患者笔记间的关联性。此外，现有开源工具在识别器可替换性、内部署支持、跨笔记一致性代理生成方面存在不足，云服务则需将临床文本外传（需BAA协议）。TIDE 2.0旨在解决"检测≠去标识化"的根本问题，并提供完全本地化、可审计的解决方案。

Method: 系统采用两阶段分离架构：(1)识别器阶段支持多种模型（变换器token分类器、LLM、正则表达式、Aho-Corasick词典），通过Presidio兼容接口注册，输出PHI跨度缓存以便审查；(2)匿名化器阶段采用密码学构造：使用HMAC-SHA256派生每位患者日期偏移量（保留所有时间间隔），FF3格式保留加密（FPE）处理数字/字母标识符，按键确定性选择处理姓名/位置，无需存储链接表。识别器与匿名化器通过缓存的span表示通信，可在Ray分布式框架上运行。附带发布的TIDE2-Sentry是从Gemini 2.5 Flash蒸馏的DeBERTa-v3-large token分类器，使用约13,000条无标注笔记的银标准标签训练。检测评估在两个金标语料上进行（SHIELD的1,381篇Stanford笔记，i2b2 2014的1,304篇外机构笔记），跨度匹配采用IoU≥0.8的重叠标准，置信区间通过2,000次文档级bootstrap重采样获得。

Result: 检测性能：默认配置在SHIELD上微平均召回0.88/精度0.88，在i2b2 2014上为0.77/0.87；TIDE2-Sentry单独使用在SHIELD上微平均召回0.88/精度0.89。跨机构泛化：HOSPITAL召回下降0.39、PHONE下降0.29、ID下降0.26，这三类加上DATE共贡献89%的召回下降，原因可能是依赖本地词汇/格式。蒸馏保真度：学生模型在每个类别上都低于教师（WEB差距最大-0.15，DATE差距最小-0.04），但保留了LOCATION等弱类的模式。匿名化验证：在2,000个合成值的压力测试中，确定性、新密钥重映射、跨笔记一致性和日期间隔保留均达到100%；吞吐量在1块NVIDIA L4 GPU上SHIELD语料端到端1,573 tokens/秒，长笔记子集5,506 tokens/秒。外部开源PII标注器作为分布外探针表现较弱（微平均召回0.18-0.51），主要因缺乏患者/医生区分能力。AIMI v1/v2缺少AGE、LOCATION、WEB标签。

Conclusion: TIDE 2.0证明可交换识别器、密钥代理替换、间隔保留日期偏移和跨笔记一致性可在机构自有硬件上同时实现，解决了"检测≠去标识化"的根本问题。该工作贡献有三：(1)将检测与匿名化解耦的引擎架构；(2)TIDE2-Sentry蒸馏识别器；(3)评估协议的设计选择论证（召回率作为主要指标、per-category报告优于F1聚合）。局限性包括：未做下游表型分析或时序推理实验验证实用性；学生模型训练于银标准标签，教师系统误差未量化；未运行重识别/链接攻击；不提供差分隐私等正式隐私保证。引擎MIT许可发布，识别器在门控研究使用协议下发布，便于机构内部部署、检查和扩展。

Abstract: Clinical notes capture most of what is documented about a patient's care, but they cannot be used for research until protected health information (PHI) is removed. De-identification is often treated as a detection problem. Detection alone is not sufficient: redaction strips clinical content along with identifiers, date blanking destroys the temporal intervals needed for longitudinal analysis, and assigning a fresh random surrogate at each occurrence breaks links between a patient's notes. We present TIDE 2.0, an MIT-licensed engine with two separable stages: an interchangeable recognizer and a keyed anonymizer. Both run on hardware the institution owns. Surrogates are generated cryptographically with no stored linkage table. Dates shift by a per-patient, interval-preserving offset; each value receives the same surrogate across all occurrences under a given key; and a release produced under a new key cannot be linked to earlier releases. We also release TIDE2-Sentry, a recognizer distilled from a large language model. On two gold-annotated corpora from two institutions, the default configuration reached span-level recall of 0.88 in-domain and 0.77 on the second institution's corpus, at precision 0.88 and 0.87. We report recall and precision per category alongside these aggregates. The engine is open source, and the recognizer is available under a gated research-use agreement, so institutions can run, inspect and extend both within their own environments.

</details>


### [7] [Recurrent Looped Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07591)
*Yifan Zhang,Jichen Feng,Shihan Qin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出循环循环 Transformer (RLT)，将层分为并行因果编码器和循环解码器，通过门控融合将每个 token 的编码器输出与前一个 token 的最终解码器状态结合，使计算路径随序列长度增长而每个 token 成本固定。在六个算法任务上显著优于标准 Transformer 的长度泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 Transformer 对每个 token 应用固定深度，计算路径不随序列长度增长，在需要状态持续更新的算法任务（如奇偶校验、置换跟踪）中难以进行长度泛化。理论上，除非 TC⁰=NC¹，否则固定深度 Transformer 无法跟踪任意长度 S₅ 置换的复合。受电路复杂度理论启发，需引入循环结构使计算路径随序列延伸。

Method: RLT 将 8 层分为 L_E 层因果编码器和 L_D 层循环解码器。编码器并行处理已知 token 并构建全局 KV 记忆；解码器在每个位置通过门控融合 (gated merge) u_t = e_t + α·g_t⊙W_s·r_{t-1} 将编码器输出与前一个 token 的最终解码器状态 r_{t-1} 合并，然后通过滑动窗口注意力 (SWA) 与编码器前缀进行交叉注意力。处理 t 个 token 产生 t·L_D 的循环路径，但每个 token 仅通过 L_E+L_D 层。变体包括 RLT-1（每 token 反馈，B=1）、RLT-2（每 B 个 token 反馈）和 RLT-0（无反馈）。比较五种 8 层分配方式（1+7 到 7+1）与 8 层 Transformer 在六个任务（加法、奇偶校验、带/不带括号模运算、标准与基于交换的 S₅ 状态跟踪）上使用三个种子的表现。

Result: 训练长度最多 40 时，RLT 的 5+3 和 7+1 分割在 256 位奇偶校验上达到 100±0% 准确率（每个种子），而 Transformer 仅 50.07±1.63%；基于交换的 S₅ 在 256 操作（训练长度 8 倍）时，4+4 达 97.30±2.76%，Transformer 仅 0.85±0.30%；平坦 mod-5 表达式长度 63 时 6+2 达 93.36±5.69%，Transformer 仅 33.20±2.33%。奇偶校验最佳分割为 1-3 层解码器，S₅ 准确率随解码器深度增加（1 层接近随机，4 层达 97%）。无反馈时所有任务降至接近随机；4-token 分块使 64 位奇偶校验保持 98.99±1.66%，但 S₅ 从 100% 降至 19.60±6.54%。

Conclusion: RLT 通过将反馈贯穿整个解码器并复用编码器记忆，有效实现计算路径随序列长度增长，在长度泛化要求高的算法状态跟踪任务上显著优于固定深度 Transformer。深度分配是任务依赖的设计变量：奇偶校验偏好浅解码器，置换跟踪偏好深解码器。反馈机制至关重要，尤其是置换跟踪需要逐 token 反馈以维持跨 token 的复合信息。

Abstract: State tracking requires an update at every input, but the depth a Transformer applies to each token is fixed regardless of sequence length. We introduce the Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT), which splits its layers between a parallel causal encoder and a recurrent decoder. At each token, the decoder merges the encoder output with the previous token's final decoder state, so the computation path grows with sequence length at a fixed per-token cost. On six algorithmic tasks, we compare five splits of eight layers with an eight-layer Transformer over three seeds. Trained on at most 40 bits, two RLT splits generalize parity to 256 bits with 100% accuracy in every seed, while the Transformer stays at chance. On swap-based $S_5$ permutation tracking at eight times the training length, RLT reaches 97% final-state accuracy versus under 1% for the Transformer, and accuracy increases with decoder depth. On modular arithmetic beyond the training lengths, RLT reaches up to 93% versus 33% for the Transformer. Ablations show that these gains depend on the feedback: removing it drops parity and swap-based $S_5$ to chance at every split. Updating the feedback once per four-token chunk lets known tokens in a chunk run in parallel and keeps 64-bit parity at 99%, while permutation tracking depends on per-token feedback: chunking lowers length-64 swap-based $S_5$ from 100% to 20%.

</details>


### [8] [Monte Carlo Estimation for KV Cache Eviction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07643)
*Ahsan Bilal,Muhammad Ahmed Mohsin,Muhammad Umer,Wajih Hassan Raza,Atta Ul Asad,Young D. Kwon,Michal Valko,Dean F. Hougen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出LORE-KV，一种无需训练的KV缓存淘汰方法，通过蒙特卡洛采样短自回归续文来估计未来查询状态，并基于投影的留一注意力输出删除代价对提示词令牌进行打分与可靠性加权聚合，以解决现有方法中提示端查询与实际解码查询不匹配的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KV缓存淘汰方法大多基于提示端注意力分数评估令牌重要性，但这些分数在解码阶段可能并不能准确反映令牌的实际价值（即"查询参考不匹配"问题）。先前的前瞻方法依赖伪响应或合成查询估计，缺乏对多种合理未来函数的概率性建模，且未结合输出感知的删除代价评估。

Method: LORE-KV包含三阶段流程：(1)从冻结目标模型采样M条短自回归续文作为未来查询轨迹；(2)通过集中典型性、预测熵和查询空间分歧度对轨迹进行软可靠性加权；(3)基于投影留一删除代价（考虑注意力权重和值向量在残差流中的投影偏差）计算每个候选令牌的效用分数，统一预算分配后保留Top-B令牌。前瞻续文在压缩完成后丢弃，不修改模型权重或解码过程。

Result: 在B=128的激进压缩下，LORE-KV/E在Mistral-7B上LongBench平均分从38.96（AnDPro）提升至40.28；在Qwen2.5-14B上从45.49提升至48.24（+2.75）；在Mistral-7B的16K RULER上从45.20提升至51.05（+5.85）。在六个密集和混合注意力骨干网络上均优于先前基线，增益随缓存预算增大而递减。单条响应侧续文即可恢复约89%的增益；M在4左右饱和。代价为AnDPro的1.46-2.77倍壁钟时间（一次性压缩开销）。

Conclusion: 未来感知缓存淘汰的核心增益来源于修正查询参考不匹配，而非删除目标函数或聚合启发式。LORE-KV将固定预算淘汰重新构建为合理模型条件查询轨迹上的分布式估计问题，为面向未来解码需求的推理时记忆系统提供了新视角。未来方向包括自适应前瞻、可恢复缓存以及基于提示-未来失配代理的动态跳过机制。

Abstract: Most KV-cache eviction methods ask, in effect, which memory appeared important while reading the prompt? We instead ask, which memory will matter while answering? Since decoding queries are unavailable at eviction time, prior future-aware methods rely on pseudo-responses or synthetic future-query estimates. We cast fixed-budget future-aware eviction as distributional estimation over plausible model-conditional query trajectories and introduce LORE-KV (Lookahead Output-perturbation with Reliability-weighted Ensembles for Key-Value caches), a training-free method that samples short autoregressive continuations from the frozen target model and uses their response-side query states to estimate prompt-token utility. Tokens are scored by projected leave-one-out attention-output deletion cost and aggregated across sampled futures with optional trajectory weighting. The temporary continuations are discarded before final decoding, requiring no auxiliary model or training. Ablations isolate the mechanism: at B=128, a single response-side continuation recovers about 89% of the gain over the prompt-window control, while additional futures provide smaller improvements. At B=128, LORE-KV raises the LongBench average on Qwen2.5-14B from 45.49 to 48.24 (+2.75) and the 16K RULER average on Mistral-7B from 45.20 to 51.05 (+5.85). Gains diminish at larger cache budgets and coexist with task-level regressions. LORE-KV incurs 1.46-2.77x AnDPro's per-sample wall-clock time as a one-time compression overhead across six dense and hybrid-attention backbones.

</details>


### [9] [SanSi: A Looped Typed Decision Model for System 1.5 Thinking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07730)
*Shuyu Gan,Young-Jun Lee,Dongyeop Kang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SanSi，一种循环式类型化决策模型，通过递归应用相同的Transformer层（"思考三思"）在单次前向传递中为每个声明选项返回概率，以实现"系统1.5"思维。在10,027个跨6类任务的测试决策上，SanSi-1.4B（8次循环）达到72.0%准确率，比相同架构的单次遍历模型高13.5个百分点，比参数三倍的单次模型仅低1.7个百分点。循环还能将模型可解推理深度延伸到训练之外，并以作为GRPO训练中的奖励信号提升生成器F1值7.7点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的类型化决策模型在单次前向传递中为所有决策分配固定算力，对需要多步推理的复杂决策（如追踪关系链）能力不足。而生成的链式推理虽然能处理复杂任务，但破坏类型化合约、增加延迟。需要探索介于单次快速系统1和生成式推理系统2之间的"系统1.5"思维模式。

Method: SanSi基于预训练为可循环的语言模型Ouro（其24层Transformer块被递归应用）。每个循环后读取决策，并使用交叉熵+Brier分数之和作为每个循环的适当评分规则进行训练。输入提示列出选项，决策头从每个循环后的最终隐藏状态读取，仅训练LoRA适配器（rank 64）和小型读出器（总共61M参数）。一个模型可服务于1至8次循环的任何预算。在奖励学习用例中，SanSi的概率充当GRPO训练2WikiMultiHopQA生成器的唯一奖励信号。

Result: SanSi-1.4B在10,027个测试决策上达到72.0%准确率，比同形状SmolLM2-1.7B单次模型（58.4%）高13.5个百分点，比Qwen3.5-2B（66.7%）高5.3个百分点，仅比参数三倍的Qwen3.5-4B（73.8%）低1.8个百分点。三个循环贡献循环1到8间88%的增益。在两个深度受控任务（说谎链、对象交换）上，循环将可解深度扩展到训练深度（k≤8）之外，达到k=11（说谎链）和k=9（对象交换），而Qwen3.5-4B在k>8时退化至随机水平。作为GRPO奖励，SanSi（8次循环）将生成器的F1从39.5提升至47.3（+7.7点）。证据AUROC从0.835提升至0.935，表明循环有助于检测缺失证据。

Conclusion: 循环使小型类型化决策模型能够通过增加算力而非参数来处理复杂决策。在相同数据和训练方案下，循环式1.4B模型比同形状非循环模型准确率高13.5个百分点，比三倍参数的单次模型仅落后1.8个百分点。循环还通过扩展可解推理深度到训练之外（单次遍历的三倍参数模型在此失败），购买推理深度。三个循环提供大部分增益，更难项目需要更多循环。作为唯一的奖励信号，SanSi有助于基于GRPO的生成器训练。然而校准仅改善至第3次循环，且超出训练循环数的循环会降低准确率。这些效果依赖于预训练为可循环的骨干网络。

Abstract: Typed decision models answer a declared question without generating text: a decision head returns a probability for each of the declared options in a single forward pass. A single pass is fast, intuitive System 1 thinking. We study what lies between one pass and generated reasoning: looping, in which the same layers are recursively applied several times before one typed readout. Each loop lets the model revise its hidden state before it commits to an answer, without generating a token; we call this System 1.5 thinking. We propose SanSi, which turns a pre-trained looped language model into a typed decision model. The option probabilities are read after every loop, and every loop is trained with a proper scoring rule, so that one model serves every budget from one loop to eight in a single run. On 10,027 test decisions from 59 sources, SanSi reaches 72.0% accuracy: 13.5 points above a non-looped model of the same shape trained with the same recipe, 5.3 points above a newer non-looped model of its size, and 1.8 points below one with three times the parameters. On two depth-controlled tasks, loops extend the solvable depth beyond the depths seen in training, where the larger single-pass model fails. Used as the judge for policy optimization with reinforcement learning, without gold answers, SanSi raises the generator's F1 by 7.7 points.

</details>


### [10] [From Evidence to Action: How Tool-Using Agents Fail](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07753)
*Hongzhan Lin,Shidong Cao,Ziyang Luo,Wenhao Chai,Mong-Li Lee,Wynne Hsu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出SafeActBench基准，将工具使用代理的评估从端点正确性转向证据到动作的可观测链条，揭示静态判断能力强但交互执行能力弱的普遍现象，并系统定位失败源于调查不完整、过早行动、多步依赖处理不当等环节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代理评估多关注任务是否完成（端点正确性），但忽视了产生该结果前是否已建立必要的证据支撑。对于会改变外部状态的后果性动作，正确的最终结果不能保证行动前已具备充分证据，特别是当后续动作依赖前期结果时，问题尤为严重。

Method: 构建SafeActBench基准（656案例，6个领域，5个协议：Legacy静态判断、V0调查性非动作、V1单动作、V2线性多动作、V3 DAG约束多动作）；设计带有溯源绑定的Evidence Ledger跟踪证据建立与来源；采用确定性轨迹评估器（无需LLM评判器）验证调查完整性、工具/目标/参数正确性、执行回执、动作依赖与状态变更；实验覆盖10个模型-框架配置（5个模型家族各搭配家族专属框架与Inspect ReAct框架）；进行控制性证据干预（Withheld/Contradicted）与机制探针（evidence-package、requester-claim、urgency、warning、distractors）。

Result: 1) 强静态评估与弱交互执行并存：GLM-ZCode在Legacy达97.7%，但V1-V3仅12.1%-34.1%；2) 失败多在执行前发生：BSR在V0达21.7%-62.9%，PAR在V1达37.0%-66.9%；3) 一旦证据建立，单动作执行通常可靠（CAS九配置在93.2%-100%）；4) 多步工作流暴露未解析前置条件与执行不完整；5) 框架效应显著且因模型而异（DeepSeek在DSH下提升4.4点，GLM在Inspect下优于ZCode 6.8点）；6) 干预表明代理对缺失证据的敏感度低于对请求者反向声明的反应；7) 附加SCGR-EG结构化证据收集可提升多步执行（GLM-ZCode ECS从37.7%升至53.9%）。

Conclusion: 工具使用代理的失败不仅源于信息缺失，更源于代理如何使用已建立的证据进行决策与执行；评估必须从端点正确性转向可观测的证据到动作链条检查；静态判断能力无法预测交互执行能力；通过结构化证据采集可在一定程度上改善多步工作流表现，但效果因模型、框架与协议而异。

Abstract: Tool-using agents make consequential changes to external state, yet correct outcomes do not guarantee that their actions were supported by evidence established beforehand. We study where this evidence-to-action chain breaks as agents move from deciding whether to act to executing single actions and dependent workflows. Across ten model-harness configurations, strong static action assessment can coexist with much weaker interactive execution. Failures often begin before execution: agents stop with incomplete investigation or act before required evidence is established. Once required evidence is obtained, single-action execution is usually reliable, while multi-action workflows additionally expose unresolved prerequisites and incomplete execution. For this analysis, we introduce SafeActBench, comprising 656 cases across six operational domains and five protocols that progress from static action judgment and investigated non-action to single- and multi-action workflows. A provenance-bound Evidence Ledger and deterministic trajectory evaluator track what information was established, when actions occurred, and whether downstream dependencies were satisfied. These results show that failures arise not only from missing information, but also from how agents use established evidence when deciding and executing actions.

### [11] [No Transformer Beats Six Covariates: Long-Horizon Prediction of Depressive Symptoms from Childhood Essays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07764)
*Daniel Kua,Emrul Hasan,John-Jose Nunez,Frances Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究能否利用儿童时期的作文（11岁时所写）来预测23岁时的抑郁风险，基于英国国家儿童发展研究（NCDS）队列数据。结果表明：仅使用6个童年期协变量的逻辑回归基线模型（AUC=0.737）在长达12年的预测中优于所有文本模型，包括7个微调Transformer、TF-IDF、冻结嵌入和4个零样本LLM；任何文本得分都不能明显提升基线模型的AUC；领域预训练Transformer在统计上也未明显优于通用领域对照模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的心理健康NLP研究大多预测与文本撰写时间接近的结局（即"近期"预测），而早期干预需要更前瞻的"远期"预测——即在症状出现前从童年文本预测远期抑郁风险。已有研究（如Boehm et al., 2024）发现手工编码的作文幸福感评分与远期抑郁症状相关，但手工编码难以规模化，因此需要测试能否用预训练Transformer从童年文本做出远期预测。这是NLP在远期预测中尚缺乏充分检验的问题。

模型设置：
1. **基线**：对6个标准化童年协变量（性别、父亲社会阶层、父母精神病史、认知能力、内化行为评分、外化行为评分）进行L2正则化逻辑回归。
2. **微调Transformer**（7个）：通用领域（BERT-base、RoBERTa-base）、领域特定（ClinicalBERT、BioBERT、MentalBERT、MentalRoBERTa）、跨条件（StressRoBERTa）。
3. **非神经网络**：TF-IDF + 逻辑回归、冻结BERT嵌入 + 逻辑回归、冻结BGE嵌入 + 逻辑回归。
4. **零样本LLM**（4个）：Qwen2.5-7B/32B-Instruct、Gemma-2-9B-it、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，用精心设计的提示对作文在乐观、积极情感、目标感、社会联系4个维度上1-5分评分。
5. **任务自适应预训练（TAP）**：在非测试作文上对7个编码器进行MLM继续预训练。

评估方法：主指标为AUC-ROC，采用配对检验（DeLong检验）、Bonferroni校正、2000次分层bootstrap置信区间、calibration-belt检验、交叉拟合（避免泄漏）。

Result: **RQ1**：基线模型AUC=0.737，胜过所有文本模型（最佳Transformer为0.697）。在配对DeLong检验中，基线领先全部7个Transformer（5个经Bonferroni校正后仍显著），TF-IDF、冻结嵌入、零样本LLM均不及基线。

**RQ2**：将任何文本得分（经交叉拟合训练或零样本）加入基线时，ΔAUC的置信区间均包含0。仅Qwen2.5-32B的似然比检验勉强显著（p=0.04），但未通过Bonferroni校正（阈值0.05/4）。

**RQ3**：5个领域预训练Transformer与其通用领域对照模型相比，无一在Bonferroni校正后明显胜出；所有5个种子集成置信区间均包含0。

**稳健性**：在5个新分割上重测，基线均领先BERT-base；任务自适应预训练略有提升AUC但无一通过校正；调整学习率、扩大模型规模（Qwen2.5-32B、DeBERTa-v3-large、RoBERTa-large）均不能明显缩小差距。

**协变量分解**：文本得分主要由其协变量拟合部分驱动（"协变量拟合"部分AUC高于整个得分），残差接近随机水平。说明文本得分主要复制了协变量所含信息，对结局无明显独立贡献。

**并发对照**：BERT-base和MentalBERT能高准确度恢复作文中的性别（0.991）和认知能力（0.864），说明编码器"能读懂"这些作文，其落后源于对行为相关语言预测能力较弱。

Conclusion: 在NCDS跨越12年的远期预测中：
1. 没有任何文本模型能匹配仅含6个变量的简单逻辑回归基线；
2. 没有文本得分能明显提升基线的AUC；
3. 没有领域预训练Transformer能明显胜过通用领域对照模型（Bonferroni校正后）。

因此，在远期预测场景下，简单协变量基线仍是难以超越的标杆。研究强调：评估文本模型时，应报告其在协变量基线之上的增量价值，而非仅报告独立AUC。此外基线对女性预测能力较弱（分配性伤害），不应未经治理即部署。作者建议未来研究可探索更多儿童文本或专门诱发痛苦相关语言的提示。

Abstract: Natural language processing (NLP) models can detect depression-related language in text written near the time symptoms are measured, but whether pretrained transformers can predict depressive symptoms from text written twelve years earlier is largely untested. In the National Child Development Study, a British birth cohort, we predict probable depressive symptoms at age 23 from essays the same people wrote at age 11. Our baseline, a logistic regression on six childhood covariates, outperforms every text model that sees only the essay: seven fine-tuned transformers, a bag-of-words model, frozen embeddings and four zero-shot large language models. Its area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) is 0.737 against 0.670 for the best transformer on the primary seed, and no added text score detectably raises the baseline's AUC-ROC. None of the five domain-pretrained transformers detectably beats its general-domain control after Bonferroni correction. For long-horizon prediction, the baseline remains the model to beat.

*Hans Schabert,Christoph Peters*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出SOP-MCP方法，通过MCP协议逐条交付标准操作规程(SOP)指令，牺牲LLM自主性以换取流程可预测性。在SOP-Bench上对4款开源模型、13个领域、15,475次试验的评估表明：流程依从性从76-95%提升至95-99%，无依据答案率从2.1-4.5%降至0.2-0.3%；轻量级执行器获得+6.5pp的grounded accuracy增益，而能力较强的执行器以小幅raw accuracy下降换取完全流程可见性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在将LLM代理部署到受监管的运营流程时，组织不仅需要正确答案，还需要预测执行过程、追踪实际运行的步骤并逐步审查。当SOP嵌入系统提示、由代理自主执行时，可预测性丧失：同一SOP下轻量级模型平均产生20种不同的工具调用序列，甚至会出现"幻觉过程执行"——跳过规定工具直接给出正确答案（KYC风格领域中31-49%的正确答案，包括48%的前沿模型答案，完全绕过了SOP）。这构成了受监管环境下的部署障碍。

Method: 核心方法是通过Model Context Protocol (MCP)以逐步方式外部化SOP流程控制：服务器通过run_sop工具一次释放一条指令，模型执行该步骤并返回结构化step_output，服务器仅在模型报告完成后才推进。这是一种"自上而下的分解"（advisory→enforced），将模型自主性限制在当前步骤，无法预读后续或自我修正。研究设计：比较两种SOP交付条件（rfc2119_sop系统提示 vs sop_mcp逐步MCP），跨13个SOP-Bench领域、4款开源执行器（Ministral 3 8B轻量、DeepSeek V3.2和GLM 5大模型、Kimi K2.5前沿），共15,475次试验。引入三项指标：(1) Grounded TSR——以流程依从性（pa_coverage≥0.5）为条件的准确率；(2) 流程依从性；(3) 路径一致性（主导工具调用序列占比）。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 流程依从性：所有四个模型显著提升，从76-95%提升至95-99%；(2) 无依据答案：所有模型的率从2.1-4.5%降至0.2-0.3%（95%CI均排除零），know_your_business领域中无依据占正确比从31-49%降至0-8%；(3) 路径一致性：能力较强模型的执行路径向主导路径收敛，DeepSeek和GLM 5显著（+13.7pp和+7.0pp）；(4) Grounded accuracy呈能力依赖性：Ministral 3 8B获得+6.5pp（[+3.4,+9.6]）显著增益（从61.0%到67.5%），而GLM 5下降-2.9pp（[-5.2,-0.5]），Kimi下降-1.7pp（n.s.），DeepSeek持平+0.4pp（n.s.）。Raw TSR方面，能力较强模型显著下降（GLM 5 -4.7pp、Kimi -3.8pp、DeepSeek -2.5pp）——这些是shortcut答案被剔除而非替换。Ministral的增益主要源于依从性提升（76%→95%），在依从试验中的准确率反而下降-9.1pp（重新分类效应）。领域层面：顺序SOP领域增益最大（traffic_spoofing_detection +39.8pp、patient_intake +13.3pp），分支决策树领域损失最大（video_classification -21.6pp，因为步骤级自主性阻止前瞻）。经济性：MCP条件带来2.1-2.9×的成本和延迟税，但Ministral在MCP下$0.010/试验、17秒，仍比Kimi便宜约4.3×。案例研究：customer_service领域的MCP惩罚-14pp通过步骤追踪定位到SOP缺陷，AI优化器60秒内重新排序决策树修复问题。

Abstract: Organizations automating operational processes need more than a correct outcome: they need to predict how a process will run, know which one actually ran, and inspect it step by step. When an agent is the executor that predictability is normally lost: the prescribed procedure goes into the system prompt, and only a final answer comes back. We deliver the procedure step by step over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) instead: a server releases one step at a time, the agent executes it, and each step returns a structured step_output. This trades autonomy for predictability, and two properties then follow by construction, independent of the executor. The execution path is prescribed before the run, so the process is predictable in advance rather than reconstructed afterwards; and the completed step records form a machine-readable execution log that downstream tooling can audit and optimize step by step. Evaluating 15,475 trials across 13 SOP-Bench domains and four open-weight executors from frontier (Kimi K2.5) to lightweight (Ministral 3 8B), we find step-level delivery makes the executed process predictable and inspectable for every executor, and additionally raises accuracy when the executor is small. Across all four, process adherence rises significantly (76-95% to 95-99%) and ungrounded answers (correct outputs produced without executing the SOP) near-vanish, falling from 2.1-4.5% to 0.2-0.3% of trials (all 95% CIs exclude zero); under prompt-based delivery, 31-49% of correct answers on know_your_business bypass the SOP entirely, even for the frontier executor. Accuracy is where the executor's capability enters: the lightweight executor gains +6.5pp grounded accuracy because supplying the process externally removes a reconstruction burden it cannot carry, while capable ones trade a small raw-accuracy decrement for a predictable, auditable process.

</details>


### [13] [Dynamic Positional Attention Modulation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07848)
*Dayan Pan,Jingyuan Wang,Xie Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 DyPAM（Dynamic Positional Attention Modulation），一种针对 RoPE-based 大语言模型的参数高效微调（PEFT）方法。它通过直接调制查询（Q）和键（K）表示，结合维度级输入条件调制与头级、层级结构调制，实现与 RoPE 位置结构对齐的细粒度位置注意力适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 PEFT 方法（如 LoRA、IA³、OFT、Bone 等）在层、头、维度、token 上施加均匀静态的适配，未能考虑注意力机制的固有异构性。RoPE 引入维度依赖的位置结构，使得不同注意力维度、头、层对位置信息贡献不同，均匀适配是次优的。因此需要一种能区分维度、头、层，并保持输入条件性的细粒度 PEFT 方法。

Method: DyPAM 在 RoPE 之前直接对 Q、K 表示进行乘法调制。其核心包括：(1) 通过隐藏状态生成调制特征（低秩投影 H·A·B）；(2) 输入条件、维度级调制——使用维度嵌入矩阵将调制特征映射到 RoPE 维度对空间，对 RoPE 配对的两个维度共享同一调制因子；(3) 头级与层级结构偏置——为每个头和层添加与输入无关的结构偏置；(4) 通过 sigmoid 函数将调制得分归一化为有界调制因子 s ∈ [1-α/2, 1+α/2]，在保持预训练结构的前提下进行稳定适配。

Result: 在 LLaMA 3.2 3B、Qwen3 8B、Gemma 3 4B 三种 RoPE-based 模型上，DyPAM 在数学推理（MultiArith、GSM8K、AddSub、AQuA、SingleEq、SVAMP、MAWPS）和常识推理（BoolQ、PIQA、SocialIQA、ARC-C/E、OBQA、HellaSwag、WinoGrande）基准上均一致优于 LoRA、AdaLoRA、OFT、Bone、IA³、LN-Tuning、FourierFT、SHiRA、RoSA 等强基线。Qwen3 系列 0.6B 至 8B 的扩展性实验表明 DyPAM 随模型增大持续保持优势。消融实验验证了各组件的互补贡献，超参数 α 的敏感性分析显示适度调制效果最佳。DyPAM 额外 FLOPs 开销仅约 1.03%，低于未合并的 LoRA（1.13%）。

Conclusion: DyPAM 提出了一种原则性的 PEFT 方案，通过细粒度、输入条件、与 RoPE 结构对齐的位置注意力调制来适配 LLM。该方法在不修改预训练骨干的前提下，有效建模了注意力在维度、头、层、token 上的异构性，在多类推理任务上取得了稳定增益。未来工作将优化运行时实现并扩展至更多架构机制。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has become a standard approach for adapting large language models to downstream tasks. However, most existing PEFT methods rely on uniform and static adaptations, without accounting for the structured heterogeneity of attention across dimensions, heads, layers, and input tokens. In practice, attention representations exhibit non-uniform behavior, and positional encoding mechanisms such as rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) induce dimension-dependent positional structure, making uniform adaptation suboptimal. In this work, we propose DyPAM (Dynamic Positional Attention Modulation), a PEFT method that adapts how positional information contributes to attention by operating directly on the query and key representations. DyPAM combines input-conditioned, dimension-wise modulation with head-wise and layer-wise structural modulation, performing fine-grained adaptation of positional attention aligned with the RoPE-induced structure without modifying the pretrained backbone. Extensive experiments on mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks across multiple backbone models demonstrate that DyPAM consistently outperforms existing strong PEFT baselines.

</details>


### [14] [ReFold: Training-Free Reversible Inter-Turn Context Folding for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07863)
*Yupeng Su,Jiayi Tian,Zheng Zhang,Souvik Kundu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ReFold是一个无需训练的渲染层，通过去重和折叠两个轻量级操作符压缩长程LLM智能体的渲染上下文，同时保留可恢复的完整交互历史。它使用块状渲染保持前缀缓存复用，所有移除操作都可逆。在五个长基准测试中，ReFold将token消耗减少最高2.5倍，KV缓存减半，并显著提升并发服务效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程LLM智能体在每次推理时需重发整个append-only交互历史，导致上下文随步数二次增长。现有上下文管理方法（位置驱逐、内容剪枝、外部存储、摘要）依赖辅助预测器，带来运行时开销、破坏前缀缓存复用、且不可逆地丢弃内容。这些方法无法在压缩上下文的同时保证系统效率和信息可恢复性。

Method: ReFold在渲染层引入两个操作符：(1)去重——将重复的工具输出替换为指向首次出现位置的存根；(2)折叠——将智能体标记为已完成的轮次压缩为单行注释，包含progress元数据。两者通过提示让智能体在每步输出中声明stale步骤索引，无需额外模型调用。块状渲染机制每k=3步才重写缓存前缀，保持append-only特性以维持前缀缓存复用率（87%）。所有移除操作可逆——智能体可通过restore命令从历史恢复内容，或重新执行原始命令。

Result: 在5个长程基准（SWE-bench Verified/Pro、Multi-SWE-bench、Terminal-Bench 1.0/2.1）和两个模型（Qwen3.6-27B密集型与Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE）上：完整256k窗口下token减少18-60%，成本降低最高45%，KV缓存峰值减少30-58%，任务完成率不变。在受限上下文预算下（如32k），强制压缩减少92%。在并发服务负载（w=64）下，队列延迟从42.2s降至23.1s，完成任务数从18增至39/71。渲染开销仅0.4ms/步，远低于compact的3.3s。

Conclusion: ReFold证明无需训练的渲染层即可有效管理长程智能体上下文，其去重+折叠操作符、块状渲染和可逆性设计在不牺牲任务性能的前提下显著降低token、内存和延迟成本，且与compact、检索记忆等其他机制正交可组合，为生产级长程智能体部署提供了高效的上下文管理方案。

Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents act on an append-only interaction history that is re-sent to the model at every step, so the context and its cost grow with steps until the sessions exceed the context window. Existing methods manage the context through context requirement prediction, relying on additional model calls, heuristic rules, or trained policies. However, these predictive approaches introduce runtime overhead, invalidate prefix caches, and permanently discard content with no guarantee of recovery. To overcome these limitations, we introduce ReFold: a training-free rendering layer that preserves the underlying interaction history while compressing only the model's rendered context. It removes two kinds of inter-turn redundancy without an auxiliary predictor: content an earlier turn already displayed, replaced by a stub, and turns the agent itself reports finished, folded into a one-line note. Both operators use chunked rendering, rewriting the cached prefix once every few steps rather than at every step. Every removal is strictly reversible, a wrong removal costs one restore from the history rather than permanent content loss. Because it operates at the rendering layer, ReFold is plug-and-play across standard ReAct-style harnesses. Evaluations across five long-horizon benchmarks and two frontier LLMs demonstrate that ReFold reduces token consumption by up to 2.5x and halves the KV-cache memory per session without degrading task success rates. Under capped context budgets, it avoids up to 92% of forced compactions. Under concurrent serving workloads, it reduces request queuing delays by up to 100%, accelerating inference by up to 1.7x, while cutting inference costs by up to 3.4x.

</details>

*Chufan Shi,Cheng Yang,Tiannuo Yang,Isadora White,Yiwei Chen,Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick,Xuezhe Ma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文针对统一多模态模型（UMMs）在面对不可行的视觉编辑请求时缺乏拒绝能力的问题，提出"视觉弃权"概念，构建了包含1050对可行-不可行请求对的Draw-or-Decline基准，并提出VisTA训练方法，使VisTA-BAGEL在无需提示的情况下拒绝93.0%的不可行请求，同时保持74.3%的编辑准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一多模态模型虽然能理解和生成，但其生成行为很少受其对任务理解所约束。当请求的视觉变换在任务规则下不可能时，模型应识别无解并拒绝生成，而非输出看似有效但违反规则的图像。现有评测缺乏对这种"可行性判断引导生成行为"能力的系统评估。

Result: 1. 8个UMM在无提示时几乎不拒绝不可行请求（最高仅1.7%），最强编辑器UniREdit-BAGEL编辑准确率68.4%但仅拒绝0.4%不可行请求。2. 案例研究揭示三种失败模式：Acknowledge then Comply（3.2%）、Premise Rewriting（前提改写，如SenseNova-U1.0占52.5%）、Premise Acceptance（前提接受，描述不存在对象）。3. 添加显式提示可提升拒绝率（如ThinkMorph达57.5%），但编辑准确率下降，且带来高误拒率（ThinkMorph误拒35.6%可行请求）。4. 解耦管线（VLM+编辑模型）虽更频繁识别不可行，但编辑性能下降。5. VisTA-BAGEL在无提示情况下拒绝93.0%不可行请求，误拒仅0.8%可行请求，编辑准确率达74.3%（超越所有8个UMM）。6. 推理质量重要：无推理消融使拒绝率降至80.1%。7. 弃权能力可迁移至未见类别（迷宫94.0%）。

Conclusion: 视觉弃权是不同于编辑能力的独立能力。VisTA通过配对监督训练，使模型在保持高编辑准确率的同时可靠地拒绝不可行请求，无需任何推理时提示。这表明统一的可行性判断机制是构建可信多模态系统的关键。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) integrate understanding and generation, yet their generative behavior is rarely governed by what they understand about the task. We formalize visual abstention: when a requested visual transformation is impossible under the task's rules, the model should recognize that no valid solution exists, state this, and decline to generate. We introduce Draw-or-Decline (DoD), a benchmark of 1,050 feasible-infeasible request pairs across 7 task categories that jointly measures editing success and the refusal of infeasible requests. Evaluating 8 UMMs, we find that editing ability and abstention are distinct capabilities: even the strongest editor, at 68.4% editing accuracy, refuses only 0.4% of infeasible requests under ordinary instructions. Their reasoning shows why: the models rarely notice the conflict, and instead plan the edit as if the request were possible, often describing objects that are not in the image, or quietly change the request into one they can complete. Explicitly prompting these UMMs to report infeasibility increases textual refusals but reduces editing accuracy. We propose VisTA (Visual Transformation and Abstention), a training method that pairs feasible and infeasible examples so that a model judges feasibility before deciding whether to generate. We train VisTA-BAGEL to perform feasible edits and decline infeasible requests. Without any reminder, it refuses 93.0% of infeasible requests, up from 0.4% for the strongest editor, while falsely refusing only 0.8% of feasible ones. Unlike a reminder, this does not cost editing accuracy: VisTA-BAGEL completes 74.3% of feasible edits, more than any of the 8 evaluated UMMs.

</details>


### [16] [Hybrid Latent Attention for Looped Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07940)
*Yuhan Chen,Siyuan Zhang,Nan Wang,Feiyang Kang,Ruoxi Jia*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出混合潜在注意力(HLA)以解决循环语言模型(looped LM)因多次循环(T次)导致的KV缓存过大的问题。HLA为每个旧token存储紧凑的潜在表示(各loop直接读取而不重建KV),并保留最近W个token的精确KV。在Ours-1.4B和Ours-2.6B(T=4)上,HLA将每token缓存缩小10.7倍,使GPU可容纳4.0-8.8倍的并发序列,峰值解码吞吐量提升2.5-7.4倍,同时在数学、知识、推理基准上保留超过97%的原精度,16K长上下文检索上保留96-100%。微调后与原模型在竞赛级数学上表现相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环语言模型(如Ouro)通过重复应用同一层堆叠T次来加深模型而不增加参数量,但代价是KV缓存扩大T倍。在16K上下文下,一块80GB A100 GPU仅能同时解码5个Ouro-1.4B序列,严重限制了吞吐量。已有方案存在明显问题:单loop共享(只保留最后一loop的KV)严重损害精度(Ouro-1.4B在RULER 16K上仅19%);循环潜在注意力(LLA)虽然精度较好,但每步需重建各loop的KV,吞吐仅为全缓存的7-18%。因此需要一种既能大幅缩小缓存,又能保持高精度且不重建KV的方法。

Method: HLA包含三个核心组件:(1)潜在写入器:为每token每层写两个latent,主latent是loops 2-T隐藏状态的线性映射,较小的loop-1 latent是第1循环隐藏状态的线性映射(因loop 1的KV最难从最终隐藏状态预测);(2)潜在读取器:每个loop用查询映射A_t将query投影到latent key空间并直接对存储的latent打分,再用输出映射B_t将加权和映射回head维度,全程不重建任何loop的KV;键latent组织成对并与RoPE频率对齐,通过旋转整个latent保持位置信息;(3)精确滑动窗口:保留最近W=128个token的精确KV,latent与精确注意力共享单一softmax。同时提出uptraining(冻结预训练权重,仅训练新映射,1200步)和两遍微调(第一遍用精确注意力并写入latent,第二遍按解码规则并行处理)两种训练策略。

Result: 在Ouro-1.4B和Ouro-2.6B(T=4)上:HLA将每token缓存从768/1536 KiB缩小至72/144 KiB(10.7×压缩);单GPU并发序列数提升4.0-8.8×;峰值解码吞吐量在1K上下文提升2.5×,在16K上下文最高提升7.4×;单序列延迟在1K时比全缓存慢26%,在4K时持平,在16K时快2倍。精度方面:冻结权重下,MATH500、MLU-Pro、BBH保留97.5-99.6%原精度;RULER长上下文检索(4K-16K)保留96-100%。微调后在AIME/HMMT竞赛数学上与原模型持平或略优(16.4% vs 16.2%, 28.0% vs 27.2%)。LLA精度相当或略低,但吞吐比HLA低28-59×;单loop共享精度损失巨大。消融显示无窗口版本MATH500掉8.1点,RULER 16K掉11.5点,验证了精确窗口的必要性。

Conclusion: HLA证明循环语言模型中各loop可以直接读取紧凑的latent表示而无须重建KV,在不损失精度的前提下大幅缩小缓存并提升推理吞吐量。该方法与现有KV压缩方法正交,可组合使用;未来工作包括从零开始预训练带HLA的循环模型(而非仅适配已有模型)、合并窗口与latent的注意力kernel、以及在更大循环数T下的验证。局限包括:HLA仅加速生成阶段;单序列在短上下文下因额外映射开销稍慢;仅测试至16K上下文;仅在一种循环架构(Ouro,T=4)上验证。

Abstract: Looped language models apply the same stack of layers T times to each token, which deepens the model without adding parameters but multiplies its key-value (KV) cache by T. The larger cache limits how many sequences a GPU can decode at once and slows each decoding step, which reads the whole cache. We uptrain HLA on Ouro looped models (T=4) with 1.4B and 2.6B parameters, keeping the pretrained weights frozen and training only the added parameters to reproduce the original attention. The cache shrinks by 10.7x per token, fitting 4.0-8.8x as many concurrent sequences per GPU, and decoding throughput improves by 2.5x at 1K-token contexts and by up to 7.4x at 16K. HLA retains over 97% of the original accuracy on math, knowledge and reasoning benchmarks, and 96-100% on long-context retrieval up to 16K tokens. After supervised fine-tuning, it performs on par with the fine-tuned original model on competition-level math.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Developing reliable models for clinical tasks, such as Medical Question Answering (QA), is severely constrained by the limited availability of high-quality, expert-annotated training data. This challenge is exacerbated by stringent privacy requirements and the impracticality of utilizing large open-source corpora or proprietary cloud APIs within resource-limited clinical settings. To address these obstacles, we introduce SAGE (\textit{Semantic Anchor-Guided Evolution}), a novel data synthesis framework that enables small, locally deployed models to generate high-quality medical training data. SAGE leverages lightweight, publicly available taxonomies such as MeSH as semantic anchors, imposing a structured prior to effectively guide and ground the data generation process. At its core, SAGE iteratively interleaves atomic (individual concept-based) and associative (relation-based) synthesis, bootstrapping training data from minimal seeds. This approach eliminates the need for large collections of medical documents or reliance on external APIs, providing a practical solution for on-premises data creation. Extensive experiments across multiple medical question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that models fine-tuned with SAGE-synthesized data consistently outperform those trained using self-derived or conventional document-based paradigms, highlighting tangible improvements in data efficiency and resource utilization for medical LLM development. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [18] [Penalty-Framed No-Valid-Option MCQA: Analyzing LLM Abstention under Invalid Choices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08153)
*Jinhyeok Kim,Hye-Young Jung*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"惩罚式无有效选项MCQA"评估范式，旨在衡量大语言模型在选项集无效时拒绝作答的能力，并引入"正确条件分析"来区分知识缺失与拒绝失败。核心发现是：标准MCQA高准确率不能保证可靠的弃答能力，即便在显式提示和惩罚机制下，模型仍会在部分原本能答对的题目上选择无效选项。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准MCQA评估假设选项集中至少有一个正确答案，仅衡量答案选择准确率。然而现实中检索系统或用户可能提供无效选项集，强行选择会带来下游成本代价。回答选择能力与拒绝无效选项集能力并非同一能力，需要专门的评估方法来揭示标准准确率无法捕捉的可靠性问题。

Method: 1) 构建方法：从MMLU-Pro数学子集（10选项）移除标注的正确选项，经人工与模型辅助筛选剔除存在等价答案形式的实例，得到1118条过滤后数据集。2) 评估设置：模型可选剩余选项或输出ABSTAIN，采用+4/-1/0评分规则（正确+4，无效强制选择-1，弃答0），期望弃答。3) 正确条件分析：仅在模型在原始MCQA三轮全部答对的"稳定正确子集"上评估弃答行为（CAR/CIFR），以排除知识缺失因素的干扰。4) 消融实验：变动惩罚值（-0.5/-1/-2）和弃答指令风格（仅惩罚/不确定感知/无有效选项感知）。5) 模型涵盖GPT-5系列、GPT-4.1系列、Gemini-3.0/3.1、Claude Sonnet 5、Qwen3-8B。

Result: 主要结果：1) 高原始MCQA准确率不能保证可靠弃答——所有模型在Acc与AR之间存在2.4至30.3个百分点的差距，IFR范围为9.9%-52.2%。2) 即使在稳定正确子集上，CIFR仍非零，例如Gemini-3.0-Flash为9.1%，GPT-5-mini为12.8%，GPT-4.1-nano高达45.5%。3) 惩罚值变动对CIFR影响甚微，表明该行为对惩罚强度不敏感。4) 指令风格影响更大——无有效选项感知指令显著降低CIFR，但仍无法消除。5) 在多领域MMLU子集上GPT-5-mini的CIFR升至42.2%，表明该现象非数学领域独有。6) 定性分析揭示两种失败模式：选择最接近的剩余选项；引用相关但不同的问题结论以匹配某个剩余选项。

Conclusion: 标准MCQA评估应同时衡量两个维度：在有效选项存在时是否选择正确答案，以及在选项集无效时是否拒绝作答。高答案选择准确率无法完全迁移至可靠的选项集拒绝能力。即便采用显式提示与惩罚机制，无效强制选择行为依然存在，只能被减弱而无法消除。这表明MCQA评估需要超越单纯答案选择准确率，加入拒绝无效选项集能力的考量。本研究主要局限在于聚焦数学领域、模型覆盖有限，且过滤后仍可能存在少量残余歧义。

Abstract: Multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) is commonly used to evaluate large language models under the assumption that one of the provided options is correct, typically using answer-selection accuracy. However, in real deployments, users or retrieval systems may provide invalid option sets in which none of the listed choices is correct, and selecting one of them may incur downstream cost. We study this setting as penalty-framed no-valid-option MCQA. Using the mathematics subset of MMLU-Pro, we remove the labeled correct option, allow models to either choose a remaining option or output ABSTAIN, and penalize invalid forced-choice responses. We further introduce correct-conditioned analysis, evaluating abstention only on instances that the model originally answered correctly. Experiments show that high MCQA accuracy does not fully guarantee abstention reliability: even under explicit no-valid-option-aware instructions and penalty-based scoring, models still produce invalid forced-choice responses for a subset of originally correct instances. These results show that penalty-framed no-valid-option MCQA reveals an aspect of model reliability not captured by standard answer-selection accuracy.

</details>


### [19] [STRUCTURALCOST: A controlled reading time dataset for modeling human sentence processing difficulty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08208)
*Nina Nusbaumer,Iria de-Dios-Flores,Corentin Bel,Christophe Pallier,Guillaume Wisniewski,Benoît Crabbé*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了STRUCTURALCOST数据集，一个包含475名参与者和40,800个观察值的可控自定步速阅读数据集，用于隔离长距离主语-动词依赖解析的处理成本。


<details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in question answering, yet they still frequently suffer from hallucinations on knowledge-intensive tasks. Knowledge graphs (KGs) provide LLMs with structured, interpretable, and updatable factual grounding, making them a promising external knowledge source for reliable reasoning. However, existing LLM-guided graph reasoning methods typically rely on hop-wise greedy or beam-style pruning during evidence retrieval. Such local decision processes are inherently myopic: evidence that appears weak near the source may become crucial only after deeper graph context is explored, causing answer-critical branches to be discarded prematurely and making the reasoning chain difficult to recover. FoG iteratively constructs a question-relevant evidence subgraph and uses far-to-near feedback to guide path exploration, and maintains a compact memory subgraph to support continued exploration. Extensive experiments on widely used KBQA benchmarks demonstrate that FoG achieves state-of-the-art performance, with a particularly large improvement of 16.58% in Hit on CWQ, while also reducing LLM calls and token usage.   <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 方法分三部分：(1) 严格1:1对齐的跨分词器OPD——在共享词汇上计算反向KL；(2) span监督实验——在严格损失基础上加入mismatch组的span对数概率MSE损失，扫描权重λ∈{0, 0.25, …, 1.5}；(3) 紧凑监督——将严格KL限制在学生选择的top-k共享词汇子集（k=16, 128）上。实验涵盖三对异构师生（Qwen→Llama, Granite→Phi, Granite→Qwen），任务为数学推理（MATH500, GSM8K, AIME等7个）和代码生成（HumanEval, MBPP, LiveCodeBench），训练数据为DAPO-Math和CodeForces各10k提示，100轮on-policy迭代。此外还用梯度余弦和范数比进行优化诊断，并扩展到Qwen3-235B→Granite-8B和ALFWorld实验。

Abstract: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generations using teacher feedback. With different tokenizers, comparing teacher and student predictions requires alignment at both sequence and vocabulary levels. In this paper, we examine whether expanding this alignment coverage improves learning. Across three heterogeneous teacher--student pairs on mathematical reasoning and code generation, strict 1:1 groups already cover most student-generated tokens despite substantial vocabulary mismatch. On responses sampled from the students before distillation, the shared vocabulary retains nearly all teacher and student probability mass at strictly aligned positions on average. Restricting reverse KL to a student-selected top-16 subset of the shared vocabulary at each strict position achieves accuracy comparable to full shared-vocabulary OPD, outperforming the evaluated cross-tokenizer baselines. Adding mean squared error supervision on span log-probabilities in mismatch groups gives complete supervision coverage, yet reduces accuracy. At checkpoints from training with only the strict loss, the span gradients show weak or negative directional agreement with the strict gradients and grow in magnitude relative to them. These diagnostics may help explain the accuracy drop from adding span supervision. Our findings motivate a shift from maximizing alignment coverage to prioritizing supervision reliability: compact supervision at strict positions can be more effective than broader coverage that introduces weakly aligned or conflicting training signals.

Abstract: Depression has no diagnostic blood test. Language models promise tireless, consistent assessment, but can accurate raters disagree about individuals? Average over-rating governed how many were flagged, yet equal-capacity raters chose differently for about one participant in five. TL;DR: 本文介绍Wiki-Talkie，一个基于维基百科讨论页的多语言（德、英、西、法、意）真实对话数据集，配有真实用户画像，用于评估LLM智能体在跨语言协作讨论中模拟人类交互行为的群体保真度。实验发现：具体的评论历史比抽象的画像描述更能引导智能体产生人类化行为；模型系统性地少产生负面/极端情绪、多产生请求与承诺，呈现出讨好性和积极性偏差；这些模式在五种语言间稳健存在，跨语言差异较小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有persona-based对话数据集依赖虚构persona且仅覆盖少数语言，无法验证智能体行为是否忠实反映真实人类群体的意见与互动模式。本文旨在填补这一空白，创建一个多语言、基于真实维基百科协作讨论的基准，用于跨语言评估LLM智能体的行为保真度。

Conclusion: 具体的交互示例比抽象persona描述更有效地引导LLM智能体产生类人行为；社会人口统计信息有时反而降低性能，这对隐私保护应用是一个积极信号；模型存在一致的行动导向增强和对抗性减弱偏差；这些发现在跨语言条件下稳健成立，为persona条件化生成研究提供了重要基准和局限性洞察。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in social environments, making it critical to study their ability to faithfully simulate human interactions. Central to this is grounding agents in realistic user personas, yet existing datasets rely on fictional personas and are limited to a handful of languages, lacking the empirical grounding necessary to evaluate behavioral fidelity across diverse populations. We introduce Wiki-Talkie, a multilingual dataset of real-world conversations from Wikipedia Talk pages across five languages spanning two language families: Germanic (German, English) and Romance (Spanish, French, Italian), paired with personas derived from real user communities and encompassing sociodemographic attributes, self-descriptions, and behaviorally grounded interaction traits. Results show that user's comment history exemplifying interaction behavior consistently outperforms explicit persona information. In addition, models systematically underproduce negative or extreme sentiments, while over producing references and suggestions, revealing biases toward agreeableness and positivity. Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出"地板-天花板-净空"(floor-ceiling-headroom)框架，通过将探针分数归一化到两个参考点（简单输入可预测的地板、全输入可预测的天花板）之间，解决探针分数缺乏固定意义的问题；证明净空通过"目标弱敏感"和"弱识别"两种机制消失，并在元分析Transformer、scGPT及四个LLM探针研究中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始探针R²分数缺乏内在的证据强度标尺：R²=0.6可能仅反映输入本身就能预测的信息，且同一分数在不同数据分布下含义不同。这导致无法判断探针得分反映的是表征计算还是输入统计特征，特别是在分布偏移下更成问题。

Method: 定义三个参考量：地板ρ²_O（仅用受限信息O可达到的最大R²）、天花板ρ²_I（用全部信息I可达到的最大R²）、净空Δ=ρ²_I−ρ²_O。提出归一化分数U_H=(R²_H−ρ²_O)/(ρ²_I−ρ²_O)表示探针恢复的净空比例。理论证明净空可通过两种机制消失：(1)目标T=f(O,Z)对潜在变量Z的弱敏感性（即使Z已知也无法大幅降低预测误差）；(2)弱识别——额外证据X对Z的互信息不足（MI(X;Z|O)小）。方法在受控随机效应元分析任务中通过解析/数值积分获得精确参考点，并构造解码器组（Ridge、MLP、GBM）从样本估计参考点，验证估计与精确值一致。

Result: 在受控元分析中：分布偏移下原始探针R²从0.64降至0.40，但归一化分数U_H几乎不变（0.78→0.82），表明分数下降反映数据信息减少而非表征退化。精确参考点显示主要机制是弱识别而非弱敏感。在合成单细胞模型中通过独立调节证据分数p_X和目标分数p_T证实两种机制可分离。在真实scGPT数据中，原始R²在0.35–0.81之间，但U_H仅0.28–0.57，表明生物变异性仅部分被编码。对四个已发表LLM探针的重分析显示：世界级地理位置探针恢复了63–77%的净空；Othello棋盘在mine/theirs编码下线性探针恢复92%净空，但绝对编码下的探针分数基本可由棋子放置解释；用户属性探针的精度几乎完全来自文本本身（地板0.92–0.98）。

Conclusion: 探针归一化框架将原始R²分数置于上下文相关的证据尺度上，澄清了计算与统计伪迹的区别。在分布偏移下，原始探针得分的下降并不必然意味着表征退化——可能是数据本身的信息减少。该框架为科学基础模型的可解释性声明提供了量化审计工具，揭示了若干先前声明应被弱化（用户属性、NYC位置）或被加强（Othello相对编码、世界级地理）。

Abstract: Probes are the workhorse of interpretability. If a model's hidden states predict a variable, the model is said to represent it. But a probe score has no fixed meaning. An $R^2$ of 0.6 may only reflect what the input already gives away, and the same score can mean different things on different data. We propose reading every probe score against two reference points: a floor, what a declared set of simple inputs already predicts, and a ceiling, what the full input can predict. The gap between them, the headroom, is the range in which a probe can show that a model computes something beyond the simple inputs. We prove that headroom vanishes in two ways: the target stops depending on a hidden variable the model must infer, or the input stops revealing it. We test this on transformers trained for in-context meta-analysis, which must infer the hidden heterogeneity between studies to weight them correctly, and where both reference points are known. Under distribution shift, probe scores fall and prediction error rises $12$--$15\times$, yet the model recovers a similar share of the headroom, indicating that the data lost information, not the representation. We then analyze the real models. The single-cell foundation model scGPT encodes biological variability only partially. We also revisit four influential LLM probing studies, which claim that models represent geography, the state of an Othello board, truth, and the demographics of their users. Against a floor computed from the input text alone, some of these claims hold, while others are largely explained by the text itself.

</details>

TL;DR: 该论文发现，激活导向（activation steering）中常用的"去偏方向"实际上主要捕获的是模型置信度而非社会偏见，导致所谓的"去偏"实际上是通过降低模型置信度、促使模型放弃回答或均匀化选项概率来实现的，并非真正纠正了偏见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活导向作为一种轻量级的推理时去偏技术被广泛应用，但先前研究表明其泛化能力差、存在非预期效果且在不同数据集上迁移性有限。作者试图探究这一去偏方向在激活空间中究竟编码了什么，以解释其不稳定表现。

Result: 核心结果包括：(1) 线性分类器在区分偏见/反偏见时 AUROC 较低（如 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 在 BBQ 上为 0.57），但在区分高/低概率答案时 AUROC 高达 0.94；(2) 去偏向量与从 MMLU/OpenBookQA 提取的置信度向量的余弦相似度在 0.29–0.91 之间；(3) 导向降低了偏见评分，但这是弃答率上升的副作用——当允许弃答时，有偏和无偏答案概率同时下降，中立/弃答概率上升（如 Llama-3.1-Instruct 在 BBQ 模糊情境下弃答率比从 5.51 升至 21.90）；(4) 当不允许弃答时，导向使各选项概率趋于均等（类似温度缩放），导致熵升高、准确率下降；(5) 在 MMLU 和 OpenBookQA 上导向同样增加熵（如 Qwen3.5-9B 在 OpenBookQA 上熵从 0.24 翻倍至 0.50），表明效果与偏见无关。

Conclusion: 论文得出结论：激活导向用于去偏时产生的"偏见减少"是错误的因果归因——它并未纠正模型固有的刻板关联，而是通过降低模型置信度来实现的。这种偏见-置信度混淆使得无法在不去损模型自信的前提下获得纯净的偏见线性表示。因此，基于激活导向的去偏结果应谨慎解读，未来的工作应致力于寻找与置信度解耦的真正偏见方向，并审视其他基于线性表示假说的导向技术在 AI 安全领域的可靠性。

Abstract: Activation steering has gained popularity as a lightweight inference-time debiasing technique for large language models. However, prior work reports that steering vectors generalise poorly, with unintended effects on model performance and limited transfer to new datasets. Our experiments show that model confidence is the dominant separating factor between biased and anti-biased prompts in hidden space, indicating that isolating a linear representation of bias which is disentangled from model confidence is difficult and steering-based debiasing results should be interpreted with care. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网页代理面临间接提示注入（indirect prompt injection）攻击：第三方页面作者可通过植入指令将代理偏离用户目标。现有的固定注入微调防御方法（如 SecAlign、StruQ）易被自适应攻击者绕过；而对抗训练方法虽能自适应攻击，但任务集固定后会失去教学信号，且每个新任务需要可执行的环境。该工作旨在同时解决"任务适应性"与"攻击适应性"两个局限。

Method: 提出 AdvSim2Real 框架，在冻结的 WebWorld-14B 世界模型中共同训练三个策略：(1) 课程 C（生成任务：目标+初始页面）；(2) 执行器 E（网页代理）；(3) 攻击者 A（请求页面注入）。两阶段训练：Stage 1 中课程与执行器交替更新，课程按 R-Zero 不确定性奖励 q(p)=1−2|p−1/2| 在执行器约 50% 成功率时获得最高奖励；Stage 2 中课程冻结，攻击者与执行器交替训练，攻击者采用"成功翻转（success flip）"奖励——仅当其注入使原本被判成功的干净轨迹变为失败时才获得奖励。三个策略均通过冻结 LLM 评判器（Qwen3.8-27B）评分，使用 LoRA 适配器在固定骨干网络上训练，采用基于 GRPO 的组归一化优势函数与基础策略 KL 惩罚。评估基于 150 个表单填写任务（10 个模板，5 个技能层级，含保护字段与禁用控件），并以 Kimi-K3 前沿模型作为未见过的外部攻击者。

The agent cannot simply ignore the page, because the page also holds the values and controls the task requires. Current defenses fine-tune the agent on injections fixed before training, and attackers that adapt to the trained model bypass them. Adversarial training lets the attacker adapt but keeps the tasks fixed, so a task stops teaching once the agent solves it. The curriculum is rewarded for tasks the agent solves about half of the time, and the adversary only for a success flip, an injection that turns a judged success into a failure. On 150 web tasks, AdvSim2Real raises completion under this unseen adversary by 33.6\% relative to the base agent.

Abstract: Scientific research often begins by synthesizing ideas from a set of related papers to identify gaps and formulate new directions. TL;DR: Fiorillo v0.5 是一个 40 亿参数的开源医学模型，其核心组件是基于 Qwen3-4B-Base 的随机对照试验结果分类专家。它通过 LoRA 微调，在仅采用许可证允许的 1,431 篇训练文章上进行 Evidence Inference 2.0 任务。该模型在注册预注册的测试中全部通过四项校准与性能标准，并以 Apache 2.0 协议发布。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) adapts frozen large multimodal models (LMMs) to new tasks from a few demonstrations (demos), but re-encodes them at every query, where each demo image adds up to hundreds of visual tokens. Demo-free methods remove this cost with a compact task state. However, they add it at locations searched per task or at every decoder layer, where task parameters grow with depth. Moreover, inserted tokens or keys cannot change how the original prompt divides its attention within a layer. Specifically, a readout vector updates the answer-producing tokens and a context vector updates the other structural token groups. Both are trained with answer labels on prompts with and without demos. We justify these design choices theoretically using a first-order analysis of the loss and a margin bound. Extensive experiments on six LMMs and five large language models show that STAVE matches or outperforms state-of-the-art methods on multimodal tasks with far fewer task parameters and surpasses 15-shot ICL and prior task vectors on 18 text tasks, all at zero-shot inference cost.

Main category: cs.CL

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Speculative decoding reduces large language model inference latency by drafting multiple tokens before target-model verification, but its effectiveness depends on both the proposal mechanism and draft depth. Fixed configurations cannot respond to changes in predictability, repetition, and acceptance during generation, so deeper drafting can increase wasted computation without proportional speedup. Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are expected to answer questions faithfully based on the provided context, abstaining when the context information is insufficient to answer the questions.   <summary>Details</summary>

TL;DR: 本文提出Turnslide框架，通过将每个API建模为有限状态机（FSM）来高效生成多轮工具调用微调数据，仅需单次LLM调用即可合成完整对话轨迹，显著降低了合成成本并提升了生成数据的质量。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对多轮工具调用任务的合成数据生成方法成本过高——通常需要为每个领域搭建模拟运行环境，且每生成一条对话轨迹需要数十甚至数百次LLM调用（对话引导式合成）。此外，现有方法基于无状态的工具图进行采样，产生的工具序列可能违反系统前置条件，导致大量浪费。同时，小型语言模型（SLM）原生能力不足，需高质量领域数据微调，但此类数据极为稀缺。

Result: 在BFCL v4的五个领域（Trading、Travel、VehicleControl、FileSystem、Tick.&Trav.）上的实验表明：FSM方法的全对话准确率显著优于未修改基线（回归系数β=10.1%, p<0.01），优于马尔可夫工具链基线（β=7.88%, p<0.05）。在与ToolFlow和APIGen-MT的对比中（固定20M token预算），Turnslide达到70.7%全准确率，超过ToolFlow的63.4%和APIGen-MT的53.7%，且LLM调用次数仅1.0次/轨迹（对比34.3和107.2），token消耗减少3.6-6.6倍，可生成的轨迹数多3.6-6.6倍。LLM评判数据质量得分3.34，也高于两个基线（3.03和3.04）。

Conclusion: Turnslide通过FSM建模实现了状态合法的工具序列采样和单遍对话合成，在保证数据质量的同时大幅降低了合成成本，为SLM在多轮工具调用任务上的微调提供了一条可扩展的路径。局限性包括：未预先验证FSM可能导致错误传播；与基线方法的对比受限于计算成本，仅在单个领域、固定token预算下完成；测试集部分由LLM生成。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型频繁做出关于自身的声明，但这些声明可能与真实的内部计算过程脱节（confabulation）。以往关于自报告忠实性的研究主要基于行为评估，而缺乏一种能够区分"真正的内省"与"巧合正确的猜测"的机理层面的判据。本研究旨在回答：能否从模型内部计算结构出发，不依赖对自报告内容的解读，来判断自报告是否具有因果基础（grounding）。

Result: 1. 观察到"延迟泛化"现象：小模型很快达到高决策性能（≈0.9），而忠实自报告只有在32B规模下才重新出现，且显著晚于决策性能的达标时间（如checkpoint 1000决策性能0.82但忠实度仅0.25，checkpoint 3000忠实度跃升至0.83）。2. 权重消融与层冻结实验显示，忠实自报告依赖于偏好表示迁移到网络更早的层（第10–20层范围），以便与已有的语言化机制对接。3. 在32对配对适配器（64个模型）上，忠实模型的平均归因相似度为0.34，而不忠实模型仅为0.08，差异Δ=0.26（95% CI [0.16, 0.36]）；按层汇总时，忠实模型决策与自报告任务均在第38层达到峰值，而不忠实模型决策任务峰值在第49层。4. 跨任务因果patching表明，忠实模型恢复给定比例的KL散度所需激活的矩阵数量比不忠实模型少8–12倍。5. 局限性：该方法区分群体而非个体；仅限于线性偏好、LoRA适配器及特定模型族的受控场景。

Abstract: Large language models make claims about themselves that are both consequential and increasingly difficult to verify from behavior alone. Using low-rank adapters, we train models to make decisions on behalf of fictitious characters, according to latent linear preference functions. We find sustained fine-tuning on an implicit decision task can lead to the emergence of accurate self-reporting of models' learned preferences, even without explicit self-report supervision. We ask two research questions about this emergent phenomenon. First: is the emergence of accurate self-reporting accompanied by a measurable structural change in the model? Weight ablations and frozen-layer experiments together indicate that preference representations shift to earlier layers over training, consistent with the hypothesis that faithful self-report requires preferences to be located where pre-existing verbalization mechanisms can access them. Second: can these structural differences distinguish faithful models from unfaithful ones? Using attribution patching, we find that faithful models exhibit significantly higher attribution similarity between the decision-making and self-report tasks -- a mechanistic signature of faithful self-report that does not require us to understand the content of the report itself. Previous work on self-report has observed behaviorally that models can be faithful or unfaithful; our work proposes that, at least in our restricted setting, it is possible to distinguish between the two patterns of computation by examining the structure of the networks themselves.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Scientific search systems can find papers that are relevant to a question, but they generally do not assess the quality of the evidence that those papers provide. We present Kurate, a system that uses large language models (LLMs) to assess the quality of published studies. Kurate uses both the paper and its related documents (e.g., the study's trial registration and protocol), and links each of its judgments to the passage of text on which that judgment is based. We applied Kurate to a corpus of 4,347 papers (3,913 of which report randomized trials) and scored each paper on 8 dimensions of study design and reporting: specifically, statistical power, causal identification, preregistration, selective reporting, measurement validity, analysis prespecification, reporting transparency, and conflict of interest and funding. Across the corpus, we found that papers most often exhibited issues with statistical power, selective reporting, and analysis prespecification, although average quality differed between clinical areas. When compared against expert annotations of 60 held-out clinical-trial documents, the information Kurate extracted matched the expert label in 221/242 protocol scorepoints and 294/370 results-publication scorepoints, with AC1 0.94 and 0.81, respectively. Using a well-reputed, high quality clinical trial as a worked example, we show how a single paper's overall grade breaks down into separate judgments, with each linked to specific evidence from the trial's registration, protocol, and published report. Together, these results show that large-scale quality assessment of this kind is feasible, and that it can be used to address meta-scientific research questions.

</details>

TL;DR: 本文提出"Insight Provenance"（洞见溯源）任务，旨在区分科学评审意见中的洞见究竟来源于人类、LLM还是人机混合贡献，而非仅检测文字层面的AI生成。作者构建了包含4,057篇论文和12,660条人类评审的大规模数据集InsightTrace，并通过GPT-4o、Gemini和DeepSeek模拟不同层级的LLM参与；同时提出两阶段对抗框架InsightShield以抑制文本作者身份（Table A Authorship）等短贷特征；分析表明人类洞见更常引入外部知识与独立判断，而AI洞见多停留在论文已有信息或通用层面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM广泛参与学术写作与同行评审，仅检测"谁写了文字"已不足以满足学术诚信与责任归属的需要；亟需从文字层面深入到洞见层面，判断一条评审意见背后的实质性观点究竟由谁提出，以区分人类仅借助LLM润色文字与LLM独立生成新观点两种本质不同的情形。

Method: 1. 数据方面：从OpenReview采集4,057篇论文与12,660条人类评审，构建三种LLM参与程度的生成条件（LLM-Polish润色、LLM-Expand扩展、LLM-Review全生成），并由GPT-4o在句级进行洞见溯源标注（Human/Hybrid/AI）。2. 测试方面：设计逐步去偏的测试集——Debiased-Test-v1进行风格中性化（去除第一人称、模糊语、被动语态等），Debiased-Test-v2进一步内容规范化（去除建议性语言、编号引用、评价立场等）。3. 模型方面：Stage 1联合学习洞见溯源与文本作者身份两个分类头；Stage 2冻结两个头作为对抗项，学习残差投影器z=g(h)，通过KL散度迫使冻结头对z的预测趋近均匀分布，同时保留洞见溯源预测，从而抑制作者身份等短贷信号。4. 训练增强：引入Unrelated类（用语义相似的其他论文替换原文），迫使模型利用论文上下文进行推理。

Result: 1. 主实验：InsightShield在Test-raw上达到93.61/92.80/92.21加权F1（GPT/Gemini/DeepSeek），在严格去偏的Debiased-Test-v2上仍达67.16/66.30/68.45，显著优于RACE等强基线（后者在v2上从约90%下降至55–66%）。2. 消融实验：去掉Stage 2导致v2上性能大幅下降（例：GPT从67.16降至58.31），证明对抗去短贷至关重要；去掉f_ins或f_auth单独对抗项也均有下降。3. 跨LLM迁移：混合三LLM训练可在三个测试生成器上取得更均衡的性能（均值75.52，标准差13.44，低于单LLM训练的波动）。4. 洞见溯源分析：AI洞见中44.5%为领域通用、38.6%为论文显式信息，合计83.1%无需超出论文；人类洞见中28.0%依赖外部知识、28.9%基于经验判断，仅53.8%落在通用+论文显式区间。5. 输入消融：去掉论文P使v2性能下降约10个百分点（如Gemini 66.30→62.59）；去掉邻接评审上下文使v2性能下降更显著（如DeepSeek 67.16→58.12），但上下文干预表明其主要贡献是局部溯源先验而非话语关系。

Conclusion: 本文将AI内容溯源从文字层面推进到洞见层面，证明即使在语言风格被标准化后，洞见溯源仍可被检测——因为人类与AI洞见在信息源上存在系统性差异：人类更频繁地引入外部知识与独立判断，而AI洞见多停留在论文显式信息或领域通用知识层面。InsightShield通过对抗去短贷框架有效抑制作者身份等表面线索，在逐步去偏测试中保持稳健性能。研究还揭示，论文与邻接评审上下文提供互补信息——论文用于判断洞见可能的来源，邻接句子提供局部溯源先验。总体而言，风格可被LLM改写，但观点的溯源距离（provenance distance）是更难抹除的深层信号，为人机协作下的学术责任归属提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: As LLMs increasingly assist scientific writing and peer review, detecting who wrote the text is no longer sufficient: we need to determine who contributed the underlying insight. We introduce Insight Provenance, the task of identifying whether a review insight originates from a human, an LLM, or their hybrid contribution. We construct InsightProv-v0 from 4,057 scientific papers and 12,660 human reviews, simulating different levels of LLM involvement with GPT-4o, Gemini, and DeepSeek and annotating provenance at the sentence level. We show that strong performance on raw data can be misleading, as models exploit linguistic and textual-authorship shortcuts that degrade substantially under progressively debiased evaluation. We therefore propose a two-stage adversarial framework that suppresses shortcut signals while preserving provenance-relevant information. Beyond detection, extensive analyses reveal what makes intellectual authorship identifiable: paper grounding and neighboring review context provide complementary provenance signals, while human, hybrid, and AI insights systematically differ in their information sources and failure modes. Most strikingly, AI insights predominantly remain close to generic or paper-provided information, whereas human insights more often introduce external knowledge and independent judgment. These findings suggest that while wording can be rewritten by an LLM, the provenance of an idea leaves a deeper and more persistent signal.

</details>

Main category: cs.CL

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的临床NLP研究（如起草医疗记录、ICD-10编码和医嘱提取）通常假设已拥有完整的转录文本，但现实中医生口述记录往往存在大量信息缺失，需要文档专家发送"问询"（Provider Queries）来补充。填补这些文档缺口对于准确计费至关重要，但这一环节尚未被自动化研究覆盖。

Method: 1. 对3000次真实临床问诊进行审计，识别缺失文档的来源；2. 基于公开数据构建5个转录退化（degradation）基准；3. 在21k个真实问询回合（turns）上分析，提出了DAU（Draft, Ask, Update）流程，让LLM自动决定何时提问以及提问内容；4. 比较了不同任务（笔记起草、ICD-10编码、医嘱提取）下提问策略的差异。

Result: 1. 任务特定性：有用提问的预测因子因任务而异——Oracle置信度是主导信号，但笔记完整性只需简单的回忆性问题，而ICD-10编码则需要更难的多选题；2. 负面收益：约9%的问询回合实际上降低了性能，主要原因是冗余提问和未作答却仍触发重写的情况；3. 部署启示：系统部署不仅需要学习"问什么"，更要学习"何时不问"。

Conclusion: 自动化临床问询循环具有可行性，但效果高度依赖于任务类型；模型必须谨慎决定是否提问，因为过度提问或错误提问反而会降低下游任务表现。这为临床文档自动化的实际部署提供了重要参考。

Abstract: Provider queries are clarifying requests sent by clinical documentation specialists to physicians to close gaps in the clinical note and ensure accurate billing. Prior work automates note drafting, ICD-10 coding, and order extraction assuming a complete transcript, leaving these gaps unaddressed. We study whether an LLM can automate the query loop, termed DAU (Draft, Ask, Update), across those three tasks. An audit of 3,000 real visits identifies the sources of missing documentation, from which we build five transcript-degradation benchmarks on public data. Analyzing 21k clarification turns on real conversations, we find useful-question predictors are task-specific: oracle confidence dominates, but note completeness needs only simple recall questions while ICD-10 coding needs harder, multi-option ones. About 9% of turns hurt performance, driven by redundant questions and non-answers that still trigger a rewrite. Deployment depends on learning "when not" as much as "what to" ask.

</details>

*Muhammad Rafiullah Memon,Viet Vo,Wanlun Ma,Yang Xiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文指出，当听障儿童通过自动手语翻译（SLT）与AI对话系统交互时，现有的儿童安全机制（基于文本的过滤器、不当引诱分类器等）所处理的是机器翻译后的文本，而非儿童真实表达。已有SLT系统在非手部标记（否定、疑问、情感）、多义词、空间指代、虚构内容等方面的缺陷恰恰对应安全决策所依赖的语义属性，但目前没有任何系统对"手语→文本→安全决策"这一整条链路进行联合评估。作者提出了一套以聋人社群参与、隐私安全为前提的预部署审计框架，包含失败分类法、消毒场景模式、四种翻译条件对比（C0专家参考、C1人工口译、C2自动SLT、C3不确定性感知SLT）和四项结局指标（语义保持、决策一致性、严重性加权错误率、安全的不确定性处理），并计划以Auslan作为首个案例研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着SLT技术进入消费级产品（如手机键盘、对话助手），听障儿童通过手语与AI系统交流时，其表达首先被翻译成英文文本，然后才被基于文本的儿童安全机制（年龄过滤器、不当引诱分类器等）处理。然而，SLT系统的已知缺陷（丢失否定、混淆主客体、忽略情感紧迫性、虚构内容等）恰好集中在安全决策所依赖的语义特征上，且现有SLT模型未在18岁以下使用者上训练或评估。更关键的是，SLT研究界与儿童安全研究界各自独立发展，从未有人将两者作为一条完整链路进行联合审计。因此需要一套聋人知情、可在无未成年人参与条件下启动的预部署审计方法，在风险落地前发现界面缺陷。

Method: 方法为审计框架设计：审计路径为"手语用户→SLT→文本安全机制→决策"。方案包括：（1）设计24-36个合成的、消毒过的安全场景，涵盖六类（引诱与保密、胁迫与同意、线下会面、霸凌威胁、痛苦求助、信任成人倾诉），每个场景标注结构化槽位（actor、age、relationship、action、consent_or_negation、secrecy等）；（2）优先使用最小对（minimal pairs）以仅改变一个安全关键属性；（3）设计两类对抗变体（冒充聋人流利者的冒犯者、利用翻译歧义使有害内容无害化）；（4）定义七大安全关键失败类别（极性/同意反转、主客体混淆、年龄/身份丢失、保密/胁迫弱化、情感/紧迫性丢失、上下文碎片化、虚构）；（5）设置四种翻译条件对比（C0聋人双语专家口译参考、C1人工专业口译、C2自动SLT top-1输出、C3不确定性感知接口），统一安全模型使决策差异归因于翻译；（6）四项指标：SCSP（安全关键语义保持）、DDC（下游决策一致性）、严重性加权错误率（区分假阴/假阳）、安全的不确定性处理；（7）由聋人和Auslan顾问共同设计场景与严重性排序，付费并保留否决权；视频作生物特征数据最小化保留。整个框架为前瞻性设计，未报告结果。

Result: 无实证结果。论文为框架提案阶段，明确报告"我们报告无结果"（All of this is planned; we report no results）。

Conclusion: 文本安全机制默认其输入等于用户所言，但对通过SLT交流的听障儿童而言，输入只是其手语的机器翻译，且翻译系统的已知弱点集中在安全决策所依赖的否定、指代、情感与上下文等属性上。作者提出了安全关键翻译失败分类法和一套聋人知情的预部署审计协议。结论强调：在手语介导访问尚处早期时审视该边界，可在缺陷影响儿童求助通道之前发现界面问题。下一阶段是与聋人及儿童安全组织合作的Auslan试点，并测试协议对其他手语的迁移性。论文同时指出隐私保护型片上安全关键手语检测器是延伸方向，并强调审计不应替代人工口译员或专业保护人员。

Abstract: Automatic sign language translation (SLT) has entered consumer products, turning American Sign Language into English text for dictation, messaging, and queries put to a conversational assistant. Child-facing AI and platform trust-and-safety tooling decide on text, using filters on minor accounts and grooming classifiers that score chat messages. A signing child who uses SLT therefore reaches these safeguards through a translation. We found no publicly documented system in which the two have been jointly evaluated, and the leading deployed SLT model was neither trained nor formally evaluated on signers under 18. Errors that alter negation, participant roles, secrecy, urgency or help-seeking could change a safety decision without disturbing fluency. This paper proposes a Deaf-informed pre-deployment audit of that boundary, with a failure taxonomy, a sanitised scenario schema, four comparison conditions, and four outcome measures. Auslan is the planned first case study.

</details>

*Zubair Ajmal Farooq,Diptesh Kanojia*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种完全离线运行的语音翻译流水线，部署于 Jetson Nano (4GB)，利用质量评估（QE）门控触发二次纠错。在三种纠错方法中，最小贝叶斯风险（MBR）解码表现最佳，在 BLEU、ChrF 和 COMET 指标上均获得统计显著的提升，并发现 QE 适合作为触发门控而非候选排序器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语音翻译系统多依赖云服务，存在隐私和带宽问题；边缘设备虽然保护隐私，但级联流水线（ASR→MT→TTS）会累积错误，且小模型在边缘硬件上尤其脆弱。本文旨在探索低成本（<150美元）边缘设备能否在完全离线、无需重训练的情况下实现语音翻译、检测并自我纠错。

Method: 采用四级联流水线：Whisper-tiny ASR + Opus-MT en-es 翻译器 + 多语言 BERT 余弦相似度作为 QE 信号 + eSpeak-ng TTS。当 QE 置信度低于阈值 τ 时触发二次纠错。比较三种纠错方法：(M1) QE 重排序、(M2) 最小贝叶斯风险（MBR）解码、(M3) 受限束搜索（CBS）。在 1,012 句 FLORES-200 上对 4×3 网格（τ ∈ {0.75,0.80,0.85,0.90}，N ∈ {3,5,10}）进行配对 bootstrap 显著性检验。提出 gain-to-edit ratio (GER) 作为句级分析工具，结合 COMET 增益和 TER 编辑距离。

Result: 在 τ=0.90 时，M2 (MBR) 在所有指标上获得统计显著提升：BLEU +0.67 (p<0.001)、ChrF +0.51 (p<0.001)、COMET +0.0020 (N=3, p=0.002)；M1 无显著增益；M3 显著低于基线。核心发现：QE 适合作为门控但不适合作为排序器，将 QE 从候选选择中移除（M1→M2）不损害质量，并释放 680MB 内存。词汇指标（BLEU、ChrF）在 N=10 时最优，语义指标（COMET、GER）在 N=3 时最优。延迟分析显示单加载架构下逐话语延迟约 41 秒，瓶颈为 RAM 而非计算。

Conclusion: 边缘设备可实现完全离线的语音翻译自纠错，关键在于：(1) MBR 在小候选池上实现自纠错；(2) QE 仅用作触发门控而非排序器，可节省约 680MB 内存；(3) 候选池大小存在词汇-语义权衡，可通过 GER 观测；(4) CBS 不适用于对已标记输出进行纠错；(5) 当前边缘部署的主要瓶颈是 RAM 而非纠错算法本身。系统支持六种语言对的实时翻译。

Abstract: We present a fully offline speech-to-speech translation pipeline that runs on a Jetson Nano (4 GB) and corrects its own weak translations without retraining. We compare three correction methods: QE reranking (M1), Minimum Bayes-Risk decoding (M2), and constrained beam search (M3). On 1,012 FLORES-200 sentences (English-Spanish), M2 at $\tau=0.90$ produces statistically significant improvements over greedy decoding on BLEU (+0.67, p<0.001), ChrF (+0.51, p<0.001), and COMET (+0.0020 at N=3, p=0.002); M1 yields no significant gains, and M3 is significantly worse than baseline (p>0.99). Our central finding is that QE functions effectively as a gate but poorly as a ranker: removing the QE model from candidate selection (M1$\to$M2) does not hurt quality and frees 680 MB from the critical path. Using a gain-to-edit ratio adapted from the post-editing-effort literature, we further show that smaller candidate pools (N=3) yield more surgical corrections with better semantic adequacy, while larger pools (N=10) maximise lexical reward. </details>


### [53] [HouseholdBench: Evaluating Large Language Models as Predictors of Household Economic Behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07563)
*Jin Huang,Diego Ferreras Garrucho,Yutong Xie,Walter M. Yuan,Qiaozhu Mei,Chen Lian,Jonathon Hazell*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 HouseholdBench 基准测试，基于 6 项美国住户调查构建 32 个预测任务，覆盖消费、收入、劳动、宏观预期与住房五大领域，对 13 个专有和开源大语言模型（LLM）进行评估。结果显示多数 LLM 优于"无变化"基线，但梯度提升树（XGBoost）整体最优；专有 LLM 接近 XGBoost，开源模型落后。通过监督微调（SFT）与 16 次预测聚合，40 亿参数开源模型可匹配顶尖专有模型水平，且改进可泛化至未见过的政策响应任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经济学长期追求建立家庭决策的定量模型。现有 LLM 评估范围有限，缺乏对家庭如何应对经济政策变化（特别是真实政策冲击）的系统测试，亟需一个覆盖多领域、多任务类型的综合基准来衡量 LLM 在家庭经济行为预测方面的能力。
