Most LLMs outperform the no-change baseline, including for policy response tasks -- with the best model lowering error for numeric outcomes by 12.2%. Across most tasks, gradient-boosted trees rank first; leading proprietary LLMs approach their performance, but open-weight models lag. LLMs exhibit systematic over- and underprediction across different tasks. We identify methods that enable a 4 billion parameter open-weight model to match proprietary models' performance: fine-tuning and aggregating 16 predictions per observation. Improvements generalize to policy-response tasks, which are excluded from fine-tuning. We release our datasets, code, and leaderboard on our website: this https URL

Abstract: LLM orchestration investigates how an orchestrator coordinates a group of autonomous agents to achieve common goals or maximize collective welfare. The agents are typically heterogeneous, each holding a private preference that it pursues but does not reveal. Inferring such hidden preferences from behavior has been a subject of long-standing research in game theory and multi-agent systems. The core challenge lies in maintaining a belief over every agent's preference and updating it from the agents' observed actions. Existing LLM orchestrators carry that belief as prompt text with no explicit update rule. This lets early errors persist and propagate rather than be corrected. We therefore propose \textbf{HARP} (Heterogeneous-preference Agent oRchestration via Preference inference), a novel framework that moves the belief out of the prompt. Specifically, HARP maintains one numeric posterior per agent over a finite set of candidate preferences and updates it in closed form by Bayes' rule. The language model supplies only actions and per-candidate likelihoods, so estimation is decoupled from its reasoning. We prove that HARP attains the same $\tilde O(\sqrt K)$ Bayesian regret as explicit joint inference when the factorization is exact. Furthermore, HARP\textsuperscript{+} augments planning with a bonus for actions that distinguish the candidates, so inference continues even when the optimal action is uninformative. Empirical results on three substrates, ranging from payoffs the preferences fully determine, through payoffs that depend on more than them, to scales where explicit joint inference is infeasible, demonstrate that HARP\textsuperscript{+} is the strongest non-oracle method across the class our theory identifies.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation in large language models. In each drafting stage, a lightweight draft model proposes tokens that the target model subsequently verifies. With increasingly capable draft models, we find that the target model frequently accepts all tokens produced in a drafting stage. A verification nevertheless follows each drafting stage, resulting in unnecessary target-model forward passes even when drafting could have continued. Adaptive draft length methods decide during decoding how many draft tokens precede a verification, but they raise the speedup only for autoregressive draft models. For a parallel draft model, drafting further requires target-model hidden states for draft tokens that have not been verified. We propose DLoop, a looped form of speculative decoding that adaptively performs multiple drafting stages before verification. DLoop continues drafting while the draft model remains confident and verifies all accumulated draft tokens together. Loop-aware training keeps the draft model reliable in the additional drafting stages by exposing it to its own hidden states for unverified draft tokens. By spending additional draft-model forward passes, DLoop reduces the number of target-model forward passes required for verification. Across diverse speculative decoding methods including EAGLE-3, DFlash, Domino, DSpark, and multi-token prediction modules, DLoop improves the wall-clock speedup by 5 to 41 percent while preserving lossless decoding. Abstract: We study the robustness of keystroke dynamics for detecting large language model (LLM)-assisted writing. We introduce a Vietnamese keystroke dataset capturing realistic writing modes, including bona fide composition, transcription, and paraphrasing. We also define a behaviorally grounded threat model in which users deliberately alter typing patterns. To implement the threat model, we create behaviorally manipulated variants of the data designed to evade keystroke-based detection. We evaluate four keystroke modeling approaches: temporal and rhythmic representations, and sequential representations modeled with a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) and TypeNet, under user-independent and context-independent settings. The results show that sequential models outperform feature-based approaches in most cases and that keystroke signals encode discriminative information about the writing process. However, detection is not uniformly robust: transcription is reliably identified, while paraphrasing and adversarially manipulated samples are frequently misclassified as bona fide when not explicitly modeled. To address this, we incorporate adversarial training using behaviorally manipulated data, which substantially improves separability and robustness. These results suggest that keystroke-based detection depends critically on exposure to diverse writing behaviors, and that strong performance under limited conditions does not generalize to realistic or adversarial settings without targeted modeling.

Abstract: Activation steering provides a lightweight and flexible way to control large language model (LLM) behavior. However, effective steering requires more than inducing the intended behavior: it should also limit unintended changes and remain robust across inputs and training data. Existing evaluations cover these dimensions only in fragments. As a result, the trade-offs between efficacy and side effects have not been systematically characterized. We introduce SteerScope, a two-axis, multi-dimensional evaluation suite that jointly characterizes steering outcomes and method properties through 15 metrics. We score target efficacy and side effects on language quality, task capabilities, and safety and reliability, and further assess generalization and data dependence through steering-specific metrics for sample efficiency and sample sensitivity. Rather than comparing methods at a single operating point, we characterize the trade-offs between efficacy and side effects. Under matched models, tasks, and evaluation protocols, we benchmark 23 methods spanning 4 families, including prompting, LoRA, and SFT as baseline methods, and release the suite as an extensible codebase. We find that current activation steering methods do not yet surpass the Prompt Steering baseline in their overall balance between steering efficacy and side effects: across both model scales, no evaluated activation steering method achieves higher efficacy without incurring greater composite side effects. We further uncover a consistent coupling between steering efficacy and side effects. Under OOD prompts, target efficacy is often preserved, whereas side effects tend to become more pronounced, particularly through declines in instruction relevance and fluency. Methods also exhibit sharply different sample-efficiency profiles.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对MoE视觉语言模型的安全干预方法（提示、监督微调、专家路由操控）存在跨模型和跨评估分布的不一致改进问题，且修改模型行为会引入过度拒绝导致的安全-效用权衡问题。因此需要一种非侵入式的安全检测方法。

Method: 在提示预填充阶段收集所有MoE层在最后一个提示token处的路由器logits，将其拼接为路由表征向量；然后使用带L2正则化的逻辑回归分类器（线性探针）作为外部安全读出器，通过设定阈值在生成前识别不安全请求。该方法重用前向传播中已计算的信号，无需额外VLM前向传播或修改模型参数与路由行为。

Conclusion: 模型内部信号不一定是可靠的控制柄，但可以是有效的诊断信号。MoE路由状态包含高度可预测多模态安全性的信息，通过轻量级外部机制读取这些自然涌现的内部信号，可实现有效且非侵入式的安全防护，为模型安全研究提供了"读取而非操控"的新视角。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) face compositional safety risks where harmful intent emerges from the interaction between visual and textual inputs. As mixture-of-experts (MoE) VLMs become increasingly common, recent work has explored various safety interventions, including prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and routing-based expert steering. However, these methods show inconsistent improvements across models and evaluation distributions, and the intervention into model behavior or internal states introduce safety-utility tradeoffs by over-refusal. Rather than manipulating internal states to steer model behavior, we instead ask whether routing states can serve as diagnostic signals for multimodal safety. We find that router logits indeed provide highly predictive signals of whether a multimodal input is safe or not. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a lightweight router-logit safety detector that reads out routing signals during prompt prefill and identifies unsafe requests before generation, without modifying model parameters or expert routing. Across Qwen3-VL and Kimi-VL, the proposed detector substantially reduces safety errors on the HoliSafe benchmark and resoundingly generalizes to out-of-distribution safety benchmarks featuring different safety patterns, including MISHard and MM-SafetyBench. The success of the proposed router-logit detector also suggests a broader perspective on model internals: rather than focusing only on manipulating internal components to steer behavior, simply reading naturally emerging signals and linking them to an external safety mechanism can provide a simple, effective, and non-intrusive complement to existing safety interventions.

</details>


### [60] [Nucleus Speculative Decoding: Plausibility-Aware Verification Beyond Exact Distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07822)
*Shuhao Li,Fanghua Ye,Wanyu Lin,Tianyu Yuan,Xiaoyu Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"核心采样推测解码"（Nucleus Speculative Decoding, NSD）的宽松验证方法，通过将目标模型的可能性（plausibility）纳入推测解码的验证流程，提高了自回归生成的速度，同时保持了竞争性的任务性能。NSD在标准推测解码基础上增加了一个简单的接受条件：如果草稿令牌属于目标模型的nucleus，则接受它。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准推测解码（SD）的接受规则过于保守：当草稿模型对某令牌分配了超额概率时，即使该令牌在目标模型中仍然高度可信（如图1显示，被SD拒绝的令牌中81.5%排在目标模型前十，52.6%位于top-p=0.95区域内），仍会被拒绝。这限制了每个验证周期保留的草稿令牌数量。论文观察到，目标模型验证占推测解码总时间的57.1%-78.1%，是主要瓶颈。

Method: NSD在每个提议位置构造目标分布的nucleus（top-p集合），接受条件为：草稿令牌通过标准SD验证 **或** 属于目标模型的nucleus。理论上，论文推导出单步TV偏差恰好等于草稿模型在目标nucleus内的超额概率（E_S），并给出了序列级保真度边界：当nucleus接受引入的逐token误差ε_t较小时，NSD与目标解码的耦合一致性概率至少为∏(1-ε_t) ≥ 1 - Tε。NSD不改变草稿机制、残差校正或奖励采样，可与各种推测解码范式结合使用。

Result: 在Nemotron（3B/8B/14B）和Qwen3（4B/8B/14B）模型上，NSD在30组模型-基准对比中始终获得最高吞吐量加速，相对自回归解码最高加速5.16×，相对标准SD最高加速3.15×。平均接受长度τ显著增加。任务性能与SD相当：30组对比中，15组超过SD，14组略低于SD，平均高0.40个百分点。验证时间从每输出令牌5.26ms降至2.72ms（降低48.3%）。分析显示86.5%的额外接受令牌位于nucleus核心区域，94.1%排在目标模型前五。消融实验考察了草稿块大小K（8-32）和nucleus阈值θ（0.85-0.95）的影响。

Conclusion: NSD通过在推测解码验证中考虑可接受性，提供了一种有效且有竞争力的选择——从精确分布校正到有把握的宽松验证。NSD的效率来源是减少验证开销，并通过更高效的API组合和验证策略实现吞吐量提升，同时保持与标准SD竞争的任务性能。这表明宽松验证和可接受性感知验证是设计高效推测解码算法的有效方向。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by using a lightweight draft model to propose multiple tokens that are verified by a target model in parallel. However, the standard acceptance rule focuses on exact distribution correction and rejects tokens that remain highly plausible under the target model when the draft model assigns excess probability. This conservative verification limits the number of draft tokens retained after each verification forward pass. We introduce Nucleus Speculative Decoding (NSD), a relaxed verification method that incorporates target-model plausibility into speculative decoding. NSD accepts a draft token if it satisfies the standard acceptance rule or belongs to the target model's nucleus. We theoretically characterize the distributional deviation introduced by our method and show that the single-step error is exactly determined by the draft model's excess probability within the target nucleus. We further derive sequence-level fidelity bounds that quantify how local deviations accumulate over autoregressive decoding. Experiments across multiple target models and proposal mechanisms demonstrate that NSD consistently improves speculative decoding efficiency while maintaining competitive task performance. Our method achieves throughput speedups of up to $5.16\times$ over autoregressive decoding and up to $3.15\times$ over standard speculative decoding. These improvements coincide with longer accepted lengths, allowing more output tokens to share the cost of each target verification pass. Analysis shows that plausibility-aware verification provides an effective approach for relaxed verification and speculative decoding efficiency. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [61] [OMIT the Action: Measuring Framing-Invariant Omission Bias under Philosophical Disagreement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07847)
*Sihyeon Lee,Jihun Song,Chanwoo Kim,Jiwoo Kum,Chanjun Park*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 OMIT 基准，通过五哲学人格面板分歧模式构建 218 个配对框架场景，衡量 LLM 在道德冲突下的框架不变遗漏偏差，评估八个 LLM 并测试四种推理时干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 遗漏偏差研究存在三大局限：(1) 局限于功利主义-义务论单一冲突轴；(2) 仅使用 13 个配对短场景和少量模型，规模不足以做模型级估计和冲突类型分析；(3) 未探讨缓解策略。作者旨在系统化地评估 LLM 在更广泛哲学冲突下的框架不变遗漏偏差，并探索推理时干预是否能缓解该偏差。

Method: 1) 从 MoralChoice 高模糊度场景出发，通过 LLM 进行镜像框架重构（动作框架 vs 遗漏框架），使两个框架下"不行动"对应不同结果。2) 使用五哲学人格面板（功利主义、义务论、德性伦理、关怀伦理、契约论）作为构建时探针，仅保留在 (Y,N) 与 (N,Y) 间存在分歧的场景，按哲学冲突类型标注。3) 对 8 个 LLM（3 档：小型开源≤12B、大型开源≥27B、闭源）评估遗漏偏差率(OBR)、行动偏差率(ABR)和框架一致率(FCR)。4) 比较四种推理时干预（M1 通用 CoT、M2 反对自答、M3 想象镜像框架、M4 道德原则先于决策的两阶段提示）与基线 M0。5) 额外评估 5 个前沿模型验证泛化性。

Result: 1) 面板过滤场景的 OBR 显著高于随机基线（约 0.30 vs 0.17 vs 0.12），且面板分歧越强 OBR 越高，具有构念效度。2) OBR 跨模型差异显著（0.063-0.550），Gemma-3-12B 最高，Gemini-2.0-flash 最低。3) 同家族内模型规模越大 OBR 越低（Gemma -0.252、Llama -0.381、Qwen -0.109），但规模本身不能消除偏差。4) 低 OBR 不等于稳健：Gemini-2.0-flash OBR 最低但 ABR 最高(0.227)，表明偏差从遗漏方向转移到行动方向。5) M1 和 M4（先考虑道德原则再回答）降低 OBR 并提高 FCR；M2 和 M3 增加 OBR。6) 缓解效果的评估需联合 OBR/ABR/FCR 三者，单看 OBR 可能误导。M4 的两阶段"原则先于决策"机制是关键，即使 M1 未显式要求道德原则，其推理也常自发引入原则性语言。

Conclusion: OMIT 基准证明：(1) 哲学人格面板分歧是识别能暴露遗漏偏差场景的有效构造信号；(2) 遗漏偏差在 LLM 中普遍存在，家族内随规模增大而降低，无模型完全消除；(3) 推理时干预通过在回答前引导道德原则思考可降低 OBR 并提高框架一致性，但部分缓解同时伴随 ABR 升高，偏差从遗漏方向转移到行动方向。因此缓解效果应通过 OBR、ABR、FCR 联合评估，而非仅看 OBR。这表明遗漏偏差可能是 LLM 处理道德冲突时更深层次的模型级倾向，而非表面措辞伪迹，未来工作应探索训练时方法。局限：仅评估 Llama 70B 规模、仅推理时干预、未做机制分析解释遗漏偏差何时转化为行动偏差。

Abstract: As LLMs increasingly assist in moral reasoning, omission bias, the tendency to prefer inaction even when equivalent framings reverse substantive outcomes, poses a significant risk of skewed decision-making. Yet omission bias remains underexplored in LLM evaluation, with the few existing studies limited in scale and focused largely on utilitarian-deontological conflicts. To address this gap, we introduce OMIT, a benchmark consisting of 218 paired-frame scenarios across 10 conflict types, constructed by leveraging disagreement patterns from an LLM-based, five-perspective philosophical persona panel (utilitarianism, deontology, virtue ethics, care ethics, and contractualism). Evaluating eight LLMs, we find that omission bias is pervasive but inversely correlates with model size within families. We further evaluate four inference-time interventions and find that interventions encouraging models to consider moral principles before committing to a yes/no answer reduce omission bias and increase frame-consistent responses, although lower omission bias rates can also coincide with shifts toward action-biased responses. Ultimately, this work contributes not only the OMIT benchmark, but also a methodology for using diverse philosophical disagreement signals to evaluate framing-sensitive inaction preferences and the distributional effects of mitigation attempts in LLMs under complex moral conflicts.

</details>


### [62] [ARIA: Audio-Driven Melody-Tone Relation Modeling for Cantonese Lyric Authoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07902)

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有旋律引导的歌词生成方法依赖符号化旋律输入（如MIDI音符），但实际创作场景中旋律常以原始歌唱音频或哼唱录音形式存在，音高信息隐含、含噪且非结构化，难以直接应用。此外，粤语歌词写作要求词汇声调与旋律音高紧密对齐，传统0243编码是粤语文本与旋律之间的紧凑、可编辑的接口，但此前缺乏从音频直接恢复0243方案的工作。

Method: ARIA采用两阶段框架：(1) TRATE（Tri-Stream Relation-Aware Tone Estimator）——从带字符级时间戳的歌唱音频预测0243序列；提取绝对、轮廓、相对三种声学特征流，通过门控融合和关系感知Transformer编码器建模行内依赖，使用高度头、轮廓族头、寄存器头和成对关系头进行结构化预测。(2) DRA-TCLG（Decoupled Retrieval-Augmented Tone-Conditioned Lyric Generator）——基于Qwen3.5-4B，采用解耦两阶段训练：先学习0243到歌词的基础映射，再用从0243.hk检索的频率感知词典候选词进行LoRA微调。数据集包含10万+对齐的音频-歌词样本和17万+0243-歌词对。

Result: 实验结果显示：(1) 音频到0243预测：TRATE在TokAcc(0.644)、Macro-F1(0.615)、Within±1(0.885)和NED(0.347)上均优于四分位规则基线和Qwen3.5基线。(2) 0243到歌词生成：DRA-TCLG的Harmony(0.9740)和Consistency(0.9421)超越ToneCraft等基线。(3) 端到端音频到歌词管线达到0.9786 Harmony。(4) 消融实验验证三流特征、关系感知建模、门控融合和解耦检索的必要性。(5) 边界扰动测试显示TRATE对±50ms以内的时间戳误差具有鲁棒性。(6) 错误传播分析表明Stage 2基本如实实现而非修正Stage 1预测的方案。

Conclusion: ARIA验证了从真实歌唱音频直接恢复粤语0243音调方案的可行性，并证明了以0243为统一中间表示连接音频分析与可控歌词生成的框架的有效性。TRATE通过声学、轮廓和行内关系的联合建模实现可靠的相对音高结构恢复；DRA-TCLG通过解耦训练策略使检索引导的词汇先验能够稳定提升生成质量。当前局限包括：仍需字符级时间戳、仅限粤语、Stage 1错误传播仍为瓶颈、人工评估规模有限。架构层面设计（两阶段分解、三流建模、关系感知、延迟检索）可迁移至其他语言，但需替换语言特定的资源和控制表示。

Abstract: Cantonese lyric writing requires close alignment between lexical tones and melodic pitch. Existing melody-guided lyric generation methods typically rely on symbolic melody to generate lyrics. However, in real songwriting scenarios, melodies are often expressed as raw singing audio or hummed recordings, where pitch is implicit, noisy, and unstructured, making these methods difficult to apply directly. To address this limitation, we propose ARIA, a two-stage audio-driven melody-tone relation modeling framework for Cantonese lyric authoring that generates Cantonese lyrics from singing recordings with provided character-level timestamps. Specifically, we first design a Tri-Stream Relation-Aware Tone Estimator (TRATE) to predict 0243 sequences from timestamped singing audio by modeling multi-stream acoustic cues and relational tonal structure. We then propose a Decoupled Retrieval-Augmented Tone-Conditioned Lyric Generator (DRA-TCLG) to generate fluent lyrics conditioned on predicted tonal plans with retrieval-enhanced lexical guidance. Moreover, we construct a large-scale aligned audio-Jyutping-0243 dataset from real Cantonese singing recordings to support this new task. Experimental results demonstrate that ARIA achieves strong performance in both 0243 prediction and tone-consistent lyric generation, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [63] [Pseudowords as probes: Large Language Models show little of the sublexical sensitivity that governs human pseudoword processing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07936)
*Jing Chen,Giulia Loca,Simona Amenta,Marco Marelli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究以意大利语假词（pseudoword）为探针，测试了五个大语言模型（GPT-4o、DeepSeek-V3、DeepSeek-R1、o4-mini、Minerva-7B）在两项二选一强制选择任务中与人类行为的一致性，并与 fastText 字符 n-gram 模型进行对比。结果表明：LLM 在仅含假词的条件下与人类一致性显著低于 fastText；驱动人–fastText 一致性的亚词汇余弦相似度线索（D_cos）未能可靠地迁移到人–LLM 一致性上；推理模型的推理 token 消耗与人类处理难度之间无一致关联。研究将这一亚词汇敏感性缺失归因于分词机制（tokenization）和训练数据覆盖（尤其是意大利语在英语主导语料中的代表性不足）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言的系统性（systematicity）使亚词汇形式–意义线索能够引导人类对假词的加工，而 fastText 已能可靠预测此类判断。然而，LLM 是否同样对这些亚词汇线索敏感尚不清楚——尤其因为 LLM 使用基于频率的子词分词，可能破坏对人类读者有意义的形–义线索，而假词作为完全 OOV 字符串，正是隔离并检验亚词汇敏感性的理想探针。

Method: 复现 Gatti 等人（2024）的两项意大利语 2AFC 假词实验。EXP1：目标真词 + 一个相关假词 + 一个无关假词；EXP2：目标假词 + 一个相关真词 + 一个无关真词。测试五个 LLM（GPT-4o、DeepSeek-V3、o4-mini、DeepSeek-R1、Minerva-7B-instruct），设置基线与角色扮演两种提示条件，每个条件迭代三次。以多数投票聚合模型回答后，用截距项二项 GLMM 评估人–模型试次级一致性；用含 D_cos（fastText 余弦差）、长度差、Levenshtein 距离差及词频差的 GLMM 检验亚词汇预测因子；用 Pearson 与偏相关检验推理 token 数与人类 RT 及响应熵 H_i 的关系；并以二分半信度（Spearman-Brown 校正）验证 H_i 作为刺激难度指标的有效性。

Result: （1）人–模型一致性：EXP1（双假词）中仅 Minerva-7B 基线条件下显著高于几率（58.8%，p=.018），其余模型均不显著，且所有 LLM 均远低于 fastText（66.3%）；EXP2（含真词）中四个前沿模型达到或略超 fastText 水平（58.1%），Minerva-7B 仍处于几率水平。（2）亚词汇预测因子：fastText 中可靠的 D_cos 效应未一致迁移至 LLM，仅 DeepSeek-R1 在 EXP2 显著（β̂=0.35，p=.008）。（3）推理努力：仅 o4-mini 在 EXP1 出现 RT 与 token 数正相关（r=.28，p=.046），DeepSeek-R1 全程无显著关联；token 数与 H_i 也仅 o4-mini 在 EXP2 显著。（4）角色扮演提示对一致性无显著影响（EXP1 p=.621；EXP2 p=.539）。

Conclusion: LLM 并未与人类共享支配假词加工的亚词汇形式–意义线索。在纯假词条件下，LLM 表现远逊于 fastText；驱动人–fastText 一致的余弦相似度线索无法可靠预测人–LLM 一致性；推理模型的计算努力与人类处理难度亦无系统对应。作者提出两种可能的解释：（a）分词机制——LLM 的频率驱动子词切分可能将形–义线索碎片化甚至破坏之，使 fastText 的全 n-gram 覆盖优势凸显；（b）训练数据覆盖——意大利语在英语主导语料中代表性不足，Minerva-7B 作为唯一以意大利语为主要训练语言的模型在 EXP1 中表现最佳，间接支持该解释。两种解释互不排斥：分词词表本身也从同一倾斜语料中习得，低资源语言的切分可能更具破坏性。局限在于亚词汇预测因子与 token–RT 相关分析仅基于 50 个项目，统计功效受限；训练数据与亚词汇加工的相对贡献也需在更高资源语言中复现以厘清。

Abstract: Systematicity, the probabilistic mapping of form to meaning, permeates language at all levels, and sublexical cues have been shown to govern human pseudoword processing. Yet whether LLMs exhibit comparable sensitivity to these cues remains unclear. We tested five LLMs on two Italian two-alternative forced-choice pseudoword experiments and compared their responses with a human behavioural baseline. LLMs aligned more reliably with humans when real-word options provided a lexical familiarity cue than in the pseudoword-only condition, where they fell substantially below fastText, a character-n-gram model. In addition, the sublexical cosine-similarity cue that reliably drove human--fastText agreement did not consistently transfer to human--LLM alignment, and reasoning-token expenditure bore no consistent relation to human processing difficulty. These findings suggest that LLMs do not necessarily share the sublexical cues that govern human pseudoword processing; we discuss tokenization and training-data coverage as candidate explanations.

</details>

TL;DR: 本文针对Redpine Science（一个面向生物医学领域的检索增强生成/RAG系统）提出了一种"四象限"评估框架，分别从"问题来源（公开基准 vs. 内部构建）"与"测量目标（生成端答案 vs. 检索端结果）"两个维度交叉组合，全面评估系统在检索与生成两环节的独立贡献，并在四个维度上与基线方法（无检索、Web搜索、Exa、Tavily、PubMed）进行了系统对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG系统评估通常将两个独立环节——检索（是否返回相关文献）与生成（模型是否基于检索内容给出准确回答）——混合报告为一个综合分数，导致无法分辨性能提升究竟来自检索改善还是生成改善；此外，公开基准常面临饱和（模型可凭记忆作答）与污染问题，难以真实反映RAG增益。因此作者主张将检索与生成效应分离，并同时使用公开基准与专家构建题集以避免单一来源偏差。

Method: 四象限评估框架：Q1（公开基准×QA）使用ScholarQABench SciFact的208条生物医学声明，以Claude Sonnet 5为代理在4种工具配置（无工具、Web搜索、Redpine、Web搜索作为补充）下各运行5次取均值；Q2（内部基准×QA）使用179道由领域专家依据单一论文构建的循证题（含105道开放获取+74道付费获取），涉及四个临床方向，由Claude Opus 5在Web搜索与Web搜索+Redpine两种配置下作答，使用Sonnet 5与Jev双评判器并引入prediction-powered inference与专家标签校准；Q3（公开基准×检索）使用Exa发布文献检索基准中Redpine语料库覆盖的668条查询，对比Redpine、Exa与Tavily在Recall@1/5/10与nDCG@10上的表现；Q4（内部基准×检索）由3位临床博士在盲法下对115道题（90专科+25互评）按0–4相关性量表对Redpine与PubMed的前5条结果打分，比较Precision@5与DCG@5。

Result: Q1：SciFact上Redpine准确率达94.4%，无检索基线为87.6%，Web搜索为93.1%；Q2：Redpine覆盖了80.1%的金标准声明，Web搜索仅70.2%，差异+10.0pp（p=6×10⁻⁶），付费文献子集差异更显著（+14.6pp vs. 开放获取的+6.7pp），专家标签与自动评判方向一致；Q3：在668条查询上Redpine Recall@10为83.1%，超过Exa（79.3%）和Tavily（60.9%），Recall@1领先Exa 6.9pp；Q4：Redpine Precision@5为75.2%，PubMed仅为39.8%，平均DCG@5为7.26 vs. 4.02。但专家间一致性仅中等（Krippendorff α=0.49–0.53），未达到预设的可靠性阈值，因此未对评判器下充分性结论。

Conclusion: 四象限方法可有效将RAG系统的检索贡献与生成贡献解耦。Redpine Science在生物医学RAG任务上全面优于无检索、Web搜索及主要竞品，尤其在付费/受限文献上的优势最显著，表明高质量、经过授权的全文语料库是提升临床循证问答质量的关键资产。然而，自动评判器与人类专家之间的一致性仍属中等区间，提示自动化评估在临床领域仍需谨慎校准；作者将四套基准及完整复现脚本开源，推动RAG评估的标准化。

Abstract: Redpine Science gives models and agents a single access point to a wide range of peer-reviewed literature, queried directly through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and an API. This report evaluates Redpine Science on two levels: the relevance of the retrieved chunks, and a model's answer when it has access to Redpine Science compared to web search. Both public and expert-validated benchmarks are used. Public benchmarks are a widely accepted way to test model development and are comparable across labs, but risk saturation and memorization. To address this, we complement them with an expert-validated question set. In total, this report presents four evaluations. On ScholarQABench SciFact, the public answer-quality benchmark reported here, an agent with Redpine Science answers 94.4% of claims correctly against 87.6% with no retrieval. On the expert-validated question set, an agent with Redpine Science states 80.1% of the required claims against 70.2% for an agent restricted to web search. On the 668 queries of a public retrieval benchmark whose gold paper Redpine holds, stripped of any model reasoning, Redpine Science places the correct source paper in its top ten results for 83.1% of queries (Recall@10), against 79.3% for the benchmark's creator. A blinded expert relevance panel places Redpine Science's Precision@5 at 75.2% against 39.8% for the PubMed search tool. We release the expert-validated question set and instructions to reproduce every headline result above, at this https URL .

*Kyojun Choo,Minsoo Song,Yunju Kang,Chanjun Park*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍TACIT框架，通过对四个开源LLM家族的预生成隐藏状态进行线性探测，研究用户查询所隐含的外部能力需求是否可线性解码，并发现"结构化但沉默"现象：能力信息在隐藏表征中线性可访问，但模型无法通过自然语言可靠表达。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具使用方法主要关注是否触发工具或匹配API描述，忽略了选择具体工具前必须先推断查询所隐含的能力需求这一基本前提。此外，先前的表征分析局限于工具触发的二元判断，未探索细粒度、多维度的能力结构是否在生成前的隐藏状态中被编码。

Method: 提出TACIT三轴能力框架（Source/Transformation/World Effect，定义八个结构化能力类别）；使用1,600条平衡训练查询（来自基准、合成示例和新领域场景）；对四个开源LLM家族（Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen 3 8B、Gemma 2 9B、Mistral 7B v0.3）在预生成隐藏状态上训练ℓ₂正则化逻辑回归线性探针；在920查询主测试集和220查询欺骗性评估集上，与TF-IDF、N-gram和E5句子嵌入基线以及四样本语言化分类进行比较。

Conclusion: 查询侧的能力需求在预生成隐藏表征中可靠地线性可解码，但同一模型无法通过显式语言化可靠表达相同的标签。这一系统性的表征-语言化差距为诊断LLM内部能力信息与生成行为之间的不一致提供了新视角，未来工作应探索探针表征是否因果影响工具选择以及是否能改进智能体执行。

Abstract: Reliable tool use requires more than triggering a mechanism or matching a query to an API description. Before selecting a specific tool, an agent must first infer the capability requirements implied by the user query. In this paper, we investigate whether these query-side capability requirements are linearly decodable from LLM hidden representations prior to generation, and how this hidden-state accessibility compares with explicit verbal classification. We introduce TACIT, a framework that decomposes external requirements along three fundamental axes: Source, Transformation, and World Effect, defining eight structurally distinct capability classes. Using 1,600 balanced training queries from benchmarks, synthetic examples, and new domain scenarios, we train linear probes on pre-generation hidden states from four open-weight LLM families. Our empirical results demonstrate that fine-grained capability structures are linearly decodable with high accuracy across all models. Crucially, however, we expose a representation-to-verbalization gap: these same models are significantly less reliable when asked to explicitly classify the same queries in natural language. This disconnect indicates that information about required external capabilities is linearly accessible in LLM hidden representations but not reliably expressed, a phenomenon we define as "structured but silent."

### [66] [The Labeling Problem in Hallucination Detection Benchmarks: An Empirical Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08026)
*Jorma Valjakka,Juhani Kivimäki,Juha Mylläri,Jukka K. Nurminen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文系统性地揭示了大语言模型(LLM)幻觉检测基准测试中一个被忽视的关键问题:自动化标签策略所测量的"参考忠实性"(reference faithfulness)与基准测试声称要测量的"事实正确性"(factual correctness)之间存在系统性标准错配,产生大量假阳性错误,进而污染幻觉检测器的评估结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有幻觉检测基准测试普遍依赖自动标签策略(如ROUGE-L、BERTScore、NLI模型或LLM评判器)将LLM生成的答案与参考答案对比来标记幻觉,但这些策略通常实际执行的是"参考忠实性"标准——即把答案中未被参考支持的内容都视为幻觉——而许多基准测试声称要评估的却是"事实正确性"。当LLM给出正确但带有参考之外真实补充信息的答案时,这两种标准会产生分歧,导致忠实性标签器将事实上正确的"润色"误标为幻觉(系统性假阳性偏差)。这一构造级错配此前未被作为开放域QA基准测试中自动标签误差的来源进行专门分析。

Method: 论文构建了一个900对人工标注的问答基准(300道题×3个生成器:TriviaQA/HotpotQA/TruthfulQA × Llama-3-8B/Gemma-2-9B/Mistral-7B),两名标注员独立标注300题子集,Cohen's κ=0.808(95% CI [0.729, 0.879])。标注协议以"事实正确性"为目标,采用"先参考后外部"程序,区分矛盾与缺失,不对正确润色扣分。评估的自动标签源涵盖三类家族:(1)词汇相似度指标(ROUGE-L、BERTScore,含oracle阈值与3折CV阈值);(3)参考蕴含NLI基线(T5-11B,strict与oracle两种设置);(3)七个LLM评判器(API: GPT-5-mini、GPT-5-nano、GPT-5.4、Claude Opus 4.7;本地开源: Gemma-2-9B、Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3-8B),采用三种受控提示变体p1(忠实型)/p2(事实正确型)/p3(扩展事实正确型)。评估指标包括Cohen's κ、正负标签偏差、FP/FN计数、FP%以及McNemar检验与bootstrap置信区间,并通过p1s/p2t因子对照实验分离"标签标准"与"提示结构"两个变量。

Result: 主要发现:(1)忠实型p1提示在所有API评判器上呈现强烈的假阳性主导偏差(GPT-5.4在Mistral上FP%达100%);(2)将p1替换为事实正确型p2在大多数评判器-生成器配对上显著提升与人工标签的一致性(GPT-5-mini上McNemar p<0.0001),且大幅降低假阳性主导;p3相比p2无统计显著改善,说明效应在p1→p2之间饱和;(3)因子对照实验证实改善主要来自标准对齐而非提示结构;(4)前沿模型能力并非充分条件——GPT-5.4和Claude Opus 4.7在相同p1提示下行为差异巨大,但在p2下趋同;(5)非LLM基线在不同方向失败:strict NLI几乎完全假阳性主导(FP% 98.3-99.4%),ROUGE-L多为假阴性倾向,BERTScore混合;严格NLI的最佳oracle阈值崩塌至τ=0.01;(6)Llama-3-8B作为评判器在p2/p3下转向假阴性主导,显示小型本地模型的稳健性局限;(7)跨方法κ矩阵中,标准对齐评判器形成一致的协议块,词汇指标、strict NLI与忠实型p1与其他标签源一致性较弱。论文最后给出三条实践建议:基准论文应明确声明标准、当目标是事实正确性时应在提示中显式区分"矛盾"与"缺失"并允许正确润色、应在小型人工标注集上先验证自动标签源是否对齐目标标准。

Conclusion: 论文结论是,在短参考答案开放域QA中,"幻觉"这一二元标签背后的构建标准并不一致,基于参考忠实性的自动标签源会系统性惩罚事实正确的答案,构成对事实正确性基准的测量误差。标签源选择不是可互换的实现细节,而是基准设计的基本组成部分:基准应明确声明目标(参考忠实性还是事实正确性),自动标签源应针对该目标进行验证。一条最小但关键的规则是:仅当信息与参考答案矛盾或在具体可验证细节上事实错误时才应标记为幻觉;单纯未出现在参考答案中不应被自动视为幻觉。

Abstract: In recent years, several methods for detecting when large language models (LLMs) hallucinate have been developed. These methods are often benchmarked with open-domain question answering (QA) datasets containing questions and corresponding short reference answers. First, an LLM is used to generate answers to questions within the QA dataset. Then, some automated labeling strategy is used to label these answers as hallucinated or not by comparing them with the reference answers in the dataset. This evaluation setting creates a methodological ambiguity between two criteria: reference faithfulness (whether the answer is fully supported by the reference) and factual correctness (whether the answer is free from contradictions and factually false specific claims). In practice, automated labelers may apply the former criterion even when the intended target is the latter. We study this potential criterion mismatch using 900 human-labeled question-answer pairs spanning three commonly used QA datasets and three generator models, with labels targeting answer-level factual correctness. We evaluate lexical similarity metrics, a reference-entailment NLI baseline, and seven LLM judges under controlled prompt variants as automated labelers. Our experiments reveal substantial disagreement both among automated labeling strategies and between these labels and human annotations. Many strategies also exhibit strong directional error biases, and for most judge-generator pairs, replacing a faithfulness-oriented prompt with a factual-correctness prompt improves agreement with human annotations and reduces false-positive dominance, indicating that automated hallucination labels depend strongly on how the target criterion is specified. Label-source choice should therefore be considered a fundamental part of benchmark design and made explicit, validated, and matched with the benchmark goal.

</details>


### [67] [Are Language Models Script-Aware?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08037)
*David Kletz,Sandra Mitrović,Ljiljana Dolamić,Fabio Rinaldi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了大小语言模型（SLMs和LLMs）对书写系统（script）的认知能力，即是否能选择和控制输出所用的文字。通过在多种多书写系统语言（克里米亚鞑靼语、哈萨克语、塞尔维亚语）和单书写系统语言（法语、英语）上的两类实验——脚本保真度与脚本指令遵循——发现模型具有显著的脚本知识，能自适应输入脚本并遵循明确指令，但在非标准组合下表现下降，且LLMs明显优于SLMs。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的"脱靶生成"（off-target generation）研究多聚焦语言层面的语言选择错误，而忽视了更基础的脚本/文字符号层面。脚本是用户可读性的前提，且许多语言存在多脚本现象（如塞尔维亚语用拉丁与西里尔，哈萨克语用拉丁、西里尔与阿拉伯），因此需要系统评估模型是否真正"理解"脚本作为可独立操控的实体。训练语料高度偏向拉丁脚本（如mBERT词汇量中超77%为拉丁），导致脚本相关的系统性偏差，影响低资源语言用户。

Method: 数据：选用克里米亚鞑靼语（拉丁/西里尔）、哈萨克语（拉丁/西里尔/阿拉伯）、塞尔维亚语（拉丁/西里尔）作为多脚本语言，法语、英语作为单脚本控制语言；每语随机抽取1000条至少100字符的问题。模型：5个开源SLM（Llama-2-7B-Chat、Mistral-7B-Instruct、Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct、Qwen1.5-7B-Chat、DeepSeek-Distill-Llama-8B）和6个API LLM（GPT-4o/mini、DeepSeek-Chat、Claude-Haiku/Sonnet、Gemini-Flash/Lite）。两个互补实验：(1)脚本保真度——测量输出脚本与输入脚本匹配率；(2)脚本强制——通过显式指令要求指定脚本输出，匹配率作为衡量。词表覆盖率用Heaps定律归一化（log V / log N），并用glotLID识别脚本。用LLM-as-a-judge（gpt-5-nano）对10%响应做事实性与完整性质量评估，并补充SLM的perplexity分析。

Result: （1）脚本保真度：所有模型对拉丁输入接近完美保真（最低98.9%），但西里尔输入保真度差异大，从Llama-2-7B的13.4%到DeepSeek-Chat的98%；模型规模不决定保真度。（2）脚本强制：自然语言-脚本组合（如法语-拉丁、哈萨克-西里尔、塞尔维亚-西里尔）分数最高（常达100%），非标准组合（哈萨克-阿拉伯、法语-西里尔人工组合）显著下降；LLMs对非标准组合优势明显（如法语-西里尔：LLM 71.8 vs SLM 16.0）；哈萨克-阿拉伯常逊于人工的法语-西里尔；塞尔维亚-拉丁优于塞尔维亚-西里尔，反映拉丁脚本南斯拉夫语言（克罗地亚语、波斯尼亚语）跨语言干扰。提示语言本身可带来10-12分的波动。（3）质量评估：切换脚本后事实性与完整性变化大多在0–10分内，说明语义准确性与脚本控制能力相对独立。（4）异常模型：Qwen1.5-7B严重偏向生成中文，即使拉丁输入保真度仅63.9%。词汇覆盖在多数语言-脚本对均衡（0.55–1.1），但哈萨克-阿拉伯较低（~0.6）。

Conclusion: 当前语言模型已具备显著的脚本认知，超出简单模式匹配：能根据输入调整输出脚本，也能遵循显式脚本指令。但知识不均衡：对拉丁脚本保真度一致较高，对西里尔可变；对自然组合处理更可靠，对非标准组合明显退化；LLMs在灵活脚本操控上显著优于SLMs，尤其在非标准请求中。提示建议：在请求特定脚本输出时，使用相同脚本的提示能降低模型不确定性。局限：依赖glotLID分类（可能有误判）；所研究语言多为低/中资源，训练数据本身可能偏向特定脚本；仅考察一个人工配对（法语-西里尔）。未来可扩展更多人工/罕见脚本组合，并探究Qwen类异常行为的根源。

Abstract: Language models frequently generate outputs in unintended languages or scripts, a phenomenon known as off-target generation. While existing research has focused on language selection, the dimension of script knowledge remains understudied: before any linguistic understanding can occur, users must recognize the graphic symbols in a model's response. We investigate whether Small and Large Language Models (SLMs and LLMs) possess script knowledge by testing them on multi-scriptic languages. Through two complementary experiments, we evaluate whether models (1) adapt their output script to match the input, and (2) follow explicit instructions to generate text in a specified script. The models we tested demonstrate substantial script knowledge: they all achieve a near-perfect Latin script fidelity (more than 98%) and follow script instructions with high frequency. Nevertheless, we notice differences between LLMs and SLMs, with higher scores for LLMs including for non-standard script combinations.

</details>


### [68] [DirectSpeech2LLM: A Simple End-to-End Framework to Mitigate Prompt Overfitting in Speech-LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08085)
*Hemant Yadav,Sunayana Sitaram,Roger Zimmermann,Rajiv Ratn Shah*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出DirectSpeech2LLM，一种简单的端到端框架，旨在解决Speech-LLMs在仅使用ASR指令训练后无法泛化到新指令（如语音翻译、情感识别）的prompt overfitting问题。该方法通过基于距离的CTC损失在冻结的LLM嵌入矩阵上计算，并利用贪心CTC标签获得几何和时间对齐的语音嵌入直接输入LLM。仅使用960小时LibriSpeech ASR数据训练，在ASR任务上超越级联系统，并在零样本语音翻译和情感识别上接近级联系统上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Speech-LLMs通常在ASR任务上微调后，即使使用不同提示（如翻译或问答），模型仍主要表现为ASR系统，丧失了LLM原有的指令跟随泛化能力（prompt overfitting）。作者假设原因有二：(1) SFM输出嵌入空间（SFM-OES）未与LLM输入嵌入空间（LLM-IES）进行几何约束；(2) 固定时间下采样与语音的可变时间动态不一致。

Method: DirectSpeech2LLM包含两个阶段：Stage 1使用修改的CTC目标（基于负平方距离计算logits），将LLM嵌入矩阵作为固定码本，通过VQ实现几何对齐，并通过贪心CTC标签动态下采样实现时间对齐；Stage 2加入冻结LLM的交叉熵损失进行端到端微调。CTC词表通过在LibriSpeech转录上训练BPE并与LLM词表取交集构建。SFM为Data2Vec-Large，LLM使用Qwen3-4B和Phi3.1-3.8B。损失函数为L_ctc + L_commit + λ_llm·L_llm。

Result: 在LibriSpeech ASR上（Qwen3-4B）取得2.21/4.28 WER（test-clean/test-other），超越级联系统和AlignFormer。零样本语音翻译（CoVoST2 en-de/en-zh）BLEU达19.97/33.74，零样本情感识别（IEMOCAP）准确率40.16，IFR=1.00，接近级联上限。扩大数据至2.8k或扩大模型至8B均能进一步提升性能。移除commitment loss影响很小（19.97→19.69 BLEU），表明隐式几何约束已足够；而Wav2Prompt移除MSE则从13.8降至5.4 BLEU，对比凸显本文方法对几何对齐强度不敏感的优势。

Conclusion: DirectSpeech2LLM通过统一的修改CTC目标在时间和几何两个维度上将SFM-OES对齐到冻结的LLM-IES，有效缓解prompt overfitting，仅需单一ASR任务训练即可在零样本场景下保持LLM的指令跟随能力。模型具有三种独立运行模式（独立CTC ASR、CTC+n-gram LM、端到端Speech-LLM），并在两个LLM家族上展现一致的可扩展性。未来工作方向包括多任务多语言设置、blank embedding的副语言信息建模、长语音推理以及使用teacher模型扩展半监督训练。

Abstract: Speech-LLMs often exhibit prompt overfitting, where models solely trained on automatic speech recognition (ASR) instruction fail to generalize to new instructions such as speech translation and continue to behave primarily as ASR system. We propose DirectSpeech2LLM, a simple end-to-end framework that preserves the instruction-following ability of the LLM on unseen tasks when conditioned on speech. It computes distance-based CTC loss over the frozen LLM embedding matrix and uses greedy CTC labels to derive geometrically and temporally aligned speech embeddings respectively as an input to the LLM. Trained solely on 960 hours of LibriSpeech ASR data, DirectSpeech2LLM outperforms the cascaded system on ASR (seen task) and generalizes zero-shot to speech translation and emotion recognition (two unseen tasks), closely matching the cascaded system upper bound on these two new instructions despite seeing neither during training. We also find that geometric alignment strength plays a smaller role than previously assumed, as our modified CTC loss is shown to provide sufficient implicit geometric grounding without requiring an explicit regression loss. Results are consistent across two LLM families and scale with both more training data and model capacity.

</details>

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验研究了长对话记忆中两个关键参数——层级深度(D)和上下文宽度(W)——对问答质量与token效率的交互影响,发现增加宽度比增加深度更有效,主张未来研究应聚焦于大而连贯的上下文块而非更深的层级结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM长期记忆系统普遍采用分层结构(主题、事件、因果/时间图),但深度(Depth)与重构上下文宽度(Width)通常作为耦合架构属性被联合变化,缺乏作为独立受控参数的系统研究。本文旨在通过受控实验分离这两个变量,探究它们对答案质量与token效率的独立及交互影响。

Method: 使用EverMemBench数据集(多轮多方对话,2,996条消息,127个问题),构建Memory Writer与Hierarchy Writer生成事件卡与因果-主题映射;Production Router通过混合词法-语义检索排序节点和卡片,Context Packer在宽度预算内填充源块。在Dev集上开发协议,在Main集(89题)上冻结22个条件(D1-D4 × 1K/2K/4K核心矩阵 + D1扩展至8K/16K/32K/全图 + Oracle 6条件),使用Grok 4.3作为reader,text-embedding-3-small作为嵌入模型(α=0.65),采用Accuracy、TPCA(每正确答案token数)、evidence recall、Q-hit四个指标,结合McNemar检验+Holm校正进行统计推断。

Result: 主要结果:1)在每个深度下,宽度从1K增至4K使Accuracy提升10.11-17.98百分点(支持H1);2)深度未带来单调增益——4K处排序为D1(60.67%)>D3(55.06%)>D4(52.81%)>D2(48.31%),D1-Dx差异未通过联合Holm校正(H2未正式检验);3)Production D1在8K-16K处Accuracy达64-69.66%,之后32K与全图条件下停滞(67-69.66%)而TPCA持续翻倍(支持H3);4)Oracle在68-71K全档案下保持74.16% Accuracy,未见reader退化,但Gold-only与各宽度对比无显著差异。Q-hit达96.63%时Accuracy仅60.67%,说明检索到证据不等于答案正确。

Conclusion: 研究表明,在本设定下增加层级深度未带来可靠收益,而增加上下文宽度收益显著但存在8-16K后的效率平台期。作者提出未来方向:记忆应设计为对少量大型、因果与主题连贯块的浅层索引,索引选块、模型在块内推理,而非追求事实的最大化原子分解。需进一步研究事件边界定义、跨块链接与路由成本的可扩展方案。

Abstract: Long-term conversational memory is becoming an integral component of modern LLM systems. Proposed architectures group records by topics and events, construct hierarchies and graphs, and connect facts through causal and temporal relations. We experimentally study the interaction between two memory parameters: structural depth and the width of context supplied to the answer model. Using EverMemBench, we evaluate depths D1-D4, core budgets of 1,024/2,048/4,096 tokens, and additional Production and Oracle conditions up to the full archive. Increasing width from 1K to 4K improves Accuracy by 10.11-17.98 percentage points, whereas increasing depth provides no monotonic gain. Beyond 8-16K, Production performance reaches a plateau while tokens per correct answer continue to increase; Oracle preserves quality on full archives of 68-71K tokens. These results motivate further investigation of large, coherent context blocks instead of progressively deeper memory structures.

</details>


### [70] [Language Unalignability: Why Some Concepts Resist Cross-Cultural Benchmark Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08303)
*Shu-Kai Hsieh,Da-Chen Lian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"语言不可对齐性"（Language Unalignability）概念，挑战多语言LLM评估中隐含的"翻译同构假设"（TIA）。基于"使用云"（usage cloud）框架，将概念表示为上下文嵌入的点集，形式化定义α-不可对齐性：从行为证据（FLORES-200与LOBSTER分析）、机制证据（Yami语言九模型案例研究中的"表示-干预差距"），到四指标诊断剖面（循环一致性、语用负载分歧、流形曲率失配、RIG），论证部分概念（如语用标记、敬语、历时分层术语）在结构上无法跨语言保真映射。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多语言LLM评估依赖隐含的翻译同构假设（TIA），假设跨语言语义结构同构且无损可映射。这一假设不仅在实践中被违反，对某些类型学可识别的概念类别（语用标记、敬语、证据标记、历时负载术语）而言在原则上就是不适定的。这种"概率扁平化"抹杀了文化差异，亟需在评估范式中得到正视。

Method: 1）使用云框架：将概念表示为上下文嵌入的点集Φ_L(C,t)，而非词汇类型；2）形式化两个保真度条件——词汇保真（M1，质心对应）与结构保真（M2，局部邻域拓扑对应），定义α-不可对齐性为不存在同时满足两者的映射；3）三条结构路径：语用负载不对称（A）、历时非平稳性（B）、范畴不对应（C）；4）行为证据：FLORES-200跨204语言评估（Gemini-2.5-Flash）显示语系与资源类是翻译质量显著预测因子但文字不是；LOBSTER显示语系差异；5）机制证据：九个模型（Qwen3、Gemma3、SeaLLMs-v3、SEA-LION-v4、NLLB-200）的Yami案例研究，采用LAPE（Language Activation Probability Entropy）方法识别语言特异神经元并以LoRA掩码微调；6）四指标诊断剖面：循环一致性（CC）、语用负载分歧（PLD）、流形曲率失配（MCM）、表示-干预差距（RIG）。

Result: 1）Yami激活剖面分析：九个模型中Yami的最近邻均为南岛语言，激活距离与FineWeb-2语料大小呈强相关（Pearson r=0.879）；2）LAPE掩码LoRA对比随机掩码LoRA（控制稀疏度匹配）在所有条件下均无显著优势（BLEU上Cohen's d_z ∈ [-0.18, +0.17]，95%稳定区间包含零）；3）LAPE掩码LoRA劣于无约束标准LoRA（d_z ∈ [-2.64, -1.45]）；4）系属代理掩码（菲律宾语、泛南岛语、英语）均劣于不相关语言负控制，颠覆系属直觉；6）亲属代词掩码与普通话掩码Jaccard重叠极低，排除了简单的"普通话附带损伤"假说；7）跨对训练导致NLLB-200在Yami→中文方向上出现大量空预测，揭示细粒度的失稳模式。

Conclusion: 1）跨文化对齐不是单一良定义目标，而是一组互不相容的投射；2）某些概念在结构上不可对齐，将其压缩为单一标量评估指标会奖励"概率扁平化"行为；3）存在表示-干预差距：模型激活中编码的规律性不一定可被基于局部化的干预所利用；4）仅靠数据量无法消除该结构失真，需采用(M2)条件化监督（释义集目标、语用语境条件损失）；5）建议用四指标剖面⟨CC, PLD, MCM, RIG⟩替代单一标量排名，并按类型学特征分层、加入历时项、允许多个语用语境登记版本。

Abstract: Current evaluation of multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) rests on an implicit Translation-Isomorphism Assumption (TIA): that semantic structures across languages are congruent and mutually mappable without loss of information. We argue that this assumption is not merely violated in practice, but ill-posed in principle for a typologically identifiable class of concepts, including pragmatic markers, honorifics, and diachronically stratified terms. We formalize this failure using a usage-cloud framework, representing concepts as point sets of contextualized embeddings. We define $\alpha$-unalignability as the impossibility of any mapping that simultaneously preserves lexical faithfulness (centroid correspondence) and structural faithfulness (local neighborhood topology). We provide three layers of evidence. Behaviorally, we show that FLORES-200 translation failures are predicted by language family and resource class but not by script, and that LOBSTER reasoning scores vary by family. Mechanistically, we report a Representation-Intervention Gap (RIG) in a nine-model case study on Yami: the models' activations encode a regularity along which Yami groups with other low-resource and Austronesian languages, yet interventions on language-specific neurons show no demonstrated advantage over random masks: the regularity is visible but not usable by this intervention. Finally, we operationalize these findings into a multidimensional diagnostic profile: Cycle-Consistency, Pragmatic-Load Disagreement, Manifold-Curvature Mismatch, and RIG. We argue that collapsing cultural competence into a single scalar incentivizes "probabilistic flattening," and that recognizing the unalignable class is a precondition for AI that respects, rather than erases, cultural divergence. This suggests that multilingual alignment is not a single well-defined objective, but a set of mutually incompatible projections.

</details>


### [71] [Incidental information contaminates patient notes and disrupts clinical reasoning in large language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08585)
*Krithik Vishwanath,Brandon Ye,Anton Alyakin,John E. Markert,Aaron Hsieh,Michał Mańkowski,Eric K. Oermann*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了大语言模型在临床文档生成与推理中对"非患者相关信息"（闲聊、旁观者信息、背景语音）的敏感性，提出并初步验证了"双重编码假设"——即负责临床推理的模型组件同样易受干扰信息影响，导致文档污染且通用质量评分无法捕获此类错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM被广泛用于环境式文档（ambient documentation）和临床推理支持，其对患者会诊中无关信息（小对话、背景语音）的鲁棒性成为部署安全的核心问题。此前研究已发现LLM在医学考试题目中受无关医学信息干扰，但该故障模式对真实临床文档的影响及机制尚不清楚。通用笔记质量评分可能无法检测到"归属错误"——即无关内容被错误归属于患者并影响诊疗计划。

Method: 1. 构建MedDistractNotes基准：在576个患者-医生对话（ACI-Bench 77个完整访问+MTS-Dialog 500个短摘录）中插入与患者无关的小对话（旁观者型：他人非传染性疾病/择期手术；非字面型：医学术语的非临床用法），生成clean-distracted配对；评估4个前沿模型（GPT-5.4/5.6 Sol、Claude Opus/Fable 5.1）和4个开源权重模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B、Gemma-2-9B）生成的SOAP笔记，使用配对LLM评委检测目标特异性污染和归属错误。
2. 构建MedDistractAudio基准：在57个PriMock57模拟会诊上叠加另一会诊的5-15秒语音片段（-20至-5 dB四个背景水平），由Whisper large-v3转录后由4个开源模型生成笔记。
3. 提出双重编码假设的机制验证：在MedDistractQA（1273道USMLE题）上开发"对比因果头门控"（CCHG），识别区分clean与distracted输入的注意力头；通过激活patching（用clean激活替换）和抑制实验测试这些头是否同时支持临床推理。

Result: MedDistractNotes：前沿模型将插入内容写入35.0%的笔记（Claude Opus 5高达67.6%，GPT-5.4仅8.9%）；开源模型污染率达50.1%。3.7%的前沿笔记错误归属或临床使用旁观者内容（如将同事的"冠心病支架"变成患者病史、将咖啡店名"Delirium"解释为认知筛查指征、将游戏玩笑当作焦虑筛查触发器）。开源模型归属错误占25.7%，远高于前沿的2.0%。污染率随转录长度递减（最短五分位60.1 pp → 最长17.0 pp）。标准5分质量评分几乎不变（前沿≤0.20分），无法捕获污染。
MedDistractAudio：-10 dB时48.2%的混合转录泄漏背景语音词，5.3%的下游笔记被污染（混合-清洁差3.9 pp，-5 dB达8.6 pp）。泄漏与污染强相关（11.5% vs 0.6%）。
机制：旁观者与非字面干扰选出的注意力头高度重叠（Jaccard 0.39-0.78 vs 随机0.008-0.1）。在distracted输入上patching清洁激活可恢复6.3-16.5 pp准确率（7/8条件显著）；抑制相同头部使clean问题准确率下降24.4-37.8 pp，远超随机头部抑制（-9.4至+0.8 pp）。提示忽略无关信息或思维链方法均无法稳定改善。

Conclusion: LLM临床文档系统存在系统性"污染-归属"失败模式，通用质量评分无法检测；前沿与开源模型在错误性质上分化（前者在归属准确但易临床误用，后者直接误归属）。双重编码假设获得初步机制证据：干扰信息处理与临床推理共享相同的注意力头组件，使得简单地抑制这些组件以防御干扰会损害临床推理能力。未来需要专门针对归属的训练目标、结构化输入保留主语信息，并发展在笔记生成过程中可干预的机制方法。本研究将发布MedDistractNotes、MedDistractAudio基准及相关评分协议以支持部署前评估。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly relied upon to support ambient documentation and clinical reasoning. Here we examine the impact of a failure mode shared between these two applications by assessing their sensitivity to information incidental to the patient encounter. In 576 patient-clinician dialogues, we found that frontier models inserted small-talk exchanges into 35% of notes, while mean quality scores changed by at most 0.20 points on five-point scales. In 3.7% of frontier notes, models misattributed the asides or used them clinically. In 57 mock recorded consultations, background speech from a separate patient encounter at -10 dB leaked into 48.2% of transcripts, with contamination detected in 5.3% of downstream notes generated by four open-weight models. We propose a dual encoding hypothesis of clinical reasoning and distraction in LLMs, with preliminary evidence that LLM components associated with disruption by incidental information also support clinical reasoning. These findings support evaluating resistance to incidental information before clinical use, with safeguards that prevent contamination while preserving clinical reasoning.

</details>


### [72] [Generative AI translations in high-stakes emergency messaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08601)
*Nune Ayvazan,Anthony Pym,Yu Hao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探讨了在紧急信息（如极端天气报告、地震指示）翻译中使用生成式AI的可行性与挑战，强调提示词设计对翻译质量的重要性，并指出人工修订仍不可替代。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 紧急信息翻译事关生命安全，传统机器翻译或生成式AI存在风险。作者旨在探索如何在保证准确性的前提下，利用生成式AI提高翻译效率，以争取更多时间用于修订和扩大翻译覆盖语言范围。

Method: 实验方法：将一段地震指示文本从英语翻译为中文和西班牙语，比较使用针对话语（discourse-specific）优化提示词前后的翻译效果，评估其在可理解性（understandability）和可操作性（actionability）上的差异。

Result: 使用话语特定提示词后，生成式AI翻译的可理解性和可操作性显著提升；但翻译人员仍然不信任完全由AI生成的译文，仍需人工修订以检测错误，并因伦理责任问题需要明确责任人。

Conclusion: 生成式AI可作为紧急信息翻译的辅助工具，通过优化提示词可获得较高质量的译文，但人工修订仍是必要环节，既是质量保证也是伦理责任的要求。

Abstract: Emergency messaging such as extreme-weather reports and earthquake instructions can involve high stakes, to the extent that translation errors can lead to tragic consequences. The use of machine translation or generative artificial intelligence might therefore not be recommended. On the other hand, time savings in the initial translation can allow greater investments of resources in revision and authorization processes, as well as a wider range of target languages. An experiment with generative AI translations of an earthquake instruction text from English into Chinese and Spanish shows that use of discourse-specific prompts can considerably improve understandability and actionability, although the translations may still not be trusted by translators. Human revision is still required, not only to detect errors but also because of the ethical need for someone to take responsibility for any errors or delays in such messaging.

</details>


### [73] [InterCorrect: Intersection-Aware Correction of Demographic Model Merging for Fair ASR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08604)
*Ashley E. Bravo-Bravo,Yuchen Zhang,Haralambos Mouratidis,Ravi Shekhar,Monorama Swain*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: InterCorrect 提出了一种面向公平 ASR 的交叉群体感知修正方法，通过人口学子组合并与交叉校正向量的两阶段策略提升 Speech-LLM 语音识别在多人口学维度和交叉群体上的性能，在 Fair-Speech 数据集上将整体 WER 从 7.38% 降至 5.13%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 ASR 系统在不同人口学群体（如年龄、性别、口音、族裔等）之间存在显著性能差异，且针对单一群体的改进未必能迁移到同时属于多个人口学维度的交叉群体。已有公平性方法依赖额外数据、特殊损失或适配模块，且较少从参数级模型合并角度探讨人口学公平性问题。本文旨在探索模型合并能否同时实现 ASR 适应和缓解人口学及交叉群体的不公平。

Method: 1. 基于 SLAM-ASR 架构（Whisper-large-v3 + TinyLlama + 线性 connector），仅微调 connector 训练基础模型；2. 在各人口学子组上微调后，采用 Linear/Task Arithmetic/TIES/Breadcrumbs/DARE-TIES 五种合并策略进行全局人口学合并；3. 通过子组 WER（选取每个轴上最差子组）与任务向量余弦冲突（选取冲突最大的跨轴对）两种准则识别关键交叉群体对，对成对合并模型在交集数据上微调得到修正向量 δ，加到全局合并模型上形成三种组合方式（Method1/2/3）。

Result: 在 Fair-Speech 数据集上：全局合并将 WER 从 7.38% 降至 6.38%–6.77%（相对 8.3–13.6%）；TIES + Method 1（基于 WER 校正）取得最优 5.13%（相对 30.5%）；Breadcrumbs + Method 3 达 5.63%。各人口学轴上的子组 WER 均有所下降，但 TIES+M1 在年龄和 SES 轴上反而增大了最大-最小 WER 差距；交叉分析显示校正主要改善目标交叉群体且不显著损害非目标交叉群体。

Conclusion: 人口学感知模型合并可在不引入额外数据的前提下改善 Speech-LLM ASR 的整体及子组性能；交叉感知修正可对部分合并策略带来额外收益（TIES + WER 修正最优），且能改善目标交叉群体而基本保持非目标交叉群体性能；但平均 WER 降低并不必然意味着子组差距缩小，公平性需单独评估。

Abstract: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems often show uneven performance across demographic groups, and errors can be especially difficult to address for speakers belonging to multiple demographic groups. This work studies demographic-aware model merging for fair Speech-LLM-based ASR. Starting from a SLAM-ASR-based model, we fine-tune only the connector on demographic-specific subsets and merge the resulting subgroup-adapted connectors into a global model. We then identify critical cross-axis demographic pairs using subgroup WER and task-vector conflict, and apply intersection-specific correction vectors to the global merged model. Experiments on Fair-Speech show that global demographic merging improves overall WER over the base model, while intersection correction provides additional gains for several merging strategies. In particular, TIES with WER-based correction achieves the best overall WER, reducing it from 7.38\% to 5.13\%. Subgroup and disparity analyses further show that the proposed approach improves performance across demographic axes, while highlighting that lower average WER does not always imply reduced subgroup disparity.

</details>


### [74] [Towards In-Parameter Memory Augmentation for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08630)
*Haoyu Huang,Zhongwei Xie,Jiaxin Bai,Yisen Gao,Hong Ting Tsang,Wuganjing Song,Huihao Jing,Yufei Li,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文综述了大语言模型(LLMs)的"参数内记忆增强"(In-Parameter Memory, IPM)方法,提出了一个统一的算子形式化框架(记忆对象φ、获取算子𝒜、组合算子𝒞),并沿"参数位置"和"参数获取时间"两个正交维度对现有方法进行了系统分类与比较,讨论了干扰、安全性、与ICL协同设计以及递归自我改进等开放方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM需要在预训练后整合新知识(领域事实、用户偏好、文档、交互经验等)。当前主流的上下文学习(ICL)方法虽灵活但消耗上下文容量,且重复编码成本随长度增长。因此需要一种补充性的"参数内记忆"范式,将可复用记忆信息编码为模型参数、适配器等参数化对象,在前向传播时动态组合,以避免二次方的长上下文预填充成本。

Method: 提出统一的算子框架:(1)获取算子𝒜(一次性或状态化)生成记忆对象φ;(2)组合算子𝒞在推理时将φ注入前向传播。沿两个正交维度分类方法——参数位置(Embedding层、Attention层、FFN层、Hybrid)与参数获取时间(在线/离线),并通过三项测试(参数化、独立获取、部署时增强)明确界定IPM与相邻范式(ICL/RAG、可插拔PEFT、全参数SFT、未修改KV缓存、编码KV库)的边界。

Result: 系统梳理了50+种代表性方法(覆盖Embedding/Attention/FFN/Hybrid各位置,在线/离线各时机),通过记忆对象类型、获取算子、任务用途、物化方式、写读成本等属性进行表格化比较。关键权衡包括:在线获取响应快但写时算力高;离线获取稳定但无法实时吸收新数据流;Embedding侧组合最便宜但影响间接;Attention侧支持内容寻址;FFN侧可直接编辑事实关联但缺乏基于内容的条目选择;Hybrid最表达力强但更新需跨异构对象协调。

Conclusion: IPM是比ICL更高效、更模型原生的LLM增强范式。未来开放方向包括:(1)干扰与遗忘管理(子空间投影、范数约束、固定容量分配);(2)安全感知获取(来源溯源、写入门控、隐私保护);(3)与ICL协同设计(动态分配什么保留在文本、何处进入φ);(4)模型原生递归自我改进(让𝒜将部署经验写入φ本身,缩小离线训练与在线推理的鸿沟)。文章也指出了局限:仅考虑文本模态,未涵盖新架构(MLE/MLA/mHC)内置的IPM设计,且比较基于定性分带而非数值测量。

Abstract: Recently Large Language Models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents increasingly need to incorporate knowledge acquired after pretraining, e.g., domain facts, user preferences, documents, and interaction experience. In-context learning (ICL) and ICL-based agent harness remain flexible, but they consume context capacity and incur repeated discretized encoding cost that grows with context length. \textbf{In-parameter memory} offers a complementary substrate: reusable memory information is represented in model parameters, adapters, or other parameter-like objects that are composed into the forward pass at inference time. This survey focuses on methods that augment LLMs with such parametric memory at deployment: a memory-bearing parameter object is plugged into the forward pass during inference, whether it is acquired before or during deployment. We organize the landscape with two orthogonal axes: \textbf{Parameter Placement}, which includes Embedding, Attention, FFN layers, or Hybrid when two or more layers are used; and \textbf{Parameter Acquisition Time}, which distinguishes methods whose memory object is acquired during deployment (online) from those acquired before it (offline). We clarify boundaries, conduct comparisons, and discuss open directions in interference, safety, co-design with ICL, and recursive self-improvement.

</details>


### [75] [Evidence-Bound Reasoning: Neuro-Semantic Verification of Biomedical AI in Glioblastoma Radiogenomics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08660)
*Mariya Miteva,Maria Nisheva-Pavlova*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种神经-语义验证框架，将放射组学测量转换为可寻址的证据记录和机器可检查的声明，以解决生物医学AI生成解释时缺乏可靠验证的问题。该框架在多中心脑胶质瘤队列中实现了跨队列可迁移性、确定性验证和受控预测降解的独立评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物医学AI虽然能生成看似合理的解释，但往往无法可靠地验证每个声明是否有患者特异性证据支持，这限制了其在临床中的可信应用。

Method: 方法包括：(1) 将UPenn-GBM放射组学与来自独立多中心队列的标准化MRI及专家验证分割进行CaPTk重新提取对齐；(2) 在T1、T1GD、T2和FLAIR MRI的三个肿瘤区域构建包含1,728特征的共享空间；(3) 从611例UPenn病例推导参考定义的语义状态；(4) 评估跨队列可迁移性、模型关联溯源、确定性验证、受控预测降解及LLM声明提取试点；(5) MGMT预测仅用作迁移压力测试。

Result: 结果包括：(1) 中位语义状态一致性为0.786（加权kappa 0.709），形态学特征达0.918，强度特征仅0.252；(2) 外部证据台账为331名患者包含1,655条模型关联记录；(3) 验证器在6,620条声明腐败基准测试中达到100%精确集准确率；(4) 24例试点中GPT-5.6 Sol重现72/72预定义原子声明，冻结验证器恢复24/24预期条件；(5) 受控降解中ROC AUC从0.899降至0.500，而验证准确率保持1.000；(6) 外部MGMT区分能力较弱（ROC AUC 0.543）。

Conclusion: 可验证性可以独立于预测性能进行工程化和评估。LLM可用于构建解释结构，但最终的证据一致性检查应保持确定性。这一框架将可解释性与预测性能解耦，为生物医学AI的临床可信部署提供了新范式。

Abstract: Background: Biomedical AI can generate plausible explanations without reliably verifying whether each statement is supported by patient-specific evidence. We developed a neuro-semantic verification framework that converts radiomic measurements into addressable evidence records and machine-checkable claims. Methods: UPenn-GBM radiomics were aligned with de novo CaPTk extraction from standardized MRI and expert-validated segmentations in an independent multicenter cohort. The shared space comprised 1,728 features from T1, T1GD, T2, and FLAIR MRI across three tumor regions. Reference-defined semantic states were derived from 611 UPenn cases. We evaluated cross-cohort transportability, model-linked provenance, deterministic verification, controlled predictive degradation, and an LLM claim-extraction pilot; MGMT prediction served only as a transport stress test. Results: Median semantic-state agreement was 0.786 (weighted kappa 0.709), ranging from 0.918 for morphologic to 0.252 for intensity features. The external evidence ledger contained 1,655 model-linked records for 331 patients. The verifier achieved 100% exact-set accuracy in a 6,620-claim corruption benchmark. In a 24-case pilot, GPT-5.6 Sol reproduced 72/72 prespecified atomic claims, and the frozen verifier recovered 24/24 expected conditions. During controlled degradation, ROC AUC declined from 0.899 to 0.500 while verification accuracy remained 1.000. External MGMT discrimination was weak (ROC AUC 0.543). Conclusions: Verifiability can be engineered and evaluated independently of predictive performance. LLMs may structure explanations, while final evidence-consistency checking remains deterministic.

</details>


### [76] [Same-Number Citation Swaps: Stress-Testing Jev as a Financial Evidence Judge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08675)
*Chuhong Xu,Bo Su,Ziyao Chen,Ruiyang Xu,Shimeng Dai,Xinyu Qiu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM金融计算助手提出一种受控评估方法，通过"同数值引用交换"压力测试Jev概率验证器在固定数值匹配条件下识别"金融角色错误"的能力，揭示验证器在检测错误角色与保留有效引用之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成的金融计算可能在数值正确的同时引用了错误的金融角色（period、metric、accounting category等），现有验证多停留在数值匹配或字面引文层面，缺乏对"角色识别"这一独立维度的受控评估。需明确概率验证器相对于确定性数值匹配究竟额外区分了什么，以及在何种引用变化下会失效。

Method: 1) 在FinQA单步计算题上构建192条GPT-4.1-mini自然轨迹及一个36题新源页面跟进集；2) 以"带符号数-指针（signed-number-at-pointer）"零调用基线对比Jev Noul概率验证器；3) 设计"同数值引用交换"——固定操作数与算术，仅将引用指针指向同数值的另一单元格，区分wrong-role与equivalent-fact；4) 通过显式列标签干预探测表示敏感性；5) 由非作者审阅者在新页面上盲标。

Result: 放松指针规则恢复了大部分字面引文未通过的记录；same-number交换显示Jev在wrong-role与equivalent-fact之间存在权衡：可识别部分时期/状态错误并放行部分wrong-role引用，又会扣留部分有效替代引用；显式列标签在所选wrong-role对比上提升分离度，但在equivalent-fact控制上降低支持度；新源跟进由非作者盲标确认相同权衡；原始固定门限发布端点在该银行上未观察到修正收益。

Conclusion: 概率验证器在金融场景中应被评估为其在数值匹配之外所增加的信息——即区分错误金融角色与等价事实引用的能力。结论将数值正确性、引用角色支持与答案发布质量分离为三个独立可测维度，强调评估需同时包含wrong-role检测与equivalent-fact保留两类对照。

Abstract: Financial reports repeat values across periods, metrics and accounting lines, allowing an LLM-generated calculation to be numerically correct while citing the wrong financial role. We evaluate what probabilistic evidence verification adds beyond number matching using Jev as a source-support verifier for GPT-4.1-mini calculation traces. A signed-number-at-pointer baseline explains most recovery over exact quotation checks. To isolate the remaining role-recognition problem, we hold operands and arithmetic fixed, move citations between same-number cells, and retain controls that express equivalent facts. These contrasts reveal both wrong-role citations that pass and valid alternative citations that are withheld. Explicit column labels improve selected wrong-role decisions while also lowering support for some equivalent evidence. A constructed follow-up on 36 new source pages, labeled by a non-author reviewer, extends this evaluation and exposes the same tradeoff between detecting role errors and retaining valid citations. The contribution is a controlled evaluation that identifies what a probabilistic financial verifier distinguishes when numerical matching is held fixed. For LLM-based financial assistants, it makes numerical correctness, cited-role support and acceptance outcomes separately assessable.

</details>


### [77] [Agreement Is Not Validity: Cross-Model LLM Consensus in Diagnosing Student Failure Modes in K-12 Math Tutoring Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08703)
*Clayton Cohn,Joyce Fonteles,Kirk Vanacore,Gianni Mazza,Candida Crawford,Tom Hooper,Gautam Biswas,Rene Kizilcec*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究针对K-12数学辅导对话中LLM对学生失败模式的分类效度问题展开实证调查,发现跨模型一致性不能替代对人类判断的真实吻合,模型存在系统性偏向于过度诊断"概念性缺陷"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型广泛应用于学习分析中的对话标注,研究者通常以跨模型一致性作为标注可靠性的证据。然而,模型间的高一致性可能源于共享的系统性偏差,反而掩盖对学习者真实困难的有效推断。本研究聚焦于细粒度的学生失败模式分类,质疑"模型共识=效度"的隐含假设。

Method: 基于Third Space Learning的真实辅导转录数据,建立包含五种失败模式(UNC/MIS/OP/CON/PROC)及NA标签的诊断分类法。两名人类专家对100条本地化语段进行独立标注并通过仲裁形成参考集。三家厂商的二级模型(GPT-5.6 Terra、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Claude Opus 5)以相同提示词、代码本和17个少样本示例进行结构化分类,采用三次自一致性投票。采用Cohen's κ、Krippendorff's α、宏F1及McNemar检验进行评估,并辅以Gemini 3.6 Flash高推理能力稳健性检验。

Result: 人-LLM一致性处于中等水平(κ=.524-.597),未达预设基准κ=.70;而跨模型一致性显著更高(κ=.755-.781,α=.769)。LLM-LLM一致性的点估计甚至高于两位人类标注者前仲裁一致性(.588)约.17-.19。所有非CON类别的最大误分类均落入"概念性缺陷"(CON),其中62%的真实PROC被错标为CON(F1=.283);NA类召回率仅40%,模型显著倾向于强行给出诊断而非承认证据不足(p≤.0098)。人-LLM差距在不同厂商、模型层级和推理能力下均持续存在。

Conclusion: 跨模型共识不应作为学习者诊断效度的替代证据,因模型可能共享相同偏差。可扩展的标注仅在所推断构念本身有效的前提下才有意义。学习分析须将构念效度置于方法论核心,系统需保留"不诊断"选项,并结合多模态证据、多标签与不确定性感知推理以减少系统性误判。

Abstract: In K-12 mathematics tutoring, student-tutor dialogue provides rich evidence of learners' problem-solving processes and sources of difficulty. Learning analytics research increasingly relies on large language models (LLMs) to extract such information from dialogue for a variety of downstream tasks, including knowledge tracing, behavioral modeling, and diagnosis of student reasoning errors. However, the validity of these model-generated interpretations remains insufficiently understood. In this exploratory study, we examine the validity of LLM classifications of five student failure modes in mathematics tutoring dialogue using an operational diagnostic codebook: uncertainty, misattribution, operator selection, conceptual gap, and procedural slip. Across models, human-LLM agreement was moderate (kappa = .524-.597), while cross-model agreement was substantially higher (kappa = .755-.781; alpha = .769). These findings show that cross-model agreement can create a misleading appearance of correctness, challenging the assumption that consensus among LLMs constitutes evidence of valid learner interpretation. For learning analytics, the implication is clear: scalable labeling is useful only if the inferred constructs are valid, and model consensus cannot substitute for independent evidence of that validity.

</details>


### [78] [Holdout Best-of-N: Unbiased Evaluation and Its Cost](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08719)
*Shrey Shah,Yinheng Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究Best-of-N策略的无偏评估问题。核心贡献是"Holdout Best-of-N"估计器：通过循环列分割（cyclic column splitting），使用J个分数列选择候选，用剩余K-J列评估，实现对期望奖励的分布无关（distribution-free）无偏估计。论文证明当J<K时存在无偏估计量，但当J≥K时无偏估计不可能存在（estimability frontier）。在高斯模型下，沿J=K-1边界的最小极大无偏风险为σ²/√K量级，允许偏差时可达σ²/K。Holdout无需已知方差即达到最优速率，尖锐常数1/(π√2)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Best-of-N选择机制因重用选择噪声而高估期望奖励，独立评估虽能解决此问题，但其无偏性与成本尚不清晰。论文动机在于：(1) 阐明从固定得分矩阵能否对J-分数BoN策略做精确无偏评估的条件；(2) 量化无偏性的均方误差代价；(3) 在样本边界处提供具有尖锐常数的实用估计器，无需方差输入即可达到最优无偏率。

Method: 方法核心是Holdout Best-of-N估计器：(1) 对1≤J<k的循环列分割——在K列上以J列均值选择候选，用剩余K-J列评估并对选择块做循环平均；(2) 子集权重扩展了pass@k计数恒等式（rank i的权重为C(i-1,N-1)/C(M,N)），可在O(MK log M)运算内计算；(3) 在定理2中通过多项式次数论证证明J≥K时无偏估计的不可能性（estimability frontier）；(4) 对独立同分布高斯函数，使用完备充分统计量行均值推导UMMV估计器T_{K-1,K}=S+(D/2)erf(bD)-(τ²b/√π)e^(-b²D²)；(5) 通过Hoeffding分解和U统计量结构为有界分数提供固定深度MSE上界。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 定理2（可估计性边界）：对独立稳定得分类，Θ^(J)可无偏估计当且仅当J<k；(2) 定理3（高斯风险代价）：沿J=K-1的无偏最小极大风险为σ²/√K量级，允许偏差时为σ²/K；(3) 定理4（高斯无偏风险）：对两个候选情形推导最小方差无偏估计量，并给出等均值时的尖锐MSE界ℛ_{J,K}=(σ²/K)[1/2+(1/π)(arcsin r+r/√(1-r²))]，其中r=J/K；(4) 命题1：Holdout无需方差输入即达到∼σ²/(π√(2K))的最优无偏率，尖锐常数1/(π√2)；(5) 命题2：有界分数情形下，循环估计有O(K⁻¹)MSE且关于池规模一致；(6) 实验验证：五组Bernoulli池与四组高斯对照显示Holdout偏差在1.81倍MCSE内，与理论预测一致。

Conclusion: 论文得出结论：从固定得分矩阵，J-分数BoN策略的精确无偏评估在所述分布类中恰在J<k时可行。Holdout Best-of-N在无需已知方差的情况下沿J=K-1边界达到最优高斯无偏率σ²/(π√(2K))。允许偏差可将最小极大率提升至σ²/K。估计边界处MSE的尖锐常数表明无偏性代价本质为√O(K)而非O(K)。实际含义包括：(1) 评估设计应先确定待测策略，再权衡采集成本与MSE；(3) 沿J=K-1的偏差缩减需要新增一个全新的赢家分数（NJ+1次评分调用）。独立性假设与得分法则的稳定性为该无偏保证的前提条件，实际相关性会同时改变赢家估计和持有条件均值，论文给出偏差上界。</conclusion>

Abstract: Reusing the scores that select a Best-of-$N$ winner can overstate its expected reward. We study evaluation from a fixed matrix of $K$ independent scores per candidate for a policy that selects using $J$ fresh scores. A single estimator based only on this matrix is exactly unbiased for expected judge reward under every independent, stable collection of candidate-specific score laws if and only if $J<K$, for every pool size $M\ge N\ge2$. At $J=K-1$, the selector deepens as $K$ grows. For independent Gaussian scores with common variance and fixed $M\ge N\ge2$, the unbiased minimax risk in this regime is of order $\sigma^2/\sqrt K$, attained by Holdout; allowing bias improves the rate to $\sigma^2/K$. For two candidates, we derive the minimum-variance unbiased estimator at known variance and the sharp asymptotic unbiased minimax constant $1/(\pi\sqrt2)$, which Holdout attains without knowing the variance. The cyclic average over subsets and ties can be computed in $O(MK\log M)$ operations. At fixed selector depth, cyclic evaluation of bounded scores has $O(K^{-1})$ risk uniformly in pool size. The impossibility result concerns the fixed matrix: one additional fresh winner score permits unbiased evaluation of the all-$K$ policy.

</details>


### [79] [The Missing Minimal Pair: Stereotype Evaluation in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08747)
*Nataliya Stepanova,Ivan Titov,Emily Allaway,Björn Ross*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型(LLMs)中常见的基于单一对比句对(single minimal pair)的刻板印象评估方法,指出其存在逻辑不一致问题——同一群体可能被同时关联到语义相反的属性。文章提出"双最小对"(dual minimal pair)框架,即同时在群体轴和属性轴上进行对比,并设计了基于互信息(MI)的新评估指标 $I_{G \times A}$。研究在英语、俄语、西班牙语和中文四种语言上构建了增强的刻板印象数据集,并在9个LLM配置上验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM刻板印象评估方法(如Mitchell et al., 2025; Rowe et al., 2025)仅使用单一对比句对(对比群体但保持属性不变),这存在根本缺陷:同一群体可能同时被模型偏好某属性及其语义反义属性,造成逻辑矛盾。实验证明17-30%的刻板印象存在这种方向翻转问题,说明单一对的log-probability比较不足以可靠测量偏差。

Method: 1. 提出双最小对评估框架:同时对比群体轴(G vs G_alt)和属性轴(A vs A_alt),形成两组句对。
2. 构建多语言数据增强流水线:使用Qwen3-32B和Gemma-4-31B为刻板印象生成释义(paraphrases)与对立属性(alternate attributes),辅以语法检查、LaBSE语义相似度(≥0.7)、多语言NLI矛盾概率(>0.8)等自动质量过滤。
3. 提出两个新指标:有符号的 $B_{G \times A}$(保留方向,差分再差分)和无符号的 $I_{G \times A}$(将log-probability信号重新包装为群体与二元属性变量间的互信息,理论上有界、可跨tokenizer聚合),并证明 $I_{G \times A} \sim B_{G \times A}^2$。
4. 在英语、俄语、西班牙语、中文上扩展BiasShades数据集(平均每个刻板印象10个释义)。
5. 利用McRae语义norms对指标进行外部验证。

Result: 1. 17-30%的刻板印象在引入对立属性后出现偏差方向翻转,证实单一对方法不可靠。
2. 人类验证显示自动生成的释义接受率为91.2%-97.5%,对立属性为93.8%-97.5%。
4. 在McRae语义norms验证中,基于 $q_c$ 分数的ROC-AUC普遍较高,证明指标能有效捕捉LLM的语义关联。
5. Split-half可靠性测试(Spearman ρ):$I_{G \times A}$ 为0.563-0.680, $B_{G \times A}$ 为0.583-0.739,表明指标对释义变化仅中等稳健。
6. 与表面形式变化度量(BLEU、ROUGE-L等)的Kendall相关性大多在|0.1|以内,说明对表层语言变化稳健。
7. 3-way ANOVA显示语言、模型和偏差类型均显著影响 $I_{G \times A}$,语言解释6.12%的方差,偏差类型解释10.39%;以英语为锚点时,俄/西/中刻板的偏差强度普遍低于英语。
8. 研究未发现指令调优模型普遍更公平,或特定模型族在特定语言上一致更公平的模式。

Conclusion: 本文论证了在LLM刻板印象评估中纳入对立属性的必要性,提出了双最小对评估范式与对应的两个度量($B_{G \times A}$ 和 $I_{G \times A}$)。推荐 $I_{G \times A}$ 用于跨模型与跨分词器的聚合分析(有界、方向无关、理论上由KL散度推导而来、与 $B_{G \times A}$ 平方成正比),而 $B_{G \times A}$ 适合保留方向性的单条刻板印象分析。配套的多语言数据增强框架可作为未来刻板印象评估的标准工具,有助于在训练生命周期中进行频繁、低成本的偏差诊断。

Abstract: A common approach to measuring bias in Large Language Models is to compare the log-likelihoods of two contrastive stereotype sentences. We argue that such single-pair comparisons are often unreliable: simply rewriting the same stereotype with an alternative attribute can yield logically inconsistent preferences. To address this, we propose a dual minimal pair setup that introduces two axes of comparison for robust stereotype evaluation. First, we present a data-augmentation framework that fills critical gaps in existing stereotype datasets by generating paraphrases and alternate attributes. We apply our framework on a set of English, Russian, Spanish and Chinese stereotypes. Second, we introduce two evaluation metrics tailored to the dual minimal pair setup. One of these metrics provides a new perspective on bias by modeling the mutual information (MI) between social groups and stereotyped attributes. This MI-based metric is better suited for aggregation and enables more robust comparisons of stereotype strength across different languages and models. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>

### [80] [Text2Dashboard: A Governed Agent Architecture for Natural-Language Dashboard Generation over Enterprise DataBrain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06914)
*Yiou Wu,Zezhi Tang,Ningwei Bai,Liuhaichen Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Text2Dashboard 是一个面向企业 DataBrain 平台的自然语言到仪表板的受控 Agent 原型，通过 Codex 插件和独立 Agent Runtime 实现模型决策与确定性执行的分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业环境中，自然语言生成的查询可能使用错误字段、错误数据域或未经授权的操作，仅有流畅输出不足以保证安全性。需要一个在保持数据访问和操作可审计、可恢复的前提下，能将自然语言分析请求转化为可检查仪表板的系统。

Method: 采用双入口架构（Codex 插件和独立 Python Agent Runtime），遵循 ReAct 式决策-行动-观察循环；通过类型化工具注册表、生命周期 Hook（审批、断路器、循环防护、检查点、审计）、Agent 状态与仪表板状态分离持久化、只读 SQL 词法策略、以及静态校验、动态预检和浏览器检查的多阶段验证管线实现治理。

Result: 核心元数据和 SQL 任务严格成功率 6/8（元数据 4/4，SQL 语义 4/4，严格列名契约 2/4）；最终单面板仪表板任务 4/4 通过；双面板任务、现有仪表板精化任务各通过 1 项；联合参数化任务因超出 30 步预算而失败；10 项受控 Hook 故障场景全部产生预期结果且无未授权外部副作用；模型推理占观察运行时间的 97% 以上。

Conclusion: 该原型验证了将模型提案与确定性执行权限分离的架构可行性；语义正确的 SQL 仍可能因输出列名不匹配下游契约而失败，成功的中间工具执行也不保证 Agent 级收敛；完成与终止应作为显式系统属性而非完全依赖模型判断；模型推理是主要延迟瓶颈，亟需改进输出契约遵守和确定性收敛控制。

Abstract: Text2Dashboard is a DataBrain-specific prototype that turns natural-language analytic requests into inspectable dashboards. An installable Codex plugin and standalone Agent Runtime combine schema-constrained model decisions with typed tools, persistent state, and deterministic Hooks for approval, audit, checkpointing, recovery, and failure handling. The pipeline resolves entities, discovers metadata, enforces read-only SQL, composes dashboards, and applies static checks, dynamic preflight, and browser inspection. The model proposes actions while deterministic software controls execution and records state transitions. We evaluate the workflow on frozen real-DataBrain tasks and controlled Hook faults. Strict success was 6/8 on metadata and SQL tasks: metadata selection passed 4/4, all four SQL tasks met semantic criteria, and 2/4 met the exact output-column contract. The final release passed 4/4 single-panel dashboard tasks, one two-panel task, and one existing-dashboard refinement; a parameterised task exceeded its step limit. All ten fault scenarios met their specified outcomes without unapproved external side effects. Model inference accounted for over 97\% of observed runtime in every reported group. These small, DataBrain-specific results do not establish production readiness, general text-to-SQL accuracy, or an efficiency advantage over manual dashboard construction.

</details>


### [81] [GAMEGO: Training Game-Dev Agents with Synthetic Trajectories Anchored in Real-World Assets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06910)
*Haoyue Yang,Jingyao Li,Zhengfan Wu,Jing Liu,Xuanle Zhao,Kang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了GameGo框架，通过将简短的游戏种子转化为详尽的PRD（产品需求文档），并采用任务自适应动态压缩策略，生成高信息密度的查询，用于训练游戏开发代理。基于此构建了包含55,060条轨迹的GameGoData数据集和124个任务的GameGoBench基准，训练的GameGoCoder模型在游戏开发基准上显著优于同规模基线并可媲美前沿大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接从简短、稀疏的用户查询生成复杂游戏时，编码代理需要做出欠指定的假设，导致游戏机制不完整、玩法流程断裂、视觉美感受限。因此需要一个系统化的流程来补充必要的细节信息，同时不限制设计探索空间。

Method: GameGo框架包含四个阶段：(1)游戏种子收集与去重——从18个源（Steam、浏览器游戏门户、微信小游戏）收集约7万条记录，经游戏级聚类和配额选择保留67,564个种子；(2)规范合成——基于动态约束满足理论，通过任务定义、可玩蓝图、资产接地三个规划阶段将种子扩展为完整PRD；(3)任务自适应查询构建——通过关系密度公式G_s=R_s/r_s衡量信息密度，将完整PRD压缩为高密度查询，保留核心机制同时为编码代理留出实现自由度；(4)轨迹合成——使用前沿模型在沙箱环境中执行查询，记录完整交互轨迹，经多阶段过滤得到55,060条高质量训练数据。监督微调Qwen3.5-27B和Qwen3.8-27B得到GameGoCoder模型。

Result: 在ArtifactsBench-G（413任务）、Cookie-Bench-G（156任务）和GameGoBench（124任务）上的评估显示：GameGoCoder 3.8在GameGoBench上Overall达55.29，超越同规模基线Qwen3.8-27B（52.53）以及部分前沿模型如DeepSeek-V4-Pro（49.52）和Kimi-K3（53.82）；任务自适应查询在人工对比中获得85.7%偏好率（vs完整PRD）和86.6%偏好率（vs直接查询），关系密度增益达3.79×，压缩比44.2×；三个验证器（Sonnet 4.6、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、Qwen3.8-Max）的排名高度一致（Spearman相关性>0.96）；盲评专家间一致性达81.7%-84.7%。

Conclusion: GameGo通过将种子到PRD的扩展与动态约束压缩相结合，分离设计规划与执行指令，在过度约束与欠指定之间取得平衡。结构化规范合成配合任务自适应压缩是训练游戏开发代理的有效范式，可使小参数模型经过SFT后在游戏开发任务上媲美前沿大模型。

Abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in web front-end execution, with browser-based game generation emerging as a particularly prominent frontier. While previous efforts frequently rely on complex multi-turn workflows or focus on static game evaluation benchmarks, this work targets direct end-to-end real-world game synthesis driven by coding agents. However, generating complex games directly from sparse user queries often forces coding agents to make underspecified assumptions, yielding incomplete mechanics, disconnected gameplay flows, and limited visual aesthetics. To resolve this issue, this paper presents GameGo, a scalable framework that systematically transforms brief game seeds into comprehensive Product Requirements Documents grounded in industry game-development practices. To retain core gameplay constraints without restricting design exploration, GameGo uses task-specific dynamic compression to maximize information density while preserving instruction following. Based on this pipeline, GameGoData is constructed with 55,060 development trajectories across 2D, 2.5D, and 3D games, alongside GameGoBench, a benchmark comprising 124 diverse game queries. Training GameGoCoder on GameGoData yields a model that outperforms matched baselines and is comparable to frontier models across gamedev benchmarks. All code, datasets, and models will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [82] [FluidPD: In-Place Elasticity for SLO-Aware Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06917)
*Kartik Ramesh,Kaidi Fu,Zihan Zheng,Jiahuan Yu,Fabio Oliveira,Carlos Costa,Minjia Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FluidPD 是面向 Prefill-Decode (P/D) 解耦 LLM 服务的 SLO 感知系统，通过两种原地弹性机制（FluidToken 与 FluidRole）配合预测式压力信号，在不增加 GPU 的前提下缓解短时突发与持续 P/D 比例失衡；在 Azure 生产 trace 上较静态 SGLang 提升 SLO 达标率最高 94.6 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 P/D 解耦系统采用固定 worker 比例与请求路由，难以应对实际负载中既存在短时突发又存在持续 P/D 比例漂移的特性，导致即使集群仍有空闲容量也会发生 SLO 违约；自动扩缩容反应慢（单 worker 就绪需约 200 s）、需额外 GPU，且不适合短时尺度相位失衡。

Method: 1) FluidToken：在不改变 worker 角色的前提下，将部分 prefill 计算以"前缀-后缀"形式卸载到 paired decode worker；2) FluidRole：通过 Active→Drain→Switch→Active 状态机实现 worker 角色原地双向切换，保留模型权重与并行通信组；3) PPI（prefill 端排队相对 TTFT 预算）与 DPI（decode 端负载与 KV-cache 入队压力，含 load 与 adm 两个分量）作为领先指标驱动决策；4) 在线优化：在偷取预算约束下贪心求解偷取比例 βi，并设 η 与冷却阈值等防止抖动。

Result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-14B、Qwen3-30B-A3B（MoE）三模型上，基于 Azure trace 派生的 Azure(staged) 与 Azure(mixed) 工作负载：相对静态 SGLang，Azure(staged) SLO 达标率最多提升 94.6 个百分点，Azure(mixed) 最多提升 74.3 个百分点；相对 Dynamo 自动扩缩容，在 6→8 GPU 配置下最多领先 88.3 个百分点且所用 GPU 更少；消融显示 FluidRole 处理持续比例漂移贡献更大、FluidToken 处理突发贡献更大，二者互补；P→D 切换约 1 s，D→P 切换最长约 12 s，控制环路 CPU 开销 <0.50 ms/iteration，预测器 MRE 约 2–10%。

Conclusion: FluidPD 表明 P/D 相位失衡通常可由部署内部已存在的容量吸收：在无需增加 worker 的前提下，通过 token 级偷取与原地角色重分配即可显著提升 SLO 达标率；自动扩缩容更适合长时段容量短缺，而非短时相位失衡。

Abstract: Prefill-decode disaggregation is becoming a common architecture for LLM serving because it separates two phases with distinct execution patterns and SLO objectives. Existing systems typically combine a fixed prefill/decode worker ratio with request routing across workers. However, real-world workloads exhibit both short bursts and sustained shifts in the prefill-to-decode demand ratio. As a result, a configuration that is well provisioned at one time may quickly become mismatched, causing latency SLO violations even when idle capacity exists elsewhere. Existing autoscaling mechanisms can add capacity, but they react slowly, require spare GPUs, and do not directly address short-timescale phase imbalance. We present FluidPD, a P/D-disaggregated serving system that provides SLO-aware in-place elasticity. FluidPD introduces two complementary mechanisms. FluidToken handles transient imbalance by offloading a bounded portion of prefill computation to decode workers when decode-side slack is available. FluidRole handles sustained imbalance by reassigning running workers between prefill and decode roles in place, avoiding model reload and engine restart. Both mechanisms are guided by lightweight pressure indices that expose prefill and decode-side resource pressure before they appear as SLO violations. Across production Azure trace workloads, FluidPD improves overall SLO attainment over static SGLang by up to 94.6 percentage points, demonstrating that SLO-aware in-place P/D elasticity improves service quality without provisioning additional workers.

</details>


### [83] [Anchor Divergence for Semantic Geometry in Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06919)
*Akash Kannan,Kiho Park,Victor Veitch*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"锚点散度"(Anchor Divergence)，一种在固定对比表示上指定上下文相关语义几何的方法。通过将对比学习中的softmax结构与指数族和信息几何建立联系，揭示锚点上的概率分布与表示空间上的Bregman几何之间存在对应关系，从而能够通过改变锚点分布来控制相似度的语义维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对比学习表示（如CLIP）通常使用余弦相似度作为单一固定几何度量，但语义相似性本质上是上下文依赖的：两张图像可能因描绘同一物体、共享视觉风格或涉及同一临床发现而相似。固定余弦几何无法针对特定任务强调相应的语义方面，因此需要一种"灵活泛化、上下文敏感"的语义几何指定框架。

Method: 核心方法是利用对比softmax（本质上是经验锚点测度的指数倾斜）将图像映射到锚点上的分布，并证明当锚点从某个底层分布q独立同分布采样时，softmax锚点散度以概率1收敛于由q的累积生成函数诱导的总体Bregman散度。由此将"语义上下文"建模为锚点分布q，并通过以下三种方式实例化：（a）实证分布（恢复softmax形式）；（c）参数化模型（高斯、高斯混合等）；（b）经验贝叶斯后验建模（用广泛锚点构建先验，用少量目标锚点特化）。对应的散度包括高斯锚点散度、隐高斯散度、隐球面散度和高斯混合散度。

Result: 实验验证三个关键发现：（1）改变锚点分布可在ImageNet-R上平稳切换对象/风格检索维度，在CheXpert上针对特定病理（如胸腔积液AUPRC提升+0.0465）优于余弦相似度和ITI基线；（2）参数化模型在锚点有限时占优，softmax在高覆盖率时最强；（3）后验锚点模型利用WordNet等广泛锚点作为先验，可将目标锚点需求降低一个数量级。计算开销方面，参数化模型一旦拟合，运行时间不再随锚点数量增长。

Conclusion: 锚点散度提供了一个原则性框架，用于在固定对比表示上指定、建模和适配上下文相关的语义几何。其核心洞察在于：建模锚点分布即建模几何本身。这一构造不局限于图像，可推广至任何具有softmax结构的对比/多模态设置，对softmax模型语义几何的一般理论研究具有独立价值。

Abstract: This paper concerns how semantic context determines geometry in learned vector representations. Similarity is typically measured using cosine similarity, which provides a single fixed geometry. Semantic similarity, however, is inherently context dependent: two images may be similar because they depict the same object, share a visual style, or are relevant to the same clinical finding. We show that contrastive representations naturally encompass a family of geometries that can be specialized to particular semantic structure. The key idea is to use an interplay between contrastive learning, exponential families, and information geometry to establish a correspondence between probability distributions over "anchors" and Bregman geometries on the representation space. We use this correspondence to define "Anchor Divergences", a method for specifying context-specific semantic geometries on fixed representations. Under this correspondence, modeling the anchor distribution models the geometry itself. Experiments on retrieval show that anchor divergences provide an effective and efficient way to specify context-specific semantic similarity.

</details>


### [84] [RadOnc-Agent: An LLM-Orchestrated Framework for AI Workflows Across the Radiotherapy Care Pathway](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06923)
*Caiwen Jiang,Shuoyang Wei,Songlin Zhao,Junyu Li,Jingyuan Chen,Wei Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 RadOnc-Agent，一个由大语言模型编排的智能体框架，将放射治疗全过程形式化为四个临床阶段（诊断决策、模拟规划、治疗中自适应管理、随访结局），并通过对话式接口提供 26 个可调用函数（17 个核心函数 + 9 个跨阶段工具函数）。系统采用 LLM 控制器+函数注册表+专业智能后端的共享执行架构，通过消融实验验证了纵向状态管理与确定性验证的关键作用，并在合成场景和真实患者数据上评估了跨阶段工作流的执行可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的放射治疗 AI 能力多为针对单任务的点解决方案，分布于不同临床阶段、软件环境和数据模态之间，无法与从治疗决策到随访的纵向临床路径相匹配。临床智能需要在决策、图像、计划和纵向记录之间协同运作，而非孤立任务优化。需要一个工作流原生（workflow-native）的架构来协调异构专业模型，并保持跨阶段患者和工作流上下文的连续性。

Method: 1）将放射治疗分为四个临床阶段，构建 26 个可调用函数的共享执行契约（含 17 个核心函数 + 9 个跨阶段工具）；2）采用 LLM 控制器（gpt-5.2）+ 机器可读函数注册表 + 调度层 + 专业后端服务的架构，控制器将临床意图映射到模式约束的函数调用；3）实施四层评估：(a) 单函数架构基准（2,600 唯一请求×3 次=7,800 次执行 + 520 缺失输入请求×3 次=1,560 次执行）；(b) 跨阶段合成场景（200 场景×3 次=600 次执行，含 90 次扰动子集）；(c) 真实患者工作流执行（60 例×2 工作流×3 次=360 次清洁执行 + 48 次扰动测试）；(d) 26 个函数的任务特定评估；4）三项架构消融：基于嵌入的路由器 vs 完整控制器、无状态控制器 vs 有状态控制器、绕过验证门 vs 启用验证门。

Result: 主要定量结果：单函数执行中意图函数选择准确率 98.79%（7,706/7,800），模式合规 99.27%，后端分发成功 98.96%，可解析输出 98.64%；缺失输入检测率 97.95%，安全澄清率 97.18%；控制器编排开销中位数 1.42 秒。跨阶段合成场景：完成率 96.50%（579/600），轨迹依从率 95.00%，信息传递准确率 98.31%，上下文保持率 99.63%；连续阶段工作流完成率 96.67–98.67%，全程（phase1→4）工作流完成率 92.67%。真实患者评估：清洁执行完成率 96.67%（348/360），轨迹依从率 95.56%，标识符传播准确率 99.15%；决策到规划 97.78%，规划到自适应 95.56%；扰动恢复率 93.75%；复检评估一致性 91.67%（55/60）。消融实验：移除纵向状态使跨阶段完成率从 96.50% 降至 84.00%；禁用验证门使不匹配后端分发从 0% 升至 95.28%；嵌入路由器 vs 完整控制器在混淆请求上差 7.31 个百分点。任务特定证据：MR-to-CT 合成 MAE 46.8 HU；可变形配准 OAR Dice 92.07%；自动勾画 CTV+OAR 草案约 7 秒/例；质子剂量预测推理 <0.3 秒；脑坏死 AUROC 0.95；心脏损伤 AUROC 0.94；放射性食管炎 CTCAE 加权 κ=0.89；放射性肺炎加权 κ=0.87。

Conclusion: RadOnc-Agent 在三个互补评估层级（单函数路由、跨阶段合成场景、真实患者工作流）证明了 LLM 编排架构在协调异构放射治疗专业能力和跨纵向工作流信息方面的技术可行性。核心结论：(1) 完整的控制器+状态+验证门组合对可靠编排至关重要；(2) 主要挑战从单函数选择转向长程工作流中的状态维持和数据依赖保持；(3) 框架建立的是工作流原生的技术基础，而非临床正确性或临床效用的证据；(4) 临床转化应分阶段进行——外部回顾性验证、静默前瞻部署、多学科人机协同试点，最终才能进行前瞻比较研究。明确局限：未做读者研究、未做前瞻临床效用评估、未做分布偏移稳健性评估、缺失输入基准不覆盖对抗性场景，因而当前结果不应被解读为支持无监督临床使用。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence has advanced individual radiotherapy tasks, yet these capabilities remain separated across clinical stages, software environments and data modalities. This fragmentation contrasts with the longitudinal radiotherapy workflow from treatment decision-making through follow-up. Here we present RadOnc-Agent, an agentic artificial-intelligence framework that formalizes radiotherapy into four clinical phases and provides 26 callable functions through a conversational interface. A large-language-model controller maps clinical intent to schema-constrained calls, preserves patient and workflow context, and routes requests to specialist services. We evaluated system execution using 2,600 single-function requests (7,800 repeat executions), 200 prespecified synthetic cross-stage scenarios spanning four phases (600 executions), and 120 workflow instances from 60 de-identified patient records (360 clean executions) representing decision-to-planning and planning-to-adaptation. RadOnc-Agent selected the intended function in 98.79% of single-function executions, completed 96.50% of scripted cross-stage workflows, and completed 96.67% of real-patient workflow executions. In comparative ablations, removing longitudinal state reduced cross-stage completion from 96.50% to 84.00%, while disabling schema and identity validation increased mismatched backend dispatch from 0% to 95.28% in a replay/test evaluation.
