### [168] [Illusory Pattern Perception Drives Spurious Inference in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07791)
*Peihua Mai,Zhuoyan Shao,Xinbao Qiao,Meng Zhang,Xinyue Zhou,Yan Pang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究了大型语言模型（LLM）中类似人类的"虚幻模式感知"（illusory pattern perception）现象——即在随机数据中推断出虚假关联的认知偏差。通过改编三个经典心理学范式（社区相关性、投资相关性、阴谋信念），并与人类行为直接对比，发现LLM比人类更强烈地表现出虚幻模式感知。基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的特征可解释性框架揭示了两个潜在机制：整体性频率感知和分析性认知取向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM被广泛部署于招聘、法律情报、医疗诊断和算法投资等高风险分析任务中，它们可能在数据中"发现"实际上并不存在的关系，从而引入系统性且难以检测的错误。当前的AI可靠性研究主要关注幻觉、偏见和鲁棒性三大支柱，但尚未系统研究LLM是否会在证据不足时推断出虚假的结构性关系——这构成了一种独特且基本的认知失真风险。

Method: 方法包含三大核心组件：(1) 改编三个经典心理学实验范式——社区相关性、投资相关性和阴谋信念任务——对LLM和人类（通过Prolific每任务招募100名参与者）进行直接行为对比；(2) 形式化"虚幻模式感知分数"（IPP）为"不受支持的关系推断"——即感知关系强度与证据所支持强度之差；(3) 基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的特征可解释性框架——通过构造"相关性中性"提示变体，提取原始与中性条件下token级特征的激活差异，进行特征移位分析和类别级语义分类，进而实施内部信号调整（特征级引导）。共测试了9个LLM（GPT-3.5、GPT-4o、GPT-5、GPT-5.2、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B、Llama-8B-IT、Gemma-2-9b-IT、Qwen2.5-14B-IT、Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-IT）。

Result: 主要发现包括：(1) 在社区相关性任务中，LLM平均选择少数群体的比例仅为0.15（人类为0.46），即LLM比人类低31个百分点，强烈倾向于将频繁正面属性与多数群体或大组织过度关联；(2) 在投资相关性任务中，LLM少数公司选择率比人类低9个百分点；(3) 在阴谋信念任务中，LLM平均评分（5.37）比人类（4.34）高约23.7%，更倾向于从模糊事件中构建因果叙事；(4) 思维链（CoT）提示仅部分缓解该现象，仍强于人类；(5) 控制实验（等量、变化比例）证实效应源自证据量的处理偏差；(6) SAE分析揭示：相关性中性提示下，正面/负面行为特征的激活比例发生重分配，分析性框架特征激活增强、场景特定细节特征激活减弱；(7) 特征级内部信号调整（K=10，α=0.001）可将社区相关性少数选择率提升18-29个百分点，将阴谋信念评分降低8.2%-24.6%，质量仅退化约5%。

Conclusion: 本文将"虚幻模式感知"确立为LLM中一种独立且可测量的可靠性失效模式，区别于现有的偏见（信息权重失衡）、幻觉（事实准确性）和鲁棒性（输入稳定性）三个维度——它关注的是关系有效性：即使每条单独陈述准确，模型仍可能推断出证据不支持的结构性关系。核心实证特征是"将证据量等同于证据强度"。从机制层面，该现象涉及整体性频率感知（相关性任务中正面/负面特征的激活比例）以及分析性取向与表层细节之间的表征权衡（阴谋信念任务中）。研究提供了两种互补的缓解路径：指令级校准（增强对不确定性和反面证据的敏感性）和表征级干预（直接修改与过度推断相关的内部特征激活）。代码已开源。

Abstract: Illusory pattern perception is a well-documented human cognitive tendency to infer meaningful relationships in data that is actually random. Such a tendency, often described as "connecting the dots" where none exist, can result in systematic reasoning errors. This paper investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit such perceptual tendencies, which can lead to systematic errors in downstream applications. To our knowledge, this work presents the first systematic study of illusory pattern perception in LLMs, adapting classic psychological paradigms to three tasks with direct empirical comparison to human behaviors. We find that LLMs frequently exhibit stronger illusory pattern perception than humans. In particular, models tend to over-associate frequent positive attributes with majority groups or large organizations, and show increased tendencies to construct causal narratives from ambiguous events. To uncover the mechanism behind these behaviors, we develop a feature interpretability framework based on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to analyze internal representations. Our results reveal that holistic frequency perception and analytic cognitive orientation are linked to the emergence of illusory perceptions. These findings highlight a previously underexplored cognitive-like illusion that may affect the reliability of LLM reasoning. Code available at this https URL .

</details>


### [169] [Thin Evidence, Thick Priors: How Language Models Substitute Identity for Missing Financial Facts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07798)
*Saanvi Khetan,Sankar Balasubramanian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型在给出投资建议时，当用户披露的财务信息减少时，模型如何越来越多地依赖身份信息（如姓名、性别、种族、家庭规模等）而非财务证据。核心发现是：身份对建议的影响随披露减少而显著增强，从完全披露时4.78个百分点的差异增至无披露时的10.34个百分点。家庭规模是最显著的影响属性，而性别和成长背景则表现为小额但持续的差距。文章还通过机制可解释性分析发现，消除性别方向并不能减少身份依赖的总体效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着人们越来越多地向LLM咨询财务建议，但很少完整描述自己的财务状况。研究旨在揭示当财务证据不足时，模型是否会以及如何用身份特征来填补这一空白——这对弱势用户群体有潜在的不公平影响。

Method: 使用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型，在96,600个提示上运行实验，这些提示由100个财务档案、138个角色画像和7个披露条件构建而成。采用证据"剂量梯度"设计（L0-L5嵌套披露级别），固定财务信息不变而改变角色身份，测量推荐的股票配置变化。使用双向聚类自举法进行统计推断，并进行内部机制分析（线性探测、激活补丁、方向消融）。

Result: 核心发现：(1)身份摆动从完全披露时的4.78个百分点增至无披露时的10.34个百分点的差异（2.16倍）；(2)身份对建议变异的解释力从5%增至96%；(3)家庭规模是唯一随证据减少而影响持续增大的属性；(4)性别和成长背景表现为披露无法消除的持续性差距（约1个百分点的性别差距）；(5)仅披露风险偏好一项就能减少约三分之一的身份依赖；(6)在无财务事实时，模型会编造财务理由，且这些虚构对大家庭更不利；(7)消除性别方向并不改变总体身份摆动。

Conclusion: 基于LLM的咨询系统应在用户实际达到的披露水平上进行审计，而不仅仅是在完整档案上；缓解措施应跨整个身份空间和多个披露水平来评估，而非逐个属性衡量；审计的统计单位应是角色画像而非提示本身。身份依赖不仅是单点现象，而是随披露程度变化的曲线，对财务素养较低的用户影响最大。

Abstract: People increasingly ask large language models what to do with their money, yet seldom describe their finances in full. This paper asks what a model does with the gap. Holding finances fixed and changing only who the investor is said to be, we grade the financial evidence in the prompt from eight facts to none and measure how far the recommended equity allocation moves. Across 96,600 prompts to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, built from 100 financial profiles, 138 personas and seven disclosure conditions, the average gap between two personas with identical finances rises from 4.78 percentage points at full disclosure to 10.34 points with no financial facts. A two-way cluster bootstrap counting duplicated prompts once places the ratio at 2.16 (95% interval 1.69 to 2.79), and the rise is already 1.69-fold with a single fact left. Identity explains 5% of within-profile variation in advice at full disclosure and 96% with no disclosure. Household size is the only attribute whose influence grows reliably as evidence is withdrawn. Once standard errors are clustered on the persona, the unit to which identity was assigned, most attribute-specific interactions reported in the conference version lose significance, and gender instead appears as a small standing gap that full disclosure does not close. Stating risk appetite alone brings the swing into the range seen with two to seven generic facts. With no facts, the model's one-line rationale cites incomes, debts and savings it was never told, and these invented finances turn adverse more often for larger households. Inside the network, gender is linearly decodable at every layer, and ablating the gender direction at five layers leaves the aggregate identity swing unchanged. Advisory systems built on such models should be audited at the disclosure levels users actually reach, and judged across the whole identity space rather than one attribute at a time.

</details>


### [170] [ThinkFuse: Trajectory-Aware Test-Time Fusion for Small Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07803)
*Myunghoon Kang,Jungseob Lee,Jaehyung Seo,Heuiseok Lim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ThinkFuse 是一种无需训练的测试时融合框架，通过比较片段级不确定性偏移与轨迹级不确定性趋势，选择性地在不稳定推理点将辅助模型的推理路径融合到主模型的思维链轨迹中，从而提升小型推理模型的推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型推理模型（SRMs）在复杂推理任务中表现强劲，但一旦进入错误推理路径往往难以恢复。现有测试时融合方法依赖局部融合信号判断干预时机，容易被瞬时不稳定性波动误导，反而强化不稳定的推理轨迹。需要一种能够根据轨迹历史校准干预时机的方法。

Method: ThinkFuse 的核心方法包括：(1) EWCA（指数加权因果聚合）度量，将 token 级不确定性聚合为片段级不确定性，捕捉片段内部的不确定性动态；(2) 自适应阈值机制，基于主模型历史不确定性的指数移动平均统计量与累计融合比例进行校准；(3) 轨迹兼容性评分，当触发融合时，调用辅助模型生成替代片段，利用主模型的 PPL 选择与当前上下文最兼容的片段继续推理；(4) 软预算机制，通过二次调制惩罚过度融合。

Result: 在 MATH-500、GSM8K、AIME24、GPQA、NQ-Open 五个推理基准上，ThinkFuse 优于 Cool-Fusion、AdaFuse 等测试时融合基线和 Self-consistency 等测试时计算基线。以 Qwen3-4B 作为主模型时，在所有基准上均获得稳定提升，且在不同模型族组合下保持鲁棒性。ThinkFuse 所需的融合触发次数和生成 token 数更少，计算效率（精度/TFLOPs）显著高于基线方法。AIME24 上最大提升达 +20.0，GPQA 上 +10.6。消融实验验证了软预算机制、片段长度 T=8、Primary PPL 评分和熵度量的有效性。

Conclusion: ThinkFuse 验证了有效的协作推理取决于决定"何时干预"和"保留什么"，为在测试时扩展小型推理模型提供了一种实用、无需训练的方法。实验表明，互补的辅助推理轨迹而非单纯增加计算量是性能提升的关键。局限性包括对辅助模型互补性的依赖、需要推理专用的辅助模型，以及对显式推理跨度和分词器对齐的需求。

Abstract: Small reasoning models (SRMs) have shown strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by generating extended chain-of-thought trajectories, but they often fail to recover once their reasoning enters an erroneous path. Existing test-time fusion methods rely on local fusion signals to determine when to trigger fusion, which can be misled by transient uncertainty fluctuations and may reinforce unstable reasoning trajectories. We propose ThinkFuse, a training-free test-time fusion framework that selectively intervenes in unreliable reasoning segments. ThinkFuse compares segment-level uncertainty shifts with trajectory-level uncertainty trends to identify unstable reasoning points and fuse auxiliary reasoning paths into the primary model's trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ThinkFuse outperforms baselines on mathematical and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks, with consistent gains across model-family combinations, and remains robust with a smaller primary model. Our analysis shows that ThinkFuse requires fewer fusion triggers and generates fewer tokens, highlighting the efficiency of selective triggering. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [171] [Do I Need the Cloud? Uncertainty-Aware Step-Level Handoff for Small Language Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07816)
*Abolfazl Younesi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出StepGate，一种面向小型语言模型(SLM)智能体的不确定性感知、逐步级(per-step)卸载框架。它通过评分本地SLM的动作不确定性，仅在必要时将单个智能体步骤升级到更强的云端LLM执行，从而在保持本地推理效率的同时提升任务可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型路由方法大多在查询级别(query-level)做一次路由决策，但智能体在工具调用场景下，每步决策的难度会随中间观察结果动态变化。对整个用户请求进行全局路由会浪费本地能力，而让SLM全程执行则会累积结构化工具错误。作者希望回答：SLM能否在执行前预测下一步动作可能失败，并据此仅升级必要步骤。

Method: StepGate将路由单元从查询粒度细化为(state, action)粒度：本地SLM先生成结构化动作(工具名+参数)，一个轻量级门控(gate)综合六类不确定性信号(token不确定性、工具间隔、结构化schema、一致性、状态、风险层级)，通过逻辑回归/梯度提升等校准分类器估计失败概率\hat{p}_fail。结合风险等级与云端预算选择三类动作：本地执行(L)、有界本地校验(V)、升级到云端(C)。对模糊步骤，自适应触发K次采样的一致性特征以节省本地算力；并最小化上传云端的上下文(子目标、相关schema、状态摘要、提议动作、风险元数据、必要观察)。训练和阈值选择严格在验证集完成，不接触测试标签。

Result: 单步测试(52任务BFCL子集)：Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B对在30.8%升级率下达到82.7%任务成功率，相对仅本地(67.3%)提升15.4点，相对随机升级(75.4%/33.8%)提升7.3点，错误高风险动作仅3.8%(本地仅15.4%)。多轮测试(100任务，100个智能体轨迹，平均4.1步)：在30.0%云动作预算下达到69.0%轨迹成功率/84.0%动作成功率，对比本地仅48.0%/70.5%(提升21点，配对bootstrap p=0.0003)，随机升级60.0%/78.2%，查询级路由57.0%/77.1%(p=0.029)；55%成功轨迹是本地/云端协作执行。强模型仅(100%云)为82.0%/91.0%。模型规模影响显著：3B本地模型接近强模型上限，路由增益有限。门控GBDT模型AUROC达0.854，ECE 0.121。风险特征在等预算下未稳定提升任务成功率，作者视之为研究标注而非形式安全保证。

Conclusion: StepGate证明选择性逐步级升级可显著缩小本地SLM与强模型之间的性能差距(超过60%)，同时保持70%步骤在本地执行、远程token量约为全云方案28%。其不确定性感知门控优于本地推理与查询级路由，接近但并不显著优于随机升级和自一致性路由。主要局限：仅评估单一模型族(Qwen2.5)、单一强后端(7B 4-bit)、脚本化任务；单步测试集小(52任务)，单步比较置信区间重叠；风险层级是研究性标注而非形式安全保证；门控为经验校准，不具备RACER式的有限样本误路由风险控制保证。后续工作方向包括将共形风险控制(conformal risk control)推广到状态化、逐步级的路由设置。

Abstract: Small language models (SLMs) are attractive as local agent controllers because they reduce remote inference, latency, and deployment footprint, yet structured tool errors can cause an agent step to fail. Existing routers typically select a model once per query. However, agents expose sequential decision points whose difficulty dynamically changes based on intermediate observations. We propose STEPGATE, an uncertainty-aware handoff framework that scores each local SLM action and selectively escalates challenging steps to a stronger model. On a 52-task held-out single-step BFCL-derived test split, the Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B pair attains 82.7% task success with 30.8% escalation, versus 67.3% local-only and 75.4% random escalation (which uses 33.8% escalation). In a separate multi-turn evaluation, STEPGATE achieves 69.0% trajectory success and 84.0% action success using only 30.0% cloud actions, compared with 48.0%/70.5% local-only, 60.0%/78.2% random escalation, and 57.0%/77.1% query-level routing (strong-only achieves 82.0% trajectory success at 100% cloud actions). These results suggest that step-level escalation recovers a large share of the performance gap to the stronger Qwen2.5-7B backend at a matched cloud-action rate while transmitting fewer tokens remotely. However, our evaluation is limited to one model family, a single stronger backend, and scripted tasks. Furthermore, the test sets are small, multi-turn comparisons rely on paired intervals and statistical tests, and our risk tiers serve as research annotations rather than formal safety guarantees.

</details>


### [172] [Agentic Semantic Sensing for Resource-Adaptive AI-RAN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07829)
*Zhongqin Wang,Xiaoqi Zhang,Nan Yang,Kai Wu,J. Andrew Zhang,Y. Jay Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Agentic SemS is a closed-loop semantic sensing framework for AI-RAN that adaptively controls sensing profiles and observation duration based on evolving task-level evidence, reducing sensing-resource cost by 25.33% on the Widar3.0 gesture-recognition task while retaining 85.79% Macro-F1.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Open-loop semantic sensing cannot adapt sensing configurations or observation duration to evolving task-level information, leading to wasted radio and processing resources when lower-cost observations would suffice or when sensing continues after reliable inference becomes possible.

Method: A profile-conditioned causal Transformer with KV caching maintains an incrementally updated semantic belief from streaming CPI observations; a candidate-conditioned utility network predicts the cost-adjusted task-level benefit of continuing under each feasible profile, supporting both next-profile selection and semantic early exit. The expected semantic gain is theoretically linked to conditional mutual information (VoI interpretation).

Result: On Widar3.0 six-class gesture recognition with six emulated sensing profiles, the resource-efficient Agentic SemS reduces normalized cumulative sensing cost by 25.33% vs. full-sequence High while achieving 85.79% Macro-F1. Adaptive profiles alone cut cost by 14.81%; semantic early exit adds a further 12.35% relative reduction at a 0.97 pp Macro-F1 cost.

Conclusion: Semantic feedback can jointly adapt sensing configuration and duration, with profile selection and early exit providing complementary resource savings. Future work will extend the framework to dynamic communication-feasible profile sets and evaluate energy, latency, and signaling overhead on physical AI-RAN platforms.

Abstract: Semantic sensing (SemS) acquires task-relevant information rather than reconstructing complete physical information. Existing SemS formulations typically operate open loop: sensing configurations and observation schedules are fixed before inference and cannot respond to evolving task-level evidence. We propose Agentic SemS, a closed-loop framework for AI-enabled radio access networks (AI-RANs) that controls sensing within a communication-feasible profile set. A profile-conditioned causal Transformer updates the semantic belief from streaming observations, while key-value caching enables efficient state updates across profile changes without repeatedly processing the complete history. A semantic utility network estimates the task-level benefit of acquiring the next observation block under each feasible profile after accounting for sensing cost. The resulting continuation utilities jointly support next-profile selection and semantic early exit, adapting sensing configuration and duration to evolving evidence. The expected semantic gain is further related to conditional mutual information, providing a value-of-information interpretation of continued online sensing. Experiments on Widar3.0 with six emulated sensing profiles show that, in comparison with full-sequence High, the resource-efficient Agentic setting reduces normalized cumulative sensing cost by 25.33% while achieving 85.79% Macro-F1. At the same utility checkpoint, semantic early exit provides a further 12.35% cost reduction over adaptive sensing without early exit, with a 0.97-percentage-point Macro-F1 decrease.

</details>


### [173] [DHCG: Dynamic Construction of Hierarchical Collaboration Graphs for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07835)
*Jie Ren,Jiakang Yuan,Chenyu Huang,Hezeer Ma,Jiayuan Fan,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DHCG 是一种面向 LLM 多智能体系统的动态分层协作图构建框架，通过将 MAS 设计建模为 POMDP，由 Planner 在执行过程中根据查询与反馈逐步构建协作图（角色、依赖、规模），并结合 Action-aware Preference Optimization 训练 Planner，在代码生成、数学推理与领域推理等七个基准上达到 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态 MAS 方法存在三大局限：1）组成受限——基于预定义节点/算子，无法按任务生成角色；2）依赖错位——通信依赖由模板或全局目标决定，与下游信息需求不匹配；3）规模僵化——交互轮次和规模在执行前固定，难以适应推理需求的动态变化。论文将 MAS 设计重新建模为可在推理时动态决定组成与规模的序列决策问题。

Method: 1）问题形式化：将 MAS 表示为分层有向无环图 G=(V,E)，按层划分，同层并行、层间串行；将图的构建建模为 POMDP，状态包含图的构造历史与已积累的 agent 输出，观测为查询和最近一层的角色-输出对。2）DHCG 框架含 Planner、Worker、Generator 三个模块：Planner 基于查询与逐层反馈决定是否 FINALIZE 或 EXPAND 新层，并在 EXPAND 时为每个新角色选择性地从前层路由必要信息（稀疏依赖）；Worker 并行执行角色；Generator 在 FINALIZE 时仅基于 Planner 选定的子集输出合成最终响应。4）Planner 训练：采用 Action-aware Preference Optimization（APO），通过递归执行构造树状偏好数据，构建 cross-action（Expand vs Finalize，仅用任务分）和 same-action（考虑任务分与执行成本）两类偏好对，并按价值差加权，使用加权 DPO 目标进行离线优化。

Result: 在 7 个基准（MBPP、HumanEval、MATH-500、AIME、GSM8K、GPQA、MMLU-Pro）上，DHCG 平均准确率达 73.43%，相对单 agent 基线提升 13.06 点，超出静态/图/工作流类强基线（LLM-Debate、G-Designer、MaAS）4.76/3.33/2.77 点；Pass@5 上同样优于 CoT（HumanEval 98.47%）；Planner 与 Worker 模型替换（GPT-5.4-mini、DeepSeek-V4-Pro 等）均可泛化；消融显示动态规模控制贡献最大（去除后 -2.63）；相比 G-Designer 在 MMLU-Pro 上减少 50%+ token 消耗，同时保持精度优势。

Conclusion: DHCG 验证了"反馈驱动的图构建"范式的有效性：在推理时按需构造协作结构，能更好地对齐角色组成、信息依赖与系统规模与任务难度；通过 POMDP 形式化与 APO 训练，可用一个 8B Planner 取得与更大模型相当的规划能力，并具备跨 Planner 与 Worker 的良好泛化性。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have demonstrated strong capabilities in solving complex problems across diverse domains. Recently, the dynamic orchestration of agent systems has become an important research direction. However, existing methods suffer from limited composition, misaligned dependencies, and inflexible scale, restricting their ability to adapt to reasoning requirements during execution. To address these limitations, we reframe MAS design as a partially observable Markov decision process, in which both the composition and scale of the MAS are dynamically determined. We propose DHCG, a novel framework that coordinates three modules (Planner, Worker, and Generator) to progressively construct a dynamic hierarchical collaboration graph from scratch based on the query and evolving execution feedback. At each step, guided by feedback, the Planner generates a set of distinct and complementary roles tailored to the current reasoning needs and selectively routes relevant information to each role. It can also finalize the hierarchical collaboration graph early or progressively expand it when additional reasoning is required. We further introduce action-aware preference optimization to train the Planner to make more effective decisions when constructing hierarchical collaboration graphs. We systematically evaluate DHCG across code generation, mathematical reasoning, and domain-specific reasoning benchmarks. DHCG achieves state-of-the-art average performance among the compared methods, improving over the single-agent baseline by 13.06 points and outperforming both static and dynamic MAS baselines by 2.77-8.02 points. Additional experiments further demonstrate its generalization across different Planner backbones and unseen Worker models.

</details>


### [174] [RA-MoWE: Workflow-Affinity Embeddings for Query Clustering and Agentic Workflow Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07851)
*Qi Cheng,Shengyu Chen,Wei Cheng,Yiqun Xie,Haoyu Wang,Haifeng Chen,Xiaowei Jia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RA-MoWE提出了一种基于"工作流亲和性嵌入"的框架，通过聚类查询并为每个聚类生成可复用的专家工作流，在推理时减少LLM调用次数的同时提升任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体工作流（agentic workflows）让LLM能够通过协调推理、工具使用和验证来解决复杂任务。现有方法存在两种权衡：(1) 为整个任务集设计一个工作流可能忽略单个查询所需的推理策略差异；(2) 为每个查询搜索新工作流则重复了昂贵的优化过程。核心问题是如何识别应共享同一工作流的查询组，以及每组需要何种计算。传统的语义相似性并不一定能反映查询是否受益于相同的推理策略。

Method: RA-MoWE框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 工作流亲和性嵌入——用固定参考工作流集合（probes）对查询执行得到的任务分数向量来表征查询，反映查询在不同推理策略下的表现模式；(3) 离线阶段对探针执行结果进行聚类（k-means, J=6），并对每个聚类通过LLM优化器（基于执行反馈和失败信息）搜索专门的工作流专家；(4) 嵌入编码器——训练一个MLP头从查询文本预测亲和性嵌入（基于冻结BGE特征），使部署时无需执行参考工作流即可选择专家。12个探针包括Direct、CoT、CoT-SC、ToT、Self-refine、Reflexion、RAG、ReAct、Tool use、Debate、Role team、Decompose，每个坐标取S=3次重复的平均。训练使用600查询（AIME/GPQA/CodeContests/LiveCodeBench），测试300查询。

Result: 在300个测试查询上，RA-MoWE将平均任务分数提升了4.04个百分点（相比从参考工作流中选择），同时推理时LLM调用次数减少27.7%。具体而言，Guided-B达到0.3358（2.51次调用/query），优于Probe-menu-B的0.2955（2.92次调用/query）。实验涉及数学、科学、编程和代码修复（500个SWE-bench Verified实例）四个领域，并比较了六类基线方法（AFlow、ADAS、ScoreFlow、FlowReasoner、MasRouter、FrugalGPT等）。然而，论文承认主要比较在统计上不显著（Holm校正后p=1），且许多理论分析缺乏数值验证。

Conclusion: 工作流亲和性为学习查询表示和构建服务的工作流提供了共同基础。实验展示了探针互补性、重度分析中的测量亲和性特化收益以及从聚类分布初始化的紧凑工作流的有效性。嵌入编码器使该构造可从查询文本复用——其分配保真度决定了多少行为结构能够到达部署场景。论文以理论界限（附录A）严格界定了框架各组件（测量、编码器分配、搜索生成）在何种条件下能保留探针oracle的优势，并明确指出哪些假设未被现有实证验证。

Abstract: Agentic workflows enable large language models (LLMs) to solve complex tasks by coordinating reasoning, tool use, and verification. However, a workflow optimized for an entire task collection can overlook differences in the reasoning strategies that individual queries need, while searching for a new workflow for every query repeats costly optimization. To address this tradeoff, we introduce RA-MoWE, a framework that uses workflow-affinity embeddings to cluster queries and guide the generation of reusable expert workflows. Each embedding records how well a fixed set of reference workflows solves a query, revealing similarities in which reasoning strategies are effective. RA-MoWE uses each cluster's queries and average embedding to initialize and refine a specialized workflow through execution feedback. An embedding encoder predicts these embeddings from query text, allowing new queries to select a generated expert without first executing the reference workflows. On a 300-query test set drawn from four benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and programming, RA-MoWE improves average task score by 4.04 percentage points over selecting among the reference workflows, while using 27.7% fewer language-model calls at inference.

</details>


### [175] [WorkflowOps: Learning Agent Collaboration Priors for Multi-Agent Workflow Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07860)
*Qi Cheng,Shengyu Chen,Wei Cheng,Zhengzhang Chen,Xiaowei Jia,Haoyu Wang,Haifeng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WorkflowOps提出一个无训练的、基于历史的多智能体工作流编排框架，通过转移概率矩阵引导DAG构建、需求驱动的智能体创建循环以及分层语义匹配，使多智能体系统在复杂任务中能复用历史协作模式并按需扩展能力，在代码、数学和问答基准上显著超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多智能体编排层普遍缺乏持久状态记忆：每个新任务都需从零分解、分配并执行，无法从历史成功工作流中获益，导致API成本、延迟和错误累积增加。现有改进方法（拓扑选择、动态协调、学习优化等）通常孤立地解决某一方面，且多依赖任务级训练或搜索，缺乏轻量、可解释、历史条件化的统一编排机制。

Method: 将历史条件化工作流构建建模为受约束的DAG近似优化问题，目标函数Q平衡三项：历史协作先验对齐（Align）、语义充分性（Suff）和结构并行性（Par），受硬依赖、 acyclic性和智能体池单调扩展约束。三个耦合机制：(1) 从历史工作流构建行随机化转移概率矩阵P，在DAG构建中用于层内排序优化、概率阈值软边建议和传递性归约以最大化并行；(2) 充分性驱动的智能体创建循环，通过语义匹配分数φ检测能力缺口（φ<τ），由LLM生成专用智能体，并同时将其预测的前驱/后继协作关系注入P，实现立即可用；(3) 分层语义匹配，使用Sentence-BERT（all-MiniLM-L6-v2）进行快速确定性能力匹配作为第一层，仅对低置信度案例调用LLM验证，相比纯LLM路由减少80%以上的LLM路由调用。系统支持Linear和DAG两种执行模式，遵循分层拓扑并行执行。

Result: 在Mixed（300题，HumanEval/MBPP/GSM8K/MATH/DROP/HotpotQA）和Mixed_Hard（694题，AIME 2025/LiveCodeBench/CodeContests/GPQA Diamond）两个基准上，以gpt-5为骨干：Mixed上WorkflowOps (DAG) 达到0.890总体通过率，较MetaAgent（0.751）提升13.9绝对点，较ADAS（0.694）提升19.6点；CODE类别达0.960，超出最近基线40+点；Mixed_Hard上达到0.770，超出所有完整完成的基线至少15点。消融实验验证三机制：去除转移矩阵降4.5点、禁用智能体演化降1.7点、TF-IDF替代嵌入降8.5-13点、纯LLM匹配准确率更低且成本更高；语义匹配为最大单因素，转移动力学先验提供持续额外增益，DAG构造在Linear基础上增加适度提升。效率上，参考配置平均14.8次LLM调用、43.6k token/查询，中位605秒墙钟时间。

Conclusion: WorkflowOps证明简单的频率基协作统计（无需梯度训练）结合持久的智能体池演化和语义能力匹配，可作为未来工作流构建的有效操作先验；该框架轻量、可解释、增量更新，并在结构化、可分解任务（尤其是代码和数学）上取得最大收益。其局限在于：转移矩阵仅捕获一阶成对交接、动态智能体创建质量依赖LLM生成、单一共享矩阵可能不如领域特定矩阵、未评估创建智能体的长期重用效果。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed for complex knowledge work, yet their orchestration layers remain largely memoryless: each new task is decomposed, assigned, and executed from scratch with no benefit from prior successful executions. We present WorkflowOps, a multi-agent workflow orchestration framework that learns agent collaboration priors from historical workflows and expands its agent pool on demand to cover new capability requirements. Our approach introduces three coupled mechanisms. First, a transition probability matrix captures pairwise agent collaboration frequencies from past workflows and applies them as soft guidance during DAG workflow construction through intra-layer ordering optimization, probability-thresholded edge suggestion, and transitive reduction for parallelism maximization. Second, a sufficiency-driven agent creation loop detects capability gaps via semantic matching scores, generates specialized agents through an LLM, and simultaneously injects them into the collaboration matrix, so that newly created agents are immediately usable with predicted collaboration priors. Third, a layered semantic matching strategy uses pre-trained sentence embeddings for fast, deterministic capability matching as a first pass, invoking LLM verification only for low-confidence cases, thereby reducing LLM routing calls by over 80\% compared to pure-LLM approaches. Experiments on mixed code, math, and question-answering suites show that WorkflowOps improves end-to-end pass rates over recent workflow-construction baselines, with the largest gains on structured, decomposable tasks where past agent handoff patterns transfer.

</details>


### [176] [Self-Referenced Social Preferences: Cooperation without Observing Others Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07881)
*Mohamed Ayman Mohamed,Harshil Kotamreddy,Marcos Menon Jose*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"自我参照社会偏好"框架,使多智能体强化学习中的智能体无需观察他人奖励信号,通过学习自身奖励模型并应用于他人观测到的转移,从而在Escape Room、Clean Up和Commons Harvest三个序贯社会困境中实现合作。提出两种整合方式:自参照奖励(SRR,加入奖励)和自参照优势(SRA,加权策略更新),并发现SRR配合值前瞻更利于不公平厌恶,SRA利于纯利他偏好,且在公平性上常优于直接观察真实奖励的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MARL中基于社会偏好的合作方法依赖智能体观察其他智能体的私有奖励信号,但现实场景中(如人类交互或自动驾驶)智能体只能观察他人行为和结果,无法获取其私有奖励。因此需要一种不依赖他人奖励信号即可实现合作的方法。

Method: 每个智能体学习自身奖励函数模型,将其应用于其他智能体观测到的转移,获得"自我参照"评估。两种整合方式:(1) SRR(自参照奖励):将评估加入学习奖励,可选加入critic的价值前瞻;(2) SRA(自参照优势):将评估加入策略更新系数。在Escape Room(N=5)、Clean Up(N=5)和Commons Harvest(N=7)三个序贯社会困境上,采用独立PPO学习器,使用EI(利他)、SVO(社会价值取向)、IA(不公平厌恶)三种社会偏好算子进行比较。

Result: 在三个环境中,智能体均能在不观察他人奖励的情况下学会合作(包括独立学习者失败的情形),且在Clean Up中获得比观察真实奖励者更公平的回报分配。SRR-IA+V在公平分配上最优(Nash福利270,最贫困者获得251.5),SRA-EI在合作行为持续性上最强。部分可观测性(15×15窗口)下SRA仍维持合作。Commons Harvest中自参照方法仍落后于真实奖励方法(744 vs 416集体回报)。差异厌恶偏好适合SRR+价值前瞻;纯利他偏好适合SRA。

Conclusion: 显式访问他人奖励信号并非学习合作行为的必要条件,社会偏好可基于从观测行为中得出的他人结果的自我参照评估。在奖励函数共享时可近似他人实际奖励,在偏好不同时则提供自我参照的反事实评估,该信号可在序贯社会困境中维持合作。

Abstract: Social preferences can promote cooperation in multi-agent reinforcement learning, but existing approaches often require agents to observe the rewards of their peers. In many real-world interactions, however, an agent can, as humans do, observe others' behavior and outcomes without access to their private reward signals. We introduce self-referenced social preferences, in which each agent learns a model of its own reward, applies it to other agents' observed transitions to assess their outcomes from its own perspective, and feeds these self-referenced assessments into standard social preferences. We study two ways to incorporate these assessments: modifying the learning reward, or using them to weight policy updates. We evaluate the approach on three sequential social dilemmas, Escape Room, Clean Up, and Commons Harvest, which require volunteering, public-good contribution, and resource restraint, respectively. Across all three environments, agents learn cooperative behavior without observing others' rewards, including in settings where independent learners fail to cooperate, and frequently achieve more equitable divisions of jointly produced returns than agents with access to true rewards. The effective integration point depends on the social preference: inequity aversion works best in the reward together with a value look-ahead, whereas a purely benevolent preference benefits from policy-update weighting. Under partial observability, the policy-update approach continues to support cooperation. These results show that explicit access to other agents' reward signals is not necessary for learning cooperative behavior: social preferences can instead be grounded in self-referenced assessments of others' outcomes derived from their observed behavior.

</details>


### [177] [ShanLiangRen: A Nutrition Agent for Personalized Daily Meal Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07886)
*Miao Xie,Xiao Zhang,Yuan Wang,Ruixin Zhu,Chunli Lv*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出个性化饮食规划问题MDP及营养代理ShanLiangRen，通过精确RAG子图匹配缩小候选空间，结合Pareto引导的多目标LLM迭代优化，输出含食材份量的可执行日餐计划与营养合规报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有饮食规划难以同时满足个性化约束与多维营养目标，且用户需求随反馈动态变化，导致通用指南与可执行方案之间存在显著差距；LLM直接生成存在约束违反、份量缺失、营养不可验证等问题。

Method: 1) 形式化定义MDP问题，含硬约束（个性化需求、膳食结构）与软目标（多维营养区间偏离）；2) 基于精确子图匹配的RAG进行硬约束过滤与候选空间缩减；3) LLM在缩减空间内生成带份量的候选计划；4) 基于营养成分表的确定性营养计算与约束验证；5) 基于偏差向量的Pareto支配过滤+LLM最小修改迭代精炼。

Result: 在300个规划实例上，ShanLiangRen取得PCS 100%、EPC 100%、NIA 78.9%、AND 0.09，显著优于GPT-5.4、Gemini-3、Doubao-seed 2.0等基线；唯一不足是延迟较高（61s），但对日餐规划可接受。系统已部署为微信小程序。

Conclusion: ShanLiangRen通过精确检索+Pareto引导的LLM精炼，有效桥接了个性化饮食约束与可执行方案之间的鸿沟，在约束满足、营养达标、可执行性、可验证性上均优于直接LLM生成，仅付出可接受的额外延迟代价。

Abstract: Dietary nutrition planning plays an important role in chronic disease management and maintaining a healthy body. In applications, it must simultaneously satisfy personalized constraints and reasonable multidimensional nutritional goals. These two aspects often conflict, and user constraints evolve with feedback, resulting in a substantial gap between generic guidelines and executable plans. To bridge this gap, we first propose the personalized fully quantified multiobjective dietary planning problem (MDP). To tackle MDP, we develop a nutrition agent, ShanLiangRen. The system first transforms dietary specifications, nutrient data, user attributes and natural language requirements into an individualized constrained planning instance. It then employs an exact retrieval-augmented generation method to shrink the feasible candidate set from a large scale ingredient and recipe space. Finally, it adopts a refinement guided by Pareto principles, where an LLM iteratively revises candidate plans under deterministic nutrition computation and feedback from constraint verification. The system outputs fully quantified meal plans with explicit ingredients and portion sizes, together with reports on nutrition compliance that show constraint satisfaction and nutrient interval attainment. We have released the system online as a WeChat Program, ShanLiangRen. A demo video is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [178] [Textual Environmental Context and Spatial Graphs for LLM-Based Regional SST Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07895)
*Xiong Li,Xiaowei Zhou,Yanwei Yu,Qian Cui,Junyu Dong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于大语言模型(LLM)的区域海表温度(SST)预报框架,将文本形式的环境上下文与静态/动态图空间状态相结合,通过因子化空间前缀投影将双GCN编码的靶点表征映射为连续前缀令牌输入LLM,实现多步条件式数值生成,并辅以基于规则的事后可解释模块。在中国南海数据集上,完整配置在MAE和R²上取得最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SST预报受局部时间持续性、区域空间相关性以及随预报日期变化的环境条件(热带气旋、ENSO、区域环流等)共同影响。现有基于LLM的时序预报方法未能明确地将"预报日期相关的环境描述"与"日期变化的区域空间关系"联合供给LLM,且将整个SST网格序列化为文本不现实。因此需要一种文本-图分离的接口,将异构信息以合适的形式联合呈现给LLM。

Method: 方法核心包括:(1)任务形式化为条件式数值生成——靶点SST/异常历史、日期对齐的环境记录(IBTrACS热带气旋、ERA5 850hPa风场、Niño3.4等)与静态海洋知识构成文本提示;(2)构建静态地理-气候图(大圆距离+指数衰减,ℓ_s=111km)与日期相关的动态图(由历史Pearson相关图k=10邻居 + 局部热带气旋高斯影响核加权组合A^d_t=0.6A^x+0.4A^e);(3)双GCN分别编码静态和动态分支,拼接取靶点表征h∈R^48;(4)分层空间前缀融合(48→128→32×64→32×3584),比直接映射参数减少约91%,前缀长度与格点数解耦;(5)基于Qwen2.5-7B(8-bit+LoRA r=8)自回归微调,生成未来10步SST;(6)独立的基于规则模块:用线性斜率阈值分类预报/因子方向,匹配52条知识条目,返回带引用的源链接解释或中性/冲突兜底。

Result: 在0.25° OISST中国南海64×64网格数据集上,完整配置(基于Qwen2.5-7B)对比PCFNet、CoTCN、PANN、EarthFarseer等基线,在10步预报中平均MAE由0.344降至0.323、平均R²由0.953升至0.955,平均RMSE由0.448降至0.445(均在lead 1与7–10步优势显著);LLM骨干对比中Llama-3.1-8B获得最低平均RMSE 0.434,Qwen在平均MAE与R²最优,呈现指标-时效依赖的权衡;消融实验表明去掉动态文本RMSE升至0.449,去掉静态知识升至0.437,二者皆去掉升至0.456,再去掉双GNN升至0.464,验证文本与空间分支的互补贡献;可解释模块给出了热带气旋/ENSO/风场/历史趋势四因子与52条知识条目匹配的可追溯解释及中性/冲突兜底。

Conclusion: 该工作证明可通过对齐日期的"文本+图前缀"接口将异构SST预报条件高效供给LLM,在南海多步预报上取得了最优平均MAE与R²,消融显示静态知识、动态上下文与双GNN空间分支贡献互补,且骨干选择带来指标-时效的权衡;未来工作将扩展更多LLM骨干并检验跨区域泛化能力。需注意:消融将双图作为一个整体,未分别考察两个GCN及前缀投影器;解释模块为规则化的因子方向匹配,不构成因果归因。

Abstract: Sea surface temperature (SST) forecasting depends on local temporal persistence, regional spatial dependence, and environmental conditions that evolve with the forecast date. We study how these heterogeneous conditions can be presented to a large language model (LLM) for regional multi-step forecasting without serializing the full SST grid as text. We formulate forecasting as conditional numerical generation: historical SST and anomaly sequences, date-aligned environmental records, and static ocean knowledge form a textual context, while regional spatial state is supplied through continuous graph-derived prefixes. A static graph encodes persistent geographic--climatological relations, and a dynamic graph encodes recent SST correlations and localized tropical-cyclone influence. Two graph neural networks produce a target-node representation that is mapped by a spatial-prefix fusion and injected into the LLM input. On SST forecasting in the South China Sea, the complete configuration achieves the best MAE and $\Rtwo$ among the compared methods over ten forecast steps. Alongside the numerical forecast, a rule-based module matches predicted trends and environmental-factor directions with knowledge entries to return source-linked, post-hoc contextual explanations.

</details>


### [179] [Isotropic Yet Undecodable: The Sequential Content-Sufficiency Gap in Latent-Predictive Text Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07906)
*K. P. Santoso,N. Z. Fadil,F. P. Harsanti,R. V. H. Ginardi,G. N. Iyer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究序列内容充分性问题，揭示了视图一致性和各向同性高斯正则化并不保证对有序目标内容的可恢复性，并通过 CANOPE 框架实验验证了几何规律性与下游任务可访问性之间存在显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在序列生成任务中，文本表示需保留有序的目标内容信息。现有的视图一致性自监督学习和各向同性高斯正则化（如 LeJEPA）声称可保证下游风险最小化，但作者质疑这些几何保证是否足以保留恢复有序目标内容所必需的判别信息，从而动机在于分离输入模糊性、表示损失和读出失配，并评估几何规律性对下游任务可访问性的实际影响。

Method: 1. 信息论分解：定义内容充分性缺口 Δ_info，将期望对数损失分解为输入模糊性、表示损失和读出失配三部分。2. 构造反例（定理2）：证明完美一致性和联合各向同性高斯性可与零目标信息共存。3. 规范锚定限制（命题3）和分词监督约束（命题4）：给出固定读出头的可观察方向与内容界限。4. 固定惩罚岭分析（定理5）：证明在保持目标信息不变的前提下，有效秩的提高可能增加或降低固定读出的风险，取决于目标对齐阈值 η*。5. CANOPE 框架：非自回归架构，包含有序潜在画布、规范分词监督和 VISReg 几何正则化，分 Controlled-Length（CL）和 Parametrized-Length（PL）两套设置对比潜在一致性（PL0/CL-LP/LT）与分词接地（PL2/CL-GP/GT）。6. 实验：在 40,000 验证序列上测试检索和重构，在 LJSpeech 3,930 验证话语上结合冻结 PL0/PL2 与 MatchaTTS 读出测试语音合成。

Result: 1. CL 设置：CL-GP/GT 在可恢复严重度3下达到 99.985%/99.980% 检索和 98.97%/98.78% 精确重构，而 CL-LP/LT 仅 0.52%/0.75% 检索。2. PL 设置：PL0 和 PL2 的池化秩几乎相同（15.76 vs 15.82），但自然损坏下位置 Recall@1 分别为 13.5% 和 98.8%。3. 语音合成：冻结 PL2 + MatchaTTS 在损坏文本上 WER 为 21.54%，而冻结 PL0 为 99.22%，端到端 MatchaTTS 为 10.93%。4. 外部语义任务 PL0/PL2 在 SemAntoNeg 和 PAWS 等任务上表现较弱，表明几何规律性本身不能保证语义泛化。5. 岭分析有效秩增加对同一目标秩有 0.1276 → 0.2066 的风险上升，对另一目标秩有 0.6944 → 0.3086 的风险下降，验证了定理5的阈值条件。

Conclusion: 1. 视图一致性和联合各向同性高斯性可与零目标信息共存，规范分词接地才是保留有序内容的关键。2. 仅凭池化秩或几何规律性不能确定预测风险；目标对齐比纯几何更重要。3. CANOPE 的对照实验表明，分词接地能在可恢复输入下实现近完美恢复，潜在一致性即使在相似秩下也访问困难。4. 该访问差异在训练语音读出后仍然存在，外部评估则将规范匹配与语义泛化区分开来。5. 几何诊断（各向同性协方差、有效秩）必须与目标特定的访问评估并用，LeJEPA 类型的最坏情况目标秩保证与特定目标的实际困难保留兼容。

Abstract: We study sequential content sufficiency by investigating whether a representation retains the ordered target information available in its input. An information-theoretic decomposition separates input ambiguity, representation loss, and readout mismatch. We construct recoverable views where perfect agreement and joint isotropic Gaussianity coexist with zero target information, and establish limits imposed by deterministic canonical anchors. Token log-loss provides a one-sided information-loss bound; a fixed-penalty ridge analysis shows why rank alone cannot determine prediction risk. These results motivate CANOPE, a nonautoregressive framework with ordered latent canvases, canonical-token supervision, and geometric regularization. On 40,000 validation sequences, latent-agreement (PL0) and token-grounded (PL2) have nearly identical pooled ranks but reach 13.5% and 98.8% positional Recall@1, respectively, under strong natural corruption when the correct target length is provided. On 3,930 LJSpeech validation utterances, frozen PL2 with a trained MatchaTTS readout yields 21.54% word error rate (WER) on corrupted text, versus 99.22% for frozen PL0, while end-to-end MatchaTTS reaches 10.93%. These results show that geometric regularity alone does not guarantee recoverable sequential content or effective downstream access in the text settings studied here.

</details>


### [180] [Continuous Memory Machines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07907)
*Ciaran Regan,Kai Arulkumaran,Luke Darlow,Stefania Druga,Sebastian Risi,Llion Jones*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为连续记忆机（Continuous Memory Machine, CMM）的新型循环神经网络架构。该架构通过引入矩阵值的长时记忆（LTM）与短时记忆（STM）分离的双重记忆系统，并使用Transformer作为双向读写机制来联合更新两者，解决了传统RNN中短时计算与长时存储共享单一表征的瓶颈问题。CMM在算法任务、上下文学习、迷宫求解等任务上显著优于基线模型，并保留了CTM的可解释注意力模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统循环神经网络将序列历史压缩到单一向量隐藏状态中，迫使短时计算与长时保留共享同一表征，造成性能瓶颈。现有改进方案（多尺度RNN、快速权重RNN、MANNs等）虽然扩大了容量或分离了时间尺度，但缺乏生物神经系统中兼具快速神经元级处理与长时保留的能力。本文受生物记忆系统中互补学习系统框架的启发，旨在将CTM的丰富短时动力学与MANN的持久存储能力相结合。

Method: CMM基于CTM构建，包含两个矩阵值循环状态：(1) 短时记忆（STM）：滑动窗口中存储最近的M_S个预激活状态，由神经元级模型（NLMs）处理用于计算；(2) 长时记忆（LTM）：持久矩阵B^t ∈ ℝ^(d×M_L)，存储信息供后续使用。两者通过共享的Transformer联合更新，Transformer接收[sink token; LTM; STM]的拼接序列，实现内部计算与跨记忆交互。激活状态通过NLMs和神经同步机制产生输出。架构还包括可学习的sink token以抑制不必要的注意力、学习的LTM初始化、以及同步矩阵的归一化改进。

Result: 在算法任务（Copy、Associative Recall、Priority Sort、Parity）上，CMM在Copy任务损失低于5×10⁻²，在Sort任务中以4.1×10⁻³的损失达到最低，泛化到长度N=50时仍保持72.1%准确率。在迷宫求解任务（39×39）中，CMM将动作准确率从CTM的88.8%提升至96.3%，完整迷宫准确率从37.4%提升至61.6%。在少样本回归任务（K=10,20）中，CMM分别达到30.63%和9.86%的最高准确率。在ImageNet-100上达到89.7%的竞争性准确率。消融实验验证了CTM的短时处理和Transformer更新的独特贡献。CMM学习到了任务相关的记忆策略：在算法任务中STM查询主要关注LTM，在迷宫任务中则完全路由至sink token。

Conclusion: CMM成功结合了CTM的丰富短时处理能力与MANN的持久长时存储，通过Transformer实现表达性强的双向读写机制。该架构在算法泛化和循环推理任务上均优于现有方法，同时保留了CTM的可解释注意力模式。CMM展示了如何从生物记忆原理中汲取灵感来设计更强大的循环模型，为灵活短时计算与持久存储的结合提供了范例。局限性包括计算开销较大（每步联合更新两个存储）以及非线性RNN固有的训练并行性限制。

Abstract: Recurrent neural networks typically compress information into a single vector-valued recurrent state, forcing short-term computation and long-term retention to share the same representation. Past extensions alleviate this bottleneck by increasing the memory capacity or separating timescales, but lack the combination of rapid neuron-level processing and longer-term retention found in biology. To that end, we introduce the Continuous Memory Machine (CMM), a recurrent architecture with matrix-valued short- and long-term memory states serving distinct functional roles. Building on the Continuous Thought Machine (CTM), the CMM's short-term memory tracks recent neural activity, with uniquely parameterized neuron-level models learning to use these activity patterns for computation. A persistent long-term memory stores information for later use, with a Transformer jointly updating both memory stores, providing an expressive bidirectional read--write mechanism such that each store can reorganize its own contents and both read from and write to the other. Across algorithmic, in-context learning, and recurrent reasoning tasks, the CMM outperforms a broad suite of baselines, exhibiting stronger generalization than prior memory-augmented networks while preserving the CTM's interpretable attention patterns. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [181] [SIGMA: Self-Improving Alignment Generalization from a Model Spec](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07935)
*Jingyu Zhang,Shruti Palaskar,Daniel Khashabi,Benjamin Van Durme,Leon A. Gatys,Joseph Yitan Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SIGMA提出了一种数据生成与训练流水线，仅依靠Model Spec和领域提示，让模型自我构造训练任务、评分细则并充当奖励模型，实现无需更强模型或人工标注的对齐自我改进，并能将单轮对话训练效果泛化到多轮智能体安全场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在软件工程、数学等可验证领域已能递归自我提升，而对齐难以验证且依赖更强模型监督或人工数据，形成外部监督瓶颈。研究动机是：能否仅凭Model Spec让模型自我改善安全对齐并泛化到分布外场景。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) Spec-guided task synthesis——以模型本身作为任务设计智能体，基于种子场景和指定Model Spec章节生成成对的对齐困境任务(含测试提示、评分细则、成功/失败响应)，通过自验证-精化循环过滤；(2) Self-judged alignment training——模型同时作为奖励模型，对自身采样做评分细则合规奖励与按章节分解的Spec合规奖励的乘积，结合拒绝采样SFT与GRPO强化学习。

Result: 在Qwen3.6-27B上，仅用单轮对话训练，AgentHarm有害性从22.6降至14.8，Agentic Misalignment从79.1降至3.8，工具性收敛从56.6降至19.7，谄媚真实性从84.2升至86.3；XSTest过度拒答保持低位，IFEval/GPQA/MMLU-Pro能力基本保持；SFT与RL效果相当，均优于STAR-1、Constitutional AI与Deliberative Alignment基线；消融表明rubric与spec奖励需乘积组合、平衡型Model Spec、自验证精化循环和测试时推理均对泛化至关重要。

Conclusion: SIGMA证明模型可从Model Spec出发自我构造对齐监督并实现分布外泛化，消除了对齐自我改进对更强模型或人工数据的依赖；分析表明平衡且含价值解释的Model Spec、测试时安全推理及自生成rubric质量是关键因素，为可扩展监督与自动化对齐研究提供了新路径。

Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly capable of executing complex tasks and of recursively improving themselves on easy-to-verify objectives such as software engineering and mathematics. Since alignment is much harder to verify, this creates a growing risk of capabilities increasing without appropriate safety alignment, especially as capabilities expand to auto-research and cybersecurity. Existing approaches focus on capability self-improvement using verifiable feedback or on alignment training with supervision from stronger models or curated data, creating an external supervision bottleneck for alignment. We ask whether current models can improve their own safety alignment, and propose SIGMA, a data generation and training pipeline enabling alignment self-improvement that generalizes to out-of-distribution settings. Given only a "Model Spec" stating the model's desired behavior, SIGMA leverages a model's reasoning capabilities to strengthen its own safety reasoning. SIGMA first performs spec-guided task synthesis, using the candidate model as a task designer agent to generate diverse alignment dilemma scenarios and convert them into training tasks that stress-test its understanding of the Model Spec. Next, SIGMA conducts self-judged alignment training through supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning with the model itself as the reward model. Despite training only on single-turn chat data, SIGMA improves safety alignment in multi-turn agentic environments (AgentHarm harmfulness decreases from 22.6 to 14.8; Agentic Misalignment decreases from 79.1 to 3.8), outperforms Deliberative Alignment and Constitutional AI baselines, and retains general capability. Analyses show that a Model Spec balancing harmlessness and helpfulness, test-time reasoning for safety deliberation, and high-quality rubrics from SIGMA's task designer agent are crucial for effective self-improvement.

</details>


### [182] [Confidence Reasoning Graphs: Structured Confidence Estimation for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07948)
*Brendan King,Farima Fatahi Bayat,Jean-Flavien Bussotti,Pouya Pezeshkpour,Estevam Hruschka*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Confidence Reasoning Graphs (CRGs)，一种用于LLM智能体任务成功置信度估计的推理时框架。它通过将"智能体成功完成任务"这一根声明递归分解为基于轨迹证据的子声明，估计每个叶声明的置信度，然后聚合得到总体置信度。CRGs无需特权模型访问、重复rollout或训练数据，在三个智能体基准测试、三个骨干模型和三个智能体框架上均实现了比verbalized、sampling-based和white-box surrogate基线更好的校准和风险感知决策能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在关键领域使用LLM智能体时，需要校准良好的置信度来判断是否信任其输出或进行干预。智能体置信度估计具有挑战性，因为成功证据分布在异构、互依赖的轨迹步骤中。实际部署中，前沿LLM通常限制内部信号访问、智能体rollout成本高昂、训练数据可能不可用或快速过时。现有的verbalized置信度方法往往过度自信，而token概率方法无法应用于黑盒LLM，agreement方法需要不切实际的多次运行。

Method: CRG方法包含四个步骤：(1) 声明分解(Claim Decomposition)：使用LLM将根声明"智能体成功完成任务"递归分解为子声明，采用decomposition（分解为独立子声明的合取）和particularization（根据具体任务重声明）两种策略，受Goal Structuring Notation保证案例形式启发；(2) 证据收集(Evidence Gathering)：LLM从轨迹中提取证据项并附加到叶声明，标注为Supports、Undermines或Unverified关系；(3) 叶置信度估计(Leaf Confidence Estimation)：使用LLM对每个叶声明进行verbalized置信度估计，基于其关联的证据和缩减的轨迹；(4) 置信度聚合(Aggregation)：在条件独立性假设下，将叶置信度相乘得到根声明的置信度。该方法满足三个约束：black-box（仅读取轨迹文本）、single-trajectory（仅观察一次执行）、training-free（无需标注轨迹）。

Result: 在SWE-Bench Verified、EnterpriseOps-Gym和SkillsBench三个基准测试上，使用GPT-5.5、Gemini-3.5 Flash和MiniMax-M3三个智能体LLM，以及OpenHands、Codex和Claude Code三个智能体框架进行评估。CRGs在所有基准测试上实现了最低的adaptive ECE和Brier分数以及最高的BAS（Behavioral Alignment Score）。具体而言，Qwen-3.8 27B CRG在SWE-Bench Verified上ECE为0.09，EnterpriseOps-Gym上为0.13，SkillsBench上为0.11，显著优于verbalization（0.18-0.49）和surrogate-probability（0.10-0.22）基线。CRG还具有良好的成本效益，每条轨迹仅需$0.04-$0.07，位于成本-校准Pareto前沿。消融实验表明，改进主要来自叶级别置信度估计和聚合，而非仅图构建本身。值得注意的是，发现仅凭校准误差可能误导：白盒surrogate基线看似校准良好，但区分能力接近随机水平。CRG还支持审计，用户可追溯低置信度路径到具体的不确定叶声明和轨迹证据。

Conclusion: CRGs提供了一种结构化、可检查的、无需训练的置信度估计框架，能从单条黑盒智能体轨迹估计任务成功概率。它通过将成功声明分解为证据支持的子声明并聚合其置信度，在多个基准测试、模型和框架上实现了更好的校准和决策效用，同时保持强大的区分能力。这为黑盒智能体提供了实用的、可审计的置信度估计，促进了LLM智能体在关键应用中的安全使用。该方法也暴露了其局限性：分解可能不完整、依赖关系可能被遗漏、证据可能被误解，因此应作为决策支持信号与适当的验证和人工监督结合使用。

Abstract: When using an LLM agent in a consequential domain, making an informed decision about whether to trust its output or intervene requires calibrated confidence in the agent's success. Confidence estimation for agents is difficult because evidence about success is distributed across heterogeneous, interdependent steps of an agent's trajectory. Practical agentic deployments introduce further challenges: frontier LLMs often provide limited access to internal signals, agent roll-outs are costly, and training data may be unavailable or quickly become outdated. To address these challenges, we introduce Confidence Reasoning Graphs (CRGs), an inference-time framework that estimates the probability an agent accomplished its task from a single trajectory, without privileged model access or training data. Rather than compressing an execution into a single holistic judgment, a CRG begins with the claim that the agent accomplished its task, decomposes it into contextualized sub-claims grounded in trajectory evidence, estimates confidence for each terminal claim, and finally aggregates these into an overall confidence estimate. Across three agentic benchmarks, three backbone models, and three agent frameworks, CRGs yield better-calibrated confidence and stronger risk-aware decision making than verbalized, sampling-based, and white-box surrogate baselines. We further find that calibration error alone can be misleading: a white-box surrogate baseline appears well calibrated while providing near-chance discrimination. Ablations attribute CRG's improvements to claim-level confidence estimation and aggregation rather than graph construction alone. Finally, a CRG exposes the claims and trajectory evidence underlying each confidence estimate, enabling it to be audited at decision time.

</details>


### [183] [Can Agents Work for Everyone? Cross-User Reliability for Mobile GUI Agents in Personalized User Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07972)
*Yeji Park,Jaeyun Shim,Taesik Gong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PAIR和RePAIR框架,系统研究移动GUI智能体在用户个性化界面中的跨用户可靠性问题。研究发现任务成功率在不同用户间存在显著差异,用户个性化上下文中的子目标完成率明显降低,尤其在处理个人目标时易出现错误选择。RePAIR通过强化学习利用跨用户差异作为训练信号,有效提升了智能体在未见用户上的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的移动GUI智能体评估主要关注鲁棒性(对界面扰动的抵抗能力)或个性化交互(利用用户偏好),但很少有研究系统性地评估同一指令在不同用户的个性化应用状态下能否被一致执行。真实场景中,用户的个性化内容(如历史记录、收藏、未读消息等)会显著改变界面呈现,导致针对某一用户成功的智能体在另一用户的相同任务上失败。本文旨在揭示并解决这种跨用户可靠性问题。

Method: 本文提出两个核心方法:1) PAIR(个性化应用状态实例化与渲染):一个从用户配置文件构建用户条件化应用状态的流水线,包括画像编码、用户-应用实体相似度计算(精确匹配或语义相似度)以及实体选择三个阶段,使同一任务可在不同用户的应用状态上进行受控评估;2) RePAIR(个性化感知交互奖励强化学习):一种训练方法,通过构建来自两个训练用户的四组完整任务轨迹组成的rollout组,只在用户条件化上下文中的子目标上计算二元成功奖励,利用组内相对优势进行GRPO策略优化,从跨用户差异中学习以提升可靠性。

Result: 实验涵盖6个主流开源GUI智能体,在10个用户画像、10个应用、30个任务模板的1,200个测试任务上进行评估。主要发现:1) 任务成功率在不同用户间存在高达9.31个百分点的差距;2) 用户条件化上下文中的子目标完成率比用户无关上下文低6.98至15.4个百分点,对个人目标的差距进一步扩大至8.77至22.0个百分点;3) 错误模式主要是选择错误的相似项,尤其在目标暴露之前;4) RePAIR在未见用户上将用户条件化子目标完成率提升5.87个百分点,全成功率提升7.50个百分点,整体任务成功率提升9.42个百分点,验证了跨用户差异作为训练信号的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文系统揭示了移动GUI智能体在跨用户个性化界面中面临的可靠性挑战。用户条件化界面内容会显著干扰智能体的目标选择行为,尤其对于需要从用户自身内容中识别的个人目标。RePAIR通过显式学习跨用户在用户条件化子目标上的表现差异,有效提升了智能体在未见用户上的任务成功率和一致性,为解决个性化界面可靠性问题提供了新的训练范式。未来的研究方向包括开发更鲁棒的目标定位方法、不确定性感知搜索和目标验证机制,以及探索最优的用户画像池规模与训练迭代次数的平衡。

Abstract: Mobile GUI agents increasingly operate on interfaces influenced by users' histories and preferences, but their reliability across different users remains underexplored. We introduce PAIR (Personalized Application-state Instantiation and Rendering), a pipeline for constructing user-conditioned application states that enables controlled evaluation of the same task across different users. We further introduce RePAIR (Reinforcement learning with Personalization-Aware Interaction Rewards), a training approach that learns from cross-user differences in subgoal outcomes to improve reliability across user-conditioned mobile environments. Across six agents, we find substantial variation in task success across users and consistently lower subgoal achievement in user-conditioned UI contexts (6.98 to 15.4 pp). This gap further increases for personal targets drawn from each user's own content (8.77 to 22.0 pp). Failures in these contexts frequently involve selecting another item instead of the intended target, particularly before target exposure. Finally, RePAIR improves user-conditioned SAR (+5.87 pp), all-success (+7.50 pp), and overall Task SR (+9.42 pp) over its supervised fine-tuning parent on unseen users, providing initial evidence that explicitly learning from cross-user variation can improve GUI-agent reliability.

</details>


### [184] [Learning from Revision Consequences: Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation for Self-Improving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07979)
*Qianhan Feng,Zhongzhen Huang,Yakun Zhu,Xiaofan Zhang,Qi Dou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出HMED（事后元经验蒸馏）机制，通过在还原的发现状态下重新执行旧版与修订版元技能，将成对轨迹蒸馏为"元经验"记录，使自改进智能体能够学习可复用的改进策略而非仅拟合搜索分支结果。在三个交互式智能体基准上均优于强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自改进智能体从搜索分支（branch）的整体结果中提取改进信号，但分支结果混淆了"初始发现状态"与"元技能修订"两个因素的贡献——一个好的分支未必源于一个好的改进策略。问题在于：缺乏以"修订"为中心的经验表示形式，使元技能更新可能偏向受益于有利初始状态的修订，而非真正改进发现过程的修订。

Method: HMED核心包含三步：(1) 修订锚定——将元技能修订绑定到催生它的已完成事件e_t；(2) 匹配元延续——在同一还原发现状态x下，分别重新执行旧版m_t与修订版m'_t的搜索过程，得到过程差异Δ_process与发现结果差异Δ_discovery；(3) 蒸馏为元经验记录ℰ_t=(e_t, Δm_t, Δ_process, Δ_discovery)，无论修订是否被采纳均保留。该记录同时提供"是否采纳当前修订"的选择信号和"指导未来修订"的反馈信号。

Result: 在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、BiomniBench-DA三个基准上，HMED对Qwen3-32B与DeepSeek-v4-Flash两种模型均取得最佳下游任务性能（如ALFWorld：54.11% vs MetaSkill-Evolve 51.49%）。消融实验表明，仅用于选择（去除后果反馈）使性能降至49.25%，省略事件锚定降至47.76%，仅保留结果级信息降至51.49%。45.5%（ALFWorld）至75%（ScienceWorld）的案例显示分支结果与匹配延续Δ给出相反方向信号。在新发现起点上冻结元技能并重置技能库后，HMED仍领先（50.41% vs 49.25%），证明学到的是可迁移的改进策略。

Conclusion: HMED将元技能学习的经验单元从分支结果转向修订后果，使被采纳与被拒绝的修订均可贡献学习信号。学到的元技能在新起点上仍有效，表明HMED捕获的是可复用的改进策略，而非对原搜索轨迹的拟合。结果支持在自改进智能体中以"修订后果"为中心组织经验。

Abstract: As agents continuously improve by generating and revising Skills, the process that discovers and refines those Skills becomes a learnable object in its own right. Task-Skills directly act on task execution, whereas Meta-Skills govern how agents discover and improve future Skills; their value therefore emerges through the subsequent search processes they induce. Existing approaches improve Meta-Skills from observed raw Skill-search trajectories and branch outcomes. However, branch performance entangles the effects of the initial discovery state and the Meta-Skill revision that generated the search process, making it difficult to characterize what a particular revision actually changed, and pushing updates toward revisions that benefit from favorable states rather than those that improve the process. We introduce HMED (Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation), a mechanism for constructing Meta-Experience for self-improving agents. HMED revisits the completed event from which a revision originates and re-executes the incumbent and revised Meta-Skills from the same restored discovery state, so that the changes associated with the revision can be observed under a shared condition. Each comparison is distilled into a Meta-Experience, a structured record that can be reused by future updates, so that even revisions that are not ultimately retained still contribute a learning signal. Across three interactive agent benchmarks and both open-source and closed-source models, HMED consistently improves Skill discovery performance over strong baselines, shifting Meta-Skill learning beyond branch outcomes toward the consequences of changing the improvement process.

</details>


### [185] [Learning in Dreams, Winning in Reality: A Continuous Dyna Loop for a Ten-Hero MOBA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08033)
*Jordy Kieto*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种连续异步 Dyna 循环框架，在十英雄 MOBA（PufferLib MOBA，206 个单位、最长 6000 tick）中学习结构化多智能体世界模型，并在其内部通过 dream-PPO 训练策略（1400 tick 的自由展开想象回合）。最终策略在真实游戏中对阵游戏内置对手（radiant 方）取得 70.2% 胜率（421/600，95% CI 66.4–73.7），而单独的 dream 训练胜率为 0%，循环前为 33.7%；但作为 dire 方未尝胜绩，对手自我对战同样不胜。四个核心发现揭示了模型利用（exploitation）在梦境内部不可见、世界模型在策略自身游戏分布上严重失真而 Dyna 可修复（贡献 +9.2 胜率百分点）、以及策略逐机制地继承了世界模型的保真度特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型评估多基于其自身指标（似然、帧质量、想象回报），或基于从真实状态分支的短展开想象训练；而本文关注一个实践性问题：当策略通过长程自由展开的想象在习得模型中学习时，它究竟学到了什么，以及能否在真实环境中存活？作者选择在十英雄 MOBA 这一极具挑战的设定中验证——206 单位、十五种技能、十智能体每步决策、长达数千 tick 的游戏——这些正是模型误差易失控、模型利用易发生的危险地带。

Method: 1) 结构化多智能体世界模型：以 207 个 token（206 单位 + 全局时钟）表示完整状态，含位置/血量/法力/经验/技能冷却/眩晕减速计时/9×9 墙块等；双层 Pre-LayerNorm Transformer 块融合，GRU 携带单位记忆；typed heads 预测回归/事件/分类目标（0.66M 参数），自回归式训练分块 16 tick，最长 4096 跨度。2) Dream-PPO：PufferLib MOBA 策略（MinGRU），五英雄共享网络；梦境中观察从想象状态重建（真实状态字节一致），对手为 GPU 移植的 shipped net（logits 误差 <5×10⁻⁶）；回合 1400 tick；奖励含胜负 ±100、推塔、击杀、经验（减半因梦境过度奖励）。3) 连续异步 Dyna 循环：四个并行进程——世界模型训练、PPO 训练、采集器（新策略对阵 shipped net）、评估器（每策略 60 局/侧）；策略损失含 0.3·KL(π_anchor‖π) 锚定项，锚由新鲜种子胜率选定并替换。4) 世界模型调试器：同一真实状态同动作下，300 tick 开环对比真实与梦境，按单位/字段/批量机制生成指标。

Result: 最终策略在 holdout 上以 radiant 身份赢得 213/300（holdout2 上 208/300），合并 70.2% [66.4, 73.7]；作为 dire 方 0/300，shipped net 对战自己亦 0/300。消融阶梯：0% → 1.3% → 5.7% → 33.7% → 53.0% → 70.2%。模型利用在循环早期无锚情况下反复崩溃（两次跑 LR 相差六倍均在 4–6 次更新内崩溃），梦境内部无指标可追踪（梦境奖励/经验/死亡/熵更新幅度 |r|<0.37），而真实击杀与死亡与真实胜率强相关（r=0.84, 0.82）。冻结世界模型对照：pre-Dyna 模型在策略自身游戏中预测塔数为真实 1.79 倍（精度 29%），Dyna 后为 1.16 倍（精度 52%），英雄位置误差从 22.8 降至 9.7 格；固定策略配方，Dyna 世界模型贡献 +9.2 [3.5, 14.7] 胜率百分点。逐机制保真度：梦境较好表示塔/线/总伤害，但对眩晕召回率 17%、减速 3%、治疗 3%、英雄死亡召回 20%；策略因此偏好地图全域施压（5 英雄聚集 9%，shipped net 54%），击杀前眩晕仅 7%（net 26%），3.3 死亡/击杀。

Conclusion: 本文证明：长程自由展开的想象在真实数据与目标下可迁移——通过 Dyna 在策略所在分布上修复世界模型，并通过真实游戏评估进行锚定与选择，这是必要的外部观察者。但梦境训练策略的能力受其世界模型保真度的逐机制限制：梦境中保真度高的机制（塔/线路/总伤害）被策略习得并利用；失真的机制（眩晕/技能时机/致死性）策略未学会，且按失真方向过度伸展（过度冒进）。结论主张：用于控制的世界模型应在目标策略的数据上按机制评估，并附以持续性基线作为标准报告；该保真度画像同时构成了 70% 胜率之外的研究路线图（提升团控、施法时机、致死性保真度，并降低外部观察成本）。项目全部开源，总云端成本约 $382。

Abstract: World models are usually judged from the inside: by prediction loss, by the return a policy earns in imagination, or by how convincing their frames look. We judge one from the outside. We learn a structured, multi-agent world model of a complete ten-hero MOBA (206 units, every hero acting every tick, games of up to 6,000 ticks), train a policy only inside it with 1,400-tick free-running imagined episodes, and measure that policy in the real game against the opponent the game ships with. The real game never provides a gradient; it provides the policy's own games as training data for the world model, and an online evaluation that selects and anchors the policy. Run as a continuous asynchronous Dyna loop, the policy wins 70.2% of real games as radiant (421 of 600; 95% CI 66.4-73.7) on seeds never used for any decision, up from 0% for dream training alone and 33.7% before the loop. It wins none as dire, and neither does the shipped opponent when it plays itself. Four findings explain the result. Model exploitation is invisible from inside the dream: every unanchored run collapsed within a few updates while no in-dream metric tracked the collapse. A world model that is accurate on its training corpus is badly wrong on the policy's own games, and Dyna repairs it there, which is worth +9.2 points of real win rate with the policy recipe held fixed. Finally, the policy inherits its world model's fidelity profile mechanic by mechanic: the model represents the macro game but not crowd control, cast timing or lethality, and the policy wins by map-wide pressure with almost no coordinated fighting. We release the world model, the dream-PPO harness, a world-model debugger, the evaluation protocol, and every policy and log.

</details>


### [186] [Same Feedback, Different Answer: Measuring Run-to-Run Instability in Frontier-Model Customer Feedback Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08036)
*Viraj Bagal,Raviraja Ganta,Prabhath Chellingi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对AI智能体在非结构化语料分析中的"运行间不稳定性"问题，提出了一套基于重复运行的评估框架，并通过在客户反馈分析任务上的大规模实验证明：基于预建分类体系的智能体（TGA）相比原始生成和分层分解方法，能将主题变动率降低86%-88%，且匹配主题的计数差异为零。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI智能体被广泛用于自动化知识工作（如客户反馈分析），其输出的可重复性成为关键运营需求。若相同语料、相同问题、相同配置下每次运行返回的主题集合、排序和计数发生显著变化，则这些主题会作为仪表盘类别、路线图优先级和资源分配的依据变得不可靠。然而现有LLM可靠性研究多聚焦于提示敏感性、自洽性或置信度估计，鲜有针对开放式多主题语料综合任务的运行间稳定性进行专门度量。

Method: 论文提出"重复运行评估框架"，核心包括：(1) 语义主题对齐——使用text-embedding-3-large嵌入主题名称，在余弦阈值γ=0.82下做一对多最优匹配；(2) 四类稳定性距离指标：主题变动率（基于Sørensen-Dice补集）、排序不稳定（Kendall τ映射）、主题新生/消亡、体量分歧（匹配主题对的相对计数差）、证据变动率；(3) 聚合方式——对所有运行对取平均，并采用完全运行jackknife估计95%置信区间。三种执行设计被对比：原始前沿模型全语料一次生成、无分类体系分层分解、基于分类体系的智能体（TGA）查询持久主题与记录级预测。实验覆盖8个前沿模型、100至5000条语料、三种客户反馈问题。

Result: 实验1（100条记录筛选）中最佳原始模型Claude Fable 5主题变动率0.616，TGA为0.000；实验2（规模扩展）中TGA在100/1000/5000条记录下变动率分别为0.013/0.148/0.033，而Fable为0.552/0.623/0.726；实验3（Claude Opus 4.8受控消融）中TGA主题变动率0.104，原始生成为0.765，分层分解为0.841——相对降低86.4%与87.6%；TGA匹配主题的体量分歧恒为0；阈值扫描0.76-0.90均不逆转系统排序。代价方面TGA在5000条记录下成本$14.81，显著低于原始模型的$143.25。

Conclusion: 基于分类体系的智能体通过在生成前将主题身份与成员关系物化为持久存储，能显著提升重复语料综合任务的运行间稳定性。该结论在多种模型、语料规模、提示词与匹配阈值下稳健成立，但研究仅度量稳定性而非正确性——稳定地重复错误答案同样可能发生。论文强调该框架可推广至财务报告、法律文档、事件记录、科学文献等其他非结构化语料的重复综合任务。

Abstract: AI agents are increasingly being programmed to automate knowledge work over large collections of unstructured data. Such automation requires repeatability: when the underlying evidence is unchanged, the agent's categories, priorities, and counts should not shift materially between runs, even if each individual answer appears plausible. We introduce a repeat-run evaluation framework that aligns semantically equivalent categories and focuses on two operating metrics: theme churn, the normalized change in the returned category set, and volume disagreement, the change in counts for categories that persist. We evaluate three recurring customer-feedback tasks across eight frontier models, corpus sizes from 100 to 5,000 records, multiple prompts, and three execution designs: raw generation, taxonomy-free hierarchical decomposition, and a taxonomy-grounded agent (TGA) using persistent themes, subthemes, and record-level predictions. With Claude Opus 4.8 and the 1,000-record corpus fixed, TGA reduces theme churn by 86--88% relative to both raw generation and hierarchical decomposition, while matched-theme volumes have zero disagreement. The taxonomy-grounded agent is more stable than every raw model in the screen, remains more stable at each corpus size, and keeps this advantage when theme matching is made stricter or looser. Although evaluated on customer feedback, the framework targets repeated synthesis of unstructured corpora more broadly, including financial reports, legal documents, incident records, and scientific literature. Overall, these results show that taxonomy grounding produces more consistent and repeatable outputs for recurring knowledge work.

</details>


### [187] [DAEDALUS: Bootstrapping Agent Memory from Self-Generated Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08048)
*Antoine Edy,Max Conti,Victor Xing,Marc-Antoine Allard,Nawfal Benhamdane,Gautier Viaud*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DAEDALUS 提出了一种无需训练任务和oracle验证器的方法，通过自生成任务和求解器失败来引导构建可复用的LLM智能体启发式库。在AppWorld、τ²-bench和AutomationBench上平均成功率最高提升15.9个百分点，pass^5最高提升2.2倍，性能媲美使用训练任务的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在新环境中缺乏操作性知识，容易重复犯错并产生长轨迹。现有智能体系统依赖人工编写指南或基于训练任务和oracle验证器构建过程式记忆，均需环境的先验知识。本文旨在解决在没有训练任务和oracle验证器的新环境中，如何自动构建可复用的过程式记忆的问题。

Method: DAEDALUS采用"探索者-求解者"双智能体框架：探索者与环境交互生成"有挑战但可解"的任务，求解者尝试这些任务。每次求解者失败后，由提取器从失败轨迹中提炼启发式，并仅当该启发式使求解者连续Ns次成功（基于失败-成功的实证验证）时才被接受。任务难度根据循环结果反馈给探索者进行校准。接受的启发式最终被整合到记忆库中，在测试时一次性注入智能体上下文。生成阶段还引入了Surveyor环境调查和Explorer任务设计指南以提高效率。

Result: 在三个基准测试中，DAEDALUS在无训练任务方法中表现最优，平均成功率较无记忆基线提升15.9（AppWorld）、10.0（τ²-bench）和4.3（AutomationBench）个百分点，pass^5提升1.7-2.2倍。其性能与使用训练任务的多种方法（如ACE、ExpeL等）具有竞争力，且推理成本大多更低。生成的启发式可跨模型家族迁移。消融实验表明：(1) 求解者轨迹是提炼有效启发式的关键信息源；(2) 失败触发的修订和连续成功验证机制至关重要；(3) 任务设计指南和环境调查可降低约48%的生成成本。生成的DAEDALUS任务还可作为评估代理，与官方基准在模型排序上高度一致（Kendall's τ=0.89）。

Conclusion: DAEDALUS证明可在无人监督的新环境中自举构建智能体记忆，无需训练任务和oracle验证器。其核心贡献是基于失败-成功的实证启发式验证机制（而非仅凭轨迹结果判断），这是性能提升的主要原因。此外，生成的启发式可跨模型家族迁移，生成的任务本身可作为模型评估的代理。未来工作方向包括：测试时动态更新记忆、扩展至更大记忆库的检索机制、支持双控制环境（如τ²-bench telecom）、以及更可靠的多验证器判断机制。

Abstract: LLM agents often lack the operational knowledge to act reliably in new environments, as they must discover specific tool behaviors or environment conventions on their own. Without memory of past attempts, they repeat the same mistakes across tasks, leading to more task failures and longer trajectories. To address this, agentic systems typically rely on human-written guidelines or on procedural memory built from training tasks and an oracle verifier, both of which require prior knowledge of the environment. We present DAEDALUS, a method for bootstrapping reusable agent memory from self-generated practice without existing tasks or oracle verifiers. DAEDALUS pairs two agents: an explorer that interacts with the environment to generate challenging yet solvable tasks, and a solver that attempts them. A heuristic is derived from each solver failure and accepted only after the solver repeatedly succeeds with that heuristic in context. These outcomes also provide feedback for the explorer to refine the difficulty of future tasks. Accepted heuristics are then consolidated into a memory bank for test-time use. Across AppWorld, $\tau^2$-bench, and AutomationBench, DAEDALUS improves mean success rates by up to 15.9 points and pass^5 by up to 2.2x over a no-memory baseline, and is competitive with methods using training tasks, at a lower inference cost than most. We show that performance gains already emerge with a small exploration budget, and that its heuristics also benefit agents from other model families. Our ablations further reveal that solver traces provide the key information needed to derive effective heuristics, while factorizing early discoveries makes exploration more cost-efficient. Beyond memory construction, we find that the tasks generated by DAEDALUS can serve as a proxy for benchmark tasks when ranking models by performance. Code and artifacts: this http URL .

</details>


### [188] [SpeedrunBench: Challenging LLM Agents with Video Game Speedrunning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08076)
*Yoshinari Fujinuma,Keisuke Kamahori,Ryuto Koike,Abdelrahman Madkour,Varun Prashant Gangal,Monty Bichouna,Martyna Markiewicz,Shivani Jain,Duncan Curtis,Rebecca Qian,Anand Kannappan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了SpeedrunBench,一个通过电子游戏速通任务评估前沿LLM智能体策略形成能力的基准测试,覆盖9款不同类型的游戏,包含在线和离线两种设置,旨在提供一个难以饱和的长期评估标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体游戏基准多以"完成游戏"为目标,易于饱和。作者认为速通(speedrunning)作为人类社区实践策略形成的活动,能更严格地测试智能体的探索、发现和优化策略能力,且因最优完成时间未知而具有抗饱和特性。

Method: 提出SpeedrunBench基准,包含9款跨平台、跨类型的游戏(平台、RPG、赛车、解谜、策略),设置三种评估模式:online(基于帧画面预测动作)、offline-seed(从给定种子轨迹优化)和offline-scratch(从零开始构造轨迹)。采用类似auto-research的迭代优化循环,固定200轮迭代。评估10余款前沿模型(闭源和开源),与人类世界纪录对比,并分析预训练数据污染等影响因素。

Result: 实验表明:1)在简单平台游戏中接近人类水平,但在长流程复杂游戏(RPG/赛车/策略)中所有模型均远落后于人类世界纪录,平均慢2倍以上;2)offline-scratch能区分能构造路线与仅能改进路线的智能体;3)允许每轮多次评估后,DeepSeek-V4-Pro在SuperTux上达到世界纪录7%以内,GLM 5.2在Super Mario Land上达到3%以内;4)流行游戏(Pokémon)与冷门开源同类(Tuxemon)上性能排名相关性为负(-0.18),说明预训练污染影响显著;5)即使从近最优TAS轨迹出发,智能体仍能发现更优路径。

Conclusion: SpeedrunBench是一个有用且抗饱和的基准,可推动LLM智能体在战略思维、长期连贯性和路线发现方面的研究。当前前沿模型在长流程复杂游戏中表现欠佳,具备足够评估预算时在简单游戏中可逼近人类世界纪录,但起点轨迹质量和预训练暴露程度会强烈制约性能。

Abstract: Frontier LLM agents have been shown to be capable of solving increasingly complex tasks for which humans have measurable solutions. This begs the pertinent question of whether LLM agents can go beyond what humans have already solved. The ability to develop sophisticated strategies to tackle consequential problems becomes paramount as well-trodden, human-developed solutions become insufficient for problems for which we lack context or enough training data. We study agents' capability of such strategy formation through the communal practice of video game speedrunning. In speedrunning, practitioners compete to find the fastest way to complete a video game under certain conditions, and in so doing uncovering interesting unorthodox play styles that require a thorough understanding and mastery of the underlying game mechanics. We introduce SPEEDRUNBENCH, a benchmark that evaluates frontier LLM agents across 9 different games. To perform well in this benchmark, agents must repeatedly improve their strategy, reflect on their performance, exploit their gained knowledge, and reason across a long-horizon of actions to improve on an increasingly difficult problem: being faster than themselves and everyone else. Our experiments show that while frontier agents approach human world records in simple platformer games, they remain behind human performance on longer, more complex games under practical budgets. These results suggest that SPEEDRUNBENCH is a useful testbed for studying agents' strategy formation capabilities as well as being a saturation-resistant evaluation measure, as there is almost always a faster completion time waiting to be discovered.

</details>


### [189] [Self-Retrospection Distillation: Turning Post-hoc Experiences into Prior Foresight](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08077)
*Haoxiang Zhang,Qinglin Chen,Hiroaki Hayashi,Zhuofeng Li,Siming Zhang,Jiaxin Zhang,Jixuan Chen,Fang Wu,Pan Lu,Silvio Savarese,Julian McAuley,Chien-Sheng Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"前瞻学习"(Prospective Learning)概念，并实例化为"自我反思蒸馏"(Self-Retrospection Distillation, SRD)，利用后验经验（已完成轨迹）来监督预测阶段的前瞻信号，从而补充RLVR在奖励对比稀疏时的学习信号缺失问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）主要依赖标量结果奖励进行学习，但当一组rollout获得相同奖励时（如全部失败或全部成功），组相对目标的学习信号消失，尽管这些轨迹本身仍包含关于任务需求和失败模式的宝贵信息。这造成在奖励对比稀缺（特别是模型能力不足时大量组全失败）的情况下，RLVR无法有效学习。

Method: 提出前瞻学习框架：利用后验经验（已完成轨迹揭示的知识与陷阱）来监督预交互视角下的前瞻预测。SRD作为具体实现，将带有特权后验信息（trajectory-aware hindsight）的信息蒸馏为无轨迹的前瞻预测（trajectory-blind foresight）。关键设计：前瞻仅作为训练目标，在推理时无需显式生成，可与RLVR及自蒸馏方法结合使用。

Result: 在10个工具集成推理和长视野智能体任务上：1）SRD相对RLVR和自蒸馏基线提升最高达24.2个百分点；2）在奖励稀缺场景下优势尤为突出——各模型规模下有37%-98%的rollout组奖励一致；3）在2B设置中，98%的组全失败时，纯RLVR训练成功率为0.0%，而加入SRD在相同rollout预算下达60.6%。

Conclusion: 后验的智能体经验不仅可用于评估或改善行为，还能塑造交互前可获得的预测性表征。SRD证明即便在奖励信号完全缺失的场景下，轨迹本身仍可作为有效学习源，显著增强RLVR在困难早期阶段的学习效果。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) turns agent experience into learning signals primarily through scalar outcome rewards after interaction. For group-relative objectives, however, this signal vanishes when all rollouts receive the same reward, even though their trajectories may reveal useful information about what the task requires and how the agent fails. We ask a complementary question: can hindsight teach an agent what it could have anticipated before acting? We introduce prospective learning, which uses post-hoc experience to supervise foresight predictions from the pre-interaction view, and instantiate it with Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD). Intuitively, a completed trajectory reveals knowledge that would have been useful and pitfalls that should be avoided; SRD distills this privileged hindsight into trajectory-blind foresight of the same policy. Foresight serves only as a training target and need not be explicitly generated at inference time. Across 10 tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks, SRD complements RLVR and self-distillation baselines with gains of up to $24.2$ pp. Its advantage is especially pronounced when reward contrast is scarce: when $37$--$98\%$ of rollout groups are reward-uniform across model scales, yet SRD can still exploit learning signal from sampled trajectories. In the 2B setting, where $98\%$ of groups are all-failure, the RLVR training ends up at $0.0\%$ success, while adding SRD reaches $60.6\%$ under the same rollout budget. Our results suggest that post-hoc agent experience is useful not only for evaluating or improving behavior, but also for shaping predictive representations before available interaction.

</details>


### [190] [POLAR: Ontology-Guided Risk Prevention for Tool-Calling LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08082)
*Yunju Kang,Seonghyeon Cho,Irene Li,Yeo-Chan Yoon,Chanjun Park*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: POLAR是一种用于小型工具调用LLM代理的预判式安全护栏框架，通过双层本体（静态动作本体与动态状态本体）反向推导候选逆向操作序列，为每个工具调用分配分级可逆性评分，低分调用在执行前被剪枝。在τ²-bench上评估显示效果不均：航空域中6个模型有4个获得提升，但18个模型-域组合中仅8个整体改进，零售域及较强模型常出现回退。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM工具调用代理在动态环境中执行高风险操作，但现有安全机制多为事后反应，或仅基于自然语言推理而缺乏结构化、可审计的判定依据。作者希望解决：能否在执行前以结构化、可审计的方式评估操作的可逆性，从而预防不可逆危害。

Method: 提出POLAR框架，包含两层本体：Layer A为手工编写的静态动作本体（编码每个可变工具的类型化可逆性关系），Layer B为基于当前环境状态动态构建的状态本体。对候选动作，POLAR在Layer A中以Layer B为基础反向推导，组装候选逆向序列π并计算分级可逆性评分φ_POLAR∈[0,1]，低于阈值的调用在执行前被剪枝。采用可插拔的DecisionPolicy将评分转化为判定，并提供可审计的结构化解释。

Result: 在τ²-bench上对6个代理模型评估：航空域中4/6模型平均任务奖励提升0.11–0.18分；但18个模型-域单元中仅8个整体改进；零售域和较强模型经常出现回退。表明POLAR在小型到中等代理的简单有界域中效果较好，但存在任务效用权衡，且奖励并非预防危害的直接度量。

Conclusion: POLAR提供了一种结构化、可审计的预判式可逆性检查机制，贡献包括：(1)面向可逆域小型代理的护栏；(2)免训练的流水线，不修改代理权重或提示；(3)基于本体的可解释拒绝解释，每项判定都有可审计的类型化依据。但其效果因模型与领域而异，揭示了安全防护与任务效用之间的权衡，奖励分数不能直接等同于预防的危害量。

Abstract: LLM tool-use agents operate in dynamic environments where many actions carry operational risk. However, most safety mechanisms react only after errors manifest. Existing pre-emptive approaches either fine-tune the agent on chain-of-thought deliberation or compile natural-language guardrails into runtime checks, but they do so without exposing a structural, auditable verdict. We propose POLAR, a guardrail framework for small tool-calling agents that assesses reversibility through a structured two-layer ontology. POLAR assigns each action a graded reversibility score by deriving a candidate inverse sequence; calls failing a threshold are pruned before execution. Evaluated on $\tau^2$-bench across six agent models, POLAR improves mean task reward by 0.11 to 0.18 points on airline for four of six agents, but only eight of eighteen model--domain cells improve overall; retail and stronger agents often regress. POLAR provides an auditable structural check and characterizes its task-utility trade-offs. Reward is not a direct measure of prevented harm.

</details>


### [191] [Natural Language Questions as an Interface for Knowledge Graphs: QRAKEN Graph Distillation and Semantic Self-Healing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08095)
*Remo Grillo,Lukas Klic,Giovanni Colavizza*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: QRAKEN是一个面向RDF知识图谱的免训练、与本体无关的神经符号Text-to-SPARQL流水线，通过离线蒸馏将图谱使用模式（TTQL文件+共现矩阵）注入LLM提示，并配合三阶段确定性自愈校验，在CK25基准上以较小模型取得显著优于参赛系统的严格F1分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在Text-to-SPARQL中的主要失败模式并非语法,而是在预训练分布之外的图谱上,生成的查询语法合法但语义上不忠实于实际填充的数据模型(幻觉谓词、反向边、不可达捷径)。现有方法(在线代理探索、训练/记忆、shape提示)要么依赖在线探索开销大、要么需要标注数据、要么注入的是规范式schema而非经验模式。论文主张KGQA中"图谱接地"比模型规模更重要。

Method: 两阶段流水线:(1)离线Graph Distiller通过穷举式SPARQL枚举构建类-属性-目标类共现矩阵M(零支持即为空结果的确定性证书),并对排名靠前的类采样多跳路径,生成Turtle启发的描述性TTQL文件,含条件频率与路径条件字面量示例;(2)在线NTQ模块将TTQL注入LLM提示生成候选SPARQL,经三阶段校验——语法(rdflib+PrefixManager)、词法(对TTQL词汇)、数据模型(对共现矩阵M)——失败则基于诊断进行确定性自愈迭代直至通过或耗尽预算。

Result: 在CK25(50题/13类/30属性)同条件重计算上:严格F1 GPT-4.1 mini 0.643±0.026、GPT-5.4 0.652±0.012,相对最强参赛系统(ARUQULA同为GPT-4.1 mini)分别+30%/+32%。消融显示TTQL模式块为主导驱动因素(A2−A4达+0.309/+0.153严格F1),自愈循环贡献有限(−0.009至+0.067),仅作"必失败过滤器"。TTQL较自动派生SHACL基线(A8)高+64%相对F1。本地4-bit量化的35B开源模型(Qwen3.6)达0.491±0.036,与ARUQULA 0.493持平,零边际成本。QRAKEN仅1.43次LLM调用/题、单次端点调用、中位延迟3.5s,而ARUQULA需9.9步/59.6s。

Conclusion: QRAKEN证明在领域特定的KGQA中,紧凑的离线图谱蒸馏加确定性校验比重型在线代理编排更有效,小模型配以忠实经验上下文可匹敌前沿模型。其适用场景为词汇有界、多跳模式丰富的策展图谱(文化遗产、企业、科研);主要局限在于TTQL单块注入会饱和(约30K token已占开源模型上下文窗口三分之一),未来工作重点为TTQL之上的按题检索层以及多约束推理层,并需在更多异构图谱上验证。

Abstract: Natural-language access to RDF knowledge graphs is a core Semantic Web ambition. Large language models (LLMs) have advanced Text-to-SPARQL, yet on unfamiliar graphs they often generate valid queries that misrepresent the populated data model. QRAKEN is a training-free, ontology-agnostic neurosymbolic pipeline grounding generation in empirical graph evidence rather than schema expectations. An offline distiller produces TTQL, a compact description of populated multi-hop patterns, conditional frequencies and path-conditioned literal examples, plus a class-property co-occurrence matrix. Online, TTQL guides the LLM, while deterministic syntax, vocabulary and data-model checks provide diagnostics for iterative refinement. On CK25 (First International Text2SPARQL Challenge), under matched-condition recomputation on a QLever snapshot, QRAKEN achieves strict F1 of 0.643 $\pm$ 0.026 with GPT-4.1 mini and 0.652 $\pm$ 0.012 with GPT-5.4: relative gains of 30% and 32% over the strongest recomputed participant, outperforming systems using the same base model family. Ablations identify TTQL patterns as the dominant driver (+0.31 strict F1 over a shape-only baseline); the refinement loop provides a cheap safety net, rejecting triple patterns unsupported by the co-occurrence matrix. Compared with auto-derived SHACL, TTQL yields 64% higher strict F1, supporting the value of empirical patterns beyond schema exposure. With two local 35B 4-bit open-weight models at zero marginal cost, the same pipeline matches the strongest recomputed participant, and TTQL advantages over shape-only and SHACL baselines persist. Results on a single, relatively small benchmark provide an initial empirical signal; monolithic TTQL injection on very open cross-domain graphs remains the main limitation.

</details>


### [192] [Beyond Corrected Memory: Execution Consistency in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08101)
*Zhe Yu,Zixuan Wang,Peidong Wang,Hehai Lin,Ruochen Zhao,Chengwei Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"执行一致性"(Execution Consistency)概念,指出即使共享内存记录正确,也无法证明多智能体系统执行符合任务规范。作者定义了基于证据的判定规则,并提出CAVERT框架用于诊断和恢复。实验证明,相同的保留记录可能对应合规和违规两种执行,移除关键证据后82.4%的对偶标签执行变得不可区分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统中共享内存的正确性不足以保证执行合规性。现有方法(内存治理、失败诊断、流程审计)侧重于管理或检查记录信息,但无法判定执行是否满足任务职责。论文旨在回答:什么使共享内存上的执行具有一致性,以及什么证据能够确立这种一致性。

Method: 1. 定义执行一致性:基于职责(状态使用、信息交接、最终状态一致性)和证据满足条件的判定框架,引入三值判定(N:无违规/V:违规/U:未定)。2. 提出保留记录不可区分性(Retained-Record Indistinguishability)形式化准则。3. 设计CAVERT框架:通过两阶段LLM(范围过滤+因果状态推理)提取证据,执行确定性规则判定,支持预提交干预。4. 三类契约家族:严格时序、因果语义、最终语义,涵盖12种机制。

Result: 1. RQ1(证据必要性):450对中,移除证据后82.4%的对偶标签执行变得不可区分;恢复证据后97.9%可分离。自然日志标注证实违规确实存在。2. RQ2(诊断):CAVERT在720次执行/12个基准-执行器设置上准确率达87.1%,优于Contract LLM(80.6%)和规则基线(78.9%)。3. RQ3(恢复):CAVERT+Gate在4个环境中均优于Rules+Gate,AppWorld成功率从89/180提升至122/180(+18.3 pp)。在固定预算($0.0120/执行)下仍保持优势。正常任务性能保持非劣性(-0.7 pp,95% CI [-2.1, +0.7])。

Conclusion: 正确内存不足以保证执行一致性。相同记录可能掩盖不同的任务职责结果,任何下游判定器都无法恢复记录未保留的区分。论文将此差距形式化为执行一致性,识别了判定所需的证据。CAVERT证明这些要求可支持诊断和纠正动作。可靠的多智能体内存应不仅保留"智能体知道什么",还应保留"共享信息如何被接收、使用和据此行动"的证据。

Abstract: Shared memory coordinates agents' actions, but correct records do not establish that those actions satisfy task requirements. Memory governance and failure diagnosis regulate or inspect recorded information; they do not by themselves establish whether it is sufficient to judge task duties. We define execution consistency through duties governing state use, information handoffs, and final-state agreement, with explicit evidence conditions for judging fulfillment. Our core claim is that identical retained records can correspond to compliant and violating executions under the same task rule. Controlled removal of evidence such as receipt, action dependence, or response validity leaves 82.4% of opposite-label pairs indistinguishable; restoration separates 97.9% of the merged pairs. Natural-log annotations identify the defined violations in actual executions. However, existing logs do not always explicitly represent the execution relationships needed for these judgments. To assess the definition's practical value, we use CAVERT, a framework for consistency diagnosis and recovery, to extract supported relationships from logs and apply these criteria. It consistently outperforms contract-prompted LLM and rule-based baselines in diagnosis across all 12 benchmark-executor settings. Under the same gate and executor limits, it also outperforms rule-guided recovery in all four evaluated environments. These findings identify execution evidence that agent-memory and execution interfaces should preserve for reliable judgment.

</details>


### [193] [DSV-Mem: Evaluating Multimodal Memory in Professional Workflows for MLLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08102)
*Jike Zhong,Ritwick Chaudhry,Xuanbai Chen,Tianchen Zhao,Linghan Xu,Yifan Xing,Nishant Sankaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DSV-Mem是一个面向专业工作流的MLLM智能体多模态记忆评测基准，包含1000道专家审核的题目，涵盖五大问题类别。评测显示最强的前沿模型在该基准上也仅能达到不到45%的准确率，表明当前模型在密集、有状态的视觉记忆任务上仍面临重大挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM记忆评测基准主要聚焦于非正式的日常对话场景，使用自然照片、静态工件和回忆型问题，无法反映专业工作流中信息密集、可反复修订且需要权威状态追踪的复杂需求。因此需要一个新的评测基准来评估MLLM智能体在专业工作流中的密集有状态视觉记忆能力。

Method: 提出DSV-Mem基准及自动化生成流程：1）将潜在状态轨迹构建与对话实现解耦，通过27种领域可适的转移算子（含视觉来源、文本来源和视觉-文本混合三类）控制状态变化；2）采用Hartley启发的标准H̃₀筛选需要跨多张视觉工件证据的问题；3）问题分为五类（当前状态、历史状态、派生状态、变更历史、冲突/拒绝）；4）评估27种配置，涵盖前沿模型、开源模型、提示变体和记忆管理方法，并通过自维护账本探索改进方案。

Result: 1）所有评估基线在DSV-Mem上得分均低于45%，Gemini 3.7 Flash（最佳基线）达到39.6%，加提示提示后达43.4%；2）状态重建是主要错误来源（占错误的89.7%），而非视觉阅读（OCR准确率98.5%）或算术；3）状态演化是难度的主导因素（移除后提升+43.2pp），远超多模态性（+8.2pp）和信息密度（+12.6pp）；4）现有记忆管理方法（Mem0、SimpleMem、LightMem、MIRIX）均低于基线；5）增加推理算力收益有限；6）自维护账本可带来+13.6-26%的提升。

Conclusion: DSV-Mem揭示了当前MLLM智能体在专业工作流中维护权威状态的根本性不足：模型虽能正确读取单个工件，却难以跨多个版本调和文本与视觉更新、区分相似修订、保留变更历史或拒绝过时前提。通过提供受控的多模态转移、验证状态图和可执行的QA，DSV-Mem为诊断这些失败提供了严格测试平台，并将推动面向长期演化的专业工作流的可靠MLLM智能体研究。

Abstract: Conversational MLLM agents are increasingly expected to assist in professional workflows, from AI research and engineering design to product management and business operations. Yet this capability remains underexplored: existing benchmarks largely focus on informal, everyday interactions and personal-life scenarios featuring photographic natural images, isolated static artifacts, and recall-oriented questions. In contrast, professional scenarios often involve structured, information-heavy artifacts that undergo frequent revisions and authority updates, and compositional queries requiring reconciliation of many artifact versions while tracking state precisely. To address these challenges, we introduce DSV-Mem, a benchmark for evaluating Dense Stateful Visual Memory. DSV-Mem comprises expert-reviewed scenarios and 1,000 questions across five user-oriented categories (Current State, Past State, Derived State, Change History, and Conflict/Refusal). A Hartley-inspired criterion favors questions with broader visual-evidence inspection demands. We also introduce a generation harness that produces evaluation suites by decoupling state-transition synthesis from conversation filling. Evaluation over 27 configurations spanning frontier and open-weight models and memory management methods reveals that the strongest baseline scores below 45% on DSV-Mem. Analysis surfaces findings: 1) multimodality and information density both contribute to difficulty, but state evolution, particularly the number of governing updates, is the dominant tested factor. Raw conversation/haystack length, OCR, and arithmetic are not the primary bottlenecks; 2) models often fail to verify user premises against prior state updates before answering; 3) increased reasoning effort and memory management methods yield limited gains, whereas state-aware designs prove more effective. The benchmark and code will be publicly released.

</details>


### [194] [ChartBmkAgent: Harness-Governed Multi-Agent Construction of Chart QA Benchmarks from Sparse Error-Taxonomy Specifications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08106)
*Langxi Huang,Pingping Zhang,Lanyun Zhu,Chunyang Jiang,Jiawei Shao,Haocheng Yuan,Peilin Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ChartBmkAgent：一种由中枢控制的多智能体框架，能从稀疏的错误分类法规范自动构建完整的图表问答评测样本，通过阶段性证据验证防止诊断漂移，并在 17 个 MLLM 上验证了目标保持的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基准构建周期过长，无法跟上 MLLM 快速迭代；现有自动化方法要么依赖预置模板/数据（目标引导），要么仅保证工件有效性（从零生成），无法保证生成的样本持续对应原始诊断目标，导致"诊断漂移"。

Method: 采用三角色多智能体架构：规范智能体（定义语义与评估器）、合成智能体（构建数据/图表/问答）、批评智能体（审计继承与工件）。中央中枢拥有类型化构建状态和唯一授权权，每个新需求须引用已接纳的前驱并附带证据，失败时触发有界修订/回溯/拒绝，并保留完整条目级构建追踪 T = T_adm ∪ T_neg。引入可执行门控（computational/semantic mode）、机制锚点 M_τ 和诊断条件 π ∩ M_τ ≠ ∅ 来确保问答依赖目标机制。
