Result: 1) 300 样本上 17 个 MLLM 准确率 32.7%-84.3%，能区分能力差异；2) 三组源模型对比中，针对性样本 50.0% vs 对照 82.2%（p=8.96×10⁻⁶）；3) 220 样本盲审中 86.4% 保持了精确错误描述（Fleiss κ=0.880）；4) 漂移门控消融显示缺失 anchor-to-QA 门控会导致 80% 错误接纳；5) 直接基线对比：完整中枢 77.5% vs 直接三步法 52.5%（p=0.00635）。

Conclusion: ChartBmkAgent 是可审计的构建机制，将构建保持作为构造时的约束而非事后判断；实证支持三项有限主张：能区分模型能力、能定向验证观察到的困难、能保持目标语义。但仍需外部独立验证、扩展分类法和视觉领域。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance rapidly, while conventional benchmark development lags behind, delaying investigation of newly observed capability gaps. Such investigation requires an expressive task format and an on-demand construction process: information-rich charts make chart question answering (Chart QA) suitable for probing coupled perception and reasoning. Automated Chart QA construction is intended to shorten the benchmark-development cycle by turning identified gaps into targeted samples on demand. Current methods, however, commonly separate target guidance from scratch generation: target-guided systems often require prepared data, charts, or templates, while scratch-generation systems primarily ensure artifact validity, without explicitly controlling whether newly synthesized requirements and content remain aligned with an externally specified diagnostic target. We introduce ChartBmkAgent, which turns an identified capability gap into targeted diagnostic evidence by constructing complete Chart QA samples from sparse error-taxonomy specifications. Throughout construction, a central harness governs specialized agents, requires stage-specific evidence of alignment with the original error category, and records the basis for each acceptance decision. On 300 taxonomy-wide samples, MLLM accuracies ranged from 32.7% to 84.3% with distinct category profiles, showing that generated samples reveal capability differences. Across three source-model comparisons, targeted follow-ups scored 50.0% versus 82.2% on matched controls ($p=8.96\times10^{-6}$); all six cross-model comparisons had the same direction, demonstrating targeted validation and diagnostic-data generation. Multiple evaluator models assessed whether each sample tested its specified error category; 86.4% met this criterion, providing empirical evidence of target preservation.

</details>


### [195] [Test-Time Agent Evolution for Long-Horizon Legal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08138)
*Haotian Chen,Shuaicheng Niu,Haocong Rao,Kaisong Song,Jun Lin,Lizhen Cui,Zhiqi Shen,Yonghui Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TALA框架，针对长程法律推理中静态策略难以适应案例异构性和跨角色耦合问题，引入测试时记忆进化（TME）实现跨案例经验自适应，引入评分标准对齐协作（RAC）实现角色间行为对齐，在不更新模型参数的前提下提升长程法律推理的全局可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实法律部署存在两大挑战：1）案例异构性（事实、证据、程序差异大），静态代理策略难以适应，导致跨案例经验迁移产生误导；2）跨角色耦合（律师、当事人、法官等角色决策相互依赖），孤立优化单角色能力无法保证全局一致性，局部错误会沿多阶段传播。现有测试时适应方法（如研究适应、推理扩展）侧重单实例优化，缺乏对长程交互非平稳性的持续适应机制。

Method: 1）TALA为无训练（training-free）的测试时代理进化框架，包含两个互补组件：(a)测试时记忆进化（TME）：通过BGE编码器进行记忆检索→上下文记忆适应（利用同一代理将检索记忆适配到当前上下文）→记忆巩固（在固定容量下通过语义相似度合并相似记忆条目）；(b)评分标准对齐协作（RAC）：针对每个角色定义行为和程序评分标准，通过RubricCheck验证候选动作是否符合标准要求，不符合则触发同一代理进行修正。2）问题形式化：将每个法律案例建模为多轮多角色交互轨迹 τ^(i) = {(s_t, r_t, H_t, a_t, o_{t+1})}，代理参数Θ保持不变。3）检索相似度阈值δ=0.5，使用DeepSeek-Flash进行LLM评分。

Result: 1）J1-EVAL（6类场景×3层级）和LegalWorld（7阶段民事诉讼）两大基准上，5个骨干模型（Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B、InternLM3-8B、GLM-4-9B）一致优于ReAct、Plan-and-Solve、Plan-and-Execute、LawThinker、Reflexion等基线，尤其在文书起草和法庭辩护指标上提升显著。2）消融研究：J1-EVAL上移除TME平均下降17.5分，移除RAC下降15.3分；LegalWorld上分别下降13.0和9.4分，证明两组件互补。3）效率分析：LegalWorld中位执行时间4.27分钟/案例，GLM-4-9B上任务完成率达100%（基线仅26%–72%），工具调用和Token消耗适中。4）案例研究：TME解决"应该恢复哪些信息"，RAC解决"角色应如何行动并推动交互进展"，两者联合实现跨阶段证据保留与角色一致辩护。5）Jev审计显示RAC的判断一致率71.7%、Jev覆盖匹配错误率91.6%，可节省89.5%的本地LLM判断调用。

Conclusion: TALA通过TME和RAC实现了长程法律代理在测试时的持续进化，无需更新模型参数即可有效应对跨案例异构性和跨阶段角色耦合带来的可靠性挑战；未来工作将向人在环路（human-in-the-loop）的法律代理方向扩展，并探索在更具专业性和问责要求的法律场景中的应用。

Abstract: Legal intelligence aims to support reliable decision-making across long-horizon legal processes involving evolving case states and multiple roles. However, real-world legal deployment exhibits substantial case heterogeneity in facts, evidence, and procedural contexts, exposing the limitations of static agent strategies. Moreover, legal reasoning is inherently interdependent across roles and procedural stages, making global reliability fundamentally different from isolated role competence. To address these challenges, we study training-free test-time agent adaptation, where agents continuously exploit deployment-time signals from preceding cases and ongoing interactions without updating model parameters. We propose \method, which introduces \emph{Test-Time Memory Evolution} to retrieve reusable experience from previous cases, adapt it to the current factual and procedural context, and consolidate accumulated experience for subsequent decision-making. Further, \emph{Rubric-Aligned Collaboration} verifies and revises role-specific actions according to behavioral and procedural requirements, enabling coordinated decision-making across roles and stages. Extensive experiments on J1-EVAL and LegalWorld across five backbone models demonstrate consistent improvements over representative reasoning and agent baselines with reasonable interaction and computational costs. Ablation and case studies further show that the two components provide complementary benefits in experience adaptation and cross-role coordination, improving the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon legal reasoning.

</details>


### [196] [Partially Observable Zero-shot coordination by Predicting Intention of Partner](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08142)
*Jinnyeong Yang,Yuhwan Jeong,Hoyong Kwon,Minseok Kim,Jihun Kim,Kuk-Jin Yoon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对零样本协调（ZSC）在动态空间部分可观测条件下的两个核心难题——合作伙伴表征退化与隐藏状态不确定性——提出PIP框架，通过联合视VAE改善合作伙伴生成质量，并通过合作伙伴状态信念网络推断隐藏的位置与行为倾向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式ZSC方法（如GAMMA、GOAT）在完全可观测设置（如Overcooked）中表现良好，但转移到部分可观测环境时面临两大挑战：（1）部分可观测使编码器将不同合作伙伴轨迹映射到重叠的潜在空间，损害合作伙伴多样性；（2）合作伙伴离开视野后，智能体无法获取其位置、行为意图等关键信息，影响协调决策。作者旨在首次系统解决这两个由空间部分可观测引发的失败模式。

Method: 方法包含两大组件：(1) **联合视VAE（JV-VAE）**：采用教师-学生蒸馏框架，教师编码器接收双方局部观测的并集，学生编码器仅接收以自我为中心的局部观测，通过KL散度将教师后验蒸馏到学生后验，使学生潜在空间在保持部署兼容的同时保留合作伙伴多样性；(2) **合作伙伴状态信念网络**：包含位置信念（通过混合未来高斯目标与可达性先验预测粗粒度位置分布）和行为信念（分为反应信念与tendency信念两个时间尺度的预测头），使用屏蔽观测更新独立信念RNN，通过stop-gradient的加性接口注入到动作状态中。训练采用CTDE范式，仅在PPO更新阶段使用日志合作伙伴信息作为辅助监督。

Result: 在 Burrito-PO（4个布局）、Overcooked-PO（counter_circuit）和 Melting Pot（coop_mining）三个基准上的实验表明，PIP 在所有布局中均取得最高的平均性能，相对 GAMMA 和 GOAT 基线有显著提升（如 Burrito-PO Ring 上达到 125.8 vs GOAT 的 77.3）。66人参与者的受试中，18人将PIP评为首选合作伙伴（72.7%），在所有6个问卷类别上均得分最高，统计显著性均通过 Holm-Bonferroni 校正。消融实验证实 JV-VAE、Behavioral Belief 和 Location Belief 各自独立贡献性能，联合使用效果最佳。JV-VAE 在聚类指标（NMI、ARI）和覆盖率上均优于固定-σ和异方差基线。t-SNE可视化显示蒸馏后的学生编码器产生更清晰的合作伙伴聚类。在部分可观测条件下（Burrito-PO Open），PIP与全可观测训练的性能差距仅为+7.2，而GAMMA和GOAT在全可观测下反而退化（-20.0和-62.5），表明PIP对合作伙伴分布偏移更具弹性。观测损坏鲁棒性测试显示PIP在r=0.2的遮挡/噪声下仍优于GAMMA的清洁观测基线。

Conclusion: PIP 有效解决了零样本协调在动态空间部分可观测下的两大难题，通过联合视VAE保留了行为上有意义的合作伙伴多样性，通过合作伙伴状态信念网络实现了信念感知的决策。在多个基准上的实验以及诊断分析均支持其在未见过合作伙伴和人类评估中的协调效能，展示了合作伙伴表征和信念感知决策对受限观测下ZSC的重要性。局限性在于信念模块需要模拟环境中可获取的合作伙伴状态标签，未来工作将探索弱监督或自监督的信念学习方法。

Abstract: Zero-shot coordination in embodied settings requires acting while the partner is intermittently out of view, leaving existing methods with ambiguous partner representations and uncertainty over hidden partner states. We propose Predicting Intention of Partner (PIP) to jointly address these challenges. PIP uses a Joint-view VAE to distill richer training-time evidence from the union of both agents' local observations into a partner representation available from local observations alone. Partner-state Belief networks further infer the partner's hidden location and behavioral tendencies from the ego agent's interaction history. We evaluate PIP in Burrito-PO, Overcooked-PO, and a Melting Pot substrate, together with a human evaluation in Burrito-PO. PIP attains the highest mean performance among the compared methods across all three benchmarks. Human evaluation and diagnostic analyses further support coordination with unseen partners and the contributions of both components under partner occlusion.

</details>


### [197] [Which alloy composition,what process parameters? Inferring the recipe from optimized metallic microstructure and texture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08165)
*Mahish K. Guru,Jan Bohlen,Louam Lemjid,Marius Tacke,Roland Aydin,Noomane Ben Khalifa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究金属合金研发的"配方反推"问题：能否仅从优化的微观结构和织构推断出产生该结构的合金成分与工艺参数。基于107个镁合金挤压条件的实测数据，比较了三种微观结构描述符（传统统计量、预训练视觉嵌入、晶粒图神经网络），并提出从已知离散目录中选择的预测头，显著优于连续预测方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合金开发链通常正向运行（配方→结构→性能），反向从优化后的结构推断配方仍依赖专家知识。本研究旨在验证这一"配方环节"是否可被机器学习解决，特别是在数据稀疏的小规模实验场景下，并探索哪种描述符与预测头组合最适合该任务。

Method: 在107个挤压条件（14种镁合金，每条件含光学显微图像和X射线织构测量）的5折交叉验证下，比较三种描述符：(1)传统晶粒与织构统计量（438维）；(2)Co-PiLOT冻结视觉编码器嵌入（1280维）；(3)晶粒图神经网络嵌入（128维）。每种描述符配对两类预测头——任务A（已知工艺预测成分）和任务B（已知成分预测工艺参数），关键创新是采用尊重离散答案并保持其顺序的"目录式"预测头（如联合网格高斯过程），并引入WAPE全元素版本和误报率作为防止虚假指标的"守护指标"。

Result: 任务A中，传统描述符配合重排序器达到64.6%的合金识别准确率（多数基线仅17%），WAPE为13.6%，显著优于学习嵌入（<30%）。任务B中，联合网格GP使温度MAE从69.7°C降至35-38°C，速度对数MAE从0.75降至0.42-0.45，"一档内"命中率从26%提升至46-52%。研究发现：传统描述符优于为重建训练的大模型嵌入；离散目录式预测头配合保持设置间距离的策略优于纯分类器；速度极值预测存在"尾部收缩"问题，根本原因在于描述符本身。

Conclusion: 能否从微观结构反推合金配方，核心限制不在于表示规模或回归器自由度，而在于描述符与答案离散结构形式的匹配。实际应用中，光学显微镜和X射线极图已足够支撑配方反推环节，可作为自驱动实验室中对已有测量的免费一致性检查。但本研究的成分任务是封闭集（14种已知合金），且组成与工艺在实验设计上存在混杂，更大规模、多合金系统的数据是下一步方向。

Abstract: The mechanical properties of a metallic alloy are set by its microstructure and texture: the size and shape of its grains and the orientation of their crystals. That structure is in turn set by a recipe, the alloy composition together with the processing parameters. Alloy development runs this chain forwards, tuning the structure until a target property is met. Running it backwards, from an optimized structure to the recipe that would produce it, still relies on expert knowledge. We ask whether this backwards step can be learned. On an in-house dataset of 107 magnesium alloy extrusion conditions across 14 alloys, each with optical micrographs and an X-ray texture measurement, we compare three descriptors of microstructure and texture: conventional grain and texture statistics, a vision embedding from a pretrained image encoder, and a graph neural network on the grain network. Each is paired with prediction heads for two tasks: the alloy composition given the process (Task A), and the process parameters given the composition (Task B). Under 5-fold cross-validation, the conventional descriptors identify the correct alloy for 65% of held-out conditions, against 17% for always guessing the most common alloy, while the learned embeddings stay below 30%. The process parameters are recoverable but noisier: compared with using the composition alone, the microstructure roughly halves the temperature error. Because only a few alloys were cast and only a few press settings were used, both answers are discrete, and heads that pick from these known options, while respecting their order, worked better than heads that predict a free value.

</details>


### [198] [LFHE: Local-First Heuristic Evolution for Bounded Local Topology Search in Decentralized Learning with Non-IID Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08176)
*Yin-Kuan Liang,Yan Gao,Yang Long*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LFHE（Local-First Heuristic Evolution），一种面向非IID数据去中心化学习中通信拓扑搜索的框架。其核心思想是仅基于自 ego-neighborhood 和 friend-of-a-friend（FoF）信息执行有界局部拓扑搜索，在不依赖全局图统计量（如代数连通性 λ₂）的前提下，通过结构评分项 C_i 精确分解表示 Dirichlet 能量。实验表明，LFHE 在四个图像、语音、文本基准上具有竞争力，结构项是主要的拓扑选择信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化学习在非IID数据下对通信拓扑高度敏感。现有方法存在两极：基于模型相似度的局部方法忽略全局传播效率；直接优化谱图目标的方法依赖全局信息/中心化计算。本文研究介于两者之间的"有界局部拓扑搜索"中间地带。

Method: LFHE将拓扑自适应建模为受约束的局部组合搜索问题。每个客户端采样FoF候选节点，组合目标函数 J_i = ω₁(1-β_t)C_i + ω₂β_tD_i - ω₃·deg(i)/D_max，其中 C_i 为局部结构项（incident-edge 表示差异平方和），D_i 为邻居方向不匹配项（余弦相似度），度正则项控制密度。退火系数 β_t = β₀e^{-κt} 控制从探索向精炼的过渡。在标准线性共识动力学下，C_i 的网络总和恰好等于表示 Dirichlet 能量，控制中心化表示分歧的瞬时耗散率。算法采用串行拓扑更新，候选发现限于 O(d̄²) 每客户端、O(Nd̄²) 系统级；在有界稀疏度下退化为 O(1) 每客户端、O(N) 系统级，不随人口规模增长。

Result: 在 CIFAR-10/100、Google Speech Commands、Sentiment140 四个数据集（Dirichlet α=0.1，N=30 客户端，D_max=4）上，LFHE 表现具有竞争力：CIFAR-10 71.6%、CIFAR-100 45.2%、Speech Commands 78.8%（均为去中心化方法中最高），Sentiment140 65.3%（略低于 Epidemic Learning 的 65.5%）。目标达成轮次通常最早。匹配协议控制实验确认结构项是主要的拓扑选择信号；结构项删除导致 λ₂ 最弱且最不稳定，而度正则项去除虽增大 λ₂ 但精度并不提升。LFHE 在 N=10/50/100/500 的 FoF 候选集合保持在 9.76–11.86 peers/client，不随 N 增长。运行开销低：60 次拓扑更新总耗时约 1.89 秒，平均每轮 0.006 秒，接受率约 10⁻³。与 Morph 比较显示 Morph 精度略高（72.25% vs 71.37%）但发现状态增长至 O(N²) 系统级。

Conclusion: LFHE 是一种状态感知的有界局部拓扑搜索方法，其结构评分项精确分解表示 Dirichlet 能量，无需在线全局谱计算。匹配诊断证实结构项是受测机制中的主要拓扑选择信号，探索与度控制是辅助性搜索调节器而非普遍必要的精度来源。LFHE 应被视为状态感知局部化拓扑搜索，而非全局谱优化的近似。局限性包括：理论仅针对结构项与固定表示；D_max 是在线阈值而非硬性上限；接受仅基于发起方；拓扑更新串行；评估限于受控基准与中等规模。未来方向包括离散加权聚合算子分析、学习式探索调度、并发拓扑更新以及通信归一化下的大规模评估。

Abstract: Decentralized learning is highly sensitive to communication topology under non-IID data. Adaptive peer-selection methods can exploit local model information, but broader peer discovery may require increasingly large control state, whereas direct spectral optimization typically relies on graph-wide information. We study the intermediate setting of bounded local topology search and propose Local-First Heuristic Evolution (LFHE), a representation-driven rewiring framework whose candidate discovery and scoring use only ego-neighborhood and friend-of-a-friend (FoF) information. The structural score admits an exact interpretation through graph Dirichlet energy: its sum across clients equals twice the representation Dirichlet energy, which under standard linear consensus dynamics governs the instantaneous dissipation of representation disagreement. LFHE combines this state-dependent structural signal with early exploration and degree control, while algebraic connectivity remains an offline graph diagnostic. Under bounded sparse degree, its FoF candidate state remains local rather than expanding toward population-wide peer tracking. Across four image, speech, and text benchmarks, LFHE achieves competitive decentralized learning performance. Matched-protocol controls identify the structural term as the principal empirical topology-selection signal, while comparison with broader peer discovery exposes a trade-off between predictive performance and discovery-state locality. Together, these results motivate state-aware bounded local topology search between pairwise peer selection and globally informed topology optimization.

</details>


### [199] [Mathematical Proof Assistants for Teaching Logic: The LogiKEy Methodology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08214)
*Christoph Benzmüller,David Fuenmayor,Luca Pasetto*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一种基于经典高阶逻辑（HOL）作为通用元逻辑、通过语义嵌入将多种对象逻辑（命题、模态、认知、道义、高阶模态）统一编码到单一证明助手（以 Isabelle/HOL 为主）中的逻辑教学方法论 LogiKEy，并报告了在混合背景（计算机科学、数学、哲学）学生中实施三年的教学经验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逻辑教学面临双重挑战：（1）跨学科挑战——计算机科学、数学、哲学学生背景与需求差异巨大；（2）内容挑战——当代应用（AI、自然语言语义、法律伦理分析）需要超越经典一阶逻辑的多种非经典逻辑，传统"一种逻辑一套工具"的教学方式成本高昂且割裂概念脉络。作者主张用单一富有表达力的元逻辑配合证明助手，为混合学生群体提供统一、机器检查的多元逻辑学习环境。

Method: 核心技术是**浅语义嵌入（SSE）**：在 HOL（Church 简单类型论）中通过 λ-抽象将对象逻辑的连接词定义为世界相关命题上的函数。例如模态逻辑 K 的方块词 □φ 定义为 λw.∀v. R w v → φ v。四层架构：L0 元逻辑 HOL → L1 对象逻辑嵌入 → L2 领域专用语言/理论 → L3 具体应用。配套工具：Sledgehammer（自动定理证明）、Nitpick（反模型查找）、Isar（结构化证明语言）、LogiKEy 可视化器（将 Nitpick 文本输出转为 Kripke 图）。

Result: 呈现了一个"分级阶梯"课程示例：第1阶 命题逻辑（Liars Street 谜题，引出"知道"的内涵坍缩问题）；第2阶 模态逻辑 K 到 S5（通过可能世界解决坍缩）；Wise Men 谜题引出动态认知逻辑与公共宣告逻辑；Boolos 古怪推理展示高阶元逻辑对自动证明搜索的益处（第2阶间奏）；第3阶 Chisholm 悖论引出标准道义逻辑 KD 及二元道义逻辑（偏好关系）；第4阶 Gödel 本体论论证（高阶模态逻辑，验证 Scott 变体并复现 Gödel 原始公理的不一致性）。三年教学观察表明：跨学科探索有效、计算机科学学生擅长工具使用、哲学学生擅长把握问题实质、主要障碍是 Isabelle 语法与安装；自动化使开放式作业可行。学生能通过该项目进入研究前沿，部分发展为博士论文。

Conclusion: 文章确立（机器可复现）：分级阶梯的形式化结果及"一元逻辑承载多元对象逻辑"的方法论主张。已记录（基于教学经验）：混合班级可成功运行此课程。开放问题：学习效果的实证研究、与专用教学工具的比较、大语言模型辅助形式化下的评估方式。前景方向：跨证明助手可移植性（已移植到 Lean 4）、交互式 Kripke 模型探索、元理论本身的机器化验证、AI 伦理教学的自然延伸。所有材料在 logikey.org 公开可用。

Abstract: We report on an approach to teaching logic to mixed groups of computer science, mathematics, and philosophy students, based on the logico-pluralistic LogiKEy methodology, used for more than a decade in courses, summer schools, and tutorials. LogiKEy uses classical higher-order logic (HOL) as a universal metalogic in which object logics, classical and non-classical alike, are encoded by defining their semantics; through these semantical embeddings a single proof assistant (e.g. Isabelle/HOL), with its automated theorem provers and (counter-)model finders, becomes one environment in which students learn, experiment with, and compare logics. After making the pedagogical case for proof assistants in the logic classroom, we present a graded sequence of classroom examples, each transition motivated by a limitation of the preceding representation, by a need for more explicit modelling resources, or by a new application. A liars-and-truth-tellers puzzle leads from propositional to modal logic; the Wise Men puzzle leads on to dynamic epistemic logic; Boolos's curious inference illustrates what a higher-order meta-logic buys, even for automated proof search; Chisholm's paradox takes the sequence into deontic logic, and from standard to dyadic deontic logic; and Gödel's ontological argument brings it to a research-level metaphysical argument. We then rebut the objection that embedding everything in classical HOL is monism rather than pluralism, reflect on three years of teaching such a course, and sketch the portability of the approach beyond Isabelle.

</details>


### [200] [Learn2Play Bench: How Well Do LLM Agents Learn from Experience in Unfamiliar Environments?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08215)
*Yibo Li,Jinhang Qiu,Zhi Zheng,Qianyun Guo,Jiaying Wu,Shuo Ji,Bryan Hooi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了Learn2Play Bench基准测试，用于评估LLM智能体在陌生环境中通过交互学习的能力，包含20个隐藏规则的新颖文本游戏。研究对比了多种基座模型、自进化方法和智能体框架，并对比人类玩家，发现保留完整交互历史比提炼规则更有效，人类顶尖玩家优于所有评估的智能体，且选择合适的智能体框架可以同时提升性能和降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自进化智能体的评估基准大多基于熟悉的任务或规则已知的环境，无法区分智能体是通过交互学习获得新知识，还是仅仅调用预训练知识。因此需要一个能隔离"从交互中学习"这一能力的受控评估环境。

Method: 作者设计了20个新颖的文本游戏作为Learn2Play Bench基准，满足四个原则：(1)规则新颖或反直觉；(2)自动评分；(3)结果可复现；(4)跨回合控制变化。实验对比了9个基座模型在固定黑盒上的表现，以及6种自进化方法（Naive、Memory、Reflexion、EvoTest、ReasoningBank、AWM），并对比了OpenCode、Claude Code和Codex三种框架，最后招募人类玩家（每游戏21-30人）进行对照。评估指标包括Max（峰值）、Mean（均值）、Learning Gain（LG，学习增益）和Learning Slope（LS，学习斜率）。

Result: 核心发现：(1) 经验保留：保留完整交互历史（Memory）的效果优于将经验提炼为规则或策略的方法（如EvoTest会因一次失败就生成过度泛化的规则）；(2) 人机差距：人类Top-1达到84.3的最高分，优于所有评估的智能体（Claude Code + Opus 5最高81.8），且人类策略更多样、行动重复更少、失败后恢复更快；(3) 框架重要性：Claude Code和Codex在相同基座下全面优于OpenCode；(4) 实例变化会降低学习速度，特别是较弱的基座模型；(5) 智能体可能学会规则但无法将其转化为有效策略。GPT-5 Mini和AWM组合是唯一学习斜率为负的方法。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了受控环境来评估LLM智能体的学习能力，揭示了三个关键发现：保留原始交互记录优于经验压缩；人类玩家在策略多样性方面仍优于当前智能体；合适的智能体框架能同时提升性能并降低推理成本。未来工作应探索更好的探索-利用平衡、保留可追溯到原始证据的学习规则的方法，以及适应环境变化时区分不变规则与实例特定细节的技术。

Abstract: Learning from experience is essential for LLM agents to adapt to unfamiliar and dynmaic environments. Evaluating this ability is therefore important for understanding how effectively agents acquire and use new knowledge. Existing benchmarks have sought to evaluate this ability, but they primarily evaluate tasks whose rules are provided in the instructions or already familiar to pretrained models, making it difficult to distinguish learning from interactions from reasoning with existing knowledge. To address this, we introduce Learn2Play Bench, a benchmark of newly designed text-based games, whose rules are novel or counterintuitive, requiring agents to acquire knowledge through interaction rather than rely solely on pretrained knowledge. These games provide reproducible feedback and automatic scoring, enabling controlled evaluation of learning across repeated attempts. We also vary game instances to test whether agents can apply what they have learned to new situations. Therefore, we evaluate how backbone models, self-evolving methods, and agent harnesses affect agents' learning ability, revealing three findings: (1) Experience retention: Retaining complete records of actions and feedback can support more effective learning than summarizing these experiences into rules or strategies. (2) Human agent gap: Top-performing human players achieve higher peak scores than the evaluated agents. Human explore more varied strategies, and repeat actions less. (3) Harness matters: With the backbone fixed, changing the harness can improve performance while reducing estimated inference cost. Together, these findings provide insights into how LLM agents learn from experience and suggest directions for future work to improve their learning ability. Project website: this https URL

</details>


### [201] [Quantum Entangled Multimodal Fusion Networks (QEMFN): Resource-Aware Hybrid Vision-Language Fusion via Trainable Entanglement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08216)
*Srikar Alla,Ali Shiri Sichani,Chi-Ren Shyu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: QEMFN（Quantum Entangled Multimodal Fusion Networks）提出了一种混合量子-经典多模态融合框架，将参数化纠缠作为结构化归纳偏置用于视觉-语言融合。在冻结的CLIP骨干和匹配参数预算下，QEMFN在COCO-5k和Flickr30k上优于多种经典融合基线，并通过量子中心化分析（纠缠能力、可表达性、梯度方差、熵-性能分析）和真实超导硬件执行进行了全面评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言多模态系统的融合阶段普遍依赖经典算子（如拼接、注意力、双线性池化、张量交互），这些方法在表达高阶交互时存在参数量大、优化复杂或结构性假设受限等问题。作者旨在探索具有不同结构先验的融合机制——即通过参数化量子纠缠作为可解释的结构化归纳偏置来建模跨模态交互，并在受控的实验条件下评估其是否带来可衡量的贡献。

Method: QEMFN采用四阶段流程：(1) 使用冻结的CLIP ViT-B/32提取768维视觉和512维文本特征；(2) 通过可训练投影矩阵映射到6维/模态的紧凑潜空间并ℓ2归一化；(3) 以角度编码方式编码为12量子比特寄存器，经L=4层含模态内CZ耦合和配对跨模态CZ门（V_i↔T_i）的参数化电路演化；(4) 通过24个测量可观测量（12个局域Pauli-Z、6个配对跨模态相关子、6个模态内相关子）提取融合表示，经线性输出头映射后用余弦相似度进行检索。训练使用对称InfoNCE损失，仅优化投影矩阵、量子旋转参数和输出头。框架在理想模拟、含噪模拟和真实IBM超导硬件（带零噪声外推）上均执行。

Result: 在COCO-5k图像-文本检索中，QEMFN以0.41M参数取得R@1=68.9、MRR=0.781，超过所有参数匹配的经典方法（MLP: 61.7、低秩双线性: 63.9、张量融合: 64.8、FiLM: 67.3、交叉注意力: 67.8、紧凑Transformer: 68.1、去量化配对拓扑: 68.2），且差异经Wilcoxon检验显著。跨数据集迁移到Flickr30k时R@1=60.8保持最优。消融实验显示：96参数量子模块单独优于96参数经典MLP（62.7 vs 60.4 R@1），完整QEMFN较无纠缠变体提升1.8 R@1，归因于跨模态纠缠门。量子中心化分析：基础配置Meyer-Wallach纠缠能力Q_MW=0.61、可表达性E=0.09（结构化而非完全随机），经验梯度方差1.2×10⁻³符合局域代价 barren plateau界。熵-性能原始Spearman相关0.88，控制epoch和验证损失后偏相关仍显著（0.56和0.49），优于经典耦合度量。干预实验表明冻结纠缠门、随机配对或正则化低纠缠均同时降低熵和R@1。硬件执行：理想模拟68.9→4096 shots 68.2→含噪模拟65.9→真实硬件8192 shots 63.8→ZNE缓解后65.1 R@1。

Conclusion: QEMFN是一种结构化混合融合模块，而非量子加速学习系统。在冻结骨干和匹配参数条件下，配对纠缠结合经典投影产生了可衡量的改进，同时通过量子特有度量提供了可解释信号。该框架在COCO-5k和Flickr30k上一致优于参数匹配的经典融合基线，消融实验分离了量子模块与经典投影的贡献，量子中心化分析验证了纠缠动态、可训练性和硬件行为的特征。作者明确不声称量子计算优势，当前规模的电路仍可经典模拟，未来工作包括影子层析的硬件纠缠诊断、张量网络形式去量化分析、扩展至视觉问答等推理任务以及自适应电路架构。

Abstract: Multimodal vision-language systems typically fuse image and text embeddings through classical operators such as concatenation, attention, bilinear pooling, or tensor interactions. We propose Quantum Entangled Multimodal Fusion Networks (QEMFN), a hybrid quantum-classical framework that introduces parameterized entanglement as a structured inductive bias for multimodal fusion. Pretrained visual and textual features are projected into compact latent spaces, encoded as angle-parameterized quantum states, processed through intra-modal and paired cross-modal entangling circuits, and measured to produce fused representations for retrieval. Under matched parameter budgets and identical frozen CLIP backbones, QEMFN outperforms classical fusion baselines on COCO-5k and Flickr30k, including multilayer perceptron, tensor fusion, FiLM, cross-attention, compact transformer, and a dequantized paired-topology analogue. An ablation suite isolates the quantum module's contribution from the surrounding classical projections, and quantum-centric analyses report Meyer-Wallach entangling capability, expressibility, gradient variance against barren-plateau bounds, and entropy-performance correlation under controls for training progress alongside an intervention study on the entangling component. QEMFN is executed under shot-based estimation, a noise-modeled fake backend, and a real superconducting device with zero-noise extrapolation. This work does not claim quantum computational advantage; the contribution is the framework together with a controlled empirical and quantum-centric evaluation that positions trainable entanglement as an interpretable, hardware-executable fusion mechanism at scales accessible on contemporary devices.

</details>


### [202] [Confidence-Ordering Reversal under Contextual Priors in Neural Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08229)
*Xinyu Zhang,Sichao Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了神经-语言解码中上下文先验融合后产生的"置信度排序反转"现象：融合后的top-2 margin越大，当正确候选初始排名靠前时越可能是修复（repair），但当初始排名靠后时反而越可能是残留错误（residual error）。作者提出基于分数层面的margin形成解释，并通过仅改变融合权重的因果干预验证了这一机制，最终主张置信度估计应保留局部与先验的独立分数而非仅依赖融合分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上下文先验（contextual priors）通过重塑候选分数改善神经-语言解码，但置信度也从同一组重塑后的分数中读取。这导致先验未能修复的错误反而变得更自信，而精度不变无法揭示这一问题。在BCI持续使用中，用户依赖置信度判断哪些输出需要复核，置信度高的错误可能漏检。已有研究主要关注解码精度或文本相似度，对先验如何影响其残留错误的置信度知之甚少。

Method: 方法包含四个关键设计：(1) 在语音检索框架中保留固定候选池，分离局部解码分数与上下文先验分数，通过加性shallow fusion（权重α）组合；(2) 以融合后top-2 margin作为置信度，将初始错误分为修复（fusion后正确）与残留错误（fusion后仍错）；(3) 按正确候选的初始排名分组，计算修复-分离AUROC，并提出score-level margin形成理论（修复margin受限于α·Δπ - G⁰，残留错误margin可由两个错误候选形成）；(4) 通过仅改变融合权重α的因果干预验证理论，使用Qwen3-4B-Base LM先验（teacher-forced与free-running）进行对比实验。

Result: 在MEG-MASC与MOUS两个数据集上验证了置信度排序反转：在MEG-MASC上，融合margin的修复-分离AUROC从排名2-3的0.704降至排名21-50的0.392（pooled correctness AUROC为0.87）。初始排名超过20的残留错误占融合后所有错误的46.6%。因果干预显示，增大α使正序排列向更深排名扩展，在词级LM先验下此扩展持续到精度增益峰值之后。先验自身margin在排名21-50的修复-分离AUROC达0.937。完整估计器（含15维特征）在92.24%覆盖率下发射率从融合margin的56.7%提升至74.5%。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了上下文融合下置信度排序反转的核心机制：修复必须首先弥补正确候选的初始分差，因此最终margin受限；残留错误则可在两个错误候选间建立大margin。基于加性融合的修复-margin上界解释了反转的存在，并预测增大融合权重会将反转边界推向更深排名。先验自身分数（在融合前读取）可识别融合margin无法区分的修复与残留错误。融合后的置信度估计应保留局部证据与上下文支持，而非仅依赖融合分数的单一摘要。

Abstract: Contextual priors improve neural-to-language decoding by reshaping candidate scores. However, confidence is read from the same reshaped scores, so the errors a prior leaves behind can become more confident with no change in accuracy to reveal it. We study how a prior shapes confidence in speech retrieval on MEG-MASC and MOUS using local decoding scores, a contextual prior combined by additive shallow fusion, and the fused top-two margin as confidence. Among initially incorrect predictions, we find a confidence-ordering reversal: a larger margin makes a repair more likely when the correct candidate starts near the top of the local ranking, but less likely when it starts lower. On MEG-MASC, pooled correctness AUROC is 0.87, yet AUROC separating repairs from residual errors falls from 0.70 at initial ranks 2-3 to 0.39 at ranks 21-50. Errors starting beyond rank 20, inside the reversed region, make up 46.6% of all post-fusion errors. We propose a score-level account: a repair must first close the correct candidate's initial deficit, limiting its final margin, whereas a residual error can build a large margin between two incorrect candidates. A causal intervention that changes only the fusion weight moves the reversal to deeper ranks as predicted. Under a word-level LM prior, it keeps moving after accuracy gain peaks, so a weight chosen for accuracy does not settle confidence. Reading local and prior scores separately improves selective decoding: the decoder answers on 74.5% of windows instead of 56.7%, while 92% of output sets still contain the correct candidate. Confidence after contextual fusion should retain the local and contextual evidence behind each prediction, not just the fused scores. Project website: this https URL Code: this https URL

</details>


### [203] [OSFP4: Joint Optimization of Diagonal Smoothing and Block Scales for NVFP4 Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08231)
*Neriah Ben David,Ori Meir,Or Ordentlich*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出OSFP4，一种针对NVFP4量化的新方案，通过联合优化对角平滑矩阵和分块缩放因子（E4M3），在W4A4和W4A16配置下均取得了优于现有方法（如FP-Quant GPTQ、MR-GPTQ、H-Scale、SOAR等）的平均精度，同时保留了原生NVFP4推理吞吐量的94–97%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NVFP4格式在LLM推理中具有存储紧凑和原生Tensor Core加速优势，但FP4的极低精度（E2M1仅4个比特且动态范围有限）导致显著的量化误差。现有方法（如SmoothQuant式对角缩放）在INT量化中用于平衡无穷范数，但对FP星座因动态范围"几乎无限"而通常无用；然而FP4动态范围过小，需要微缩放块缩放（NVFP4每16个元素配E4M3缩放），而默认的absmax-to-6规则会丢弃大量小幅度值，导致较大失真。因此需要一种联合优化对角平滑矩阵和分块缩放的NVFP4量化方法。

Method: 核心方法是引入一个乘性抖动（multiplicative dithering）随机化FP4量化器分析，得到一个可微的光滑相对误差函数φ(x)（其定义在区间I_FP4=[7/4,7]上达到最小值φ_min≈0.010723），并基于此推导矩阵乘积量化误差的闭式表达式。该表达式同时考虑了RTN和GPTQ式SIC两种权重舍入方式（通过将激活方差σ²_X(r)替换为SIC下的预测误差方差U²(r)），并适用于是否量化激活的情况。优化在log参数空间（对角平滑系数α和块缩放γ的对数）下使用Adam进行80次迭代，学习率0.12，且目标函数关于每个16元素分组完全解耦为独立的子问题。第一阶段联合优化对角平滑矩阵A和连续缩放值；第二阶段在E4M3离散网格上精细搜索权重缩放（考虑了RTN和SIC两种情况）；激活缩放在推理时使用absmax-to-6加全局tensor缩放计算。

Result: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，W4A4配置（absmax激活缩放）下OSFP4 W-SIC/X-RTN平均精度达77.03%，超过FP-Quant GPTQ（76.34%）、MR-GPTQ（76.18%）、SOAR（76.60%）和H-Scale（76.67%）；W4A16配置下OSFP4 W-SIC达78.42%，优于H-Scale（78.00%），接近BF16基线79.22%。WikiText-2困惑度从absmax RTN的7.88降至7.67（OSFP4 W-SIC）。组件消融实验显示平滑A、缩放选择和SIC三者结合带来最大改进。在Qwen3-8B、Gemma-4-31B-IT等模型上也观察到一致的精度提升。在NVIDIA B200上，OSFP4保留了原生NVFP4 prefill吞吐量的94–97%，主要开销来自o_proj和down_proj处无法融入LayerNorm的显式对角平滑操作。

Conclusion: OSFP4通过将随机化抖动FP4量化器分析、闭式矩阵乘积误差公式与联合对角平滑-块缩放优化相结合，为NVFP4量化提供了一种高效且精度领先的方案。其在多种模型和精度配置下均优于现有方法，且仅带来极小的吞吐量损失。该方案已通过LLM Compressor的add-on包和vLLM插件开源，便于实际部署。

Abstract: NVFP4 is an attractive datatype for large language model (LLM) inference, offering compact storage and native tensor-core acceleration. However, preserving accuracy using NVFP4 requires careful quantization. In this work we develop a novel quantization scheme called Optimized Smoothing and Scaling for NVFP4 (OSFP4). For each linear projection it uses a diagonal smoothing matrix whose entries are optimized to minimize the squared matrix-product quantization error under NVFP4, taking into account the rounding procedure that is used (either round-to-nearest, or GPTQ-style successive interference cancellation). This requires performing joint optimization on the smoothing entries as well as the block scales, which is facilitated by analyzing a multiplicative-dither FP4 quantizer instead of the fixed deterministic one. Experiments show that OSFP4 achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated competitors in the corresponding quantization settings, while retaining approximately 94-97\% of vendor NVFP4 prefill throughput on the measured workloads. Our code is available in this https URL

</details>


### [204] [Sensor-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08244)
*Yuekai Xu,Zitao Shuai,Yuzhe Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种新的建模范式——Sensor-Language-Action (SLA)，将多模态传感器观测、自然语言和动作通过统一模型连接起来。作者构建了大规模SLA基准（涵盖116,000+个体、79种传感器模态和60个动作组），并提出了OpenSLA模型，在临床预测、手术室决策和代谢健康等真实任务中实现了优于现有方法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的传感器模型主要停留在感知层面（识别状态或预测结果），动作建模与感知分离，采用任务特定的封闭标签空间。这种分离导致无法建立异构传感器证据、上下文信息与多样化动作之间的共同关联机制，限制了传感器智能系统从感知到决策的完整闭环能力。

Method: 1. 提出SLA框架，以自然语言作为感知与动作之间的语义接口；2. 构建多维描述生成管道（Multi-faceted Captioning Pipeline），包含观察性描述（Observational）、关系性描述（Relational）、全局性描述（Global）和动作性描述（Action）四个层面；3. 设计OpenSLA模型，包括基于LoRA适配的LLM主干（Qwen-3.5-2B）、分层传感器编码器（Hierarchical Memory模块）以及多模态融合解码器（带门控残差的动作条件化字幕解码器）；4. 通过分层动作预测头实现必要性-类别-细粒度标签三级动作预测；5. 训练目标联合优化动作预测损失（必要性+类别+细粒度）和文本生成损失。

Result: 1. 在六个开发数据集和MIMIC-IV外部队列上，OpenSLA在临床、手术室和CGM三个领域的动作预测、状态理解和动作解释五项任务中均优于现有方法（包括监督模型、时间序列基础模型Chronos-2/Moirai、多模态LLM GPT-5.6-Luna/DeepSeek-V3.2及时序语言模型OpenTSLM/SensorLM）；2. 消融实验表明：去掉字幕监督导致最大性能下降，联合动作-语言微调优于VLA风格的动作单独微调；3. 在零样本未见动作预测（如Imipenem）任务上达到70.0 F1和71.4% BAcc，显著优于GPT-5.6-Luna（42.9 F1）和DeepSeek-V3.2（34.5 F1）；4. 无需任何适配即可迁移到未见MIMIC-IV队列（必要性AUROC达81.75%）；5. 表示分析揭示了语义聚类结构、连续动作插值结构以及对未来传感器状态（葡萄糖均值/最小/最大/斜率）的预测信息。

Conclusion: 论文成功将传感器智能从感知理解扩展到基于感知证据的动作推理与解释。SLA范式通过语言作为统一语义接口，将传感器观测、上下文信息和动作建模在同一框架内。OpenSLA在真实临床场景中表现出色，并展现出对未见动作和未见队列的零样本泛化能力，为构建通用传感器智能模型奠定了基础。该工作尚未经过临床验证，不能直接用于临床决策，未来需要开发跨领域的通用SLA模型并处理传感器异构性问题。

Abstract: Sensors are useful not only for understanding the world but also for deciding what to do next. Existing sensor models however largely stop at perception: they recognize states or predict outcomes, leaving actions modeled separately through task-specific and often closed label spaces. We introduce Sensor-Language-Action (SLA) modeling, a framework that connects multimodal sensor observations, natural language, and actions within a unified model. SLA uses language as a semantic interface between sensing and acting, allowing heterogeneous actions to be represented, predicted, and explained while remaining grounded in the underlying sensor evidence. We build a large-scale SLA benchmark consisting of datasets that span more than 116,000 individuals, 79 sensor modalities, and 60 action groups, together with a multi-faceted captioning pipeline that aligns user context, sensor dynamics, and action evidence. Building on this framework, we present OpenSLA, a unified SLA model for hierarchical action prediction, state understanding, and action explanation. Extensive experiments on real-world tasks in clinical prediction, operating rooms, and metabolic health verify its superior performance over the state-of-the-art. OpenSLA also demonstrates intriguing capabilities including language-guided evidence grounding and zero-shot generalization to unseen actions and cohorts.

</details>


### [205] [LeanPlan: Optimal Planning with LLM-Generated Heuristics and Admissibility Proofs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08246)
*André G. Pereira,Augusto B. Corrêa,Felipe Meneguzzi,Jendrik Seipp*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LeanPlan是首个利用LLM生成启发式函数并通过Lean 4机器检查其可采纳性证明,从而实现最优经典规划的系统。它在13个领域上超越了当前最优规划器Scorpion。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM生成的规划启发式缺乏可采纳性保证,只能用于"令人满意"的规划(satisficing planning),无法保证最优性。手工设计可采纳启发式代价高昂,而统计泛化界或学习启发式方法均无法严格保证所有任务上的可采纳性。因此需要一种能让LLM自动生成领域特定启发式,并同时生成其可采纳性的机器可检查证明的方法。

Method: 1. **PDDL到Lean模块的转换**:确定性生成器将PDDL领域翻译为Lean 4模块,固定启发式及其证明可用的词汇表。
2. **代理循环开发启发式与证明**:LLM编码代理(GPT-5.6 Sol)接收生成的Lean模块、训练任务、启发式接口和共享证明库,迭代开发启发式、其可采纳性证明以及证明所依赖的领域假设(证书)。代理使用Lean的构建失败和规划器运行结果作为反馈进行修改。
3. **可采纳性证明**:证明两个局部性质——目标感知(goal-aware, h(s)=0于目标态)和一致性(consistent, h(s)≤c(a)+h(s')于每个转移)——这两个性质一起蕴含可达状态上的可采纳性。
4. **证书(Certificate)**:领域假设被编码为布尔检查,作用于任务的对象、初始状态和目标,规划前评估,不满足则拒绝使用该启发式。
5. **自动控制器接受候选**:扫描禁用构造(sorry、admit、native_decide、新axiom),重新构建Lean模块和证明,检查训练任务的证书通过,并要求A*在训练任务上求解数不少于Scorpion、且共同求解任务上扩展状态更少。
6. **规划与搜索**:实现包括grouding(类似Helmert 2009)、h²互斥剪枝、动作与效果剪枝,以及带重复检测、重开、扩展时目标检测的标准A*搜索。
7. **共享证明库**:将领域特定证明与共享定理(从可采纳性推导最优性,以及A*正确性的soundness与optimality定理)结合。

Result: 在10个IPC 2023 Learning Track领域(900测试任务)和3个新领域(270测试任务,Orrery、Cisterns、Qubit Routing)上评估,测试任务的对象数最多可达训练任务的57倍。
- **可采纳性与证明**:成功为全部13个领域生成启发式及其可采纳性证明。
- **覆盖率**:LeanPlan求解281个IPC任务和67个新领域任务,比Scorpion(SCP配置,221和51)分别多27.1%和31.4%,总共求解348 vs 272。
- **状态扩展**:在IPC 2023上,LeanPlan与SCP共同求解的211个任务中,LeanPlan在152个任务上扩展更少状态。
- **超出训练分布的有效性**:在595个对象数超过训练任务最大值的IPC任务上,LeanPlan求解53个,SCP仅13个,LM-cut仅7个。
- **代理成本**:平均每个领域69.8分钟,平均成本US$17.30。
- **局限性**:Cisterns的证书拒绝了3个测试任务;证明无法证明不可解性;仅支持单位成本STRIPS片段;保证依赖Lean内核、编译器、运行时及PDDL语义形式化等未受证明检查的部分。

Conclusion: LeanPlan证明了LLM可以为最优规划生成可证明可采纳的领域特定启发式。结合机器检查的证明并未迫使LLM生成弱启发式;生成的启发式利用领域结构,通常比当前最优领域无关最优规划器Scorpion扩展更少状态、求解更多任务。该方法开辟了LLM辅助形式化验证规划的新方向。未来工作可扩展到含动作成本和更丰富PDDL片段,以及评估其他LLM(包括开源权重模型)。

Abstract: Frontier large language models (LLMs) can generate heuristic functions that guide search to achieve state-of-the-art performance in satisficing planning, where any plan is acceptable. However, these heuristics are not guaranteed to be admissible and can lead to suboptimal plans. We introduce LeanPlan, the first planning system that finds optimal plans with LLM-generated heuristics whose admissibility is machine-checked. Given a domain description and training tasks, an agentic loop uses planner feedback to iteratively improve a reusable domain-specific heuristic, its admissibility proof and the required domain assumptions. LeanPlan implements the heuristic, its proof and an efficient planner with machine-checked grounding and search in Lean 4. We evaluate LeanPlan on ten domains from the International Planning Competition and three new domains, using test tasks with up to 57 times as many objects as the training tasks. With GPT-5.6 Sol in the agentic loop, we successfully generate heuristics and admissibility proofs for all these domains. With the resulting heuristics, LeanPlan usually expands fewer states than the state-of-the-art Scorpion planner and solves more tasks overall.

</details>


### [206] [MASC: A Multi-Agent Self-Calibration Framework with Latent Construct Alignment for Consistent Client Role-Playing in Psychological Counseling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08250)
*Shixin Peng,Kun Jiang,Jiaxing Zheng,Qihao Yang,Jingying Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MASC框架和CRPC-Bench基准，用于在心理咨询对话中实现并评估LLM驱动的、心理一致性的客户角色扮演。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有角色扮演方法依赖静态画像提示，会出现人格漂移、不切实际的合作性，以及心理状态、沟通行为和情感的不一致；现有评估缺乏同时覆盖会话级稳定特征和回合级动态心理的统一测试平台。

Method: 提出MASC多智能体自校准框架，将潜变量构造（情感表达、心理状态、沟通行为）作为生成与验证目标，通过多智能体辩论生成候选、多智能体投票校准、记忆重试机制构成闭环校准；并构建CRPC-Bench基准，覆盖会话级画像+大五人格与回合级状态/动作/情感。

Result: 在38个动机性访谈客户画像上，MASC在画像一致性（Hetero在Persona/Behavior/Motivation/Beliefs领先）、大五人格一致性（Hetero总体最强）、以及动作/情感/状态的KL散度（Hetero分别为0.06/0.27/0.06，均为模拟方法最低）上均优于7个基线；消融实验证明多智能体辩论贡献最大，投票+记忆重试次之。

Conclusion: MASC与CRPC-Bench为AI辅助心理咨询研究与培训中开发并评估心理一致性的客户模拟提供了统一基础；局限在于数据集规模小且依赖LLM自动评估。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate clients for counselor training and psychological counseling research, but reliable simulation requires clients to remain psychologically coherent across extended interactions. Existing role-playing methods largely rely on static profile prompts and may exhibit persona drift, unrealistic cooperativeness, or inconsistent psychological states, communicative actions, and emotions. Existing evaluations also lack a unified testbed for both stable client characteristics and evolving psychological dynamics. We propose MASC, a Multi-Agent Self-Calibration framework with latent construct alignment for consistent client role-playing in psychological counseling. MASC combines construct-guided generation, collaborative refinement, consistency verification, and memory-based revision in a closed calibration loop that detects and corrects inconsistencies as dialogue unfolds. We further introduce CRPC-Bench, a benchmark covering session-level profile information and Big-Five personality traits, as well as turn-level psychological state, communicative action, and emotion expression. CRPC-Bench contains 38 motivational interviewing client profiles augmented with personality and emotion annotations. Experiments show that MASC outperforms existing methods across profile, personality, receptivity, and turn-level consistency, with the heterogeneous configuration achieving the strongest overall performance. MASC and CRPC-Bench provide a unified foundation for developing and evaluating psychologically coherent client simulations for AI-assisted counseling research and training.

</details>


### [207] [zkLLMPoT: Efficient Zero Knowledge Proof of Training for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08258)
*Junkai Liang,Zhanpeng Guo,Pengfei Wu,Qingni Shen,Jiaheng Zhang,Zhonghai Wu,Haiyang Xue,Shengfang Zhai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: zkLLMPoT提出了一种零知识框架，用于在不暴露模型权重和私有训练数据的前提下，通过前向评估而非验证完整优化轨迹，对大语言模型（LLM）训练后的检查点进行密码学审计。通过"承诺后挑战"协议和基于sumcheck/lookup的Transformer电路编译，在1.1-1.5B模型上证明时间为41-59秒，13B模型为131秒，验证时间低于0.5秒，且证明成本与训练迭代次数无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM训练成果审计面临两大难题：(1)模型权重和训练数据需保密，但用户和监管机构需要独立确认发布的检查点是否真正满足训练声明的能力或策略要求；(2)对完整训练轨迹进行零知识证明代价极大（如Kaizen在VGG-11上每迭代约需15分钟证明时间，DPproof在CIFAR-10上需要约100小时），现有zkPoT方案仅适用于演示级模型，无法扩展到Transformer规模的LLM。需要一种既能保护隐私又能在LLM规模上高效审计训练结果的机制。

Method: 1) **结果证明形式化**：zkLLMPoT将审计问题重构为验证提交的检查点在审计者选定的挑战序列上达到声明的目标值v = L(f_{A,θ}(S))，而非证明完整训练过程；2) **承诺后挑战顺序**：训练者先固定架构并提交权重承诺⟦θ⟧，然后审计者选择评估序列S，防止训练者针对评估集过拟合检查点；3) **算子级电路编译**：将Transformer前向计算分解为线性层（用sumcheck超立方体内积论证证明矩阵乘法）和非线性层（用logup风格lookup论证处理Norm、激活函数、softmax等）；4) **混合基数softmax分解**：将每行分数矩阵用多个查找表的数位乘积重构，避免直接编码expential范式；5) **Hyrax风格Pedersen承诺**：采用矩阵布局的Pedersen承诺，添加盲化因子实现完美隐藏，承诺成本仅由模型大小决定，与训练步数无关。

Result: 在四个模型家族（OPT、Llama、Qwen2.5、DeepSeek-Coder）的14个配置（0.125B-13B参数）上进行了实验评估：1) **效率**：在序列长度T=512下，1.1-1.5B模型证明时间41-59秒，验证时间<0.5秒，13B模型证明时间131秒；2) **承诺成本**：权重承诺138-206秒，可跨多次审计复用；3) **规模化优势**：参数增加104倍时证明时间仅增加8.3倍（从15.7秒到130.6秒），证明成本与训练迭代次数无关；4) **安全性**：在BLS12-381曲线下具有约127比特安全性；5) **算子分解**：softmax占证明时间的56-64%，融合sumcheck用于线性投影/FFN仅需4.1-6.0秒，注意力得分矩阵乘法4.6-10.3秒。与现有zkPoT系统相比，zkLLMPoT在更大模型规模上以更低代价完成训练结果审计，证明了完整一次前向评估而非完整训练轨迹。

Conclusion: zkLLMPoT证明了LLM训练结果的零知识审计是一条可行且高效的路径。其核心贡献在于：(1)通过结果证明形式化（损失函数风格的检查点评估）将证明成本与训练迭代次数解耦；(2)"承诺后挑战"协议防止了训练者对评估集的事后适应；(3)针对Transformer层的算子级优化和电路融合实现了实用的一次性证明性能。未来方向包括：更快算子设计以支持更大模型和更长序列、更灵活的用户定义审计目标、以及支持多训练方/审计方的协议设计。该工作为LLM检查点提供了一种可转移的、隐私保护的训练结果证书。

Abstract: Auditing the claimed outcomes of large language model (LLM) training is challenging when model weights and training data are private, while cryptographically proving the full training process is prohibitively expensive at Transformer scale. We present zkLLMPoT, a zero-knowledge framework that certifies auditor-defined properties of a trained checkpoint through forward evaluation rather than verification of its optimization trajectory. zkLLMPoT includes 2 phases: 1) The trainer fixes the architecture and the model weights are committed. Then the auditor selects challenge sequences, preventing the trainer from modifying the checkpoint in response to the audit data. 2) Then the trainer proves the objective value attained by the committed model on those sequences. This formulation makes the certification cost independent of the number of training iterations, without revealing model weights or requiring access to private training data. We build on sumcheck- and lookup-based arguments to certify Transformer computations, while supporting next-token loss and task-specific audit objectives. Across four model families, operator-level benchmarks yield proving times of 41-59 seconds for 1.1-1.5B-parameter models and 131 seconds at 13B for the covered operators, with verification below half a second at a sequence length of 512.

</details>


### [208] [CoDe-LoRA: Mitigating the Orthogonality Dilemma in Continual Learning of LLMs via Knowledge Consolidation and Decoupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08312)
*Maoqi Liu,Quan Fang,Yufei He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CoDe-LoRA，一种针对大语言模型持续学习的双分支框架，通过知识整合（Consolidation）与解耦（Decoupling）解决基于正交投影的持续学习方法中存在的"正交性困境"，在多个基准和主干模型上取得最优平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于正交投影的持续学习方法（如O-LoRA）通过严格的参数隔离来缓解灾难性遗忘，但这种刚性约束抑制了语义相关任务间共享表征的迁移与积累，形成"正交性困境"：任务相似度越高，被浪费的可复用知识越多。

Method: CoDe-LoRA采用双分支架构：（1）整合分支Consolidation Branch基于LoRA的轻量化模块，通过自适应空空间投影和动态缩放因子累积共享可迁移表征；（2）解耦分支Decoupling Branch为每个任务维护独立的LoRA专家池，通过原型相似度进行语义路由，使用LDA分类器进行任务分配，无需任务标识。整合分支采用动态缩放以稳定参数范数，理论证明其与预训练模型的距离有界。推理时采用基于置信度的回退策略以平衡稳定性与可塑性。

Result: 在四个主干模型和三个持续学习基准上，CoDe-LoRA均达到最优平均准确率，在T5模型上在标准持续学习基准达到80.4%，在多任务基准达到79.1%，显著优于O-LoRA、N-LoRA、CLoRA等基线。在长序列任务中优势更明显。无需历史数据回放，存储参数与O-LoRA相当，但具有更优的前向迁移能力。在多模态持续学习和路由可靠性方面仍有局限。

Conclusion: CoDe-LoRA通过将可迁移表征整合与任务特定适应解耦，有效解决了持续学习中的正交性困境，在多个基准上实现了最优性能，并在多种模型上验证了泛化能力。理论分析表明整合分支的参数范数有界，确保长期稳定性。

Abstract: Continual learning (CL) is essential for Large Language Models (LLMs) to sequentially adapt to evolving tasks. To mitigate catastrophic forgetting, recent advances implement low-rank adaptation with orthogonal projections (e.g., O-LoRA) to isolate task parameters. However, we reveal that such strict geometric constraints trigger an "Orthogonality Dilemma": rigid parameter isolation impedes the transfer and accumulation of shared representations across semantically related tasks. In this work, we propose a new replay-free method, called Consolidation and Decoupling LoRA (CoDe-LoRA), for CL of LLMs. CoDe-LoRA disentangles the learning process into Consolidating Universal Knowledge and Decoupling Task-Specific Knowledge. To achieve this, CoDe-LoRA leverages an adaptive null space projection mechanism and semantic routing to balance knowledge accumulation with task-specific adaptation. Experimental results across four backbones and three CL benchmarks show that CoDe-LoRA achieves the best average accuracy. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [209] [The Standardization Trap: Certifying Joint Label Processing in Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08314)
*Duong Nguyen,Nicolas Chesneau,Milan Bhan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了表格基础模型（TFM）中上下文标签处理的"标准化陷阱"，并提出了两个数学证书（certificate）来区分固定权重预测、逐标签非线性变换和联合处理（joint processing）。在五个公开 TFM 上均检测到联合标签处理行为，并发现这种交互主要由训练产生，且大部分通过注意力分数传递。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的上下文学习（in-context learning）解释（如线性回归和核平滑）通常假设特征决定每个上下文标签的权重，标签仅提供被组合的值（固定权重假设）。但这一假设是否适用于预训练的表格基础模型（TFM）尚不清楚。直接使用导数进行检验会遭遇"标准化陷阱"：公共 TFM 包在模型看到标签前会对其进行标准化，但普通导数也反映标准化标签集之外的行为，使得即使模型在每个有效预测上与固定权重映射一致，也会显得非线性。因此需要专门的方法来检验 TFM 中标签的实际使用方式。

Method: 1. 提出两个数学证书：A_T（排除固定权重预测，通过移除各向同性部分实现扩展不变性）和 X_sep（同时排除固定权重和逐标签非线性变换，通过正交投影到逐标签空间 S 的余空间实现）。2. 在标准化流形 M 上利用切向投影 P_T 消除标准化标签集外的伪影。3. 通过阻止导数通过注意力分数的路径来定位交互的来源。4. 在五个公开 TFM（TabICL-v2、TabPFN-v3、TabPFN-v2.6、TabFM 1.0、TabDPT v1.2）上进行实验，使用精确 Hessian 计算和探针估计。5. 比较训练模型与 12 个随机初始化副本以确定交互是否来自训练。

Result: 所有五个 TFM 中 A_T 和 X_sep 均非零，表明标签被联合处理而非以固定权重或逐标签方式处理。具体而言：A_T 平均占比 98.5%，X_sep 平均占比 63%（范围 23%-92%）。随机初始化副本的 X_sep 至多为 3.4%，而训练模型至少为 29.5%，表明联合处理随训练出现。阻止导数通过注意力分数后，X_sep 平均下降 85%，A_T 平均下降 81%，说明大部分交互通过注意力分数传递。固定权重替代品在任务保留标签分布下达到中位 R² = 0.72，表明固定权重仍是有用的近似。

Conclusion: 本研究得出结论：所有评估的 TFM 均存在联合标签处理行为，排除了简单的固定权重解释。这些发现促使人们需要新的 TFM 解释框架来考虑上下文标签如何改变各个样本的影响权重。注意力分数是交互的主要载体，但训练后的受控实验表明，不依赖标签的注意力分数也能实现有效的标签处理。未来的研究应区分任务推断、局部重加权和标签依赖表示这三种产生标签交互的计算方式。

Abstract: Linear regression and kernel smoothing offer tractable explanations of in-context learning: in both, the features determine the weight assigned to each context label. However, whether this fixed-weight account describes pretrained tabular foundation models (TFMs) remains unclear. Testing this account using derivatives runs into a standardization trap: public TFM packages standardize the labels before the model sees them, yet ordinary derivatives also reflect behavior outside the set of standardized labels, making a model appear nonlinear even when every prediction it makes agrees with a fixed-weight map. We propose two certificates that depend only on predictions at standardized labels and can reject two distinct explanations: fixed-weight prediction and sums of independent nonlinear label transformations. Across the five public TFMs that we evaluate, our certificates show that changing one context label alters how other labels influence the prediction, a behavior we call joint processing. We further find that joint processing emerges with training and that attention scores carry most of the measured interaction. Together, these findings motivate TFM explanations that account for how context labels change the influence of individual examples.

</details>


### [210] [SCOPE: Certified Theorem Proving with a Language Model as the Policy Planner](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08319)
*Hanchao Zhou,Jialei Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SCOPE提出了一种神经符号架构，将语言模型限制为策略规划者，由符号引擎执行数值计算、由模板编译器渲染证明文本。在218题深度链测试集上，135M参数的SmolLM2达到87.6%的认证通过率，远超7B的DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL（8.3%）和V2-7B（0%），且资源消耗低一到两个数量级。核心发现：长证明直接生成的通过率受p^k幂律约束；决策时刻的状态信息可见性（而非损失加权）是决定最终步骤正确性的关键变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接生成完整形式证明在多步数值推导问题上存在结构性瓶颈：证明有效性是所有内容整数的布尔合取，单元素准确率p与通过率呈p^k的幂律关系。token级准确率（如0.9637）与认证通过率（如0/217真）严重背离，说明现有评估指标无法反映真实能力。该文假设通过分工（模型规划、符号引擎计算、编译器渲染）可以打破这一瓶颈。

Method: 系统由四个组件构成：(1) 算子词汇表（后扩展至220个），每个算子有可执行语义和模板渲染规则；(2) C++/CUDA符号执行引擎，对每个算子执行精确整数/有理运算并返回执行证书；(3) 基于SmolLM2-135M的链规划模型，配备算子选择头和参数预测头（352维离散值空间），在决策帧F_t=(s, h_{1:t-1}, R_out^{(t-1)})上自回归决策；(4) 证明编译器，从算子链和引擎计算结果确定性渲染Lean策略文本。训练目标为算子选择与参数预测的交叉熵之和（式10）。决策序列平均长度6.12步，无自然语言思考文本输出。

Result: 主测试集（218题）：直接生成0/218；结构化槽位输出1/218；编译器渲染117/218（53.7%）；状态时序修正后191/218（87.6%）。2×2析因实验显示状态时序单独带来+74题的简单效应（从117升至191），而链端损失加权（λ=5）反而降低通过率（-7题，与状态时序组合时-19题）。资源对比：135M配置0.53秒/题、833 MiB峰值；V1.5-RL 19.88秒/题、8567 MiB（27.5× token, 37.5× 时间）；V2-7B 0/218（主套件）和0/500（Lean-Workbook分层套件）。Lean-Workbook公共库验证：可评分可接受问题中2132/3536=60.29%认证，主套件零回归。控制腐败实验（2617条参考证明）验证p^k界：测量通过率0.558 vs理论0.530（偏差来自非承重位置）。所有错误（基线101题/最终配置27题）均定位于链的最后一步。

Conclusion: 对于多步数值推导任务，限制模型自由生成范围并确保决策时刻的工具状态可见，是比扩大模型规模更直接的改进路径。幂律结构（Law 1）和状态信息可见性优先于损失分配（Law 2）共同支持"策略-计算-渲染"分工架构。SCOPE的可审计性源自组件责任的天然分离：模型输出限制为符号决策，计算由确定性引擎完成，渲染由编译完成，每层可独立验证。该架构在135M规模上达到87.6%认证通过率，资源消耗较7B证明专用模型低一到两个数量级，证明了输出通道结构和决策信息可见性是独立于模型规模的关键设计变量。

Abstract: In proof assistants such as Lean, a generated proof must pass machine compilation checks, so evaluation needs no human scoring. Direct generation fails on multi-step numeric propositions: a proof is valid only if every content integer is correct, so the pass rate is bounded by the k-th power of the per-integer accuracy. Controlled corruption across 2,617 reference proofs confirms this power law. SCOPE (State-Conditioned Operator Planning and Execution) enforces the natural division of labor: the model plans over an operator vocabulary, a symbolic engine executes the numerics, and a compiler renders the proof. On a 218-problem suite it certifies 191/218 (87.6%) with a 135M backbone; the 7B DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL certifies 18/218 at 27.5 times the tokens and 37.5 times the wall-clock, and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B certifies zero on a bidirectional dual suite. Multi-step thinking costs 6.12 discrete decision actions per problem and produces no natural-language thinking text. Replacing the lagged engine state in the decision frame with the current one lifts the pass rate from 117/218 to 191/218, while up-weighting the chain-end loss hurts. On the public Lean-Workbook library, 2,132 of 3,536 gradeable admissible problems certify (60.29%) with zero regression on the main suite. All readings come from a version-frozen review with independent rechecks and reverse verification. Restricting free generation and keeping decision-time information visible is a more direct route than enlarging the model.

</details>


### [211] [MedZERO: Self-Evolving Agents for Open-Ended Medical Reasoning Through Controlled Knowledge Accumulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08327)
*Xilin Dang,Weilin Ruan,Xue Yang,Jinghao Wang,Xiaowei Hu,Jinpeng Li,Pheng-Ann Heng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MedZERO框架，通过Examiner-Reasoner双智能体协同进化与受控知识积累机制，将自进化方法从可验证领域（如数学、编程）扩展到开放式的医学推理任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自进化方法在易于判定的任务（如数学、编程）上效果显著，但医学推理具有开放式、知识密集且仅部分可验证的特性，难以直接迁移。此外，医学领域面临静态参数化知识限制与昂贵专家监督两大瓶颈。

Method: MedZERO采用双智能体协同进化机制：(1) Examiner生成处于Reasoner能力前沿的医学问题-选项对，并附带候选知识三元组；(2) Reasoner通过多轮证据推理、结构化知识图谱检索与可选网络搜索解决问题。核心创新是"短暂到持久知识积累"机制：训练时生成的探索性三元组仅作为临时记忆，优化后再经评分过滤去重后加入持久知识图谱，避免未经验证的自生成伪迹污染未来训练。Examiner奖励由前沿难度、多样性、证据支持三项加权组合，使用GRPO优化。Reasoner结合选项级多数一致性与证据支持奖励训练。

Result: 在5个公开医学推理基准（PubMedQA、MMLU-Pro-health、MedBullets、MedBrowseComp、MedXpertQA）上，以Qwen3-4B-Base和8B-Base为基座进行开放式评估。4B规模上MedZERO平均34.9%，较最优自进化基线提升13.7个百分点；8B规模平均53.5%，较基座模型提升22.0个百分点。组件分析表明前沿课程构建、受控知识积累、Reasoner优化的协同配合缺一不可；多轮迭代持续提升性能；KG检索与网络搜索结合优于单独网络搜索。

Conclusion: MedZERO证明了通过显式设计课程构建、监督信号与知识重用机制以适应部分可验证性，自进化方法可以从可验证领域成功扩展到更现实的医学推理场景，在多个基准和模型规模上均优于基座模型与现有自进化基线。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in medical question answering and clinical reasoning, yet their improvement remains constrained by static parametric knowledge and costly expert supervision. Self-evolving agents offer a promising alternative by enabling models to improve through iterative task generation and problem-solving. However, most existing self-evolving methods are designed for easily verifiable domains such as mathematics and coding, where solutions can be checked by exact answers or executable programs. Medical reasoning is fundamentally different: it is open-ended, knowledge-intensive, and often only partially verifiable. We present MedZERO, a self-evolving framework for open-ended medical reasoning. MedZERO couples an Examiner that generates frontier medical question-option pairs with a Reasoner that solves them through evidence-grounded multi-turn reasoning with external knowledge tools. To support reliable, continual improvement, MedZERO adopts controlled knowledge accumulation, which maintains temporary exploratory knowledge and curated persistent knowledge in reasoning. We evaluate MedZERO on five public medical reasoning benchmarks using 4B- and 8B-scale base models under open-ended evaluation. Across all settings, MedZERO consistently outperforms the underlying base models and prior self-evolving baselines, achieving up to 13.7 average accuracy-point gains over the next-best self-evolving baseline.

</details>


### [212] [An AI-Assisted Formalization of the Poincaré Conjecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08329)
*Zhiyuan Zhang,Axel Delaval,Leheng Chen,Jinxuan Chen,Jie Xu,Yuxuan Liao,Jiedong Jiang,Chunlei Liu,Bin Dong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文报告了在 Lean 4 中借助大语言模型完成庞加莱猜想（Poincaré Conjecture）完整形式化验证的工作，核心贡献不在于数学新结果，而在于建立了一套"以数学家评审的里程碑语句为锚点、AI 智能体并行执行、人机协同诊断瓶颈"的大型形式化工作流，并据此在两周多时间内产出约 320 万行 Lean 代码（约 280 万行为庞加莱结论的依赖锥），最终通过了独立 Comparator 验证与 Nanoda 内核检查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 庞加莱猜想（Perelman 证明，Morgan–Tian 详细阐述）的形式化高度依赖几何分析（Ricci 流、奇点分析、外科、3-流形拓扑），而现有 Mathlib 等可复用基础设施严重不足。同时，AI 自动形式化能力已具备规模化条件（如 Fermat 大定理的 Prove2Me 形式化），但如何组织大规模人机协作、如何划分人类与 AI 角色尚未被广泛理解。本文以庞加莱猜想为压力测试场，探究"如何将 AI 辅助形式化扩展到需要大量自建基础库的几何分析领域"。

Method: 工作流核心是"里程碑（milestone）+ 依赖图"：1）数学家先按 Morgan–Tian 路线拟定自然语言证明蓝图；2）将证明拆解为 90 个里程碑，每个里程碑明确 Lean 定义、假设、结论、依赖与完成条件，构成有向无环图；3）数学家在形式化之前或并行进行里程碑语句审查（两轮：源对照 + Lean 声明器检查），冻结后作为稳定接口；4）三种 AI 模型协同（GPT-6-Astra 承担长上下文语句形式化与证明构造，Fable-5.1 用于独立对齐审查与诊断，Codex/Claude Code 用于交互式干预）；5）三种执行模式并行：交互式 agent 会话、Archon Horizon 分布式任务调度、共享 GitHub 仓库 + 集成 bot 编译合并；6）人类角色聚焦于数学范围、语句审查、任务优先级与瓶颈诊断，瓶颈分为数学缺口、Lean 实现问题、协调问题三类。准备阶段自 2026 年 5 月开始，主形式化阶段 9 月重启，约两周多完成。

Result: 1）主形式化阶段在两周多内完成，AI 订阅与服务器租赁成本约 2.5 万美元（其中约 2 万美元为 GPT Pro 订阅，约 5 千美元为 Linux 服务器租金）；2）初始开发约 320 万行 Lean 代码（去除注释后），依赖锥抽取后庞加莱结论仍依赖约 280 万行；3）同时证明了光滑庞加莱定理与拓扑庞加莱定理；4）通过独立 Comparator 验证与 Nanoda 内核对最终定理进行了二次核验；5）约 48% 的 Lean 源码用于背景理论与共享数学基础设施，其中光滑 3-流形结构相关开发约占 65 万行；6）展示了三个典型瓶颈案例：M22（非坍缩估计中维度选择）、M28（曲率估计中缺失的局部紧致论证）、M64–M65（环域比较中缺失的初值环域与加强结论），均由数学审查后被解决；7）公开仓库与构建说明已发布。

Conclusion: 大型自动形式化项目的成功不仅依赖更强的模型或更大的并行度，更依赖工作流的结构化设计：里程碑式分解、稳定语句接口、并行前移的人工审查、共享依赖图与协调机制。本文经验表明，由具备数学训练的 AI 工程师、数学家与 Lean 专家组成的小型研究团队即可借助商业模型完成几何分析级别的大规模形式化验证。当前开发并非终点，团队计划重构为可复用的几何分析库（含删除重复、泛化定义、改进文档），未来可能贡献至 TauCeti 等维护中的库；并希望最终让独立数学家也能负担得起地使用形式化工具验证自身研究。

Abstract: We present an AI-assisted Lean 4 formalization of the Poincaré conjecture. The project began with limited reusable formal infrastructure for the geometric analysis behind the proof. To organize this work, we combined a proof blueprint prepared by mathematicians with explicit milestone statements. These milestones enabled parallel agent work and gave mathematicians clear points to locate blockers and provide effective mathematical guidance. Our analysis identifies the human interventions and organizational choices behind this workflow. The project provides a starting point toward reusable infrastructure for future formalization projects; such infrastructure, once developed, could eventually reduce the cost of verifying mathematical results in geometric analysis.

</details>


### [213] [MoF: Preference-Aware Mixture Modeling for Black-Box LLM Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08330)
*Hun Park*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Mixture-of-Facets (MoF)框架，针对黑盒大语言模型个性化任务，将用户偏好建模为共享潜在偏好面的组合，通过历史条件路由替代用户特定的评分头，实现参数高效且可扩展的个性化，并支持对训练中未见过的用户进行零适配泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有黑盒LLM个性化方法（如HYDRA）依赖用户特定的评分头，导致个性化参数随用户数量线性增长，且对未见用户需要额外的适配阶段，难以应用于大规模用户场景。

Method: MoF包含三个核心组件：Facet Heads（多个共享的两层MLP评分头，用于捕获不同的潜在偏好模式）、Preference-Aware Router（基于稀疏自编码器SAE处理的用户历史表示，通过top-k路由选择相关facet heads）以及Cluster-Based Sampling (CBS)策略（通过k-means聚类对用户历史进行分簇采样，暴露更多样化的偏好信号）。整体训练目标联合优化二元分类损失和SAE重建损失。

Result: 在LaMP基准（LaMP-2/3/4/5）上的实验表明，MoF平均排名1.4，优于HYDRA（3.5）及其他提示基方法；MoF参数存储复杂度为O(1)，而HYDRA为O(N)；在1000名未见用户的大规模评估中，MoF无需额外适配即可超越零样本和RAG基线；消融实验验证了SAE、Router、多Facet和CBS各组件的贡献；定性分析显示路由权重能够捕获有意义的偏好结构。

Conclusion: MoF通过共享facet头和偏好感知路由，实现了黑盒LLM的可扩展个性化，并在未见用户上表现出强泛化能力，为大规模部署场景提供了参数高效的解决方案，但未来仍需探索自适应facet分配机制以应对偏好多样性的增长。

Abstract: Proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a wide range of tasks, yet aligning their outputs with diverse user preferences remains challenging. Existing personalization approaches for black-box LLMs often rely on user-specific scoring heads, causing the number of personalized parameters to grow linearly with the number of users and requiring additional adaptation for unseen users. To address these limitations, we propose Mixture-of-Facets (MoF), a scalable personalization framework for black-box LLMs that models user preferences as compositions of shared latent preference facets rather than dedicated user-specific parameters. MoF performs personalization through history-conditioned routing over shared facet heads, enabling personalization for users unseen during training without additional parameter updates. Across diverse personalization tasks, MoF delivers stronger personalization performance while maintaining a more scalable and parameter-efficient design than prior approaches. Additional analysis indicates strong generalization to unseen users.

</details>


### [214] [Explainable Failure Prediction and Prevention in Maritime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08363)
*Dionisis Kalogeropoulos,Georgia Sovatzidi,Panagiotis G. Kalozoumis,Dimitris K. Iakovidis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文综述了可解释人工智能（XAI）技术在海事系统故障预测与预防中的应用，提出了一种集成的概念性闭环架构，并探讨了当前挑战与未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海事系统面临高度动态的运行环境，设备突发故障会严重威胁安全、可靠性与运营效率。尽管AI、机器学习、数字孪生和预测性维护技术已取得进展，但在安全关键型海事应用中实现可信赖且可解释的决策仍是重大挑战，因此亟需系统性综述相关技术并构建支持自主或人机协同的架构。

Method: 本文采用综述（review）方法，提出了一种概念性架构，将数据采集、时间序列预测、异常检测、风险评估、决策制定与可解释AI集成于闭环框架中；围绕各架构组件，对相关海事研究进行梳理与讨论，分析其方法、优势与局限性，并归纳当前挑战（不确定性、鲁棒性、模型泛化、可解释性、海事数据集稀缺、实际部署）与未来研究方向。

Result: 论文提出了一个面向海事系统可解释故障预测与预防的闭环概念架构，并系统梳理了各组件对应的海事研究进展；总结出不确定性、模型泛化、可解释性、数据稀缺及实际部署等关键挑战，指明了实现可信赖AI辅助海事决策的未来研究方向。

Conclusion: 实现可信赖、可解释的AI辅助海事故障预测与预防，需要在数据、模型与决策层面协同推进：通过集成数据采集、时间序列预测、异常检测、风险评估与XAI的闭环架构，并结合人机协同机制，可在提升安全与可靠性的同时为操作人员提供透明的决策依据；未来的研究应聚焦不确定性量化、模型鲁棒性与泛化能力、可解释性增强、海事数据集建设以及实际运营部署，以推动AI在安全关键型海事领域的可信应用。

Abstract: Maritime systems operate in highly dynamic environments where unexpected equipment failures can compromise safety, reliability, and operational efficiency. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, digital twins, and predictive maintenance enable proactive failure prediction and prevention. However, ensuring trustworthy and explainable decision-making remains a major challenge in safety-critical maritime applications. This chapter reviews key AI technologies required for explainable failure prediction and prevention in maritime systems and presents a conceptual architecture capable of supporting autonomous or human-in-the-loop corrective actions. This architecture integrates data acquisition, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, risk assessment, decision-making, and explainable AI into a closed-loop framework. With reference to the architectural components, a review and discussion of relevant maritime studies is performed, outlining their methods, advantages, and limitations. Furthermore, it highlights current challenges, including uncertainty and robustness, model generalization, explainability, limited availability of maritime datasets, and operational deployment, and identifies future research directions toward trustworthy AI-assisted maritime decision-making.

</details>


### [215] [Transect: Retaining Observability for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Evaluations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08364)
*Toby D. Pilditch,Konstantinos Voudouris,Alexandra Abbas,Cozmin Ududec*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Transect是一个开源的转录分析工具包，旨在帮助评估者在长时域、多智能体的大语言模型评估中保持可观察性（observability），通过将行为标签、事件、token使用和子智能体活动对齐到统一的轮次时间轴上，便于审查者追溯源数据并支持可复现性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿AI评估越来越多采用开放式、代理化、长时域任务，转录可能长达数百页且涉及复杂多代理网络，导致"可观察性包络"（observability envelope）收窄。语言模型辅助分类虽能帮助分析，但也带来大量研究者自由度，威胁基于语言模型的转录分析的可复现性和可审计性。

Method: Transect构建于Inspect Scout之上，采用五阶段管线：摄入（ingest）→选择（select）→扫描（scan）→存储（store）→渲染（render）。用户通过Spec提供任务上下文和行为词汇（评估族配置），与判断模型和分析设置分开。系统沿共享的轮次轴对齐记录事件、令牌使用、子代理活动和行为标签；判断扫描器支持solo、k-roll和cohort三种模式，结构化扫描器不调用语言模型即可提取记录信息。提供自定义扫描器和报告层的扩展点，以及用于编码助手的技能包以辅助Spec编写和敏感性诊断。

Result: 在AI R&D案例研究中（一次生成约1300万令牌的TabPFN任务，Claude-Opus-4.7代理执行554次orchestrator工具调用、79次子代理部署、经历8次上下文压缩），Transect成功将智能体工作划分为行为阶段。结果显示智能体聚焦于运营工作和稿件撰写阶段（自我审阅和稿件撰写消耗约1070万令牌中的75%以上），而几乎未见持续的假设生成阶段（仅580个orchestrator输出中2个被标记为"Hypothesising"）。该综合视图将原本模糊的印象转化为可复现的、与具体轮次和明确评分标准关联的观察。引用验证显示代理人工参与草稿中18/46篇参考文献无法在公开注册库中验证，而人类论文仅4/69篇未验证。

Conclusion: Transect通过在共享时间轴上整合结构化信号与判断信号，使运行内行为可审查的同时支持可靠性验证和可复现分析，有助于在评估转录越来越长、越来越复杂时维持有效的监督覆盖。然而基于语言模型的扫描器本质上仍是可错的模型判断，一致性不能等同于有效性，需要独立的专家标注证据进行外部评估才能验证分类的准确性。

Abstract: Frontier AI evaluations increasingly use open-ended, agentic, long-horizon tasks whose transcripts can span hundreds of pages of outputs and actions from complex multi-agent networks. The observability envelop-the range of what evaluators can reliably infer about an agent's behaviours-is therefore narrowing. Language model assistants can help classify and interpret agent behaviour but also afford human evaluators significant analytical degrees of freedom, threatening the reproducibility and auditability of language-model-based transcript analysis. Transect is an open source package built on Inspect Scout to help evaluators understand how a long agent run unfolded, identify behaviour worth investigating, and check interpretations against the transcript. Users specify task context and behavioural vocabulary in a reusable evaluation-family configuration, with judge models and analysis settings supplied separately. Transect's navigable reports align recorded events, token use, sub-agent activity, and model-generated behavioural labels on a common turn-based timeline. Reviewers can quickly grasp a run's narrative, trace any label or event to its source turns, and export the underlying data tables for cross-run analysis. We demonstrate the workflow on an AI R&D evaluation that generated almost 13 million tokens, dividing the agents' work into behavioural phases aligned with research-skill classifications, sub-agent delegations and interactions, and token use. The combined view shows a focus on operational work and manuscript production, with little evidence of a sustained hypothesis generation stage-arguably a necessary component for high-quality scientific outputs. Transect's flexible, customisable transcript-analysis pipeline will enable evaluators to keep pace with longer, more complex, more frequent AI evaluations while supporting scientific rigour, transparency, and reproducibility.

</details>


### [216] [EMHO: EMbodied Agent Harness Optimization via Experience Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08432)
*Hyun Jung Lee,Jungtaek Kim,Jongwon Jeong,Tae-Eui Kam,Donghyun Kim,Yong Jae Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EMHO提出了一种自我进化的框架，通过经验轨迹迭代优化冻结视觉语言模型周围的智能体"harness"（规划、上下文、工具使用、失败恢复等），在EmbodiedBench的导航和操作任务上取得显著性能提升；其扩展EMHO-Merge通过对比episode级的增益与损失来优化跨子任务的共享harness。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的具身智能体改进主要关注底层模型的训练，而控制规划、上下文、工具使用等的"harness"通常依赖手工设计。代码/命令行环境中的harness优化已有研究，但具身环境中反馈稀疏且诊断性弱（只有动作级合法性与延迟的episode级成败信号），使得定位失败原因与修订harness更具挑战。现有自改进方法主要优化技能或恢复提示，未覆盖更广泛的harness机制。

Method: EMHO采用内外双循环：内循环用当前harness执行任务并收集执行轨迹；外循环由harness优化器结合所有历史轨迹与历史harness修订，分析反复出现的弱点，提出针对性修订；仅当候选harness在搜索集上的成功率高于父节点时才接受。EMHO-Merge在多子任务联合优化时，比较候选与父harness之间"失败→成功"的gain与"成功→失败"的loss，通过配对的gain/loss轨迹找到行为何时有益、何时有害的可见条件，对原修订进行evidence-supported的repair（每次修订最多一次），从而在保留增益的同时减少损失。优化目标为H*=argmax E[y_e(M,H)]。

Result: 在EmbodiedBench的导航与操作任务上，使用Qwen3.5-9B与Qwen3.8-27B两个冻结模型：
1. 搜索集：导航最高+23.3%、操作最高+33.3%的成功率绝对提升；held-out集也持续优于初始harness。
2. EMHO显著优于GPT-5/Claude Opus的一次性harness修订，因其能将反复出现的失败模式转化为具体执行规则而非泛化建议。
3. 全harness优化显著优于仅skill优化（如操作+33.3% vs +16.7%，部分子任务），证明优化交互机制本身的额外价值。
4. EMHO-Merge在跨子任务共享harness场景中，平均搜索成功率高于EMHO (Combined)，在导航和操作上均能更好地管理跨子任务的权衡。
5. 消融：去掉经验轨迹或修订历史都会降低搜索集表现（76.7→70.0/66.7），仅score反馈则只有63.3，说明两种历史信息互补。
6. 质性分析发现两类编辑：(a) 恢复类（无效动作避让、valid-but-ineffective检测）；(b) 非恢复类（进度监测、工具调度、视觉grounding）。早期以恢复编辑为主，后期非恢复编辑增多；规则逐步细化（如避障从"不重复受阻方向"发展到结合受阻方向、目标朝向与清障距离的条件策略）。
7. 局限性：后期迭代中搜索集最佳与held-out最佳可能不一致，存在过拟合倾向。

Conclusion: EMHO证明在稀疏、弱诊断的具身环境反馈下，可以通过经验轨迹与修订历史迭代优化冻结模型周围的完整harness，而不仅限于技能或恢复提示。进化后的harness改变了智能体监测进度、调度视觉工具、将感知证据ground到动作上的方式，能跨子任务泛化（结合EMHO-Merge），为不更新底层模型而提升具身智能体行为提供了有效路径；但需注意搜索/held-out的潜在分歧以避免过拟合。

Abstract: Improving embodied agents often focuses on optimizing the underlying model through training, while the surrounding agent harness that controls planning, context, and tool use is typically engineered. We ask whether this harness can instead improve itself directly from experience traces under sparse environmental feedback. We propose EMbodied Agent Harness Optimization (EMHO), a self-evolving framework that keeps the embodied model frozen and iteratively revises its harness by analyzing execution trajectories and prior harness history. EMHO optimizes beyond skills or recovery prompts, modifying how the agent monitors progress, uses vision tools, grounds observations, and responds to failures. To support multiple subtasks with a single harness, we introduce EMHO-Merge, which addresses trade-offs in jointly optimizing a single shared harness across subtasks by using episode-level gains and losses to guide evidence-supported refinement of when and how revised behaviors are applied. We evaluate EMHO on EmbodiedBench across navigation and manipulation tasks, and EMHO consistently improves task success for both Qwen 9B and 27B models. Qualitative analysis shows that EMHO goes beyond recovering from failures and unproductive actions to reshape how the embodied agent interprets and interacts with its environment.

</details>


### [217] [AssemState: Manual and Physical-State-Guided Reasoning for Zero-shot Furniture Assembly](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08446)
*Zhiyuan Qi,Jierui Li,Yifan Shen,Cheng Qian,Jiateng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AssemState提出了一种零样本框架，将家具装配任务解耦为两个子任务：从图解手册恢复装配树和基于当前物理状态的6D姿态推理。前者使用锚点引导的边界装配状态分解手册页面，后者通过迭代的后状态反馈在SE(3)空间进行修正，并通过仿真释放测试验证物理合理性。实验表明装配树恢复显著提升（相对最佳基线），但严格接触准确的6D姿态恢复仍未解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视觉理解上取得进展，但在与物理环境集成的精确3D空间推理方面仍然困难。家具装配既需要从手册恢复层级操作结构，又需要将语义附着关系转化为可与已有组件物理交互的6D姿态更新。现有方法多孤立解决位姿估计、空间推理或动作生成中的一个方面，缺乏对长程、模糊手册引导装配的系统研究。

Method: 框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 锚点引导的手册到结构推理：通过MLLM调用链（部件命名→语义增强→锚点规划→树转换）将手册页面分解为逐步的部件/子装配组织，并恢复层级装配树；锚点推理关注首步和末步边界锚点、子装配追踪以及"孤立子装配"vs"顺序添加"的区分。(2) 渲染后状态姿态细化：在正确当前操作和前置状态下预测候选6D姿态，渲染多视角后状态图像，由诊断器判断接受/拒绝及失败类型（wrong_side/wrong_mirror/floating/collision/not_fully_seated等），下一轮proposer基于诊断结果施加受约束的SE(3)修正，三轮迭代后输出最终姿态。仿真释放测试使用IsaacLab AABB物理引擎验证支撑稳定性。

Result: 装配树恢复：相对Manual2Skill++，F1从38.58%提升至62.80%，Tree EM从28.24%提升至53.92%；移除锚点推理后F1降至56.20%、Tree EM降至45.10%。姿态推理（243个独立操作）：三轮自检将GPT-5的judge接受率从0%提升至5.3%，Claude Haiku 4.5从4.5%提升至11.5%；GPT-5平均Chamfer距离从5.4111降至1.7744；仿真释放稳定性GPT-5从37.0%提升至39.5%，平均漂移从0.2463降至0.1754。但严格指标PA@0.01在所有方法上均为0，RMSE_t和GD无一致改善。失败案例集中在碰撞、悬浮、镜像方向错误、未完全就位、错误接触面五类。

Conclusion: AssemState在装配树恢复和部分局部姿态诊断指标上取得提升，验证了MLLM用于结构化手册推理和迭代局部修正的可行性；但可靠、端到端、接触准确的家具装配仍未解决。评估刻意将两个子任务分离（手册侧使用预计算编号步骤掩码，姿态侧使用正确当前操作条件），以避免上游结构恢复问题污染姿态空间推理测量。MLLM在空间关系推理，特别是接触拓扑、镜像辨别和完全就位判断方面存在本质局限。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding, but precise 3D spatial reasoning integrated with physical environment remains difficult. Furniture assembly requires not only recovering step-level operations from diagrammatic manuals, but also translating semantic attachment relations into 6D pose updates that enable parts to physically interact with the environment and previously assembled components. To study this problem, we propose AssemState, a zero-shot framework for manual and physical-state-guided furniture assembly. It firstly employs anchor-guided boundary assembly states to decompose manual pages into single-part operations and recover an assembly-tree. Then, it uses iterative after-state feedback refinement to guide successive (SE(3)) updates and corrections, and validates their physical plausibility through simulation-based release tests. Experiments show that compared with the strongest prior baseline, AssemState improves F1 from 38.58\% to 62.80\% and Tree Exact Match from 28.24\% to 53.92\% for assembly-tree recovery. On 243 independently evaluated part-level operations, our proposed iterative refinement improves judge-accepted operations from 0 to 5.3\% and reduces mean Chamfer distance from 5.4111 to 1.7744. However, visually plausible candidate poses may still suffer from collision, floating, mirror-orientation errors, incomplete seating, and wrong-side attachment. These results show that AssemState improves operation-structure recovery and selected local pose metrics, while MLLMs remain limited for spatial relationship reasoning.

</details>


### [218] [Cylindrical Geodesic Flow Matching for Quasiperiodic Physiological Signal Transformation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08510)
*Onur Selim Kilic,Afra Nawar,Cem Okan Yaldiz,Michael J. Cho,Ahmet Rasim Emirdagi,Demet Tangolar,Amirali Aghazadeh,Amit J. Shah,Omer T. Inan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"圆柱测地线流匹配"（Cylindrical Geodesic Flow Matching），通过将准周期生理信号嵌入到相幅柱面 $S^1 \times \mathbb{R}_{>0}$ 上，用测地线插值替代仿射插值桥，实现心血管波形（如PPG、SCG）的高精度配对翻译。在零样本PPG和有限支撑SCG任务上，HT距离、L₂和DTW指标均比最强基线降低约15%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴心血管信号（如PPG、SCG）的波形形态高度依赖测量位置。现有方法使用仿射插值桥的流匹配忽略了准周期信号固有的相幅几何结构（相位循环、振幅正定），导致中间状态出现振幅衰减和瞬时频率畸变。需要一种几何感知的桥梁来忠实传输相位-振幅信息。

Method: 1）通过解析信号变换将波形分解为瞬时相位 $\phi$ 和振幅 $a$，嵌入圆柱 $S^1 \times \mathbb{R}_{>0}$；2）用最短弧、常速的测地线路径替代仿射插值作为流匹配桥梁，导出恒定范数的oracle速度场；3）模型内禀参数化——预测角速度 $\omega_\theta$ 和振幅速度 $\dot{a}_\theta$，映射到切向量；4）每步求解器子步后投影回圆柱面，保持轨迹在流形上。理论证明了仿射路径会产生 $O(\Delta\phi^4)$ 振幅失真和 $O(\Delta\phi^6)$ 频率失真，而测地线路径完全保真。

Result: 在零样本PPG翻译（20名受试者）和有限支撑SCG适应（13名受试者、24次会话）任务中，圆柱测地线路径在HT距离、L₂和DTW三个指标上均最优，最多比最强基线降低约15%。Hilbert朴素基线（去掉圆柱几何后在相幅空间训练）性能显著恶化，证明几何结构本身是关键。消融实验显示支撑集仅32-64拍、求解器仅≤16步时优势仍然保持。

Conclusion: 桥接几何是流匹配在准周期信号翻译中的关键归纳偏置。圆柱嵌入、测地线插值和内禀切空间参数化三者结合，将每个配对样本转化为几何一致的密集速度监督，优于仿射流匹配和端点监督。方法可推广至任何"周期流形×正振幅流形"的乘积空间，适用于呼吸信号、步态周期等配对振荡翻译问题。

Abstract: Paired translation between quasiperiodic physiological waveforms (i.e., recovering a target oscillatory signal from the source) is central to the interpretation of cardiovascular signals derived from wearables placed at different body locations. This source-to-target mapping in these problems carries inherent geometric structure: the phase wraps around the cycle and must be treated as a circular variable, the amplitude remains strictly positive, and the beat-to-beat alignment can drift unpredictably across cycles and subjects. While deep neural networks have been used for phase estimation and complex-valued signal modeling, prior work does not explicitly learn phase transport between paired signals. Consequently, neither endpoint-supervised regression nor the standard affine path used in flow matching accounts for this phase--amplitude structure. We introduce \emph{cylindrical geodesic flow matching} for paired cardiovascular waveform translation. We show that the standard affine path used in flow matching distorts intermediate amplitude and instantaneous frequency when interpolating between quasiperiodic signals; replacing it with a closed-form geodesic on the phase--amplitude cylinder eliminates these artifacts and converts each training pair into dense, geometry-consistent velocity supervision. On zero-shot photoplethysmography and limited-support seismocardiography adaptation benchmarks, our method consistently outperforms interpolation baselines and matches or exceeds direct supervised prediction, reducing Hilbert Transform, $L_2$, and Dynamic Time Warping distance by up to ${\sim}15\%$ over the strongest competing baseline. These results suggest that bridge geometry is a critical inductive bias for flow matching on oscillatory signal translation.

</details>


### [219] [How Much Evidence Should a Coding Agent's Self-Correction Carry? Adaptive Dirichlet Evidence for Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08514)
*Yunbo Long,Guangya Hao,Yuhan Liu,Yiting Duan,Longyan Tan,Yunchen Long,Hao Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出有效证据自蒸馏（EESD），通过将相对转换支持与有效伪计数质量分离，使用Dirichlet后验为KL锚定的代码生成智能体自校正学习产生不确定性惩罚权重；在12个模型-领域设置中评估，其中DeepSeek/CodeARC上一轮校正学习使全测试通过率提升5.4个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码生成智能体从执行反馈中学习自我修正时，现有方法缺乏对执行证据"支持方向"与"证据强度"的分离建模，导致过度加权的训练修正可能损害递归自改进的策略。

Method: EESD：将归一化执行相关性分解为相对转换支持r和有效伪计数质量E(p)=(∑pᵢ²)⁻¹；Dirichlet后验计算不确定性惩罚的校正效用w=[ū−λσᵤ]₊；KL锚定的LoRA自蒸馏损失为w·L_CE + β·D_KL，仅LoRA参数更新。

Result: 四个模型-领域历史扫描中，n从1增至8使未来结果NLL降低55.0–59.3%；n=8时有效质量在所有四个对比中NLL均低于固定质量；DeepSeek/RunBugRun匹配研究中3000个样本argmax预测完全一致，NLL增益最大出现在相关性集中时（E(p)∈[1,2)时+0.0159）；DeepSeek/CodeARC一轮校正学习后Pass@1从15.0%提升至20.4%（95%源自助区间[+2.8,+8.0]pp）；12个模型-领域设置中变化范围为[-6.8,+5.4]pp。

Conclusion: 显式建模证据质量（与支持方向分离）可改善概率估计和校正学习；在对称先验下有效质量保持类别排序不变且监督系数受固定质量对应物约束；下游结果具有模型-领域依赖性，凸显了自适应证据建模在代码智能体自校正中的潜力与适用范围。

Abstract: Execution feedback lets coding agents revise programs and learn from their own corrections. A correction's learning weight should reflect both the transitions supported by its executions and the amount of evidence behind that support. We introduce Effective-Evidence Self-Distillation (EESD), which represents these quantities separately. Normalized execution relevance determines relative transition support and an effective pseudo-count mass; a Dirichlet posterior then produces an uncertainty-penalized weight for KL-anchored correction learning. Under a symmetric prior, changing mass preserves category ordering, and effective mass yields a supervised coefficient bounded by its matched fixed-mass counterpart. Across four model-domain history sweeps, increasing visible observations from one to eight reduces future-outcome NLL by 55.0-59.3%. At eight observations, effective mass achieves lower NLL than fixed mass in all four comparisons. In the primary matched DeepSeek/RunBugRun study, argmax predictions agree on all 3,000 examples, with the largest NLL gain under concentrated relevance. After one correction-learning round, DeepSeek/CodeARC all-tests Pass@1 increases from 15.0% to 20.4%, with a paired 95% source-bootstrap interval of [+2.8, +8.0] percentage points. The twelve-setting downstream evaluation establishes the model-domain scope of this update. These results show how separating evidence support from evidence mass changes probability estimation and correction learning in coding agents.

</details>


### [220] [Toward Alignment Scaling Laws: A Framework and First Preregistered Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08540)
*Jeremy Canale*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"对齐缩放定律"框架，将"对齐随模型规模变难还是变易"分解为每个风险类别可测量的幂律关系 B_r(N)=a_r N^α_r；通过玩具模型证明最快被修正的风险决定长期格局，并进行了两项预注册实证研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献中关于对齐与模型规模关系的结论往往相互矛盾（部分风险随规模恶化，部分改善，部分平稳），研究者常将这些发现当作"对齐"这一单一属性的证据。文章认为应将"对齐"视为一族可测量的标度关系，每个风险类别、每种对齐方法对应一个标度指数 α_r，据此判断不同风险在规模化进程中的走向。

Method: （1）形式化定义：对齐负担 B_r(N)=a_r N^α_r，三种负担度量（O1发现失败数、O2达成目标所需努力、O3能力代价），并区分观测对齐、审计对齐和真实对齐；（2）玩具模型：四种风险类别（越狱/谄媚/奖励黑客/欺骗），其中欺骗属于不可检测类别，模拟"扩展—失败—修正—负担积累"反馈环路；（3）四个命题（含证明）：最快被修正的风险决定头部空间是否被耗尽（Corollary 1）；α>1 时保持头部空间下限需超指数增长（Proposition 2）；正幂律混合下小模型拟合低估大尺度指数（Proposition 3）；无假阳性审计从不低估真实对齐（Proposition 4）；（4）预注册测量协议：模型族选择、能力轴、负担估计、精度分析、混淆因素、判定准则；（5）两项预注册实证：①Pythia 分类器对抗训练公开数据再分析；②Qwen2.5 0.5B–72B 四风险试点（谄媚/真实性/倾向性/植入后门），并在 Qwen3 0.6B–14B 复现。

Result: 案例研究（Pythia）：在垃圾邮件分类任务上，将攻击成功率压至 10% 以下所需防御计算量增长为 N^0.60（95% 区间 0.42–0.78），属"scaling helps"。试点研究（Qwen2.5）：真实性指数 −0.05、倾向性指数 0.48，均属"scaling helps"（但局部斜率在较大尺寸处趋近 1）；谄媚指数 0.89（或在 72B 处加两粒种子为 0.83）判定为"undetermined"；植入后门在已知触发器时 128–256 例即被清除，但盲式安全微调下五个尺寸中四个未能清除。Qwen3 复现中真实性 −0.53、倾向性 0.30，同样属"scaling helps"。作者明确未对当前前沿模型所属体制作出断言。

Conclusion: 将"对齐是否随规模化变难"重新表述为每个风险类别对应一个可测量的幂律指数 α_r；当负担为不同指数幂律的混合时，小模型拟合倾向于低估大尺度指数；隐藏（未被评估覆盖）的风险可能增长更快且不被察觉，因此观察到的对齐可能持续显示 100% 而真实对齐下降；α_r 显著大于 1 时，维持能力头部空间要求超指数增长。所测风险中无一项被归为"对齐债务"，但后门案例提示测量难度最大的位置恰是玩具模型所警告之处。前沿助手究竟处于哪种体制，仍有待以本文协议在更大规模上展开测量。

Abstract: Whether alignment gets easier or harder as models grow is often argued from isolated findings, as if alignment were one property. We treat it as a family of measurable scaling relations: for each risk category r, the alignment burden needed to hold a fixed safety target is modeled as B_r(N)=a_rN^alpha_r, with N a capability proxy; against a budget proportional to N, scaling helps if alpha_r<1, keeps pace if alpha_r~1, and accumulates alignment debt if alpha_r>1. We give three operationalizations of burden and distinguish observed, audited and true alignment. A toy model, in which corrections consume capability headroom, makes the consequences explicit. We prove that the largest exponent among corrected risks, not an average, sets the long-run regime; that above 1 any policy holding headroom above a floor must grow super-exponentially; that, for burdens that are positive mixtures of power laws, fits on small models underestimate large-scale exponents; and that an audit that uncovers hidden failures without false positives never underestimates true alignment. We propose a pre-registrable protocol and apply reduced versions of it twice. A preregistered reanalysis of public adversarial-training data for Pythia classifiers finds that the compute needed to bring attack success under 10% grows as N^0.60. A preregistered pilot on Qwen2.5 0.5B-72B finds exponents of -0.05 for truthfulness and 0.48 for stated dispositions (both scaling helps under its reduced rule, though local slopes approach 1 at the top; replicated on Qwen3 0.6B-14B), while sycophancy (0.89, or 0.83 with two seeds added at 72B) and a planted backdoor are undetermined: the backdoor is removed quickly when its trigger is known but survives blind safety training at four of five sizes. We release four browser games that play these laws ( this http URL ). We make no claim about which regime holds for current frontier models.

</details>


### [221] [AnyBottle: A Recipe to Only Keep the Concepts You Really Need](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08552)
*Wolfgang Stammer,Sukrut Rao,Hevra Petekkaya,David Steinmann,Bernt Schiele*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AnyBottle提出了一种无需人工概念标注的紧凑型任务特定概念瓶颈模型(CBM)构建方法。它从稀疏自编码器(SAE)的大型无监督概念池中,通过黑盒教师指导的残差驱动选择机制,迭代挑选出任务相关的少量概念,再结合嵌套Dropout实现样本自适应的推理预算。该方法在视觉和文本八个数据集上以少一个数量级的概念数量达到或超过教师模型的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无标注概念瓶颈模型依赖巨大且静态的概念词汇表,远超过任何任务或预测所需,既不利于可解释性也难以检视。作者希望证明"无标注化"不必等同于"庞大化",通过发现小型、紧凑且任务相关的概念词汇,实现与教师模型相当甚至更优的表达力,同时保留可解释性。

Method: AnyBottle由四个阶段组成——概念池构建(冻结backbone上的SAE,可任务微调)、教师引导的自适应概念选择(基于正交匹配追踪式残差拟合,以教师与学生间的归因不一致区域为候选,按最小二乘残差打分)、嵌套Dropout预测器(在发现顺序上训练,使任意前缀长度均可准确预测)以及自动概念命名(MAIA代理)。推理阶段根据置信度阈值按发现顺序逐个消费概念,实现样本级自适应预算。

Result: 在六个视觉数据集(Imagenette、Dogs-10、Machines-15、Mixed-20、Flowers-102、ISIC-7)和两个文本数据集(AG News、PubMed-20k)上,AnyBottle以比无标注基线少1-64倍的概念数达到或超过黑盒教师精度,同时获得更高的概念一致性(C²)。消融实验证实预筛选、定位搜索、最小二乘打分三个组件均对紧凑性和一致性有贡献。任务感知SAE微调在专业领域(ISIC-7、Flowers-102)收益最大。该方法在MLP教师和零样本verbalizer教师两种范式下均可跨域泛化。

Conclusion: AnyBottle表明,无标注的概念瓶颈模型无需在紧凑性和表达力之间做取舍——一个小的、由发现得到的词汇表可与一个大的、固定的词汇表一样具有表达力,同时更易于检视。该方法通过冻结backbone和概念池的简单替换实现了跨域、跨任务的可迁移性,在视觉和文本模态上验证有效。其局限在于概念发现的保真度受限于教师模型和SAE字典,且存在通过捷径学习而非真实因果传递教师偏见的风险。

Abstract: Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) make predictions inspectable and intervenable by routing them through human-interpretable concepts, but originally required concept annotations. Annotation-free variants remove this requirement, but typically use large concept vocabularies, static at both training and inference, producing bottlenecks larger than any task or prediction needs and harder to inspect. We propose AnyBottle, a single recipe for building compact, task-specific CBMs. AnyBottle assumes only a frozen backbone and an unsupervised concept pool, such as a sparse autoencoder. A black-box teacher trained on the same backbone then guides selection: each round adds the concept that best explains the bottleneck's current failures, with candidates restricted to regions of teacher/student disagreement.
