TL;DR: 本文提出DRMoET，一种即插即用的分布鲁棒优化目标，用于稀疏Mixture-of-Experts训练。它将每层专家视为内生鲁棒性组，通过EMA平滑的、激活加权的专家损失上的熵正则化softmax规则来更新每层专家分布，从而强化那些合理的非top路由路径。在FLAME-MoE基础上，DRMoET在746M和10.3B两个规模上均超越标准FLAME-MoE和无辅助损失均衡基线，例如10.3B模型67B token下七任务平均从0.6625提升至0.6767。机制分析显示其降低了专家损失方差、提升强制中k误路由鲁棒性4.3%，并改善了领域专家特化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏MoE的路由并非完美，负载均衡只优化分配而不保证非top专家的能力。当路由出错时，token会被发送到训练不足的专家，导致不可靠性。现有负载均衡方法不能保证被选中专家的质量，且可能损害有用特化。

Method: 1) 将每层路由专家视为DRO的内生组，最小化最差专家归属风险之和；2) 引入激活加权信用c̃ = sg(p·‖h‖₂)做损失归因；3) 用EMA平滑专家损失ℓ̂，用概率空间softmax更新对偶权重μ；4) 整体目标为ℓ_DRO = Σ μ·ℓ，仅重加权已计算的token损失；5) 证明正则化目标的Õ(T^(-1/2))收敛率。

Result: 在746M/33.5B和10.3B/67B规模上，DRMoET均优于FLAME-MoE和无辅助损失基线；最大七任务平均0.6767 vs 0.6625（FLAME-MoE）vs 0.6431（aux-free）。专家损失标准差降低>8%，强制中k误路由额外损失降低4.3%，领域-专家互信息+12.9%，能力优势ΔQ +30.2%。训练吞吐量无下降甚至略快。

Conclusion: 路由鲁棒性（而非仅负载均衡）应是稀疏MoE扩展的实用目标。DRMoET通过优化高损失专家归属，在不改变路由规则和稀疏计算的前提下，使非top路由路径更可靠，且不会损害专家特化，为可靠稀疏MoE缩放提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) transformers scale capacity by activating only a few experts per token, but this sparsity creates a hidden reliability problem: when routing is imperfect, load-balanced models may send tokens to experts that are insufficiently trained for the assigned inputs. We propose Distributionally Robust MoE Training (DRMoET), a drop-in objective that treats layer-wise experts as endogenous robustness groups and optimizes high-loss routing outcomes rather than merely equalizing traffic. DRMoET updates a per-layer expert distribution by an entropy-regularized softmax rule on EMA-smoothed, activation-weighted expert losses, strengthening plausible non-top routing paths while preserving standard MoE computation. Under the FLAME-MoE recipe at 746M-total and 10.3B-total scales, DRMoET improves downstream averages over both standard FLAME-MoE and auxiliary-loss-free balancing. At 10.3B total parameters and 67B training tokens, DRMoET improves the seven-task average from 0.6625 to 0.6767, while the auxiliary-loss-free baseline achieves 0.6431. Mechanistic analyses show lower expert-loss variance with nearly unchanged mean loss, 4.3% lower excess loss under forced mid-$k$ misrouting, and improved domain-expert specialization. These results position routing robustness-not only utilization balance-as a practical objective for reliable sparse MoE scaling. Project page and code are available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [251] [Minimal Witness Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07226)
*T. Y. Tsui,Zihao Ye,Pengxiang Cai,Yanchao Li,Yuqiang Li,Zhehong Ai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MWRL提出了一种新的强化学习框架——最小见证强化学习（Minimal-Witness Reinforcement Learning），旨在从仅返回二值反馈的黑盒验证器中恢复任务的所有极小充分集（反链），而非单一解或冗余超集。其核心思想是基于"组认证区域"进行信用分配：策略提出的每个成功提议若被移除将损失的区域覆盖度，即为其删除信用。该方法同时统一了极小性和多解恢复两个需求，并衍生出可在小子集格上恢复完整见证族的价值迭代规划器，以及可扩展到大语言模型规模（如电路发现）的策略梯度方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统强化学习方法（包括PPO、GRPO、RLOO、MaxEnt RL、GFlowNet等）在最小充分集识别任务上存在根本性局限：成功率奖励产生冗余超集，尺寸惩罚聚焦于最小见证而忽略其他不可比较的见证，多样性方法则无法判定答案何时完备。论文从理论上证明（定理1：关系必要性）：可分局部奖励、按比例采样和成功率目标这三类现有方法在多个最小见证存在时无法正确恢复整个反链。这一动机源自科学发现、模型可解释性和逻辑推理中广泛存在的"最小充分条件识别"需求。

Method: 1) 形式化最小见证识别问题：在单调充分性谓词s下，定义反链𝓜为所有极小充分集。2) 构造组返回值G(W)=ℛ(U(W))，其中U(W)是提议组所认证的up-set并集，采用覆盖测度ℛ_μ(U)=μ(U)作为基础。3) 设计删除信用A_i = ℛ(U_K) - ℛ(U_{-i})，即移除第i个提议后组覆盖的损失。4) 推导出极小见证价值迭代规划器（在小子集格上恢复完整反链）和可扩展的组策略梯度算法（l1o和l2o信用估计器）。5) 使用几何测度（参数p=0.7的独立伯努利积测度）保证精化率与集合大小无关。6) 引入共享采样蒙特卡洛估计器以O(NK)复杂度高效计算信用。

Result: 在三个实验设置中：1) 素蕴涵枚举（n=14，平均18.1个最小见证）：MWRL达到0.76的born-minimal率和0.67的反链召回率，远超PPO/GRPO/RLOO（均为0.00）、GFlowNet（0.05）和带尺寸惩罚的MaxEnt RL/GFlowNet（均为0.24），逼近完整信息的极小见证价值迭代（1.00）。2) Suzuki-Miyaura耦合科学变量识别：摊销MWRL在保留底物上的召回率为0.50，接近按底物单独训练的0.67上限，盲底物策略降至0.37。3) Qwen3-1.7B MMLU电路发现：MWRL获得KL保持率0.38和每个主题平均8.9个不同电路，远优于EAP（0.15，1个电路）和Wanda/幅度/HardConcrete（均约0.02）。消融实验验证了蒙特卡洛信用估计器在N=5,000时与精确枚举几乎一致（余弦相似度0.995），以及训练组大小K和部署预算B的影响。

Conclusion: MWRL将反链恢复从一个难以处理的组合搜索问题转化为可从验证器反馈学习的对象。其理论贡献在于：证明了任何忽略提议间包含关系的奖励函数都无法恢复完整反链（定理1）；建立了组返回值与认证区域之间的双射对应（定理2）；展示了覆盖测度下的组REINFORCE自然导出删除信用作为次模边际增益。该方法将强化学习的范围从单解优化扩展到一族解的学习，其应用涵盖符号逻辑、可解释AI、机制可解释性（LLM电路发现）、合成化学和因果推断等领域。

Abstract: ``What are the irreducible conditions that are sufficient to produce an outcome?'' is one of the most common questions that recur across computation and science. Its answers, the minimal sufficient witnesses, are what we mean by explanations, mechanisms and reasons. These problems usually ask for multiple minimal witnesses, yet standard RL methods may reveal only one solution or redundant ones. We formalize this problem as minimal-witness identification and introduce Minimal-Witness Reinforcement Learning (MWRL). MWRL takes the union of the sets certified by successful proposals sampled from the policy and credits each proposal for the coverage the group union would lose without that proposal. This credit assignment, derived directly from the problem definition, unifies the demands for minimality and recovery of alternatives from a single black-box verifier bit. Under this principle, we derive a value iteration planner that recovers the entire family of witnesses and a policy gradient method that can scale to large language models. Across different experimental settings, MWRL recovers most minimal witnesses, while other methods return redundant supersets or a single witness. By making witness families learnable from verifier feedback, MWRL expands the scope of reinforcement learning beyond single-solution optimization. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [252] [FlexiFlow: Bandit-based Model Switching in ML Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07286)
*Abhilash Jindal,Todd Nief,Bhanu Prakash Vangala,Shankaradithyaa V,Tvisha Malik,Anshik Sahu,Aaron Schein,Amitabh Chaudhary,Tanu Malik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlexiFlow提出了一种数据流系统，通过在多步骤ML工作流中动态切换模型来应对软失败问题。它引入了操作符选择（operator choices）和断言（assertions）编程抽象，并采用基于多臂老虎机（Multi-Armed Bandit）的贝叶斯在线优化器（包括OTS、CTS和HTS三种策略）来学习最优配置序列。实验表明，模型切换可将准确率提升高达23%，并在运行时复用中间结果，获得比顺序执行高48%的效率增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在生产ML系统中，依赖单一模型对所有数据批次进行推理往往无法最大化准确性，因为不同模型在不同数据子集上表现各异（存在软失败问题）。现有数据流系统缺乏根据性能自适应切换模型的能力，迫使用户手动按顺序测试模型，效率低下且资源消耗大。

Method: 1. 编程模型：在现有数据流语言中引入两个新原语——操作符选择（每个算子可有多种实现）和工作流断言（用于检测软失败），以及一个运行时原语——回滚（当断言失败时回滚到特定算子并复用中间结果）。2. 学习问题建模：将最优配置序列选择形式化为最小化预期执行成本的目标函数，考虑通过断言的概率和回滚执行成本。3. 贝叶斯优化策略：提出三种基于Thompson采样的策略——OTS（算子级TS，建模成功概率的对数正态运行时分布）、CTS（配置级TS，在完整配置级别学习并考虑回滚代价）、HTS（混合TS，使用经验贝叶斯方法将算子级统计信息融合到配置级别的后验估计中）。

Result: 1. 准确性：在真实ML工作流（LCQA和ICP）上，使用FlexiFlow比最佳单一配置提升F1分数高达23%，原因是不同配置的错误模式具有不相关性。2. 学习效率：OTS在50次运行内对IC和SCQA收敛；HTS在约1000次运行后对LCQA收敛。运行时感知和回滚感知对学习最优序列至关重要。3. 效率：FlexiFlow比在Spark和Flink上顺序执行工作流配置快48-49%，比仅运行最佳配置时的Spark快22%、Flink快15%。4. 消融实验：OTS-R（忽略运行时）和CTS-RB（忽略回滚代价）均无法学习最优序列，验证了完整设计的必要性。

Conclusion: FlexiFlow证明了在ML工作流中动态模型切换的显著价值，通过操作符选择、断言和回滚的编程抽象结合多臂老虎机在线学习，能有效提升准确性和效率。该系统向更智能、数据感知的工作流系统迈出了重要一步，可减少人工干预并增强ML驱动自动化的可靠性。未来工作将探索将输入数据特征纳入学习策略，并研究条件概率建模以处理配置间相关失败的情况。

Abstract: Model optimizations help improve inference performance and accuracy of ML workflows. However, relying on a single model to perform inference across all data batches often fails to maximize accuracy and thus overall performance. In many cases, alternate models could perform better on specific subsets of data where a primary model underperforms. Our experiments with real ML workflows indeed show that switching models improves workflow accuracy by up to 23%. Yet, current systems lack the ability to adaptively switch between models based on performance, forcing users to manually test models in sequence. We present FlexiFlow, a dataflow system that dynamically switches between alternate models when the current model exhibits low accuracy. FlexiFlow learns to rank models using a novel multi-armed bandit approach that accounts for model runtimes, probability of passing user-defined assertions, and the computational structure of the ML workflow. We show that the standard Thompson sampling approach is insufficient for switching models in ML workflows. In contrast, our proposed approaches are effective and scales to complex real-world ML workflows. Experiments show that switching models at runtime while reusing intermediate results provides higher accuracy, but also 48% efficiency gain compared to sequential workflow runs.

</details>


### [253] [Scale-Invariant Training for Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07324)
*Ignacy Stepka,Willa Potosnak,Kin G. Olivares,Artur Dubrawski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现ReVIN等仿射缩放方法在逆变换后计算损失会引入b^p的尺度污染(ScaleCon),导致高尺度序列主导训练。证明在缩放目标上计算损失可实现尺度不变训练(ScaleIn),仅需一行代码改动。在4种TSFM架构预训练和监督预测中均显著降低误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型(TSFM)在跨域大规模序列集合上训练,不同序列的尺度差异显著。现有方法如ReVIN对模型预测进行逆缩放后计算损失,这会引入隐式的b^p梯度偏置,使高尺度序列主导训练,导致低尺度序列欠优化。论文旨在揭示此机制并提出简单解决方案。

Method: 理论上:证明逆缩放在b^p齐次损失下使梯度被b^p加权(引理3.1),对尺度等变缩放器和任意独立尺度缩放再运算,ScaleIn使每个mini-batch梯度和完整优化轨迹不变(定理3.2)。实践上:将损失计算从预测逆缩放改为目标缩放,仅一行代码改动。实验在合成数据、尺度交换干预、4种TSFM架构(Chronos2、Moirai-2.0、TimesFM2.5、PatchTST)预训练和5种监督神经预测模型(NHITS、NBEATS、PatchTST、TCN、LSTM)上进行验证。

Result: 在所有24个架构-基准对比中,ScaleIn均降低MASE,GIFT-Eval平均降低18.8%,M竞赛平均降低21.9%。在20个监督预测设置中的16个中降低MASE。在合成实验中,ScaleCon下高尺度源收敛速度比低尺度源快50倍,而ScaleIn下三者并行收敛。尺度交换干预实验证实ScaleIn使轨迹级误差对任意尺度缩放保持不变(paired t-test, p=0.042)。MOMENT掩码重建任务中,ScaleIn将中位重建MASE从1.42降至0.69(降低51%)。

Conclusion: 损失计算空间是时间序列预测(尤其是TSFM)的关键训练设计选择,应明确报告。ScaleIn通过在缩放目标上计算损失消除b^p梯度偏置,使训练对序列尺度具有严格不变性,实现简单(一行代码改动),但在TSFM预训练中带来显著且一致的精度改进。建议将损失空间作为训练设计选择明确报告,以提高可复现性。

Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are trained on large collections of time series datasets that span various morphologies and domains. This setting exposes models to series whose scales -- typical magnitudes of their values -- can differ substantially. Affine scaling methods such as Reversible Instance Normalization (ReVIN) scale model inputs and reverse the transform before computing the loss. We show that this inversion multiplies each series' gradient by $b^p$ relative to loss on scaled targets, where $b$ is the scaling denominator (e.g., standard deviation) and $p$ is the loss degree. We call this scale-contaminated training (ScaleCon), because the scale of each series consequently becomes an importance weight, causing high-scale series to dominate training. For any scale-equivariant scaler and residual loss that is homogeneous of degree $p$, including MSE, MAE, and Quantile Loss, we prove that computing loss on scaled targets makes every mini-batch gradient and, consequently, the full optimization trajectory invariant to arbitrary independent rescaling of the training series, yielding scale-invariant training (ScaleIn). Notably, existing TSFMs use both objectives, with neither consistent reporting nor a common convention on how to compute training loss. We isolate the convergence disparity induced by ScaleCon and its correction under ScaleIn in controlled studies on synthetic and real data. In pretraining across four TSFM architectures, ScaleIn lowers MASE in all 24 architecture-benchmark comparisons, with average reductions across TSFMs of 18.8% on GIFT-Eval and 21.9% on the M-competitions. The gains extend to supervised neural forecasting, where it lowers MASE in 16 of 20 matched settings. Most existing time series forecasting pipelines can adopt ScaleIn with a one-line code change.

</details>


### [254] [Selective Critique for Cost-Aware LLM Agents in Long-Horizon Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07335)
*Heewon Park,Somin Im,Minhae Kwon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SAG（Self-improving Agent with Gated critique），一种面向长视野决策中 LLM 智能体的成本感知框架，通过基于动作级模糊度（全局熵 + 局部 top-2 边际）的轻量级、无训练门控机制，将批评调用建模为逐步决策问题，近似信息价值（VoI），从而选择性地调用昂贵的批评反馈；并在 ALFWorld 等三个基准上以接近 ReAct 的 token 预算显著提升任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在长视野交互环境中，LLM 智能体的早期错误会级联放大；引入批评（外部反馈/审议）虽有效，却带来高 token 消耗和延迟。许多现有方法以固定或启发式调度方式调用批评，缺乏对"何时调用批评值得其成本"的设计原则，限制了实际部署。

Method: SAG 将批评调用形式化为逐步的二值决策 g_t∈{0,1}：(1) 计算动作分布 q_t 的全局模糊度（归一化熵）和局部模糊度（top-2 对数概率边际 m_t）；(2) 组合为有界门控分数 S_t = H̄_t + 𝕀[m_t<δ]，当 S_t>τ 时调用批评者；从决策论角度，这近似 VoI；(3) 成功的轨迹通过在线 SFT 内化进 actor（批评者固定），形成自改进循环。理论上证明熵控制贪婪误差风险、边际控制 top-2 误差风险，为门控提供 VoI 代理的理论依据。

Result: 在 ALFWorld、BabyAI-Text、WebShop 三个长视野基准，Qwen2.5-7B/14B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B 等多种骨干上，SAG 一致优于 ReAct、Reflexion、Debate、CER、Traj-Boost、Retrospex、LAC 等基线：ALFWorld 上 Qwen2.5-7B 成功率 24.6%→78.3%，token 预算与 ReAct 相当，归一化 token 效率提升 3.1×；7B actor + 3B critic 性能匹配 14B actor 无批评；困难任务上增益更大（4×）；门控阈值稳健；随在线 SFT 进行，批评调用次数和模糊度自发下降。

Conclusion: 选择性批评是一种实用、可扩展的路径，可在长视野序贯环境中以低成本恢复审议带来的可靠性收益；轻量级、无训练的模糊度门控 + 在线自改进是兼顾性能与成本的有效组合，未来可探索更丰富的不确定性信号、自适应批评者及真实任务验证。

Abstract: Improving the reliability of large language model (LLM) agents in long-horizon decision-making remains a key challenge. When deployed as autonomous agents interacting with complex environments, early mistakes can propagate through trajectories and cause cascading failures. Recent approaches improve reliability by incorporating external critique or deliberation, but invoking these mechanisms at every step substantially increases token consumption and latency, limiting practical deployment. We propose SAG (Self-improving Agent with Gated critique), a cost-aware framework that formulates critique invocation as a step-wise decision problem during long-horizon interaction. SAG introduces a lightweight, training-free gating mechanism that estimates the utility of critique using action-level ambiguity signals--global entropy and local top-2 margin--computed over admissible actions. From a decision-theoretic perspective, this mechanism approximates the Value of Information (VoI) of critique, enabling the agent to selectively allocate expensive feedback only when its expected benefit justifies the cost. SAG further incorporates online bootstrapped self-improvement, allowing the actor to internalize critic-assisted behaviors and progressively reduce reliance on critique. Across three long-horizon interactive benchmarks and multiple backbone models, SAG substantially improves the performance-cost trade-off compared with both no-critique and always-on critique agents. On ALFWorld, SAG increases task success from 24.6% to 78.4% while maintaining a token budget comparable to ReAct, yielding a $3.1\times$ improvement in normalized token efficiency. Moreover, a 7B actor with a lightweight 3B critic achieves performance comparable to a 14B actor without critique, showing that selective critique can recover most of the reliability benefits of deliberation while dramatically reducing inference cost.

</details>


### [255] [CausalBind: Causal Modeling and Learning for Protein-Molecule Virtual Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07340)
*Loka Li,Jin Tian,Kun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CausalBind针对蛋白-分子虚拟筛选中现有方法依赖密集全局对齐的问题，将蛋白质-分子结合建模为基于V型结构因果模型的Heckman选择问题，建立了三个可识别性理论结果，并提出了基于稀疏或低秩跨模态交互的三种实现变体，在DUD-E和LIT-PCBA基准上优于现有检索基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索式虚拟筛选方法依赖密集的全局对齐，将不变结合决定因素与干扰相关性纠缠，限制了对新靶点的迁移能力。然而蛋白-分子结合本质上由稀疏的局部相互作用（少量接触界面和关键局部相互作用如氢键、疏水接触、盐桥）驱动，而非全局结构。揭示并利用这些稀疏交互模式对训练数据外的泛化至关重要。

Method: 将蛋白-分子结合建模为V型结构因果模型（绑定变量B作为分子潜概念c^M和蛋白潜在概念c^P的碰撞子），在Heckman选择偏差下建立三个理论结果：(1) 无结构约束时密集交互不可识别；(2) 稀疏反链结构下概念和交互掩码分量级可识别；(3) 低秩松弛下交互子空间可识别。基于此提出CausalBind框架的三种实现：CausalBind_SP（带可学习稀疏概念对掩码）、CausalBind_LR（概念轴掩码的显式低秩分解）、CausalBind_EMB（池化嵌入空间掩码）。每种实现使用Perceiver式概念提取器从分子口袋和序列三种模态中提取K个原子概念，通过跨模态稀疏掩码进行结合评分。

Result: 在DUD-E（102个靶点）和LIT-PCBA（15个靶点）基准上的实验显示所有CausalBind变体均优于强检索基线：CausalBind_SP在DUD-E上达到AUROC 0.935、BEDROC 0.744、EF@1% 47.69，LIT-PCBA上AUROC 0.639、BEDROC 0.097、EF@1% 8.56（相对LigUnity和HypSeek在LIT-PCBA早期富集上有最大提升）；CausalBind_EMB在LIT-PCBA EF@1%上达到9.60。在DEKOIS 2.0的零样本迁移评估（靶点级和支架级分布外分割）上同样优于HypSeek和LigUnity。掩码结构分析显示学习到的交互在λ=10⁻⁴时表现为低秩，在λ=10⁻³时表现为精确稀疏支持。THRB可解释性案例研究表明接触原子富集在学习到的概念对中。

Conclusion: CausalBind为基于检索的虚拟筛选提供了一个有因果理论支撑的结构先验，将密集全局对齐替换为稀疏或低秩的跨模态交互。理论分析表明密集交互在仅结合子选择下不可识别，而稀疏反链结构可实现分量级可识别，低秩结构可实现子空间可识别。三个实现变体从不同角度实例化了这一原理，实验一致性地在LIT-PCBA早期富集上表现出最大增益，并在分布外设置下成功泛化。该方法代表了可扩展虚拟筛选应学习更好的跨模态交互结构而非仅更好的共享嵌入的方向。

Abstract: Protein-molecule virtual screening is increasingly cast as a problem of representation learning in a shared embedding space. Existing methods rely on dense holistic alignment, entangling invariant binding determinants with nuisance correlations and limiting transfer to new targets. It has been noted that binding in protein-molecule systems involves sparse cross-modality interactions: binding is governed by a small contact interface and a few decisive local interactions (e.g., hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic contacts, and salt bridges) rather than the global structures of the protein and molecule. We hypothesize that uncovering and leveraging sparse interaction patterns is critical for generalization beyond the training data, as these patterns are reusable and expected to improve performance across different scenarios. In this paper, we aim to identify and leverage sparse interaction patterns, and verify our hypothesis. Since the training data contain only observed binding pairs, we formalize this prior via a V-structure causal model under Heckman-style selection, and establish three theoretical results: (i) the latent concepts of interacting proteins and molecules are not identifiable without appropriate sparsity constraints; (ii) these concepts and their sparse interactions are component-wise identifiable under structural sparsity conditions; and (iii) a low-rank relaxation of these conditions yields subspace identifiability of the concepts and interactions. Inspired by these principles, we propose CausalBind with three implementation variants. Extensive experiments on DUD-E and LIT-PCBA benchmarks show that all variants consistently outperform strong retrieval baselines, with the largest gains on LIT-PCBA early enrichment, and further generalize to target- and scaffold-level out-of-distribution splits. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [256] [Stepped MoE: Segment-Level Routing with Configurable Inference Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07348)
*Arnav Kundu,Zhaoyang Xu,Bairu Hou,Chang Gao,Reed Li,Tao Lei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种统一的框架Stepped-MoE，将弹性架构与稀疏门控架构结合，使单个LLM能同时适应部署约束和任务需求，通过段级路由和可配置推理复杂度，实现1-4B参数灵活切换，精度优于同规模稠密模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的MoE架构（按token路由）在DRAM受限的边缘设备上因频繁的expert I/O交换而成为I/O瓶颈；而查询级剪枝方法（如IFP）存在需要独立剪枝器模型、无法从头预训练、搜索空间过大等问题，且两者未联合考虑部署约束与任务适配。

Method: Stepped-MoE将模型分为密集部分（前12层）和MoE部分（后44层，212个专家），利用密集层输出为每个段（segment）一次生成所有后续MoE层的专家路由掩码，通过SoftTopK实现可微分选择，引入稀疏感知嵌入(sparsity-aware embedding)显式标注当前活跃容量，并采用批次复制(batch replication)和加权交叉熵损失支持多稀疏度联合训练，专家每S个生成步骤刷新一次。

Result: 预训练1T tokens后，Flexible S-MoE在12B总参数下支持1B/2B/3B/4B四种活跃配置，知识密集型基准（MMLU、GSM8K等）比同规模稠密模型提升2-5%，与静态S-MoE相当；推理延迟接近3B密集模型、显著低于6B密集模型和Vanilla MoE；段长S=16优于S=32；20B总参数扩展进一步提升精度。

Conclusion: Stepped-MoE成功统一了稀疏激活与弹性架构，单个12B checkpoint可服务多种活跃参数配置，精度匹配或超越稠密基线且推理延迟可控，为资源受限设备的LLM部署提供了可行方案，但存在训练FLOP开销大、注意层参数固定共享、段长与精度需权衡等局限。

Abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) is resource-intensive, and adapting them for diverse deployment scenarios with varying computational constraints remains challenging. While elastic architectures enable flexible model deployment and sparsely activated models allow input-adaptive computation, existing approaches treat these dimensions independently. Moreover, models catered towards on-device edge inference need to conform to the memory and compute limitations of the serving devices. In this paper, we introduce a unified framework that combines elastic structures with sparsely gated architectures to create models that adapt simultaneously to both deployment constraints and task requirements. Our approach employs a model backbone that conditions on both the context and target efficiency specifications, enabling fine-grained control over the accuracy-efficiency trade-off at inference time. The model learns to activate task-relevant parameters within elastically-nested sub-networks, allowing a single model to span multiple capacity points while maintaining input-adaptive routing. Through experiments we demonstrate that we can create a model that allows the flexibility to use 1,2,3,4 billion parameters while being more accurate than their dense counter-parts (2-5\% on knowledge-intensive benchmarks) and at par with their static versions while delivering similar latency metrics as dense models. Overall, we save on device disk space by sharing the model parameters, allow flexibility of serving based on DRAM and compute available while delivering more accurate results.

</details>


### [257] [RELACE: retrospective likelihood-based action credit estimation for long-horizon language agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07349)
*Sayak Chakrabarti,Sathish Reddy Indurthi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RELACE提出了一种无需评论家（critic-free）的策略优化框架，通过对已执行动作在原始上下文和结果增强上下文下的teacher-forcing似然评分进行对比，得到回溯相关性因子，用于重新加权折扣回报并在状态匹配组内构建局部优势，从而解决长视野语言智能体中的细粒度信用分配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO等方法在多轮智能体训练中只提供轨迹级别的监督信号，无法定位错误动作；而GiGPO等基于状态条件比较的方法仍对下游决策敏感。作者希望在不引入额外价值/奖励模型或自回归rollout的前提下，结合回溯评估与状态条件优势估计实现细粒度信用分配。

Method: RELACE的核心方法包括：(1) 结局条件回溯标注：用终止观测增强每个中间上下文；(2) 回溯信用重加权：用冻结行为策略对同一已执行动作在原始与回溯上下文下分别做teacher-forcing似然评分，形成长度归一化似然比的轨迹归一化截断权重ρ_{i,t}，用以重新加权折扣回报Q^H；(3) 状态条件分组与非对称掩码：将动作按匹配观测状态分组，构造局部相对优势，并对成功轨迹施加"do-no-harm"掩码抑制负向局部修正；(4) 时序平滑与宏观优势结合：最终优势由轨迹级GRPO优势与受保护局部优势加权组合而成，采用PPO截断替代目标进行策略更新。

Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop两个基准上，基于Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct的实验表明，RELACE在所有报告的聚合指标上均优于GRPO、GiGPO、HCAPO和GraphGPO等基线。1.5B模型在ALFWorld上达到96.35%成功率，WebShop上达到79.43%成功率，分别超越GiGPO 5.47和5.60个百分点。消融实验验证了原始上下文似然修正和局部基线一致性两个设计选择的必要性。训练诊断显示回溯分数随训练上升、平均回溯权重保持稳定。

Conclusion: RELACE是一种有效的critic-free框架，通过teacher-forcing似然评分将已执行动作与最终结果联系起来，在不引入额外模型或自回归rollout的情况下实现了细粒度的信用分配，在长视野语言智能体任务中显著优于现有的轨迹级和步进级基线方法。

Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) avoids a separate critic by estimating advantages from rollout groups. For multi-turn agents, however, trajectory-level supervision provides coarse, noisy credit: terminal rewards do not locate errors and can penalize useful actions alongside mistakes. Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (GiGPO) and subsequent methods refine supervision through state-conditioned comparisons, but their credit estimates remain sensitive to downstream decisions and outcomes. We introduce RELACE, Retrospective Likelihood-based Action, a critic-free framework that integrates retrospective action assessment with state-conditioned advantage estimation. RELACE evaluates executed actions through teacher-forced likelihood scoring under both their original contexts and outcome-augmented contexts. Comparing these likelihoods yields a trajectory-normalized retrospective factor that captures outcome-dependent changes in action plausibility, rather than hindsight plausibility alone. We use this factor to reweight discounted task returns and construct local advantages by comparing weighted returns among actions from equivalent states within a task. This couples retrospective relevance with observed reward, producing fine-grained credit that complements trajectory-level GRPO supervision. Temporal smoothing and success-protecting masking further stabilize the local signal. RELACE requires neither auxiliary value nor reward models nor additional autoregressive rollouts for credit estimation. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct demonstrate substantial improvements over GRPO, GiGPO, and HCAPO. With the 1.5B model, RELACE achieves $96.35\%$ success on ALFWorld and $79.43\%$ on WebShop, surpassing GiGPO by $5.47$ and $5.60$ percentage points, respectively.

</details>


### [258] [Inference and learning in sparse autoencoders as natural gradient flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07389)
*Hadi Vafaii,Tejas Rao,David Chanin,Thomas Fel,Jacob L. Yates,Bruno Olshausen,David Klindt,Dileep George,Miguel Lázaro-Gredilla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BeFOND，一种基于自然梯度流的稀疏自编码器方法，将推理和字典学习统一在同一变分自由能的框架内。该方法在合成数据和语言模型激活上都表现出色，特别是在特征重叠和稀有特征学习方面超越了现有的摊销SAE基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准SAE在特征重叠（叠加）和低频激活（稀有特征）场景下难以可靠恢复特征。现有研究表明，仅改善推理不足以解决特征恢复问题，因为推理误差会影响字典学习，反之亦然。论文旨在通过统一的概率几何框架同时改进推理和学习。

Method: 论文将FOND框架从仅覆盖推理扩展到同时覆盖学习，将推理和学习均视为变分自由能上的自然梯度流。实例化为BeFOND（Bernoulli FOND），使用Bernoulli潜变量、分解先验和线性高斯解码器，推导出闭式的推理和学习动力学。具体包括：(1) 推理时通过循环交互实现"解释消除"（explaining away），减轻重叠特征的干扰；(2) 学习时通过Fisher预条件补偿稀有特征的慢学习问题。证明单层推理对特征后验的局限性（定理4.1），并证明Fisher预条件在学习时给出与频率无关的收缩率（定理4.2）。此外还提出了基于最小作用原理和"适应物理学"的理论推导。

Result: 在SynthSAEBench合成数据上，BeFOND实现了最高的MCC（0.8980±0.0015）、Macro F1（0.9702±0.0011）和Rare F1（0.9519±0.0075），几乎无死潜。在Gemma-2-2B第12层激活上，524k宽度时RAVEL解缠得分为0.827±0.001，超过最强摊销基线BatchTopK约7.9个百分点。仅用约6M训练token（相比Gemma Scope的8B token）即匹配其性能，效率提升超过1000倍。在字典宽度从16k扩展到524k时，BeFOND的性能持续提升，而基线趋于停滞。

Conclusion: 论文论证了在统一概率框架内改进推理和学习的实用价值。核心启示是适应动力学应遵循"统计流形的内在几何和对称性"——即"适应物理学"原理。论文展示了循环解释消除和稀有特征恢复的实际意义。未来工作将集中在计算效率、推理收敛加速以及扩展变分族以表达潜变量间的依赖关系。主要局限是迭代推理步骤和数值解码器更新增加了计算成本（约为BatchTopK的12-14倍）。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders are widely used to uncover interpretable features in neural networks, yet reliable recovery remains difficult when features overlap or activate infrequently. These challenges involve both inferring which features explain an input and learning the dictionary that represents them. Here, we unify inference and dictionary learning as natural-gradient flows on a shared variational free energy. We instantiate this framework as BeFOND, an encoder-free sparse coding model with closed-form inference and learning dynamics. We show how recurrent explaining away reduces interference between overlapping features, while Fisher preconditioning can compensate for the slow learning of rare features. On synthetic data, BeFOND improves dictionary recovery and rare-feature detection, with a growing advantage over amortized baselines as superposition increases. On language-model activations, it improves single-feature concept detection and selective intervention, outperforming pretrained reference SAEs with substantially less training data. Its feature quality continues to improve with dictionary width, whereas the evaluated baselines largely plateau. Together, these results show how improving inference and learning within a unified probabilistic framework can make better use of data and dictionary capacity to interpret and intervene on neural representations.

</details>


### [259] [Active Feature Acquisition for Cost-Efficient Temporal Prediction with Reduced Participant Burden](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07452)
*Yunni Qu,Bing Cai Kok,Whitney Ringwald,Grant King,Aidan Wright,Kathleen Gates,Junier Oliva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了TREACT方法，通过树蒸馏将基于神经网络的纵向主动特征采集(LAFA)策略转化为可解释的决策树序列，以在生态瞬时评估(EMA)研究中平衡预测准确性与参与者负担。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心理学EMA研究中需要在最大化预测准确性和最小化参与者负担之间取得平衡。现有LAFA方法基于神经网络，策略不透明，难以在实践中解释、审查或修改，限制了其应用。

Method: TREACT通过时间感知递归分区方法，将REACT神经网络LAFA策略蒸馏为每个时间点一个决策树序列。关键创新在于：1) 仅使用树策略在先前时刻已采集的变量作为特征；2) 使用教师网络生成的采集模式代码本作为标签；3) 处理未采集变量的"NA"分支的三元分裂。

Result: 模拟研究：TREACT几乎完美恢复了REACT策略，AUROC变化<0.001，成本增加仅0.04。实证CHEEARS数据集（预测酒精消费）：TREACT在大多数成本范围内优于随机采集和Lasso基线，AUROC达0.750，AUPRC达0.643，平均成本42.73，揭示了个性化的采集模式。

Conclusion: TREACT为复杂EMA研究提供了可解释、个性化且成本高效的采集策略，将不透明神经策略近似为可审计的树协议，同时保留大部分预测和成本节省效益。未来工作应整合心理测量学考量、处理可变长度时间序列、并探索树深度对性能的影响。

Abstract: Accurate forecasting of pathological outcomes is a central problem in psychology. To do so, psychologists often collect intensive longitudinal data. However, in such studies, the desire to acquire a large number of variables for the sake of accurate prediction is often counteracted by the need to minimize participant burden. Acquiring more variables per occasion can yield better predictions, but having too many acquisitions increase the risk of non-response and attrition. Longitudinal Active Feature Acquisition (LAFA) is a principled approach to resolve this conundrum. Instead of requiring responses to every item at every acquisition occasion, LAFA produces a policy that seeks to optimally select dynamic subsets of items to be acquired at each timepoint while preserving our ability to forecast a specific outcome. However, existing LAFA methods are mostly based on Neural Networks (NN) that are difficult to interpret in practice. In this work, we introduce a tree distillation method for learning an interpretable policy from NN-based LAFA networks. We validated our method through both a simulation and an empirical EMA dataset on forecasting daily alcohol consumption. In both cases, we find that we can meaningfully reduce the number of items acquired at each occasion with minimal loss in accuracy. Networks (NN) that are difficult to interpret in practice. In this work, we introduce a tree distillation method for learning an interpretable policy from NN-based LAFA networks. We validated our method through both a simulation and an empirical EMA dataset on forecasting daily alcohol consumption. In both cases, we find that we can meaningfully reduce the number of items acquired at each occasion with minimal loss in accuracy.

</details>


### [260] [AlignQuant: Tile-Aligned Mixed-Precision Quantization for Efficient LLM Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07457)
*Hanzhi Zhang,Qiao Zhang,Qinglei Cao,Heng Fan,Yan Huang,Kewei Sha,Yunhe Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AlignQuant提出了一种基于二维权重tile的混合精度量化方法，通过统一精度分配、紧凑存储与GPU执行单元，在4个3B-14B LLM上实现最高2.50×生成加速同时保持模型质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度混合精度量化中，局部精度选择与GPU规则存储/计算单元之间的"精度边界不匹配"问题，导致压缩难以转化为实际加速。核心问题是：如何在紧凑权重存储和直接GPU执行中保留基于敏感性的局部精度选择。

Method: 方法核心包含三部分：(1) Tile级精度分配：将权重矩阵划分为GPU兼容的二维tile（如64×64），作为精度分配、紧凑存储和执行的统一单元；通过Fisher加权计算W8到W4替换的投影输出扰动作为敏感度评分，采用prefill/decode联合相位归一化评分，在模型全局存储预算下分配精度。(2) 紧凑混合精度表示：每个tile存储选定的4位或8位表示及FP32重建scale，分离的W4/W8缓冲区+1位精度标签实现索引。(3) 直接prefill/decode执行：4位权重保持打包状态在片上扩展为INT8操作数，与8位权重共享INT8计算路径；prefill使用Tensor Core MMA（权重复用），decode使用DP4A点积（并行度高）。

Result: 在Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen3-4B、Ministral-3-8B、Qwen3-14B四个模型上，AlignQuant相对BF16实现最高2.50×生成加速（132.28 tok/s vs 58.18 tok/s，Llama-3.2-3B），同时WikiText-2困惑度仅从12.49升至12.61（远优于W4A8的13.51）。内存从5.99 GiB降至2.72 GiB，能耗降低约44%。在A100、H100 NVL、RTX 4090三种GPU及最长64K上下文上均验证有效，长上下文检索任务（如LooGLE-SD 64K）保留48.06 vs BF16 48.81的成绩，远超MixLLM（47.24）和AWQ（41.69）。消融实验证实局部精度选择优于output-row、reduction-column、projection/layer等结构化分配和随机分配。

Conclusion: AlignQuant证明了通过共享tile单元，局部精度灵活性与规则GPU执行可以共存。核心原则是：为紧凑存储和规则执行设计精度单元，然后基于局部输出敏感性分配比特。这一设计原则对未来量化器设计具有更广泛的指导意义。

Abstract: Fine-grained mixed-precision quantization promises efficient large language model inference, but local precision choices can conflict with regular GPU storage and computation units. This precision-boundary mismatch limits the translation of compression into practical acceleration. We introduce AlignQuant, a post-training quantization method that uses GPU-compatible two-dimensional weight tiles as the common unit of precision allocation, compact storage, and execution. This shared partition lets precision follow sensitivity within output channels. Joint prefill/decode calibration scores precision reductions using projection-output perturbations weighted by language-model loss gradients under quantized activations. Phase-normalized scores prioritize higher precision for tiles important to either phase under a model-wide weight-storage budget. Each tile stores one selected representation, while phase-specialized kernels reuse the packed model and expand lower-bit weights for INT8 computation with 8-bit activations. Across four LLMs spanning 3B to 14B parameters, AlignQuant achieves up to $2.50\times$ generation speedup over BF16 while preserving model quality. Evaluations further cover three GPUs and contexts up to 64K tokens. These results show that local precision flexibility and regular GPU execution can coexist through a shared tile unit. The implementation is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [261] [Structure, Not Belief: Correlated Thompson Sampling from LLM-Derived Covariance in Combinatorial Semi-Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07470)
*Vikram Kakaria,Anish Kataria,Anany Kotawala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结构感知的相关Thompson采样方法（GP-CTS/CorrCTS-Full），仅利用LLM一次性返回的臂聚类信息构建协方差矩阵 Σ，改变采样协方差而非注入先验信念。理论证明 K log T 信息增益上界，并证实在合成Bernoulli家族上相对独立采样减少19%累积遗憾，在MIND-small新闻基准上减少41%；消融实验表明收益主要来自核形状（tempering）而非聚类质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统组合Thompson采样（CTS）对每个臂独立采样后验，忽略了臂之间的相关性。现有LLM增强的bandit方法通常将LLM信息作为信念注入（如先验、伪观测、推荐混合），存在反馈循环失败模式：LLM的回答质量依赖于其被展示的估计数据，而这些数据又取决于学习者自身的轨迹，错误信念会以真实观测为代价偏置后验。本文试图利用LLM提供臂的聚类结构信息，仅修改采样协方差而非后验均值和方差，以更安全的方式利用LLM知识。

Method: 1. 设置组合半bandit问题（d个臂，每轮选m个），LLM在预热时间T_w被查询一次，返回K个簇的划分；2. 通过RBF核将聚类等级映射为正定相关矩阵 Σ = ρ_max·G + (1-ρ_max)·I_d（rank(G) ≤ K）；3. 提出GP-CTS(Σ)与近似算法CorrCTS-Full：每轮从Beta后验取均值和标准差(μ̄_i, σ_i)，采样 ε ~ N(0, I_d)，令 θ = μ̄ + σ ⊙ (Lε)，其中L是Σ的Cholesky因子，保持边缘分布但改变联合采样；4. RobustCorrCTS加入可信度权重w ∈ [0,1]，在聚类质量差时回退到独立采样；5. 理论分析：证明GP-CTS(Σ)的贝叶斯遗憾上界为 O(√(2C_c m σ² β_T T γ_T))，其中γ_T = (K/2)log(1+ρτ²N/(Kσ²)) + min{...}，√(d/K)优势仅在ρ→1时精确成立，是有限期的暂态。

Result: 1. E1（合成，T=2500）：CorrCTS-Full减少18.9%遗憾（262/58胜，p<10⁻⁴），RandomCorr减少7.1%，warm-start和rec-mixing分别减少15.5%和增益小；2. E2（T=25000）：CorrCTS-Full/CorrCTS-Prune/CorrCTS-KM分别减少4.5%/6.1%/6.8%，均p<10⁻⁴；3. E3（MIND-small，d=200真实文章）：CorrCTS-Full减少41.1%遗憾（134/1胜，p<10⁻⁶）；4. 消融实验：随机划分+随机排序仍获得+13.8%，质量排序+13.9%，对抗聚类+14.2%——证明收益主要来自核形状而非聚类质量；5. tempered CTS-Gaussian（c=0.6，无核)在T=2,500获得+27.1%，是最强基线；6. 在ε=0至1范围内，结构采样器保持+14%至+18%，rec-mixing从+5.8%衰减至-10.5%，GP-CTS(Σ)最多仅+3.9%。

Conclusion: 将LLM信息从后验转移到采样协方差在构造上是安全的（命题1），并在中等时间窗口上有效；匹配oracle质量的信念注入并不起作用。固定相关矩阵通过Slepian不等式（引理5）和tempering解释（引理6）改变探索动态，无论划分正确与否；分区信息对正确的贝叶斯采样器仅提供暂态优势（定理4），仅在存在潜在结构的地方（MIND）才重要。最强的无LLM竞争者是简单的tempered采样器(c=0.6)。

Abstract: Combinatorial Thompson sampling (CTS) draws independent posterior samples for every arm, so its exploration dynamics ignore any relation among arms. We study a minimal change to those dynamics: an LLM is queried once for a partition of the arms, the partition becomes a positive-definite correlation matrix $\Sigma$ through an RBF kernel on cluster ranks, and the per-round posterior sample is drawn with covariance $\Sigma$ while the Beta posteriors are updated from real rewards only, so the LLM shapes how the sampler moves, not what it believes. We give a self-contained Bayesian regret bound for the idealized Gaussian sampler whose information gain splits into a $K\log T$ term from the $K$-cluster structure and a ridge term that grows to $d\log T$: the $\sqrt{d/K}$ improvement over independent sampling is a finite-horizon transient, exact only as the within-cluster correlation tends to one. The correlated sampler reduces regret by 19% over CTS on 16 synthetic Bernoulli families at $T=2{,}500$ (6-7% at $T=25{,}000$ with data-adaptive kernels) and by 41% on the Microsoft MIND-small news benchmark ($d=200$ real articles), while pseudo-observation warm starts give nothing. An LLM-free ablation with a simulated oracle of controlled quality shows that on unstructured instances the gain is a property of the kernel shape (a random partition, or a plain tempering of the sampling noise, reproduces it), while belief injection at matched oracle quality never helps.

</details>


### [262] [Who Bears the Burden? Learning Responsibility for Shared Constraints in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07491)
*Xiaoyang Cao,Jingqi Li,Zhe Fu,Alexandre M. Bayen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LiRA（Lagrangian Responsibility Allocation），通过学习每个智能体对公共乘子的"责任份额"来优化多智能体约束强化学习中的社会福利。LiRA在保持公共乘子执行聚合预算的同时，重新分配其对各智能体的影响力。作者证明在凸博弈条件下，责任份额变化会沿活跃成本表面产生社会福利不同的均衡族，并推导了包含数据分布变化的有限训练梯度。在CityLearn、MABIM、Harvest和MetaDrive四个基准上（3至400个智能体），LiRA在平均社会福利上比均匀分配和个体化乘法平均基线最高提升29%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多智能体共享约束场景中（如功率限制、碰撞避免、安全要求），公共拉格朗日乘子虽然能执行聚合约束，但未规定其惩罚如何在智能体间分配。均匀分配忽略了智能体为满足约束所牺牲奖励的异质性，而个体化乘子在面对相同聚合成本信号时也存在类似问题。如何将约束的"责任"在各智能体间进行最优分配以提升社会福利，是一个未解决的问题。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 责任分配机制——引入责任份额ρ_ik（通过softmax映射的可学习参数），将其与公共乘子λ结合形成各智能体的有效惩罚系数μ=Nλρ，从而在保持预算不变的前提下重新分配压力；(2) 均衡选择定理（定理1）——在凸博弈条件下，证明责任份额变化产生一个光滑的归一化广义纳什均衡族，活跃约束仍保持在预算水平但社会福利可变；(3) 有限训练责任梯度（定理2）——推导包含直接展开项（DU）和采样修正项（SC）的福利梯度，通过从同一检查点进行M≥2个独立前瞻来估计，避免修改主学习轨迹。算法从检查点x₀出发，每个外层周期运行M个独立q步前瞻，然后恢复检查点进行u次实时更新。

Result: 在四个基准测试上，LiRA在所有任务中均获得最高平均社会福利：CityLearn（3智能体，1约束）从-16.87k提升至-14.51k，电网超额维持在预算28.76 kWh附近；MABIM（400智能体，2约束）从-596.31M提升至-591.36M，同时降低更紧张的拒绝成本；Harvest（7智能体，1约束）从42.73提升至50.27，更好地利用预算余量；MetaDrive（4智能体，1约束）从49.72提升至64.26，安全事件从1.017降至0.890（低于1.00上限）。CityLearn案例分析显示，LiRA将更大责任份额分配给过度制冷的两栋建筑（0.395和0.387，对比第三栋的0.218），使它们减少制冷、恢复舒适度，同时降低区域用电量。总体福利提升最高达29%。

Conclusion: LiRA通过将共享约束惩罚的分配变为可学习参数，在均衡状态下实现了活跃成本保持预算水平的同时改变社会福利。有限训练梯度通过对学习动态求导并修正采样分布变化，使方法适用于深度RL训练。在四个不同规模和约束类型的基准测试中，学习的责任分配一致优于均匀和个体化乘子基线。CityLearn案例证实福利提升可追溯到个体建筑行为变化。局限性：定理1要求自有凹收益和凸共享成本等条件，深度策略网络违反这些条件；责任份额为状态无关的，无法根据状态（如高峰期）动态调整。

Abstract: When multiple agents share a cost budget, a common Lagrange multiplier can enforce the aggregate constraint but does not determine how its penalty should be allocated across agents. Uniform penalties ignore heterogeneity in the rewards agents sacrifice, while agent-specific multipliers may still rely on the same aggregate cost signal. We introduce Lagrangian Responsibility Allocation (LiRA), which learns each agent's share of a common multiplier by optimizing social welfare over a finite training horizon. The multiplier enforces the aggregate budget, while responsibility shares redistribute its influence without modifying the original rewards or constraints. For convex games under standard regularity conditions, varying these shares induces a smooth family of normalized generalized Nash equilibria in which active constraints remain at their budgets while welfare varies. To optimize responsibility before convergence, we derive a welfare gradient that accounts for both learning updates and the induced change in data distribution. Across CityLearn, MABIM, Harvest, and MetaDrive, spanning 3 to 400 agents, LiRA improves average social welfare by up to 29% over uniform and agent-specific multiplier baselines. Grid and driving costs remain within budget, inventory violations decrease, and Harvest makes more effective use of available budget.

</details>


### [263] [Harmful SFT Leaves a Continuous Trace in LLM Checkpoint Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07518)
*Ziqun Bao,Xinyu Zhang,Yuchen Shao,Chengcheng Wan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现有害性妥协监督微调(SFT)在检查点更新空间中留下连续的目标依赖排序痕迹，提出仅基于权重的审计方法TRACE，无需模型查询或训练数据即可检测有害微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型安全审计主要依赖模型行为评估，需要执行模型且依赖评估覆盖范围。对于开源权重模型，检查点可被进一步适配和重新分发，但后训练数据和目标未知。因此需要一种不依赖模型查询或训练数据即可检测有害微调的方法。

Method: 1)将后SFT模型表示为相对于可信基础模型的参数更新ΔW；2)定义三种纯目标参考几何：有害妥协(C)、安全导向(S)、良性实用(B)，构建原型μ_C、μ_S、μ_B；3)通过非负最小二乘将未知检查点更新表示为μ_C和平衡非有害原型μ_N的组合；4)定义有害目标坐标s_H = γ_C/(γ_C+γ_N+ε)作为连续有害目标分数；5)整个TRACE方法仅依赖检查点权重和内核计算，无需模型查询或访问SFT数据。

Result: 在四个7-8B骨干模型(Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen3-8B、OLMo-3-7B)上，有害目标坐标s_H与控制的有害目标比例的Spearman相关性达0.986-0.992，R²达0.948-0.991。匹配C/S对照证明痕迹反映SFT目标而非有害输入暴露。TRACE在ID设置AUROC达0.911，匹配C/S AUROC达0.988，OOD AUROC达1.000，未见数据AUROC达0.9998，显著优于所有基线方法(UpdateNorm、Spectral、WeightWatch-SVD、PEFTGuard、CANARY)。在Qwen3-14B和Qwen3-32B上同样保持强痕迹(ρ=0.994和0.960)。s_H与独立测量的攻击成功率(ASR)正相关(Llama ρ=0.931)。即使在5%有害目标比例下，TRACE对良性检查点AUROC达0.995。在10,000样本异构指令调优的实用规模测试中，痕迹依然稳定(ρ=0.979和0.992)。

Conclusion: 有害妥协SFT在检查点更新空间中诱导出目标依赖的连续排序结构，跨越数据分布、SFT配置、部分检查点访问、LoRA/全参数微调均保持稳定。TRACE作为仅基于权重的审计方法，在无需模型查询或训练数据的情况下有效检测有害微调，为行为评估不可用或不完整时提供了补充审计信号。局限性：仅评估SFT场景、模型最大32B、目标设置受控；未来工作将延伸至RL和多阶段后训练。

Abstract: Safety auditing of post-trained large language models typically relies on model behavior, requiring model execution and depending on the coverage of available evaluations. This work asks a different question: Do the target behaviors optimized during supervised fine-tuning (SFT) leave readable evidence directly in checkpoint updates? We find that harmful-compliance SFT induces a continuous, objective-dependent ordering in checkpoint-update space. Using a reference geometry defined by pure harmful-compliance, safety-targeted, and benign-utility SFT, we find that a checkpoint-level coordinate s_H tracks controlled harmful-objective composition with Spearman correlations of 0.986-0.992 across four 7-8B backbones, with the same ordering persisting at larger model scales. Matched compliance-versus-refusal controls show that this checkpoint trace reflects the SFT objective rather than harmful-input exposure, while additional controls rule out simple explanations based on harmful-example count or generic training intensity. Building on this structure, we introduce TRACE, a weights-only auditing method that localizes an unknown checkpoint update relative to frozen harmful and non-harmful reference prototypes and converts this geometry into a continuous harmful-objective score. TRACE requires neither model queries nor access to the unknown SFT data, and can be evaluated directly from checkpoint updates. Across distribution shifts, unseen data, different SFT configurations, partial checkpoint access, and LoRA/full-parameter fine-tuning, the trace remains stable and is positively associated with independently measured attack success rates. TRACE remains informative even at low harmful-objective proportions, providing a complementary auditing signal when behavioral evaluation is unavailable or incomplete. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [264] [Foundation Model-Aided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Wireless Random Access Network Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07550)
*Myeung Suk Oh,Zhiyao Zhang,Alvaro Velasquez,Nathaniel D. Bastian,Jia Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于基础模型(FM)的去中心化多智能体强化学习(MARL)框架，用于优化无线随机接入(RA)网络。通过将预训练FM作为与奖励无关的评论家骨干网络，并采用基于共识的去中心化架构，实现了在多种RA优化任务上的更快收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统MARL方法在无线RA网络优化中存在两个主要局限：(1) 集中式训练与去中心化执行(CTDE)范式依赖中央控制器，难以大规模部署且存在单点故障和隐私问题；(2) 现有MARL模型针对特定任务过拟合，改变优化目标需重新训练架构，导致样本效率差且泛化能力有限。基础模型(FM)虽在跨任务表示学习中表现出色，但如何将其有效集成到具有理论性能保证的RL框架中尚不明确。

Method: 1. 设计基于共识的去中心化MARL架构，采用分散训练与分散执行(DTDE)范式，设备间通过局部对等通信同步；2. 引入基于SMART架构的FM，采用前向动力学预测进行自监督预训练，将其作为评论家网络中与奖励无关的骨干网络，并附加任务特定头部；3. 设计FM辅助的去中心化Actor-Critic算法，设备间仅交换标量局部奖励而非完整评论家参数；4. 提供有限时间收敛性分析，针对局部奖励共识和非线性值函数近似，证明算法达到与基于评论家模型交换和线性近似的传统MARL相同的收敛阶。

Result: 数值实验在三个RA优化任务上进行（公平信息年龄(AoI)、最大和速率、公平速率）。主要结果表明：(1) FM辅助的MARL相比端到端训练基线和传统MARL基线，学习速度提升至少55%；(2) 算法在K=4和K=8设备时，达到95%最优性能所需时间显著缩短（例如K=4时Fair-AoI任务从335秒降至108秒）；(3) 理论分析表明算法以O(1/N_T)速率收敛至全局最优邻域，且深度对收敛界的影响比宽度更显著。

Conclusion: 该工作成功将FM集成到去中心化MARL框架中，通过自监督预训练学习网络动力学表示，显著提升跨多种RA优化目标的收敛速度。未来工作将扩展至更复杂的无线RA场景，如考虑发射功率控制的更大动作空间。

Abstract: Random access (RA) is one of the most foundational medium access control (MAC) layer scheduling schemes for handling unpredictable data traffic from multiple terminals. While multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has been explored to optimize RA-based wireless networks, its reliance on experience-driven, distributed policy learning incurs significant training overhead for each optimization task, limiting its feasibility in real-world applications. In this work, we propose to leverage a foundation model (FM) to improve MARL efficiency across diverse RA network optimization tasks. Specifically, we design an FM-aided actor-critic algorithm within a consensus-based decentralized MARL architecture and provide its convergence analysis under local reward exchanges and nonlinear value function approximations to show that our algorithm achieves the same convergence order as the conventional MARL with critic model exchanges and linear approximations. Our numerical results show that our FM-based approach significantly enhances MARL speed for RA network optimization.

</details>


### [265] [Which and When to Admit: Gradient Admission for Data-Centric Small Language Model Finetuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07553)
*Hongyu Cao,Yanchi Liu,Kunpeng Liu,Xujiang Zhao,Wei Cheng,Zhengzhang Chen,Yanjie Fu,Haifeng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出GRADE框架，将数据中心的LoRA微调从"选哪些数据"转变为"允许哪些梯度进入低秩子空间以及何时提交"，通过状态感知梯度对齐选择器和自校准步级准入门的耦合机制，在异构监督下稳定SLM微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA微调在受限低秩子空间下处理异构指令数据时存在三种结构脆弱性：(1)梯度冲突——异质监督产生不兼容的更新方向，在受限子空间内相互抵消；(2)状态不匹配——静态/一次性数据选择无法跟踪训练过程中多任务学习方向的演变；(3)子空间覆盖——低秩更新空间饱和后，后续更新会覆盖有用的已有方向。现有方法（数据选择、稳定性正则化、自适应LoRA）均假设一旦数据被选中，其梯度就可接受，这一假设在受限容量下崩溃。

Method: GRADE包含两个耦合组件：(1)状态感知梯度对齐选择器——通过前向扰动探针估计每样本梯度与演化多任务参考方向的方向一致性（内积得分），采用top-k_b样本准入，保持比例r*由池梯度几何解析确定（r*=cos_intra/(cos_intra+(T-1)cos_inter)）；(2)自校准步级准入门——维护探测损失的EMA基线，在训练初期（门未锁定时）执行标准LoRA，当相对斜率触发阈值时锁定，之后仅当当前步探测损失不差于EMA基线时才提交基础LoRA更新。两个组件形成闭环：选择决定入参池方向，入参池改变LoRA参数，更新后的适配器改变后续兼容性评分。

Result: 在三个当代骨干（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B、Gemma-2-9B）和7个异构指令数据集组成的约21K样本池（含40%噪声样本）上，GRADE是唯一在所有架构上均实现严格正Worst-Δ（+0.18pp）的方法，Mean-Δ达+0.99pp（最高）。消融表明：单独样本准入略劣于LoRA（-0.22 vs -0.15pp），单独步级准入仍存在2/3架构回归，仅联合策略（on,on）实现跨架构非回归。梯度流连贯性提升5倍，准入门稳态skip比例接近0.5的理论预测。代价：增加约1.3-1.5倍前向计算开销。

Conclusion: 成功的小语言模型微调不仅取决于选择哪些数据，更取决于哪些数据诱导的梯度被允许进入并持续存在于受限的适配子空间。GRADE将LoRA微调从无累积转变为受控准入，为异构监督与受限自适应容量并存场景下的数据中心学习提供了更广泛的设计原则。局限：使用前向探针近似而非精确逐样本梯度，在固定参数化内固定，限于8-9B指令调优骨干评估；扩展到更丰富估计器、自适应LoRA参数化及更广泛模型/数据范围是未来方向。

Abstract: LoRA fine-tuning adapts small language models (SLMs) to heterogeneous instruction data within a low-rank update subspace, making it vulnerable to three structural problems: conflicting gradients that cancel, static data selection that cannot track evolving learning dynamics, and subspace saturation that causes later updates to overwrite useful directions. We argue that effective adaptation therefore requires controlling which data-induced gradients enter the LoRA subspace and when. We propose GRADE (GRadient-Aligned Data-centric rEcipe), a data-centric framework combining two mechanisms: a state-aware selector that continually admits samples aligned with the evolving multi-task gradient field, and a self-calibrating step-level gate that rejects updates likely to cause destructive overwrite near saturation. Across three current-generation backbones and a heterogeneous seven-dataset instruction pool, GRADE outperforms strong data-selection and PEFT-stabilization baselines in accuracy and robustness. It is the only method to improve consistently over standard LoRA on every architecture, while producing more coherent gradient trajectories and less destructive overwrite. These results show that successful SLM adaptation depends not only on which data are selected, but also on which gradients are allowed to enter and persist in the constrained update subspace.

</details>


### [266] [Learning a Mixture of GFlowNets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07562)
*Tiago da Silva,Amauri H. Souza,Salem Lahlou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一的理论框架来描述GFlowNet混合模型，并将其分为连续索引(CI)和离散索引(DI)两类。CI GFlowNets通过随机特征扩展提升GNN-based采样器的表达能力并稳定训练；DI GFlowNets统一了现有方法，并催生了新提出的Stratum-Conditioned (SC) GFlowNets，该方法通过模块化函数划分状态空间，支持集中式和并行训练，显著加速收敛并改善模式覆盖，且不增加额外的计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GFlowNets作为离散空间的变分推断方法，在状态空间探索、训练收敛速度和稳定性方面面临挑战。已有的集成（ensemble）方法虽有所改善，但存在显著的运行时开销且缺乏统一的概念框架。本文旨在建立一个通用的理论框架来描述GFlowNet混合模型，以统一现有方法并指导新算法的设计，从而解决探索不足、收敛慢和不稳定等问题。

Method: 1. 提出统一的混合GFlowNet理论框架，引入索引空间Γ、先验混合分布p_M和后验混合分布q_M，推导出混合轨迹平衡(MTB)条件。
2. 连续索引(CI) GFlowNets：将γ视为连续向量（如随机特征），解释为图学习中的随机特征扩展，证明其通用逼近性，并通过谱偏移稳定训练。
3. 离散索引(DI) GFlowNets：将Γ视为离散集合，利用稀疏后验分布实现状态空间覆盖，统一了SAL和Boosted GFlowNets等现有方法。
4. 提出Stratum-Conditioned (SC) GFlowNets：利用模块化函数ψ（如轨迹长度、Hamming权重、对参考集的交集大小）将状态空间划分为"层"(stratum)，每个组件采样各自子空间；通过Doob h-transform建立理论联系，支持集中式（共享网络+索引嵌入）和 embarrassingly parallel（ASC）训练。

Result: 实验表明，SC GFlowNets在Set Generation、Hypergrid、Ancestral Graphs、Autoregressive Sequence Generation、Lazy Random Walk（Rings和Gaussian Mixture）以及Variable Selection等多个基准任务上均显著加速学习收敛并改善模式覆盖。其壁钟时间与单组件采样器几乎相同，且在计算效率（FLOPs和运行时间）上优于Boosted GFlowNets。在Hypergrid域中，随机特征CI GFlowNets降低了学习方差并稳定了训练。理论分析证明CI GFlowNets是通用逼近器，SC GFlowNets的组件通过Doob h-transform相互关联。

Conclusion: 本文提出的统一框架为GFlowNet集成方法提供了理论基础，SC GFlowNets作为一种简单而有效的DI GFlowNet实例化，以零额外计算成本显著提升了学习效率和探索能力，为GFlowNet研究建立了一个最小化的基线。未来工作应集中于自动化的状态空间划分策略以及该框架的进一步应用。

Abstract: Learning an ensemble of GFlowNets to sample from a discrete target distribution has become a common approach for achieving better state space exploration and convergence than that of a monolithic sampler. However, these methods often add a substantial runtime overhead to the base model, and their conceptual connection remains elusive. To address this, we first propose a general-purpose theoretical framework for describing a mixture of GFlowNets, which we specialize into continuously (CI) and discretely indexed (DI) collections. On the one hand, we show CI GFlowNets can be interpreted through the lens of a random features expansion, provably boosting the sampler's expressivity in graph-structured tasks and reducing learning instability via spectral shifting. On the other hand, we demonstrate DI GFlowNets encompass prior approaches for GFlowNet training and provide the foundation for the newly proposed Stratum-Conditioned (SC) GFlowNets. This method, which is inspired by the Doob's h-transform of Markov chains, decomposes the state space according to a prescribed modular function and restricts each component to sample from a distinct subset of it. Importantly, SC GFlowNets support centralized and component-wise embarrassingly parallel training, and we show both of them significantly speed up learning convergence and mode coverage without introducing any non-negligible extra computation.

</details>


### [267] [Complementary Feature Domains: Information Preservation Does Not Imply Predictive-Contribution Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07565)
*Timothy Oladunni,Farouk Ganiyu-Adewumi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"互补特征域"（CFD）理论,核心论断是:Shannon信息保持并不蕴含预测贡献保持。通过形式化"CFD贡献缺陷"作为表示重编码下的上下文贡献变化度量,并证明在有界Lipschitz效用下,该缺陷由编码前后可达动作集之间的行为距离控制。通过XOR有限反例、心电图受控重编码实验验证了机制:非线性双射重编码保持信息但改变仿射学习器下的准确性,施加精确逆映射则完全恢复所有联盟准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代预测系统常融合多种表示(时域、频域、时频等),但存在一个核心直觉误区:可逆重编码(g为双射)保持Shannon互信息I(D';Y)=I(D;Y),因此被视为"无害"。然而预测依赖于受限的决策规则族,若该族无法实现补偿映射g⁻¹,两个信息等价的编码可能产生不同的可达决策和不同的预测效用。在多表示融合场景下,单个表示的"上下文边际贡献"(即在已有其他表示的基础上该表示新增多少效用)可能在信息保持的重编码下发生改变,而上下文无关的相关性评分无法描述这种转变。

Method: 方法体系包含四个层面:(1)定义"贡献系统"——对表示系统Φ与实现族𝒜,定义联盟效用包络V*Φ,𝒜(S)=sup E[u(Y,a(D_S))],以及上下文边际贡献Δ*(i|S)=V*(S∪{i})−V*(S),整个联盟格上的贡献集合构成完整贡献系统ℭ*(Φ,𝒜)。(2)有限反例构造——通过XOR问题及其双射重编码,在四等概率源上证明I(D;Y)=I(D';Y)=1bit但仿射最优精度分别为0.75和1.00(Lemma 1);进一步通过添加独立干扰位证明子集信息等价不蕴含贡献等价(Proposition 1)。(3)形式化"兼容性缺陷"ε_g(S;𝒜,ℬ)——基于可达动作集ℋ_S与ℋ_S^g之间的对称L¹(P)Hausdorff距离;定义"CFD贡献缺陷"Γ_g(i|S;𝒜,ℬ)=|Δ*_gΦ,ℬ(i|S)−Δ*Φ,𝒜(i|S)|。(4)稳定性定理(Theorem 1)——证明|E_g(S)|≤L·ε_g(S;𝒜,ℬ),由此推出Γ_g(i|S)≤L[ε_g(S∪{i};𝒜,ℬ)+ε_g(S;𝒜,ℬ)],系统级稳定律‖ℭ*(gΦ,ℬ)−ℭ*(Φ,𝒜)‖∞≤2L·max_S ε_g(S;𝒜,ℬ)。推论表明精确闭包(ε_g=0)蕴含不变性,渐近补偿则恢复不变性。实验验证包括:(a)容量压力测试——在XOR与重编码支持上比较仿射、二次逻辑回归、RBF-SVM、深度2决策树的精度;(b)上下文-容量合成计算——3个独立公平比特在Parity/Majority/OR/AND目标下的贝叶斯与仿射边际贡献;(c)ECG受控重编码实验——对928个观测的冻结时域、频域、时频嵌入中TF分量施加g(x)=sgn(x)|x|³及其精确逆g⁻¹,在固定仿射(逻辑回归)学习器下比较原始/重编码/恢复三种条件,通过5000次配对自助法评估精度差的不确定性。

Result: 理论结果:(1)建立了信息保持与预测贡献保持之间的逻辑分离链——信息等价⇏实现等价,信息等价⇏贡献等价,但行为实现等价⇒贡献等价。(2)提供了贡献转变的定量上界,由编码前后可达动作集的行为距离控制。实验结果:(a)容量压力测试中,仿射族在XOR与重编码上呈现0.25的精度差距,而二次逻辑回归、RBF-SVM、深度2决策树均将差距消除至0。(b)Parity目标下D₃在空集、单伴、{1}、{2}、{1,2}上下文中的贡献签名为c_{3,B}=(0,0,0,0.5)与c_{3,A}=(0,0,0,0.25),展示上下文可创造信息机会而实现能力决定多少机会转化为效用。(c)ECG实验中,cubic重编码使TF单独精度从0.7372降至0.6277(差距−0.1095),T+TF从0.6569降至0.5839(差距−0.0730),F+TF从0.7883降至0.5912(差距−0.1971),T+F+TF从0.7372降至0.6058(差距−0.1314);施加精确逆映射g⁻¹后所有联盟精度完全恢复至原始值,恢复误差在所有四个上下文中均为0且自助区间为[0,0]。这直接验证了精确行为闭包导致不变性的推论。

Conclusion: CFD理论将表示层面的信息保持与预测层面的贡献保持明确区分开来,通过联盟与实现族双重索引贡献,提供了表示-实现干预下上下文预测贡献转变的定量框架。兼容性界表明Γ_g(i|S)由添加i前后的实现不兼容性控制:精确闭包强制不变性,近似闭包则界定变化幅度。非零缺陷不必然意味着信息损失,而可能揭示表示与学习器之间的失配。理论补充了PID(信息分解)、预测𝒱-信息(族相关可用信息)、Blackwell比较(统计实验排序)与Shapley归因(平均化贡献)——CFD保留了干预下联盟索引的贡献变化,而非对其进行平均。局限在于:该界是充分条件,有限样本误差处于总体定理范围之外,更广泛的任务、实现族与不确定性保证留待未来工作。ECG实验验证了预测的失败-恢复模式,但cubic映射本身并非最优ECG表示,而是一种受控的可逆干预工具。

Abstract: Complementary Feature Domains (CFD) theory characterizes predictive value as a context-indexed contribution system induced jointly by representations and their realization family. We show that Shannon-information preservation does not imply preservation of this contribution system: an invertible representation transformation can leave target information unchanged while altering predictive contribution under a restricted decision family. We formalize the resulting transition through a CFD contribution defect that measures how contextual contributions change under controlled recoding. For bounded Lipschitz utility, we show that each coalition utility shift is bounded by the behavioral distance between the attainable action sets before and after recoding; consequently, every contextual contribution defect is bounded by the sum of the corresponding coalition incompatibilities. Exact behavioral closure yields invariance, while increasingly accurate compensation yields restoration. A controlled ECG experiment illustrates the mechanism: a nonlinear bijective recoding preserves the information in a frozen time-frequency representation but changes accuracy under a fixed affine learner; applying the exact inverse restores all tested coalition accuracies. The result separates information preservation from realization-dependent contribution and provides a quantitative transition law for multi-representation prediction.

</details>


### [268] [Mechanistic Interpretability of Atmospheric Rivers in GraphCast](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07583)
*Madelyn Mathai,Timothy B. Higgins,Kevin M. Grise,Chirag Agarwal,Antonios Mamalakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对GraphCast天气预报模型训练标准稀疏自编码器(SAE)与Matryoshka SAE,在不同网络层提取其学到的"概念",重点分析大气河(Atmospheric Rivers)强度的内部表征。结果表明:尽管IVT既不是输入也不是预测目标,GraphCast却将其作为稳定的因果性内部变量进行计算;Matryoshka SAE按重要性有序排列概念并揭示出父-子嵌套结构(广义的AR概念与更强烈的AR子概念);通过激活干预实验因果性验证了关键概念的驱动作用。该方法为理解AI天气模型内部机制及评估气候变化下模型可靠性提供了新途径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI数值天气预报模型(如GraphCast)虽精度已比肩业务预报,但其内部如何表示大气仍属黑箱。现有可解释性方法(如特征归因)仅能揭示输入重要性,无法说明模型内部计算了什么、如何组合信息。理解内部表征是科学发现与模型可信部署的前提,尤其是评估气候变化下模型所学概念是否仍具物理意义。

Method: 1. 在GraphCast的0、8、15层(512维mesh节点激活)上,分别训练Standard SAE和Matryoshka SAE,字典大小4096,每样本Top-K=32稀疏激活,均使用AuxK死潜变量复活机制。2. Matryoshka SAE将4096个潜变量分为5个有序前缀组(G0–G4),核心组捕获最常用概念,外壳组捕获更稀有更具体的概念。3. 以大气河强度(IVT,综合水汽输送,模型未学过的物理量)为锚点评估潜变量激活。4. 定义"空间包含度"c衡量子概念被父概念空间覆盖的比例,识别嵌套关系。5. 通过缩放因子β进行激活干预(causal steering):在forward pass中对潜变量code缩放或写入,验证概念因果性。

Result: 1. Matryoshka SAE在G0核心组找到最强全局AR概念Concept 99,其区域平均激活与区域最大IVT在四个主要受影响区域(北美西岸、西欧、南美西岸、澳洲东部)的全周期相关达r=0.51。2. Concept 3153是其强嵌套子概念(c=0.953,95%CI [0.949,0.956]),表征相同地理范围但IVT更强的事件(均值570 vs 460 kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹),并非特征分裂,属于按强度嵌套。3. 干预Concept 99可单调调节AR内部降水(经由水汽通道而非风动力通道):放大则降水增强但柱水汽迅速耗尽,移除则削弱AR;但干预Concept 3153无效,说明GraphCast同时拥有"检测型"与"驱动型"概念。4. 跨深度上,Matryoshka字典从宽泛到细化,而Standard SAE从窄到泛化;Matryoshka给概念以稳定地址,便于跨层追踪同一概念。

Conclusion: GraphCast虽未以IVT为训练目标,但内部将其作为稳定因果变量计算,体现了模型涌现出物理意义表征。Matryoshka SAE在GNN中的首次应用,提供了有序、可追溯、可因果干预的概念字典,使AI天气模型从黑箱转变为可审计系统。该方法可推广至其他大气现象,为评估模型在气候变化下所学变量是否仍具物理意义奠定基础。

Abstract: While AI weather models now rival operational forecasts, how they represent the atmosphere internally remains an open question: feature attribution reveals which input patterns matter, not what the model computes or how it combines information internally. We train sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on GraphCast to uncover its learned concepts, using atmospheric rivers as our phenomenon of focus. Both standard and Matryoshka SAEs show GraphCast computes atmospheric river intensity, measured by integrated vapor transport (IVT), as a stable internal variable, despite IVT being neither an input nor a target. In contrast to the unstructured concept retrieval of the standard SAE, the Matryoshka SAE orders concepts by importance and exposes their relations. Atmospheric river concepts persist across depth and direct interventions confirm causality. This method offers a way to find internal variables and determine which of them the model actually relies on, which is a prerequisite for asking whether those variables remain meaningful as the phenomenon changes under a warming climate.

</details>


### [269] [Stateless Language Agents: Scaling Long-Horizon Automated Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07625)
*Qizheng Zhang,Changxiu Ji,Isaac Sun,Yuetai Li,Shubhangi Upasani,Sherry Ruan,Boyuan Ma,Fenglu Hong,Vamsidhar Kamanuru,Yoonho Lee,Yuzhen Mao,Genghan Zhang,Rulin Shao,Qiuyang Mang,Andy Dimnaku,Changran Hu,Radha Poovendran,Kunle Olukotun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出无状态语言智能体（Stateless Language Agents, SLA）框架，将研究状态从智能体对话中分离到外部harness中管理，以解决长程自动研究中智能体重复历史、互相重复工作和过早停止的问题。SLA在软件工程、内核优化和算法设计等任务上，以最多10亿token的预算，在所有任务上均取得最优结果，且仅需不到84%的token即可达到最强基线的最终性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体在长程自动研究中的应用增加，但更多推理并不自动带来更多进展：智能体会重放增长的历史、互相重复工作或停止实验但token仍在消耗。现有评估多使用短预算或早期饱和的基准，无法测试这些失败模式。本文将失败归因于两个选择：研究状态存放在哪里、谁决定下一步尝试什么。

Method: 核心原则是"有状态搜索+无状态智能体"：没有任何智能体跨调用保留对话，所有研究状态（候选解和测量结果）由harness拥有；每次调用时，harness根据角色重新构建一个全新的、角色特定的上下文。基于此构建SLA框架，包含两个机制：(1)harness控制的上下文重建——无状态Advisor看到跨搜索方向的汇总证据，每个无状态Worker只看到其分配任务、保留候选和局部反馈；(2)证据驱动的工作分配——Advisor将全局证据转化为具体实验，分配给并行Worker，避免重复工作。使用OpenAI Codex或Claude Code实现，Advisor在每个epoch启动新会话，Worker在Linux Landlock限制下作为无权限进程运行。

Result: 在Anthropic VLIW SIMD内核优化任务上，SLA（1112.0±8.9周期）优于所有九个基线运行（包括最佳基线SwarmResearch的1275.7±133.9周期），且仅用67.9M token即可达到最强基线最终性能（减少93.1%）；在4个FrontierSWE任务上，SLA在完整700M token预算下领先，在175M（25%）时反而落后；在SOL-ExecBench和FrontierCS任务上同样取得最优结果。从共享检查点进行的消融实验表明，去除Advisor上下文重建、Worker上下文隔离或Advisor分配都会降低进展；去除Worker隔离的代价从100M token延续的5-11周期扩大到1B token完整运行的224周期。Advisor仅消耗0.24-0.51%的token和1.2-2.3%的成本。Worker数量从1增至15可将耗时缩短6.6-7.3倍。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，应使用无状态语言智能体构建长程研究系统，将研究状态保留在harness中使系统保留什么、每个智能体看到什么、谁选择下一个实验成为明确的设计选择。这些选择会复合，因此提前结束的评估可能误判方法及其组件。该原则可推广到任何智能体运行远超一个上下文窗口的场景。SLA还为后训练（每次Worker试验可作为RL episode）和安全性（所有持久状态可在harness中检查和回滚）提供了新的可能性。

Abstract: Automated research systems increasingly run LLM agents over long horizons, but more inference does not by itself produce more progress: agents replay growing histories, duplicate one another's work, or stop experimenting while token consumption continues. Yet most evaluations use short budgets or benchmarks that saturate early, leaving these failure modes untested. We trace these failures to two choices: where research state lives and who decides what to try next. We introduce Stateless Language Agents (SLAs), built on the principle of stateful search with stateless agents: no agent carries its conversation across invocations; instead, the harness owns the research state (candidate solutions and measured outcomes) and reconstructs a fresh and role-specific context for every invocation. What each agent sees becomes an explicit design choice rather than a history that grows with the run. We implement this principle in the SLA framework, where a stateless Advisor reads harness-summarized evidence across search directions and assigns concrete experiments to parallel Workers. We evaluate SLA against three recent frameworks on software engineering, kernel optimization, and algorithm design at budgets of up to one billion tokens. SLA achieves the best final result on every task and reaches the strongest kernel baseline's final performance with over 84% fewer tokens. Ablations from shared checkpoints show that focused contexts and explicit assignments each contribute to SLA's progress, with effects that can compound over full runs, while the Advisor consumes less than 0.6% of tokens. These results argue for SLAs, which keep durable research state out of agent conversations, and show that short evaluation horizons can misjudge research systems and their components.

</details>


### [270] [Does On-Policy Distillation for Safety Pose Backdoor Risks?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07654)
*Jian Luo,Kehan Qi,Qingqiao Hu,Meilong Xu,Jiacheng Qiu,Weimin Lyu,Jiawei Zhou,Chao Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了面向安全的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）存在后门传播风险：安全对齐但嵌有后门的教师模型可在极低投毒率（如3%）下将后门迁移至学生模型，同时学生在标准评估中表现得更安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于OPD的大语言模型安全对齐方法默认教师与训练数据可信，忽视了教师可能携带潜伏后门、少量投毒数据可能触发后门迁移的安全威胁。

Method: 使用bi-GRPO构建含后门的安全对齐教师（Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B/7B），在含1%–10%投毒比例的Anthropic HH-RLHF harmless-base子集上对学生进行同模型与跨规模OPD训练；比较top-k KL、采样token KL与所提Lazy Defense的KL奖励裁剪方法；通过Trigger ASR与Clean ASR两个指标在DAN、DNA、Addition、StrongREJECT、AdvBench五个安全数据集上评估，并通过Jaccard相似度分析后门学习动态。

Result: 3%投毒下Student ASR高达约70%；仅10个投毒样本训练16轮后ASR可达67%；top-k KL较采样token KL更早触发后门迁移；Lazy Defense在低投毒率下可延缓后门迁移但不能可靠阻止。

Conclusion: OPD可将教师潜伏后门传播给学生，且训练轮数与top-k KL选择会加速该过程；虽然Lazy Defense提供部分缓解，但可靠防止后门继承仍是开放问题。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has attracted growing attention as an effective way to transfer capabilities from teacher models to student models. Recent studies further explore OPD as a tool for improving large language model safety with promising results. However, these approaches typically assume that the teacher and training data are trustworthy. In this paper, we uncover an overlooked threat to OPD for safety: a safety-aligned but backdoored teacher can propagate its hidden malicious behavior to an initially clean student. Under our threat model, a poisoning rate as low as 3% results in an attack success rate (ASR) of up to 70% on the distilled student. We further identify two training choices that can amplify this risk. First, increasing the number of training epochs can lead to high ASR even at low poisoning rates. With only 10 poisoned samples, ASR reaches 67% after 16 epochs. Second, the commonly used top-k KL can accelerate backdoor transfer, causing trigger-conditioned harmful behavior to emerge earlier than sampled-token KL in most settings. Alongside these findings, we explore a simple mitigation, Lazy Defense, which clips KL rewards to make student updates less aggressive, limiting aggressive updates and slowing backdoor learning. Experiments show that Lazy Defense delays backdoor transfer in low poisoning rate settings. Together, our findings reveal that OPD can propagate backdoors, highlighting the need to address the safety risks of OPD.

</details>


### [271] [Exact-Solution Volume and Length Generalization in Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07676)
*Yijia Jessica Zhu,David Chiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"归一化精确解体积"（NESV）这一度量，用于量化单层Transformer参数空间中精确解集的占比如何随输入长度n衰减。通过对四个经典任务（FIRST、INDEX、MAJORITY、PARITY）的渐近分析，建立了NESV的上下界，并发现该体积衰减速率与长度泛化能力直接相关。基于INDEX任务的体积分解，识别出两个长度敏感参数组合，进而提出归一化位置模型𝒜_norm，将NESV从Θ(n⁻³)提升至Θ(n⁻¹)，并在10×训练长度上将准确率从60%提升至85%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Transformer表达能力研究仅回答任务是否可被某组参数实现，但无法说明这些参数解是否容易被学习，以及学到的解是否能泛化到更长序列。表达能力相同但长度泛化行为迥异（如FIRST与PARITY在Chiang & Cholak 2022中的对比）这一现象，迫切需要超越"是否存在解"的更细粒度度量。参数空间几何（特别是成功解集的体积）为理解学习性和长度泛化提供了新的视角。

Method: 1. 提出NESV（归一化精确解体积）：在有界参数立方体[-B,B]^D中，精确解集合的Lebesgue测度占比，等价于均匀采样到精确解的概率。2. 考虑固定宽度、单层单头、采用log n缩放注意力的Transformer。3. 对四个二元分类任务（FIRST位置任务、INDEX位置任务、MAJORITY计数任务、PARITY计数任务），分别在三种架构（𝒜_pos位置型、𝒜_gen通用型、𝒜_sin正弦型）下建立NESV的Θ界。4. 对INDEX任务深入分析注意力分数差距g_{k+Δ}-g_k的展开式，识别两个误差来源（一个随k²增长，一个随k增长）。5. 提出归一化模型𝒜_norm：在二次位置通道中对查询的索引依赖部分应用固定光滑有界映射F(v)=v/√(1+‖v‖²)，结构性地消除k²漂移项。6. 训练实验使用20个随机种子、Adam优化器、N∈{11,21,31,41,51}、float64精度。

Result: 主要理论结果：FIRST在𝒜_pos下NESV=Θ(1)；INDEX在𝒜_pos下NESV=Θ(n⁻³)；MAJORITY在𝒜_gen下NESV=Θ(1/(n log n))；PARITY在n>h+1时NESV=0。MAJORITY在𝒜_sin下NESV=Θ(1/(n³log n))。INDEX在归一化模型𝒜_norm下NESV从Θ(n⁻³)提升至Θ(n⁻¹)。实验结果：训练至N=51后测试L=511，FIRST保持100%准确率，MAJORITY约82.6%，INDEX在𝒜_pos下仅60%，但在𝒜_norm下达到85.1%。系数χ和ℓ与训练模型的OOD准确率呈显著负相关（-0.655和-0.516，p<10⁻³）。MAJORITY在𝒜_sin下虽然NESV更小，实验表现却与𝒜_gen相当（反例）。

Conclusion: 1. NESV是一个有价值的诊断工具：体积衰减速率与长度泛化难度高度相关，可量化表达能力之外的难度差异。2. 体积分析不仅能预测泛化能力，还能定位具体的误差来源：通过分解INDEX任务注意力分数中的长度敏感参数组合χ=aᵀs和ℓ=2bᵀs+aᵀr，可识别出结构性改进方向。3. 基于此分析设计的𝒜_norm通过在查询端应用饱和非线性F，结构性消除k²漂移项，使NESV改善两个数量级，并在实验中显著提升长度泛化。4. 局限性：NESV基于均匀参数先验，不能完全捕捉初始化和优化的实际分布；分析限于单层模型，深度Transformer可能呈现不同参数约束。5. 体积分析可作为Transformer模型优化（特别是任务特定架构改进）的诊断方法论。

Abstract: Research on transformer expressivity shows whether a transformer is capable of solving a given task, but gives little indication of whether the solution, if learned, is generalizable to longer input lengths. We study this question through normalized exact-solution volume (NESV): the fraction of a bounded parameter region that achieves an exact solution on every input of length $n$. For fixed-width, single-layer transformers with $\log n$-scaled attention, we establish asymptotic bounds on NESV for four tasks: FIRST ($\Theta(1)$), MAJORITY ($\Theta(1/(n\log n))$), INDEX ($\Theta(1/n^3)$), and PARITY ($0$). These results are consistent with previous empirical results: the faster the exact-solution volume decays with input length, the harder it is to length-generalize on that task. Looking deeper into INDEX, our volume analysis reveals two error sources that grow with $n$. Consequently, we study a transformer model that would structurally eliminate one of the terms, theoretically improving the NESV bound to $\Theta(n^{-1})$, and empirically achieving 85% accuracy when tested at $10\times$ the training length, compared with the 60% accuracy of the original model. We conclude that volume analysis may be a useful approach to identify concrete sources of length sensitivity and thus provide insights into task-specific model refinements.

</details>


### [272] [WASD: Wasserstein-based Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07706)
*Byeonghu Na,Donghyeok Shin,Yeongmin Kim,Mina Kang,Il-Chul Moon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出WASD，一种基于Wasserstein距离（Sinkhorn散度）的LLM知识蒸馏方法，通过将token嵌入构建的代价矩阵引入优化传输框架，使蒸馏过程能显式利用token级语义信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM知识蒸馏方法主要依赖KL等f-散度，仅在词表索引上比较概率值，无法利用token间的语义关系（如"sofa"与"couch"语义相近却被视为完全不同类别），导致学生在保持生成质量与多样性方面存在局限。

Method: 1）利用教师模型的token嵌入构建代价矩阵C；2）采用Sinkhorn散度（去偏的熵正则化Wasserstein距离）作为蒸馏目标，通过自相似性修正消除熵正则化偏差；3）通过包络定理推导出梯度等价的可优化目标，无需对传输求解器反向传播，利用Sinkhorn-Knopp迭代和不动点迭代高效计算对偶势；4）采用k近邻稀疏化降低计算开销。

Result: 在GPT-2、OpenLLaMA2、Qwen2.5、Gemma等多个模型族上的指令跟随、数学推理、代码生成等任务中，WASD consistently优于KL、RKL、TV、GJS、SKL、α-β、CSD、AMiD等基线方法。在GPT-2 XL→Base设置上平均ROUGE-L达24.02（vs AMiD 23.46），OpenLLaMA2-7B→3B达29.61，并在质量-多样性权衡上表现优异。训练时间约为基线两倍，GPU内存增加约20%。

Conclusion: WASD通过将token级语义信息融入知识蒸馏过程，证明了词表空间语义结构对有效分布对齐的重要性，为LLM蒸馏中的语义感知对齐开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Autoregressive large language models (LLMs) have rapidly advanced in capability, but their increasing scale comes with substantial computational and memory costs at inference time. Knowledge distillation (KD) offers a practical solution by transferring knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student model via alignment of discrete probability distributions. However, existing KD methods for LLMs primarily rely on divergences that evaluate discrepancies through probability values at each vocabulary index, without explicitly leveraging token-level semantic information. We propose Wasserstein-based knowledge distillation (WASD) for LLMs, which incorporates token-level semantic information via the Wasserstein-based distance with a cost matrix derived from token embeddings. To ensure computational tractability, we adopt the Sinkhorn divergence and derive a gradient-equivalent objective that can be efficiently optimized without introducing additional networks. Experiments across multiple LLM families and scales show that WASD consistently improves distillation performance on diverse tasks, including instruction following, mathematical reasoning, and code generation. Our results highlight the importance of semantic information encoded in the token space for effective distribution alignment in LLM distillation. The implementation is publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [273] [Towards One-for-All Foundation Model for Attributed Graph Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07778)
*Yunhui Liu,Xudong Jin,Kang Zhang,Danshuo An,Yu Xing,Te Song,Jia Liu,Tieke He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出OFAG（One-for-All Foundation Model for Attributed Graph Clustering），首个面向属性图聚类的"一统"基础模型。该模型基于Prior-data Fitted Networks（PFNs），通过在广泛的属性图生成先验（CAGM）下采样合成图进行预训练，并采用维度无关的信号级图编码器（SwiFRT）和超球面聚类目标学习实数表示向量。在推理时，模型以零样本方式冻结后单次前向传播即可生成聚类友好的节点嵌入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 属性图聚类是无监督任务，现有方法需针对每个输入图单独训练和调整，开销高且不稳定，难以迁移到具有不同特征空间、结构模式和属性-结构相关性的图上。因此，本文探索能否训练一个单一模型，无需针对特定图的训练、微调或超参数搜索，即可直接应用于多样化的属性图。

Method: OFAG由三个核心组件构成：（1）CAGM（Coupled Attributed Graph Mixture）合成属性图先验，生成具有变化K值和置换簇身份、覆盖多样化特征类型、簇可分离性、结构机制和属性-结构耦合强度的聚类任务；（2）SwiFRT（Signal-wise Filter Response Transformer）维度无关信号级图编码器，将每个特征通道视为图信号，编码其在共享图滤波器下的结构响应，实现维度无关和特征通道排序不变性；（3）超球面聚类目标，基于von Mises-Fisher分布的紧凑性损失和散度损失，塑形表示单元为同簇节点聚集、簇原型均匀分散的超球面几何。

Result: 在10个基准数据集（含5个同质图和5个异质图）上，单个冻结OFAG模型在NMI、ACC、ARI和F1四个指标上均取得最优平均分数和最低平均排名，且总推理时间仅12.43分钟，比次快基线快6倍以上，比聚类质量次优基线快近28倍。

Conclusion: OFAG是首个面向属性图聚类的"一统"基础模型，将PFN范式成功适配到无监督图聚类场景。通过在CAGM先验下预训练，OFAG只需一次前向传播即可对任意新图进行零样本聚类，无需图特定的训练、微调或超参数搜索，实现了显著的效率和质量优势，验证了先验拟合基础模型推理在属性图聚类中的优越性。

Abstract: Attributed graph clustering aims to discover node groups by jointly exploiting node attributes and graph topology, yet its unsupervised nature makes model selection and adaptation inherently difficult. Existing methods typically train and tune a separate model for each input graph, leading to costly and fragile pipelines that often fail to transfer across graphs with different feature spaces, structural patterns, and attribute-structure correlations. In this paper, we study a one-for-all alternative: can a single model be trained once and directly applied to diverse attributed graphs without graph-specific training, fine-tuning, or hyperparameter search? We propose OFAG, a foundation model for attributed graph clustering. Building upon Prior-data Fitted Networks, OFAG learns a reusable clustering inference strategy from synthetic attributed graphs generated under broad priors over latent clusters, node attributes, and graph structures. To handle incompatible feature spaces across graphs, OFAG adopts a dimension-agnostic signal-wise graph encoder that treats each feature channel as a graph signal and models its response to shared graph filters. The model is trained with a hyperspherical clustering objective, producing clustering-friendly node representations in a single forward pass at inference time. On ten datasets, one frozen OFAG model achieves the best mean performance and average rank across NMI, ACC, ARI, and F1, while completing all ten datasets in 12.43 minutes total---over 6* faster than the second-fastest baseline and nearly 28* faster than the second-best on clustering quality. Our code and pretrained checkpoint are available at this https URL , allowing practitioners to directly apply OFAG to their own attributed graph datasets without additional training or tuning.

</details>


### [274] [ServeLearnBench: How Well Can Agents Self-Improve from Serving Experience?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07792)
*Haizhong Zheng,Yizhuo Di,Ranajoy Sadhukhan,Shuowei Jin,Beidi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这篇论文针对大语言模型智能体在真实环境中"从服务经验中持续学习"的能力评估空白，提出了 EESD（演化环境流数据集）框架和 ServeLearnBench 基准测试。基准涵盖零售支持、银行案例审核和销售推介生成三大领域，包含 53 个环境窗口和 7,718 个任务。作者评估了 5 种学习框架（RAG、Mem0、SkillOpt、Continual Harness、Prime）与 6 种模型的 28 种组合，共计 252 次学习运行。核心发现包括：任务能力与从经验学习之间存在显著差距；持续适应成本高昂且可能损害已正确的行为；探索不足是有效适应的关键瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型智能体被广泛部署于复杂真实任务，它们面临的环境知识往往是隐式、未公开且会随时间变化的。虽然 SkillOpt、Continual Harness、Prime 等持续学习框架已被提出以支持智能体从服务经验中改进，但现有基准存在关键缺陷：部分基准明确提供目标知识（测试保留而非发现能力），另一些假设静态环境，而支持持续适应的基准在规模和知识多样性上受限。这导致我们缺乏系统性评估智能体如何从服务经验中推断、修订隐性环境知识并维持可靠行为的方法。本文旨在填补这一评估空白。

Method: 核心方法贡献是形式化了**演化环境流数据集（EESD）** 这一抽象，它是一个按时间顺序的任务流，学习者可见的接口保持不变而评估者私有的环境随时间演化。每个环境窗口由隐性环境状态 θ_s 控制，包含同分布的服务任务和服务任务测试集，并支持策略的引入、撤销和重新激活。ServeLearnBench 包含三大领域九个场景：零售（多轮客服支持）、银行（卡片授权、信用额度提升、转账审核）、销售推介（40-80 单词生成）。难度分为三层：L1（知识获取）、L2（修订与组合）、L3（非单调演化）。奖励机制针对不同领域设计，零售奖励任务和数据库奖励转换；银行奖励正确裁决和最终状态；Pitch 使用结构化评分标准。作者通过交叉 5 种学习框架 × 6 种模型构建 28 个模型-框架对（涵盖 252 次学习运行），并引入两个非学习基线（Blind：无适应；Oracle：获取全部隐性策略）来量化学习空间。

Result: 三大核心发现：**(1) 持续学习的性能差距仍然存在**：Oracle 基线在隐性案例上达到平均 95.4% 准确率（表明任务能力本身存在），但没有任何智能体能可靠地学习策略。在零售 L3 上，最佳的 28 个模型-框架对仅达到 59.6%，中位数仅为 22.0%。**(2) 持续学习没有免费午餐**：推断隐性策略的成本是遵循明示策略的 4-101 倍（在 Kimi K3 上，Prime 花费 $2,479，而 Oracle 仅花费 $102）；适应还会损害那些不需要学习的任务的性能。Prime 和 CH 通常优于 RAG、Mem0 和 SkillOpt，但与 Oracle 之间仍有显著差距。**(3) 有效探索是持续学习的关键**：框架在适应过程中探索候选行为的能力与其最终性能强相关，探索 AUC 与隐性奖励之间的 Spearman 相关系数达到 1.00（框架级别）。知识获取与探索是不同瓶颈：RAG 经常发现正确行为但无法可靠复用，SkillOpt 表现则相反。

Conclusion: ServeLearnBench 为诊断持续学习局限性和跟踪智能体通过部署经验持续可靠改进的进展提供了受控测试平台。即使任务能力本身存在，智能体也难以获取和修订隐性环境知识；持续适应在带来性能提升的同时也带来高昂计算成本并可能损害已有正确行为；探索和知识获取是独立瓶颈，智能体不仅需要发现有用行为，还需要将成功经验转化为可复用知识。作者希望该基准能够帮助系统性地诊断这些挑战并推动能够从部署经验中持续可靠学习的智能体研究。GitHub 仓库：https://github.com/Infini-AI-Lab/ServeLearnBench

Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed to perform complex tasks in real-world environments. However, the knowledge required for correct behavior in these environments is often implicit, undisclosed, and subject to change over time. Recent continual-learning harnesses seek to address this challenge by enabling agents to improve from serving experience. Yet the effectiveness and limitations of these methods are not yet well characterized. Existing benchmarks provide only partial coverage: some explicitly provide the target knowledge, others assume a static environment, and those that support continual adaptation remain limited in scale and knowledge diversity. To enable systematic evaluation, we formalize an evolving-environment streaming dataset (EESD), in which agents must infer, apply, and revise latent environment knowledge from interaction and outcome feedback as hidden policies evolve, and introduce ServeLearnBench, spanning retail support, banking, and sales-pitch generation with 53 environment windows and 7,718 tasks. We evaluate five learning harnesses (RAG, Mem0, SkillOpt, Continual Harness, and Prime) across six models (GPT-5.6 Terra, Opus 5, Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and GLM-5.3 Flash), covering 28 model-harness pairs and 252 learning runs. Our evaluation reveals three main findings: a substantial gap remains between task capability and learning from experience; continual adaptation is costly and can degrade already-correct behavior; and insufficient exploration emerges as a key bottleneck to effective adaptation. Overall, ServeLearnBench provides a controlled testbed for diagnosing these limitations and tracking progress toward agents that continually and reliably improve through serving experience.

</details>


### [275] [The Geometry of Empowerment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07796)
*Catherine Ji,Vivek Myers,Sergey Levine,Benjamin Eysenbach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将"赋能"(empowerment)最大化与技能学习方法联系起来，从信息几何和时间距离几何两个角度揭示了赋能目标的深层结构，解答了赋能是否对应MDP中心性的长期开放问题，并发现在连续状态空间下信息几何与奖励适应几何本质上不同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 赋能（empowerment）作为一种信息论度量，能量化智能体对环境的控制能力。此前研究虽已假设高赋能状态对应MDP中结构中心、能通向广泛未来结果的"中心状态"，但这种联系从未被严格证明。此外，在连续状态MDP中，赋能最大化是否能保证下游任务适应能力也是一个未解之谜。

Method: 1. 区分两种赋能定义：潜在赋能（potential empowerment，技能策略与技能源的联合最大化互信息）和有效赋能（effective empowerment，特定策略实际实现的互信息）。2. 利用折扣状态占据度量（MDP）的可达凸多面体，建立信息几何框架，用KL散度1-中心定位问题刻画潜在赋能最大化。3. 建立离散MDP中命中时间与赋能的等价关系，并扩展至连续情形下的时间距离几何。4. 在表格设定下，利用高斯宽度与χ²散度不等式证明赋能对零样本适应能力的下界。5. 通过反例证明在连续状态MDP或各向异性奖励先验下，信息半径可以发散而适应能力趋于零。

Result: 1. 定理4.1：潜在赋能等价于在状态占据单纯形中可达多面体的KL散度最小最大化问题，最优策略将每个技能的占据分布放置在最优KL球的边界极点上。2. 引理4.2：离散MDP中，潜在赋能恰好等于承诺执行某技能后，到达未来状态的对数命中时间的期望减少量。3. 定理4.3（表格设定）：在高斯奖励先验下，潜在赋能以常数因子c≈0.8下界适应目标函数J(s₀)，其中J(s₀)等于技能偏移向量的高斯宽度。4. 命题G.2：在连续状态MDP中，可以构造出赋能任意大而对Lipschitz连续奖励的适应能力任意小的MDP和技能集。5. 命题H.2：在各向异性奖励先验下，即便固定奖励总功率Tr(Σ)=T，高互信息技能集仍可能对适应毫无贡献（J^Σ(s₀)=0）。6. 实验验证：高赋能策略能正确识别带钥匙机制GridWorld中的信息几何中心（而非物理中心）。

Conclusion: 本文从理论上严格建立了赋能最大化与MDP结构中心性的等价联系：高赋能状态是信息几何中可达区域的中心，同时也是时间距离几何中的瓶颈。在表格设定下，这一中心性提供了对未知奖励适应能力的可证明下界，部分回答了Salge的AI赋能假说。然而，在连续状态MDP或各向异性奖励先验下，信息几何（KL散度）与奖励适应几何（高斯宽度）存在本质差异——高赋能不能保证高适应能力。因此，弥合这两种几何是将赋能类内在奖励扩展到实际强化学习场景的关键挑战。

Abstract: Empowerment captures the capacity for an agent to actively control its environment. While conceptually appealing as an information-theoretic quantity, the connection between empowerment and structurally central states that provide broad access to future outcomes has remained an open question. In this work, we link empowerment maximization and skill-learning methods to provide new geometries for interpreting and analyzing empowerment. Our analyses answer longstanding open questions on the connections between empowerment and structural centrality. Our analyses also reveal distinctions between information and reward geometries, highlighting important theoretical implications to build scalable empowerment-maximization methods. Website and code can be found at this https URL .

</details>


### [276] [Label-Efficient Deep Learning for ECG Delineation: A Multi-Dataset Benchmark against Widely Used Delineation Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07885)
*Jeonghwa Lim,Minje Park,Yeongyeon Na,Yujin Eom,Soyeon Lim,Young Ho Lee,Yu Jeong Kim,Sunghoon Joo,Ki Hong Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对心电图（ECG）波形标注（delineation）任务，系统研究了标签高效深度学习策略（自监督预训练+半监督微调）的有效性，并在多个数据集上与主流标注工具进行了基准比较。结果表明：MAE自监督预训练效果最佳，所得到的深度学习模型在所有评估指标和数据集上均显著优于NeuroKit2、ECGdeli、Prominence等开源工具及CalECG商业工具，且在心律失常场景下鲁棒性最强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ECG波形标注是从原始信号提取临床测量（如PR间期、QRS时长、QT间期）的关键步骤。深度学习方法虽提升了精度，但严重依赖专家标注数据。标签高效学习（自监督预训练+半监督学习）有望缓解标注瓶颈，但其在密集预测任务（逐点标注）中的有效性以及对常用标注工具的优势尚未明确。

Method: 研究分两阶段：（1）比较三种自监督预训练目标（MAE、MoCo、MERL）与两种微调策略（监督、半监督），在1个内部+4个外部数据集上评估mIoU、间期误差、逐点灵敏度三个互补指标；（2）将最优深度学习模型与NeuroKit2（CWT/DWT）、ECGdeli、Prominence、CalECG四个主流工具进行基准对比，并进行节律分层和逐点分析。模型采用ViT-Tiny编码器+FCN解码器。

Result: （1）自监督预训练有效，但目标函数关键，MERL表现较差，MAE和MoCo显著优于无预训练；（2）基于MAE的深度学习模型在所有指标和数据集上均排名第一，在心律多样集上mIoU达71.3% vs 最强工具54.8%，平均逐点灵敏度92.6% vs 76.4%；（3）从窦律到心律失常的性能退化最小（mIoU退化14.7% vs 工具的41.6-48.5%）；（4）模型运行速度最快（17.1 ms/样本），且最稳定。

Conclusion: 本文首次提供了跨多个数据集的系统证据，表明自监督预训练（尤其是重建类目标MAE）对ECG波形标注有效；标签高效训练的深度学习模型在所有评估场景下均显著优于主流开源和商业标注工具，尤其在心律失常等困难场景下优势更明显。研究支持在临床实践中采用此类模型。

Abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) delineation, the identification of waveform boundaries, is a foundational step that translates raw ECG signals into clinically interpretable measurements. Deep learning has advanced this task but remains dependent on costly expert annotations. Label-efficient strategies such as self-supervised pretraining and semi-supervised learning are expected to ease this burden, yet it remains unclear whether they yield reliable delineation and whether the deep models they produce outperform the delineation tools used in practice. We address this in two stages. First, comparing self-supervised objectives with supervised or semi-supervised fine-tuning across one internal and four external datasets, we find that pretraining helps but the objective matters, and that the value of semi-supervised fine-tuning depends on the pretraining objective. Second, we benchmark the selected deep learning model against widely used open-source (NeuroKit2, Prominence, ECGdeli) and commercial (CalECG) tools using three complementary metrics. The model ranks best on every metric and dataset, outperforming the strongest tool by a clear margin on the rhythm-diverse set (mIoU 71.3 vs. 54.8%; averaged point-wise sensitivity 92.6 vs. 76.4%), and degrades the least from sinus to arrhythmia. A rhythm-stratified and point-wise analysis further characterizes the distinctive behavior of each tool, yielding practical guidance for tool selection. These results provide systematic, multi-dataset evidence that self-supervised pretraining is effective for ECG delineation and enables a label-efficiently trained deep learning model to outperform widely used delineation tools by leveraging abundant unlabeled data. This supports adopting such models in diverse, real-world clinical settings.

</details>


### [277] [Variance-Averse $n$-Step Offline Reinforcement Learning for Sparse Long-Horizon Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07899)
*Guhyeon Kang,Minhae Kwon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出VAN-Flow框架，通过方差厌恶期望算子在分类回报分布上选择高回报低方差的可靠动作，解决生成式actor在异构离线数据集中倾向于复现高方差不可靠动作模式的问题，结合流匹配策略与拒绝采样，在长视野稀疏奖励任务上取得稳定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式策略（如扩散模型和流匹配）虽然能建模多模态动作分布，但在异构离线数据集下会同时复现可靠和不可靠的动作模式，且仅最大化期望Q值无法区分二者。n步回报虽能缓解长视野自举偏差，却放大了高方差数据下的回报离散度，导致生成式actor在高方差场景下严重退化。

Method: 三组件框架：(1)分类分布critic建模完整回报分布；(2)方差厌恶期望算子，通过生存函数的幂次重新加权原子概率，光滑地偏好高回报低方差动作，无需硬截断或辅助惩罚项；(3)基于流匹配的actor，通过拒绝采样在M个候选动作中选优。理论上证明该算子在凸序意义下具有方差厌恶性，并通过离散化误差界保证其与谱形式的一致性。
