Abstract: Security evaluation of learning-based systems requires more than just testing the system against a fixed collection of attacks. It requires adaptive mechanisms that can efficiently discover \textit{sets} of inputs that induce model failure. We introduce ATLAS (Adaptive Trust-Regions for Latent Adversarial Searches), which is a query-based framework that discovers adversarial input sets for black-box learning systems. ATLAS casts attack generation as an active learning level set estimation problem then combines calibrated approximations with a local-global sampling architecture to find regions of the input space that contain adversarial examples. Once discovered, ATLAS is designed to sample points within these adversarial regions to build adversarial sets that accurately represent the state of robustness of the target model. When applied on toy experiments, we find that ATLAS is able to recover more of the adversarial region under a limited query budget than does previous work. When applied to standard and adversarially trained MNIST, CIFAR, and ImageNet model targets, ATLAS produces better representative attacks than other query-based black-box attacks (NES, SignHunter, BayesOpt). ATLAS represents an automated red-teaming framework that can be used for both analyzing the robustness of learning-based systems under development and continuous auditing to see how the robustness of a system changes over time.

</details>


### [335] [Structuring MoE Expert Selection for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07332)
*Bolian Li,Ting-Yao Hu,Cheng-Yu Hsieh,Sanjoy Chowdhury,Oncel Tuzel,Raviteja Vemulapalli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对长时程智能体强化学习中稀疏MoE模型的专家路由不受控问题，提出分层路由控制框架：通过轮次级操作感知互信息最大化与token级局部一致性正则化对齐智能体轨迹结构，并引入策略熵门控机制稳定训练；在AppWorld与AutomationBench上结合多种RL算法实现超10点成功率提升，同时改善推理吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现成的MoE智能体在专家路由上天然具有"操作分组特化"结构（相似操作的轮次共享专家，不同操作分离专家），但标准RL后训练对路由完全无控制，导致路由噪声增大、任务性能与推理效率受限，且MoE RL训练易崩溃。需要将智能体轨迹的语义结构作为信号显式注入MoE路由。

Method: 1) 轮次级控制：对每个MoE层，将thinking/tool-use场内token的路由器分布平均为q_i，最大化该分布与该轮操作标签（Auth/Read/Create/Update/Delete等）之间的互信息（带clip稳定化），鼓励相同操作共享专家、不同操作分离专家；2) Token级控制：在同一场内，仅当相邻token的top-k专家集Jaccard差距小于阈值h_δ时，强化当前token采用前一个token的专家选择，保持局部一致性而不压制语义过渡；3) 熵门控：当策略熵偏离[H_low, H_high]区间时关闭辅助路由梯度，仅保留标准RL更新以防训练崩溃；4) 通过自定义autograd操作在路由器logits处直接注入辅助梯度，并以token级ρ缩放因子平衡梯度量级。

Result: 在AppWorld（Qwen3-30B-A3B）与AutomationBench（Qwen3.5-35B-A3B）上，结合PPO/GRPO/LOOP/GiGPO均取得稳定提升：GRPO在AppWorld test-challenge TGC提升12.2点、SGC提升12.2点；LOOP在AutomationBench提升11.34点。token级Jaccard一致性+7.7%，轮次级专家-操作互信息+23.5%。推理吞吐量最高提升41.1%（224→316 tokens/GPU/s），单次rollout墙钟时间缩短22.3%。同时验证熵门控必要性（无门控约100步崩溃，h_δ过大亦崩溃）以及R3对路由一致性的贡献有限。

Conclusion: 智能体轨迹的操作语义结构是组织MoE专家容量的有效后训练信号；分层（轮次+token）+熵门控的路由控制框架在不改变top-k路由器架构的前提下，可与多种策略梯度算法即插即用，同时提升任务成功率和推理效率，并稳定MoE RL训练。

Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents are frequently implemented using sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, yet the co-design of agentic behavior and MoE structures remains underexplored. In this work, we comprehensively study the connections between agentic post-training and MoE expert selection. In off-the-shelf MoE models, we observe expert selection exhibits a specialized structure that naturally aligns with agentic trajectories. Specifically, expert routing overlaps more between turns where the agent performs semantically similar operations (e.g., READ, UPDATE) than between turns with differing operations. However, standard RL algorithms ignore this specialization, allowing the MoE routing to go uncontrolled during training, which empirically limit task performance and inference efficiency. To address this, we introduce a hierarchical routing control framework for agentic tasks. We explicitly encourage turn-level expert selections to align with agentic operations while regularizing token-level expert selections to maintain local consistency. To resolve stability issues that arise during post-training with the proposed methods, we further introduce an entropy-gated control mechanism. Overall, our routing control framework achieves over 10-point improvements in success rate on all evaluated benchmarks. These results demonstrate that agentic trajectory structure provides an effective signal for optimizing MoE capacity during RL post-training.

</details>


### [336] [Weight Oracles: Reading Neural Network Weights with Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07334)
*Krishna Kabra,Constantin Venhoff,Christian Schroeder de Witt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"Weight Oracles"（权重神谕）这一新型可解释性范式：通过微调语言模型直接读取目标神经网络的原始权重来诊断其性质（如后门），无需行为测试。研究分两阶段：Phase I 证明 LLM 可学会模拟小型 transformer 的前向传播（99% 保持准确率），Phase II 将其重新用于安全审计——仅用良性病理训练即可零样本检测未见过的后门（pos0 攻击 AUROC 0.93，多样化威胁分布 AUROC 0.81），且在威胁模型偏移下表现优于手工统计检测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经网络可解释性方法（激活分析、行为监控）是被动式的（reactive），需要已知输入才能发现隐藏能力（如后门），对加密构造的不可触发后门（cryptographically unelicitable backdoors）束手无策。论文探索一种主动式范式：让 LLM 直接读取目标网络的原始权重，从中提取结构化、可执行的信息，以检测隐藏的后门或异常，而无需知道触发输入。

Method: Phase I（仿真能力建立）：以 Qwen 2.5 3B-Instruct 为解释器，将小型 1-layer transformer 的权重矩阵行投影为连续 token（带类型嵌入 τ 标识 W_Q/W_V/MLP 等），通过四阶段课程学习（合成分类→回归→注意力投影→真实模型），并采用 5 次前向传播 + 外部确定性代码（如 LayerNorm、GELU、残差）的链式计算分解策略，训练 LLM 学习权重读取原语 W·h。Phase II（安全审计）：用同一权重注入框架，在仅含良性病理（无后门）的训练集上训练 oracle 回答 17 类自然语言诊断问题；在评估时针对四种威胁模型（pos0、lastpos、stealth、adversarial）零样本测试后门检测能力。

Result: Phase I：在未见过的真实小型 transformer 上达到 99% 测试准确率；瓶颈在于单次前向中难以链式组合多个操作，需将计算分解为"学习权重读取 + 外部确定性组合"。Phase II：oracle 在 pos0 攻击上 AUROC 0.93±0.04（TPR 94% @ FPR 20%），在四种威胁类型多样化分布上 AUROC 0.81（每类 0.74–0.89）。统计检测器（L2 范数 AUROC 0.445；最强 V/O 检测器 0.752）在单一威胁模型下尚可，但在威胁模型偏移时崩溃，而 oracle 在所有攻击类型上保持稳定竞争力。可解释性分析显示：W_V 梯度在 backdoor 模型上强 2×，决策呈三阶段计算（特征提取 0–10 层 → 抽象处理 11–33 层 → 决策 34–35 层，AUROC 从 0.88 回升到 0.93）。仿真初始化带来选择性负迁移（整体 AUROC 0.73 vs. 从头训练 0.81），但在 V/O 通路相关问题上仍有增益。

Conclusion: 本文确立了权重空间主动化 AI 安全审计的可行性方向，弥补了激活式和行为式方法的不足。主要局限：(1) 仅在 ~2K 参数的玩具 transformer 上验证，参数 token 数随模型规模爆炸；(3) oracle 学习到的是通路特定的启发式而非通用后门概念（lastpos 攻击仅 0.74）；(3) 假阳性率仍高（FPR 20%）；(4) 评估的后门分布较窄（单 token 触发、单类目标）。未来工作包括：链式思考 oracle（推理时执行子计算）、跨语义/混合/输入自适应攻击的触发不可知检测、基于因果消融和因果追踪的可解释性，以推动大规模模型审计的实际应用。

Abstract: Interpretability methods for neural networks are predominantly reactive: they analyse activations produced during specific forward passes, requiring known inputs to find hidden capabilities such as backdoors. We propose Weight Oracles, fine-tuned language models that diagnose properties of a target network by reading its raw weights directly, without behavioural testing. We investigate this paradigm in two phases. Phase I establishes feasibility: through a staged curriculum and an external chain-of-computation that delegates parameter-free operations to deterministic code, an explainer LLM learns to simulate the forward pass of small transformers from their weights, achieving 99% holdout accuracy on unseen targets. Phase II repurposes this infrastructure for safety auditing. We train an oracle on natural language diagnostic questions about weight anomalies using only benign pathologies as training signal, and evaluate it zero-shot on backdoors absent from training. The oracle achieves AUROC 0.93 on attention-routed backdoors and 0.81 across a diversified threat distribution including stealth and adversarially regularized variants. Hand-crafted statistical detectors are sharp on the threat models they implicitly target but collapse on threat-model shift, while the oracle remains uniformly competent across attack types. Scaling to realistic model sizes remains the principal open challenge.

</details>


### [337] [Towards Explainable Benchmarking for Data-driven Post-Wildfire Debris Flow Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07358)
*Zhisheng Qi,Li Zhu,Utkarsh Sahu,Douglas Tommey,Josh Roering,Yu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个面向野火后泥石流（PFDF）数据驱动预测的可解释基准框架，通过统一基准测试、基于LLM的天气特征增强以及强化学习驱动的特征选择方法，系统评估多种模型在不同特征配置下的表现，并揭示PFDF发生的全局与区域驱动因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前数据驱动PFDF预测研究在特征空间、模型架构和评估协议方面高度碎片化，导致方法间难以公平比较，也无法系统理解气象、地形、土壤和燃烧严重度等多源异构因素的相对重要性。此外，数据驱动模型（尤其是深度学习）的黑箱特性限制了对其科学机制的可解释性理解。

Method: 1）构建统一基准：基于USGS野火后泥石流数据库（1,131个事件，292个正样本），采用区域分层划分（50/25/25至80/10/10），以Threat Score（TS）为主要指标，对比LR、CART、SVM、RF、HGB、NN及USGS固定系数逻辑回归基准。2）LLM特征增强：利用LLM将NWS区域预报讨论（AFD）和危险天气展望文本解析为18个结构化数值PFDF天气指标；并加入USGS 3DEP地形属性与NLDAS-2土壤湿度数据。3）基于强化学习的特征选择：学习二值掩码M，通过替换掩码特征为训练集参考值（连续特征用0、序数特征用众数），最大化正负样本预测概率的均值差异坍缩程度，使用REINFORCE风格策略梯度优化离散掩码。

Result: 在基准测试中，RF*（增强随机森林）在70/15/15与80/10/10划分下取得最佳TS（0.685与0.687），NN*在50/25/25划分下领先（0.604）。固定系数的USGS模型表现最差（TS 0.371-0.402）。增强特征对SVM、RF和NN提升显著。区域分析显示：OSD/SGSBSJ（南加州）主要由风暴/降雨因子驱动；SWCO/WMT（西部高原/落基山北部）地形与地理特征更主导；MT区域USGS固定模型已较优，神经网络难以进一步提升。SWCO出现降雨量与PFDF发生率呈反向关系（违反USGS单调假设），是USGS模型最严重失效区。

Conclusion: 学习模型持续优于固定系数USGS逻辑回归基准，增强的物理与气象特征进一步提升性能。强化学习特征选择揭示风暴变量为全局主导因子，但区域间机制差异显著（加州强降雨驱动、西部高原地形驱动、落基山北部固定模型已接近最优），证明全局固定系数不足以捕捉多样化地理区域机制，需发展区域自适应的可解释模型。未来工作将致力于物理信息方程发现及PFDF预测系统的可信度研究（如知识投毒与数据提取攻击）。

Abstract: Post-wildfire debris flows (PFDFs) are destructive sediment-laden hazards triggered when intense rainfall strikes recently burned terrain, destabilizing hillslopes and threatening infrastructure, local economies, and community safety. Data-driven methods have been proposed to learn predictive patterns directly from historical PFDF observations. However, the current research landscape of data-driven PFDF prediction remains highly fragmented across feature spaces, model architectures, and evaluation protocols, making rigorous comparison and the derivation of scientific insights difficult. Moreover, existing studies lack a systematic investigation into the relative importance of heterogeneous factors (e.g., meteorological conditions, terrain characteristics, soil properties, and burn severity) in triggering PFDF. To address these limitations, we present a unified benchmark for data-driven PFDF prediction, enabling fair and comprehensive evaluation across diverse models and feature configurations. Furthermore, to better understand the underlying drivers of PFDF formation, we propose a reinforcement learning-based feature selection framework that identifies factors whose perturbations render positive and negative events indistinguishable, thereby discovering the regional underlying mechanisms of PFDF occurrence across regions. Our code and benchmark are publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [338] [Dynamic Budget Allocation for LLM Evaluation under Hard Resource Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07362)
*Shai Feldman,Yaniv Romano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HARP方法，在硬预算约束下实现严格不超预算的多轮LLM评估，并保证预测界的覆盖率和指标估计的无偏性，通过耦合样本间的采集决策实现预算回流的动态分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多轮LLM评估方法（如DAPRO）仅在期望意义上满足预算约束，在具体运行中可能超出预算。硬约束在实践中至关重要但具有挑战性：轨迹成本未知且随机，独立采集假设限制严格，预算需自适应回流。

Method: HARP将校准数据分组成批，通过加权枢纽式舍入（weighted pivotal rounding）耦合组内样本的承诺概率，动态分配预算；具有Commit（C）和Dynamic（D）两种模式，并引入depth规则限制采集深度。

Result: 在5个任务（毒性、越狱、幻觉、指令跟随）上，HARP实现接近标称水平的覆盖率、显著低于DAPRO的方差，且从不超出预算（0%超预算率 vs DAPRO的3-13%），预算利用率达94-97%（DAPRO为69-92%）。

Conclusion: HARP是首个在硬预算约束下具有确定预算控制、有限样本覆盖保证和无偏估计的LLM多轮评估方法，证明了依赖采集下仍可保证统计有效性，为实际部署提供了理论保障。

Abstract: We evaluate large language models (LLMs) in multi-turn interactions through their time-to-event: the number of interaction steps required to produce an event of interest, such as a successful jailbreak or agentic task completion. Under limited compute, interactions may be terminated before the event occurs, so that event times are only partially observed (censored). Existing allocation methods for calibrating time-to-event bounds satisfy the budget only in expectation and can exceed the available budget on a particular evaluation run. Enforcing a hard constraint is particularly challenging as the cost of a trajectory is initially unknown. We introduce Hard-budget Allocation with Reflow for Predictive calibration (HARP), a budget allocation that satisfies hard resource constraints and adaptively reallocates unused budget. We show how to use HARP to construct lower predictive bounds (LPBs) on the time-to-event and to estimate evaluation metrics such as the jailbreak rate on a fixed benchmark. Although HARP induces dependence in acquisition decisions across different trajectories, we prove that HARP never exceeds the target budget, that its LPBs have finite-sample coverage guarantees, and that its metric estimates are unbiased. Experiments on agentic task success, LLM jailbreaks, toxic content generation, and RAG hallucinations show that HARP achieves coverage close to the nominal level with low variance, while never exceeding the given budget.

</details>


### [339] [Multigroup Fairness and Omniprediction: Separations and Equivalences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07374)
*Sílvia Casacuberta,Parikshit Gopalan,Varun Kanade,Omer Reingold,Konstantinos Stavropoulos,Pranay Tankala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了两个学习保证——omniprediction（全预测）和 loss OI（损失结果不可区分性）——与多群体公平性概念（多准确率、多校准、校准多准确率）之间的关系。核心结论是：omniprediction 不需要任何形式的多群体公平性（甚至不需要期望准确率），而 loss OI 等价于一种校准多准确率形式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有几乎所有 omniprediction 的构造都依赖于某种多群体公平性概念（多校准或校准多准确率），但其必要性一直是公开问题。本文旨在回答"omniprediction 是否必须依赖多群体公平性"这一根本性问题。

Method: 1) 研究 omnipredictor 集合的闭包性质，证明"夹在"omnipredictor 与贝叶斯最优预测器之间的预测器仍是 omnipredictor（利用 Bregman 散度刻画恰当损失）。2) 利用此闭包性质构造满足 omniprediction 但违反期望准确率的预测器，前提是假设类存在平均情况困难的布尔函数。3) 对于 loss OI，利用中性动作（neutral action）的概念，通过三角不等式反推得出 loss OI 蕴含决策 OI 和假设 OI，从而等价于校准多准确率。

Result: 1) 定理 3.5：在适当复杂度假设下，存在满足 (L,C,O(ε))-omniprediction 的预测器，但其期望准确率误差（EAE）≥ 1/4。因此 omniprediction 不蕴含期望准确率，进而也不蕴含校准、多准确率或多校准中的任何一个。2) 定理 4.8：对于具有中性动作的损失函数，loss OI 等价于权重受限校准与多准确率的组合（即校准多准确率）。这与 omniprediction 形成鲜明对比。

Conclusion: 本文在 omniprediction 和 loss OI 之间建立了清晰的分离与等价关系：omniprediction 是比 loss OI 更宽松的保证，不需要任何多群体公平性条件；而 loss OI 则与校准多准确率完全等价。这一结果解决了 Gopalan 等人 (2023b) 提出的公开问题，并表明通过 loss OI 路线构造 omnipredictor 可能牺牲了效率，因为 omnipredictor 本质上比满足 loss OI 的预测器更为丰富。

Abstract: Omniprediction is a learning guarantee which requires a single predictor to be competitive relative to the best hypothesis from a benchmark class for any loss chosen from a family of loss functions. Loss Outcome Indistinguishability (loss OI for short) is a stronger notion that implies omniprediction. It requires the predicted distribution on labels to be indistinguishable from the true distribution to tests that depend on the loss functions and the benchmark class. Multiaccuracy and multicalibration are multigroup fairness notions that generalize classical notions of calibration and accuracy in expectation. Most known learning algorithms for omniprediction (both for the standard notion and for strengthenings like loss OI) rely on some version of these multigroup fairness notions, or on an intermediate notion called calibrated multiaccuracy. We ask if this is necessary: Does omniprediction require some form of multigroup fairness? We show that the answer is no for (plain) omniprediction, and yes for loss OI. First, a sequence of works shows that multicalibration or calibrated multiaccuracy imply omniprediction. We rule out even a weak converse, by showing that omniprediction for proper losses does not imply even accuracy in expectation, a much weaker notion than any of calibration, multiaccuracy, or multicalibration. Second, prior work showed how to achieve loss OI from a combination of calibration and multiaccuracy. We show a converse: loss OI is equivalent to a form of calibrated multiaccuracy.

</details>


### [340] [Fed-BRDECS: Privacy-Preserving and Heterogeneity-Aware Federated Deep Embedded Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07399)
*Haemin Park,Diego Klabjan,Martin W. Braun,Xiuqi Li,Balakrishnan Ananthanarayanan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Fed-BRDECS 提出了一种隐私保护的联邦深度嵌入聚类框架，用本地可计算的样本稳定性损失替代 IDEC 中依赖全局软分配统计的目标分布，从而避免客户端传输敏感聚类信息；同时引入预测平衡采样和质心级重启机制应对非独立同分布（non-IID）客户端数据问题。在图像和文本聚类基准以及联邦时间序列异常检测任务中均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集中式深度聚类方法（如 DEC/IDEC）依赖全局归一化的目标分布，需要聚合数据级的软分配频率。在联邦学习环境中，这要求客户端上传本地软分配统计信息，会泄露客户端的聚类组成（如缺陷类型、疾病子群等敏感信息）。此外，联邦环境下的数据异质性（non-IID）会导致质心偏向局部主导聚类、稀有聚类欠训练以及聚类坍缩等问题，使得直接将 DEC 应用于联邦场景不可行。

Method: 方法包含三阶段流程：(1) 联邦表征预训练：通过 FedAvg 联合训练自编码器；(2) 联邦质心初始化：使用 k-FED 在客户端嵌入上初始化质心；(3) 重启式聚类细化：核心创新包括——(a) 用本地可计算的样本稳定性损失（受 DECS 启发，基于 Student-t 软分配与 Otsu 阈值构造确定性分数）替代全局 KL 目标，避免传输软分配分布；(b) 预测平衡采样器：周期性计算本地软聚类频率的反向权重，对稀有预测聚类的样本进行过采样，无需真实标签；(c) 质心级重启：在不重置网络参数的情况下，通过 k-FED 周期性重新计算质心，恢复失活或偏向的质心。理论分析证明了本地重构 DEC 目标与全局目标的偏差上界，以及质心失活后重启恢复的严格正分配质量下界。

Result: 在 MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、KMNIST、REUTERS-10K 四个标准聚类基准上（K=10 客户端，IID 和 Dirichlet α=0.5 非 IID 划分），Fed-BRDECS 在全部八种设置中均获得最高 ACC。非 IID 场景下平均 ACC 达 0.6889，显著优于 F-DEC、Fed-AE、k-FED、FKM、DWF k-Means、CCFC 等基线。消融实验验证了稳定性损失（S）、平衡采样（B）和重启（R）三组件各自的贡献。在联邦时间序列异常检测中（SMD、PSM 和工业传感器数据集），将 Fed-BRDECS 作为训练模块集成到 LSTM-AE、TranAD 和 CoFormer-AE 骨干中，在全部 5 个设置中均提升 AUC-ROC，且不增加推理成本。

Conclusion: Fed-BRDECS 是首个在联邦深度嵌入聚类中同时实现隐私保护与异质性鲁棒性的框架。其本地样本稳定性损失避免了软分配统计信息的传输，预测平衡采样和质心级重启有效缓解了 non-IID 数据下的局部不平衡与聚类坍缩。该框架还可作为下游无监督任务（如时间序列异常检测）的即插即用表征学习模块。未来工作需要为 k-FED 质心均值通信添加形式化差分隐私机制。

Abstract: Federated deep clustering seeks to learn clustering-friendly representations from decentralized unlabeled data while preserving client privacy. However, Deep Embedded Clustering (DEC)-style objectives depend on global soft-assignment statistics that require clients to reveal their sensitive information. We propose Fed-BRDECS, a privacy-preserving and heterogeneity-aware federated deep embedded clustering framework. Fed-BRDECS replaces the globally normalized clustering objective with a locally computable sample-stability loss, avoiding the transmission of local soft-assignment distributions. To tackle non-IID client distributions, we introduce prediction-balanced sampling, which oversamples locally rare predicted clusters without requiring ground-truth labels, and centroid-level restarting, which periodically refreshes biased or inactive centroids. Experiments on image and text clustering benchmarks show that Fed-BRDECS consistently outperforms representative federated clustering and deep clustering baselines under both IID and non-IID partitions. We further demonstrate its applicability to federated time-series anomaly detection, where it improves reconstruction-based detectors without adding inference-time cost.

</details>


### [341] [What pass@k Cannot Measure: Evaluating Diversity and Capability Retention after Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07405)
*Subham Rath,Raj Dandekar,Rajat Dandekar,Sreedath Panat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了 pass@k 指标在评估后训练（post-training）方法时存在结构性盲区：它仅反映正确样本概率的总量，无法捕捉输出分布的多样性变化。作者在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 上对比 GRPO 和 RFT（rejection-sampling fine-tuning）后发现，两者在 token 熵、答案熵、唯一答案数三项多样性指标上呈完全相反的变化方向（零种子重叠），但 pass@8/32 无法检出此差异；且与起始 checkpoint 对比时，没有任何训练臂显著改善硬题覆盖——GRPO 对 RFT 的 pass@1 优势实为相对基座损失更小而非能力增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练（特别是基于可验证奖励的强化学习 RLVR）领域普遍以 pass@k（尤其是 pass@1 与大 k 值 pass@k）作为评判方法成败的核心标准。其隐含假设是：pass@1 衡量能力，pass@k（k 较大）衡量多样性是否受损。但作者指出这一直觉在结构上不成立——pass@k 在总体上仅是问题正确率 p 的函数，与概率质量在不同输出间的分布方式无关，因此无法识别仅改变分布而不改变正确总量的训练效果。本文旨在用受控实验证明这一结构性缺陷确实在实际评估中造成误判。

Method: 模型与数据：以 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 为统一起始 checkpoint，在 1500 题 GSM8K 训练集（过滤零方差问题）上分别训练 GRPO、RFT（最短正确回滚交叉熵）、RFT+KL 制动三种主臂（各 3 种子），并附加 GRPO+长度惩罚（λ=0.2、0.5）以及 on-policy 自蒸馏（OPD）作参考臂。评估包括域内 100 题 GSM8K（每题 32 样本）和域外 MATH-500（每题 16 样本，难度等级 4–5 子集用于留出 headroom）。指标涵盖 token 熵、答案熵、每题唯一答案数、pass@1/8/32，以及针对"多样性无反驳"机制的稳健性检查：仅限正确解的 Distinct-3（含长度匹配截断）、仅限错误解的 D_incorrect（含计数受控子采样）。统计上采用百分位置自助法（按问题聚类）和 DerSimonian–Laird 随机效应 meta-analysis。所有生成使用 temperature=1.0、top-p=1.0、无截断。

Result: 1）多样性方向完全相反且种子稳健：RFT 与 RFT+KL 三项指标全增、GRPO 全减，3 种子零重叠；仅限正确解的 Distinct-3 仍显示 GRPO 低 15%（长度匹配后 14%）；仅限错误解的 D_incorrect 仍存 2.2–2.9% 差距，排除了"GRPO 准确率高→错误池缩水→多样性假象"的混淆。3）pass@k 表现：GSM8K 上 GRPO 仅在 pass@1 干净分离两 RFT 臂（+0.058/+0.059，CI 不含零），pass@8/32 完全重叠；MATH-500 等级 4–5 上同样仅 k=1,2 分离，k≥4 后 CI 含零。4）基线对照（关键发现）：MATH-500 硬题上 Base 高于所有训练臂；RFT 在 k=1,2,4 显著低于基座（−3 至 −3.5 pp），GRPO 与基座统计上无显著区别——GRPO 相对 RFT 的优势反映更小相对损失而非能力增益，构成"缺对照组"问题。

Conclusion: 本文提出两个独立论点：（1）结构性论点——pass@k 无法观测概率质量在不同输出间的分布，因此不能单独充当多样性保留的证明，无论对照如何设置；（2）评估实践论点——pass@1 正确识别了正确质量差异，但若不与起始 checkpoint 对比，"训练臂间差距"易被误读为"能力增益"。在 GSM8K 上，唯独 pass@1 干净分离各臂，且奖励的恰恰是正确解多样性最低的方法，构成本文核心的"构造效度"失误实例。论文将贡献从"RL 缩小多样性"重新定位为"评估协议本身的盲区"，呼吁在使用大 k 值 pass@k 推断多样性时需辅以专门的分布度量。

Abstract: pass@$k$, the fraction of problems a model solves within $k$ sampled attempts, is the field's default protocol for deciding whether reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training on verifiable rewards improved a model. At the population level, pass@$k$ depends only on a problem's probability of a correct sample, with no term for how it is distributed across outputs. We show this gap is not academic. Training Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct on grade-school math with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and with rejection-sampling fine-tuning (RFT, training on the model's own shortest verifier-passed rollout) moves three complementary diversity measures (token-level entropy, answer-level entropy, unique answers per prompt) in opposite directions, with zero overlap across three seeds per arm. The gap survives restricting to verifier-correct completions only (lexical diversity among correct solutions is 15% lower for GRPO, after controlling for length) and a count-controlled check isolating diversity among incorrect answers alone, ruling out that GRPO's higher accuracy alone explains it. Yet pass@8 and pass@32 show no consistent winner on GSM8K, and a hard MATH-500 subset shows the same pattern: separation only at low $k$. Compared against the starting checkpoint, no trained arm significantly improves hard-problem coverage: RFT is significantly worse, while GRPO is statistically indistinguishable from it - so GRPO's pass@1 edge over RFT reflects a smaller loss relative to Base, not a capability gain, a missing-control issue, not a failure of pass@$k$. On GSM8K, only pass@1, with no role in detecting diversity by construction, separates the arms cleanly, rewarding the arm whose correct solutions are least diverse. We argue this is a concrete instance of a standard evaluation protocol missing a property it is routinely used to certify.

</details>


### [342] [Evaluation of Active Feature Acquisition Policies with Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07406)
*Yuta Kobayashi,Divyam Madaan,Shalmali Joshi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了如何利用先验数据拟合网络（PFN）等表格基础模型，从有限离线数据中评估主动特征获取（AFA）策略。研究发现，使用总预测熵作为奖励会因离线数据覆盖不平衡而产生认知偏差，将认知不确定性与偶然不确定性混淆。论文提出通过估计后验期望（偶然）熵来替代，使用贝叶斯预测推理（BPI）实现偏差校正。在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法减少了价值估计偏差，并提升了策略选择的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在主动特征获取（AFA）中，由于成本、延迟或风险，获取完整信息通常受限。离线数据通常由未知的行为策略生成，导致特征覆盖不平衡。在评估候选采集策略时，使用基于总预测熵的标准信息增益目标会将认知不确定性（数据不足）与偶然不确定性（特征本身无信息）混淆，从而系统性地低估那些需要获取在离线数据中覆盖稀疏的特征的策略的价值，导致次优的策略选择。

Method: 1. 将总预测熵分解为偶然不确定性 U_a 和认知不确定性 U_e，指出基于总熵的代理目标与贝叶斯最优目标之间的差异恰为 U_e。
2. 提出使用后验期望的偶然熵作为偏差校正的奖励。
3. 利用贝叶斯预测推理（BPI），通过鞅后验（Copula 法）或预测中心极限定理（CLT）从序列的一步预测分布中恢复后验分布，从而实现 U_a 的估计。
4. 结合 IPW 估计器和贝叶斯 Bootstrap，利用 TabPFN/TabICL 等表格基础模型作为 PPD 估计器，构建完整的策略价值后验分布。

Result: 在合成数据（Linear、GMM、BNN）和真实世界数据（OpenML 表格基准、Sepsis ICU 数据）上的实验表明：
1. 提出的 BPI（CLT 和 Copula）以及 Bootstrap 偏差校正估计器相比 Total（plug-in）和 Total（bootstrap）基线，显著减少了价值估计的点估计偏差。
2. CLT 估计器提供了经验覆盖率接近标称水平的可信区间，而 Marginal 和 Copula 方法则存在覆盖率不足的问题。
3. 在下游策略选择（成对准确率）方面，偏差校正估计器在合成数据上一致地匹配或优于有偏基线，且在高缺失率下增益最大。

Conclusion: 论文证明了在 AFA 策略评估中，必须将偶然不确定性与认知不确定性解耦，以避免由离线数据覆盖不平衡引起的认知偏差。通过利用贝叶斯预测推理和表格基础模型，所提出的偏差校正框架能够恢复无偏的价值估计并产生可靠的不确定性区间，从而改善下游策略选择。论文也指出了局限性：目前仅适用于中小规模数据，且依赖标准 IPW 估计器，未来可与半参数高效估计器结合。

Abstract: Active feature acquisition learns policies that sequentially acquire features to maximize information about a target variable. We study how to learn and evaluate such policies from finite offline data using prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), which are off-the-shelf models that output posterior predictive distributions without task-specific training. We show that under the imbalanced coverage of offline data, using total predictive entropy as a reward creates an epistemic bias that penalizes acquiring sparsely observed features. Specifically, this reward conflates epistemic uncertainty (arising from lack of offline data) with aleatoric uncertainty (arising from uninformative features). To address this, we target the posterior expected (aleatoric) entropy instead of the total predictive entropy output by a PFN for evaluating feature acquisitions. Empirical evaluations on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently reduces value estimation bias and yields credible intervals with strong empirical coverage, which can translate to improved downstream policy selection.

</details>


### [343] [Learnable Spectral Activations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07419)
*Tamir Shor,Or Litany,Alex Bronstein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出可学习谱激活(LSA),用残差截断傅里叶级数替换INR中固定的神经元级激活函数,在不扩展渐近函数类的前提下,通过线性权重选择特征与激活系数控制谱形之间的解耦因子化,改善优化动力学和重建质量,涵盖音频、图像、NeRF和神经声场等任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有INR方法主要通过输入编码或周期非线性来控制"哪些频率可用",但对于具有局部或空间变化结构的信号,网络还需高效地将频率组合成多谐波内部响应。固定激活使谱形与特征选择纠缠在同一组参数中,成为性能瓶颈。

Method: 在每层将固定激活替换为残差形式 ϕ(u)=u+Σ a_k sin(2πk u),其中谐波幅度 a_k 为层共享可学习参数,以零均值小方差初始化使激活起始接近恒等映射。激活输出关于系数是仿射的,因此谱调谐成为一个更直接的优化子问题。理论分析推导出有限宽度下损失下降率的精确分解,显示系数学习贡献额外的正半定NTK项。

Result: 在音频(LibriSpeech/NSynth)上LSA以FF16+σ=100配置达到86.72/90.78 dB,显著优于FINER和SIREN;在Kodak图像上24张平均38.110 dB,优于FINER(37.317)和SIREN(34.990);在Blender NeRF上8场景中5个PSNR最优、7个SSIM最优;在神经声场上所有指标均提升,MRSTFT Log-L1改进约46-52%,TDOA改进约68-72%。NTK分析显示LSA将更多目标信号能量集中到前导特征模中。主要代价是激活运行时和显存开销较大(K=16时训练时间约7×,显存约9×)。

Conclusion: LSA通过学习神经元级谐波组成而非仅扩展频率支持,提供了一种结构化的归纳偏置,在多种INR任务中一致改善重建质量与连续近似稳定性;主要局限是当前实现的计算开销较高,未来可探索更高效实现和神经元特定或输入条件化的谐波系数。

Abstract: Implicit neural representations (INRs) are shaped by the spectral structure induced by their input encodings and activation functions. Existing methods improve fitting primarily by modifying which frequencies are available to the network, through coordinate encodings or periodic nonlinearities. However, frequency access is not the only bottleneck: signals with localized or spatially varying structure require the network to efficiently compose frequencies into multi-harmonic internal responses. We introduce learnable spectral activations (LSA), which replace fixed neuron-level nonlinearities with a residual truncated Fourier series whose harmonic amplitudes are learned during training. LSA does not expand the asymptotic function class. Instead, it changes the factorization of the representation: linear weights select features while activation coefficients control spectral shaping, and the two are updated by separate gradients. Because the activation output is affine in the coefficients given fixed pre-activations, spectral tuning becomes a more direct subproblem compared to architectures where it is entangled with feature selection. Empirically, this factorization concentrates more target-signal energy in the leading eigenmodes of the neural tangent kernel, consistent with improved optimization behavior. Across audio, image, neural radiance field, and neural acoustic field tasks, LSA also improves reconstruction quality.

</details>


### [344] [Benchmarking Label-Revealed Online Updates for EEG BCI Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07420)
*Bogdan Kozyrskiy,Artem Grachev,Abraham I. Camelo Guerrero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个针对EEG BCI解码的在线自适应基准测试，采用时间顺序的prequential（先测后训）评估协议，在四个数据集上比较了CSP和黎曼协方差两大类管线的在线更新策略，发现标签揭示型在线更新在大型数据流上能显著提升性能（相对提升可达约18%），且基于Shapley值的时序数据估值分析表明最新数据块贡献最大，但旧数据仍保留正向价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG信号存在时序漂移问题，导致静态BCI解码模型在实际部署中性能退化。现有研究多为离线评估，缺乏对在线自适应策略的系统性比较基准。本文旨在填补这一空白，提出统一的在线自适应评估框架，并回答三个关键问题：(1)哪些管线最受益于标签揭示型更新；(2)受控遗忘旧数据是否能提升鲁棒性；(3)极简校准的冷启动与预训练模型相比如何。

Method: 采用prequential（test-then-train）评估协议，模拟EEG试验流式到达的真实部署场景。比较了四种评估/更新机制：冻结离线（frozen/offline）、增量扩展窗口（incremental/expanding-window）、滚动窗口（rolling-window）和冷启动（cold start）。在四个数据集（BCIC 2a、Lee2019、ALEXMI三个运动想象数据集，以及Schirrmeister 2017运动解码数据集）上评估了7种CSP和协方差基管线（包括ACM+TS+SVM、CSP+LDA、CSP+SVM、FBCSP、TS+EL、TS+LR、TS+SVM）。使用累积精度 $C_k$ 和尾窗口精度 $A_k$（w=25）作为评价指标，并采用配对Wilcoxon检验进行统计显著性分析。此外，使用截断蒙特卡洛Shapley方法和精确枚举的块级Shapley方法对训练样本进行时序贡献估值分析。

Result: 在BCIC 2a和Lee2019（两个最大数据流）的14个模型-数据集对中，有13对通过标签揭示型在线更新得到改善，最高相对精度增益约为18%（相比冻结模型）。ACM+TS+SVM在BCIC 2a上表现最佳，从离线0.69提升至增量0.77。在ALEXMI（小数据集）上，在线策略普遍不如离线基线，归因于数据匮乏。在Schirrmeister 2017上，100试验滚动窗口表现较差，说明该记忆预算不足。Shapley分析显示，在三个被分析的数据集中，最新数据块均获得最大的平均Shapley值（统计显著，p_Holm=0.0176），但旧数据块仍保持正值。遗忘策略效果具有模型依赖性：滚动窗口在某些配对中可匹配或超过扩展窗口，但FBCSP在Lee2019和ALEXMI上滚动窗口反而低于增量方案。

Conclusion: 本文确立了EEG BCI在线解码的prequential基准框架，主要结论包括：(1)在线自适应在大型数据集上有效，但在小数据集上可能适得其反；(2)保留历史数据通常有益，但最优遗忘量取决于模型，滚动窗口大小应作为管线可调参数；(3)最新试验最具价值，但旧数据不应丢弃——稳定的协方差估计和分类器参数仍需充足历史支撑，建议采用选择性遗忘而非统一窗口化策略。未来工作将探索轻量级深度神经网络的持续学习、跨被试迁移初始化以减少校准，以及扩展至P300和SSVEP等其他BCI范式。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) signals drift over time, which can cause static brain-computer interface (BCI) models to degrade in practice. We present a benchmark for online adaptation and compare two widely used pipeline families, Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) and Riemannian covariance-based methods, under time-ordered prequential (test-then-train) evaluation. We examine (i) which pipelines benefit most from label-revealed updates, (ii) whether controlled forgetting of older data improves robustness, and (iii) how a minimal-calibration cold start compares with starting from a pretrained model. Across four datasets (three motor-imagery datasets and one movement-decoding dataset), label-revealed online updates improve 13 of 14 model/dataset pairs on the two largest streams, with relative accuracy gains of up to about 18% over a frozen model. A Shapley-based data-valuation analysis over temporal blocks assigns the largest mean value to the most recent block in each of the three analyzed datasets, while older blocks retain positive value.

</details>


### [345] [StaFIR: Convex Learning of Stationarity-Aware Causal Filters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07430)
*Lorena Egger,Mathis Linger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: StaFIR 是一个因果 FIR 滤波器，通过对多个指数衰减核的非负凸组合进行学习，在金融时间序列预处理中显式地权衡了平稳性提升与原始信息保留之间的连续折中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有金融时序非平稳处理方法（如基于 ADF 检验的分数差分）只能间接控制平稳性增强与时序依赖保留之间的平衡，并将搜索限制在单参数核族内，缺少一个可同时监控与变化两端并连续优化折中的显式目标。

Method: StaFIR 将差分核表示为 J 个归一化指数衰减轮廓的非负加权和；目标函数最小化输入保真度（与原始序列的 MSE），并加入基于 KPSS 慢漂移惩罚与单边局部二阶平稳性惩罚；该凸问题可被改写为二阶锥规划（SOCP），在每个候选超参数对 (λ_s, λ) 下被高效求解。通过上下文验证准则从候选网格中选取权衡参数。附录证明了有限截断的 GL 分数差分核可被精确表示为连续指数混合。

Result: 在 ARFIMA–GARCH 合成数据上，StaFIR-context 会随持久性参数 d_true 上升而增强滤波强度，并在平稳区域避免不必要的变换。在四个金融滚动日度对数价序列（S&P 500、EUR/USD、交叉信用 CDS 与比特币）上，StaFIR-context 相比 FD-context 取得约 1.05 个百分点的经验平稳性得分提升（95% 区间 [0.39, 1.71]），ADF/PP 单位根拒绝率更高，局部 Whittle 残差记忆估计下降约 0.08（区间 [-0.11, -0.05]）。在递归再整合的已实现波动率预测中，五个预测期限 h∈{1,5,20,40,80} 的 QLIKE 损失与固定 0.5 阶分数差分无明显差异，但 StaFIR 保持了更高的输入相似度（93.5 对 79.4）。在直接预测设定下，StaFIR 在短期限上优于 FD(0.5)，但仍劣于原始表示。部署成本：单次更新约 4 μs，持续状态 1.59 KiB；每次滚动原点的超参数选择约 1.56 s，每八个原点选择一次可使摊销成本降至 0.37 s。

Conclusion: StaFIR 通过在凸框架内同时学习的混合滤波强度与时间尺度分配，提供了一种数据驱动的非平稳预处理方法，相对于传统 ADF 调谐的分数差分在经验上保留了更多输入信息，同时维持了相近的预测性能。其优势主要源于惩罚结构而非衰减尺度字典的宽度；通过选择调度可显著降低适应成本，且代价较小。未来工作可研究更高输入相似度是否在其他任务和尾部敏感损失下转化为更好的预测性能，并探索双边局部二阶惩罚以及更小的衰减尺度字典。

Abstract: Reducing nonstationarity in a persistent time series entails deciding how much of its temporal dependence to remove. In finance, fractional differencing is often tuned using the Augmented Dickey--Fuller (ADF) test, limiting the search to a one-parameter family of lag profiles and addressing input preservation only indirectly. We propose StaFIR, a causal finite-impulse-response filter with a learned nonnegative mixture of exponential lag profiles. Its convex learning objective balances empirical stationarity with similarity to the input. We evaluate StaFIR on ARFIMA--GARCH controlled settings and rolling financial series, including a realized-volatility forecasting task. The experiments show that StaFIR adjusts its filtering strength to persistence while limiting unnecessary transformation in stationary regimes. In downstream forecasting, there is no clear accuracy difference from fixed half-order differencing, while StaFIR achieves higher measured similarity to the raw signal. A complementary direct forecasting experiment finds that greater input similarity is associated with smaller forecasting penalties, although the raw representation remains stronger.

</details>


### [346] [Decoupling What from Where: How Should a Small GUI Grounding Model Receive the Action Type?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07444)
*Aadi Chauhan,Arthur Ilyasov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了在小型 GUI 定位模型（Qwen2-VL-2B + LoRA）中，将"动作类型"（action type，即"做什么"）以五种不同方式注入到坐标预测（"在哪里做"）中的效果。研究发现，混合流上的命中提升主要来自数据预处理对退化类别的保护，而非真正的空间先验；且在干净流上没有任何机制能稳定超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原生 GUI 智能体通常在单一自回归流中联合预测动作类型和目标坐标。然而，类型决策（分类）与位置决策（定位）是两类本质不同的预测问题。多智能体设计采用"先类型、后坐标"的级联方式，但缺少在匹配数据、计算和解码条件下，对"如何向小型定位模型传递动作类型"这一具体机制的系统比较与机制验证。

Method: 在 AITW（Android in the Wild）上对 Qwen2-VL-2B 进行 LoRA 微调，对比基线（A）与五种类型注入机制：辅助损失（B）、硬路由（C）、加性学习嵌入（D-hook）、前置学习 token（D-token）、提示词文本（D-text）。所有变体共享数据、适配器、优化器和解码。匹配五个种子，采用 episode 聚类 bootstrap 与配对 t 检验，并通过正确/错误/置零/类均值干预协议检验模型是否真正"读取"了类型信号。

Result: 在混合流（点击/滚动/输入）上，B、D-hook 与 D-text 相对基线提升 5–7 点 hit@0.10；硬路由与前置 token 不显著。提升几乎全部来自点击，且源于作者自身的预处理：AITW 中"输入"事件的离屏触点被钳制到原点 (0,0)，形成退化类别，移除该类后基线提升近 7 点，此时没有任何机制在 hit@0.10 上超越基线；在只有点击和滑动的"干净流"上也无人能超越基线。干预实验表明两种学习嵌入都被模型读取——错误的类型会使两者崩溃。部署时，84% 准确率的 Stage-1 分类器使流水线相对基线的优势未被建立（+0.016，95% CI [-0.017, +0.052]）。文档化了一个沉默失败：通过 inputs_embeds 注入条件会使 Qwen2-VL 的图像 token 回退到一维位置编码，损失约 9 点。

Conclusion: 在不存在退化类别的情况下，将动作类型传递给小型 GUI 定位模型并不能在点击精度上带来稳定的增益；辅助损失虽能缩短平均失误距离，但未提高命中率。最实用的建议是优先使用提示词或辅助损失而非新增参数；在监督坐标前审计序列化对每个类别的影响；通过扰动条件检验其是否被读取；并且在条件触及嵌入时保持 input_ids 在计算路径上以避免位置编码失效。

Abstract: A GUI agent decides which action to take and where to take it; we ask how a small grounding model should receive the action type. Fine-tuning Qwen2-VL-2B with LoRA on Android in the Wild, we compare a flat baseline with five ways of supplying the type under matched data, compute, and decoding: an auxiliary loss, a hard-routed action word, an additive learned embedding, a prepended learned token, and the type written into the prompt. With five seeds, an episode-clustered bootstrap, and seed-level paired tests, the ranking on a mixed stream is clear: the auxiliary loss, the additive embedding, and the prompt word each gain five to seven hit@0.10 points over the baseline, while hard routing and the prepended token are not distinguishable from it. Much of that gain is protection from a preprocessing choice of ours rather than a spatial prior. Our serializer clamps the off-screen touch point AITW records for type events to the origin; that class degrades the baseline's click grounding, and removing it lifts the baseline by nearly seven points, after which no mechanism's hit rate beats it and the intervals exclude a two-point effect, though the auxiliary loss still shortens the average miss; on a stream of taps and swipes none helps. Whether this generalizes beyond one serialization is open. For deployment, the pipeline's margin over the baseline with predicted rather than gold types is not established (+0.016, 95% interval [-0.017, +0.052]), and a wrong type collapses every model conditioned at inference. The prepended token does not help at the shared learning rate, where its rows barely move from initialization; trained ten times faster it reaches the level of the other three, with a margin three seeds do not establish. We also document a silent failure: injecting conditioning through inputs_embeds makes Qwen2-VL fall back to 1-D positions for image tokens, costing nine points.

</details>


### [347] [Fork-and-Flush: Escaping Idea Basins in Autoresearch Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07447)
*Ziyang Cai,Christos Ziakas,Vasilis Kontonis,Tim Pearce,Siddhartha Sen,Akshay Krishnamurthy,Shivam Garg,Dimitris Papailiopoulos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了"分叉与刷新"（Fork-and-Flush）方法，这是一种周期性干预策略，旨在帮助自主研究智能体（autoresearch agents）跳出"创意盆地"（idea basins）——即解空间中的局部区域。通过将智能体分叉为多个并行轨迹（保留工作区但清除聊天上下文），运行固定时长后从得分最高的分支继续，该方法在13个长周期研究与工程任务上，相较单次运行和best-of-N基线分别实现了66.0%和44.4%的相对提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长周期自主研究智能体在开放式问题上反复提出候选解、评估并根据反馈迭代。论文观察到，独立运行同一智能体解决同一任务时，会在不同分数水平上停滞，且即使增加算力差距依然持续，表明轨迹被困在解空间的局部区域（即"创意盆地"）。研究动机在于理解这种结果方差，并通过简单干预帮助智能体逃离盆地以提升性能。

Method: 方法名为"分叉与刷新"（Fork-and-Flush），核心机制包含两个操作：(1) 分叉（Forking）——将智能体分叉为K=4条并行轨迹，每条继承当前工作区W和累积成果；(2) 刷新（Flushing）——清除聊天上下文C，从(W, ∅)开始，使分支摆脱父代推理的路径依赖。算法按固定时间表运行：初始轮从空工作区分叉4个智能体，选出最高分作为"领导者"；之后在预算的33%和66%处触发分叉-刷新轮次，每轮K=4个新分支从领导者工作区分叉但以空聊天上下文启动，各获得约6%总预算的探索预算b_explore；轮次结束时选择最高分分支作为新领导者，其余丢弃。研究者还开发了基于功能相似性的工件嵌入方法（使用LLM三胞胎判断和t-STE/SOE降维），用于可视化和量化智能体的探索模式，识别"创意盆地"。

Result: 在13个长周期任务（涵盖算法优化、密码分析、科学推理和系统工程，单次运行从数小时到107小时不等）上，分叉与刷新方法在等算力预算下，min-max归一化平均得分达到0.78，相较单次运行（0.47）和best-of-4（0.54）分别实现66.0%和44.4%的相对提升。该方法在13个任务中的12个上取得最高平均分，且平均归一化标准差从单次运行的0.26降至0.16，结果更稳定。消融实验显示，仅刷新（0.55）和仅分叉（0.57）均优于单次运行基线（0.45），但完整方法（0.71）效果最佳。嵌入分析表明，在polyomino任务上，单次运行的步进距离不超过4.4个单位，而分叉-刷新中获胜分支首步跳跃达43个单位（t-STE）或10.1个单位（SOE），明确逃离局部盆地。在MAX-3-SAT难度梯度实验中发现，结果方差在模型能力边界处最大（达到约0.497的参考表现时方差峰值），解释了为何该方差会随模型扩展持续存在。

Conclusion: 分叉与刷新是一种实用且简单的方法，通过周期性地分叉并刷新聊天上下文，能有效帮助自主研究智能体逃离创意盆地，提升长周期开放式任务的性能。该方法在算力预算内显著优于单次运行和best-of-N基线，证明了其作为自主智能体测试时算力扩展的实用路径。论文指出未来工作方向包括分支间的通信与角色专业化，以及向更广泛任务和新一代前沿模型扩展评估。

Abstract: Autoresearch agents tackle open-ended problems by repeatedly proposing candidate solutions, evaluating them, and using feedback to guide subsequent experiments. We show that independent runs of the same agent on the same task often plateau at substantially different scores, with gaps that persist even after considerable additional compute. Embedding their candidate artifacts by functional similarity provides further evidence that trajectories remain in localized regions of the solution space, which we call idea basins. To help agents escape these basins, we study a simple periodic intervention, fork-and-flush. Our method forks the agent into parallel trajectories, each inheriting the accumulated workspace but starting with a fresh chat context. After running each trajectory for a fixed horizon, the agent continues from the highest-scoring one. Across 13 long-horizon research and engineering tasks, with individual agent runs lasting up to several days, fork-and-flush outperformed the single-run and best-of-N baselines by a relative improvement of 66.0% and 44.4%, respectively, on the min-max normalized average score under an equal compute budget.

</details>


### [348] [Interpretable Hypergraph Learning via Neural Additive Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07458)
*Shihan Feng,Xin Zheng,Shiyi Yang,Ren Wang,Chudi Zhong,Can Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HGNAN（Hypergraph Neural Additive Network），一种面向超图数据的固有可解释性学习框架。它将经典神经加性模型（NAM）扩展到高阶关系数据，通过特征级非线性分解与超图感知结构聚合的结合，实现了节点级与超边级预测任务的透明预测。实验表明，HGNAN在性能上与现有超图学习方法相当，同时提供内在且有意义的可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有超图神经网络（HGNN）大多依赖黑箱消息传递架构，特征贡献与高阶结构信息纠缠在一起，难以解释。事后解释方法（如GNNExplainer、HyperEX等）无法保证忠实反映模型的真实推理过程。在科学应用（如细胞类型识别、代谢反应恢复）中，仅有准确预测往往不够，还需要理解预测背后的机制：究竟是节点属性、高阶结构，还是两者交互驱动了预测。现有可解释方法（如SHy、GNAN）要么未分离属性与结构效应，要么仅适用于图结构而无法直接扩展到超图。

Method: 1. **定义超图距离**：通过s-交集图（s-intersection graph）定义超边间距离，引入距离壳归一化（distance-shell normalization），在不同重叠阈值s下刻画多尺度结构连通性。2. **HGNAN-node（节点级预测）**：保留NAM式加性结构，为每个特征学习一个形状函数f_k；在s-邻域内使用GAT式稀疏注意力权重a_ij^(s)聚合特征贡献；通过可学习的特征权重w_k和尺度权重β_s组合，最终经线性预测头输出。3. **HGNAN-edge（超边级预测）**：在s-交集图上对超边特征进行全局距离感知聚合，学习特征形状函数f_k与距离调制函数ρ_s；通过可学习的特征权重和尺度权重组合，实现特征响应φ(e_j)与结构影响κ^(s)(e_i,e_j)的精确分解。4. **训练流程**：统一监督学习，交叉熵损失；特征形状函数和距离/注意力函数均由MLP参数化。

Result: **节点分类**：在6个基准数据集上，HGNAN-node平均排名3.2（最优），在NTU2012和Mushroom上取得最佳平均精度；在异配性数据集Pokec/Actor上结构信息贡献有限，MLP更优。**超边预测（代谢网络）**：在4个BiGG GEM数据集（iAF1260b、iJR904、iSB619、iYO844）上，HGNAN-edge的AUROC均优于CHESHIRE、NHP、HyperSAGNN三个基线（如iAF1260b上0.914 vs 0.814）。**消融实验**：移除节点特征导致性能接近随机，表明这些基准主要由属性驱动；移除聚合对超边预测影响更大，表明结构信息对超边任务关键；非加性变体在多数数据集上表现下降。**机制恢复**：合成实验中HGNAN-edge能精确恢复真实特征函数和距离函数（R²与Pearson相关近0.99）。**跨网络迁移**：零样本跨GEM迁移中，HGNAN-edge在12对中的8对取得最佳AUROC。**可解释性**：Zoo数据集上"milk"强正支持、"feathers"负支持哺乳动物分类，符合生物学知识；代谢反应恢复中距离响应呈V型（距离0正值、距离1负值、远距离弱正值），符合生化合理性；保真度评估中COMP@20%与SUFF指标均优于G×I和随机归因。**复杂度**：参数和前向计算时间关于特征维度P线性增长（实证验证）。

Conclusion: HGNAN是首个专为超图学习设计的神经加性架构，通过将预测分解为特征级形状函数和显式超图结构影响，取代了纠缠的消息传递表示。HGNAN-node提供特征级和邻居级解释，HGNAN-edge在s-交集图上提供特征级和距离级解释。实验证明，该框架在节点分类和超边预测任务上均具有竞争力，同时提供生物学上有意义的透明决策分解，为生物技术、生物信息学等领域的科学发现提供了兼顾预测性能与可解释性的工具。主要局限在于每个特征需要独立神经网络，在极高维数据集上计算成本较高。未来可拓展至动态超图。

Abstract: Hypergraphs offer a natural framework for modeling networked data, where dependencies among entities are governed by higher-order interactions. While hypergraph learning methods such as hypergraph neural networks have demonstrated remarkable predictive performance, most existing approaches rely on black-box message-passing architectures, making it difficult to disentangle the contributions of node attributes and higher-order structural information. To address this challenge, we introduce the hypergraph neural additive network (HGNAN), an inherently interpretable framework for learning on hypergraph-structured data. HGNAN extends classical neural additive models to higher-order relational data by integrating feature-wise nonlinear decomposition with hypergraph-aware structural aggregation, enabling transparent prediction for both node- and hyperedge-level tasks. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that HGNAN achieves performance comparable with state-of-the-art hypergraph learning methods while providing intrinsic and meaningful interpretability.

</details>


### [349] [Efficient Multimodal Inference through Adaptive Acquisition and Sequential Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07466)
*Payal Mohapatra,Haodong Yang,Yueyuan Sui,Stephen Xia,Benjamin Lundell,Qi Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SeMARC提出了一种耦合增量融合与自适应采集的多模态推理框架，通过Sequential Modality Aggregator (SeMA)在每次采集后提供顺序鲁棒的预测，并由Adaptive Runtime Controller (ARC)在执行编码器前选择下一个模态或停止，从而避免对未选模态的编码与融合开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态系统通常对所有可用输入进行编码，即便子集已足以完成预测，导致推理计算、能耗与延迟随模态数线性增长。增量采集虽可减少开销，但融合对采集顺序敏感，可能导致对同一证据集合出现因子级数量的不同预测历史，因此需要耦合的融合-采集设计以兼顾准确率与效率。

Method: SeMA基于注意力瓶颈机制，按随机排列顺序增量融合所选模态分支，仅维护K个瓶颈token和模态摘要的运行均值，并在每次采集后即输出预测；训练时对每个前缀施加分类损失与同前向蒸馏（full-prefix stop-gradient），以鼓励跨顺序的一致预测。ARC以固定先验Q₀（置信度+基于缓存增益表的后验加权边际增益）与残差fitted-Q学习共同构建状态值，状态仅包含已采集集合、可用性、当前后验及其熵/间隔等统计量，不显式保留采集顺序；运行时选择先以Shapley值最高的模态初始化，再由ARC贪心选择下一个模态或停止。

Result: 在六个跨被试多模态分类基准（IEMOCAP、MM-Fi、CMI、CZU-MHAD、EAV、UTD-MHAD）上，SeMARC相对每个数据集最佳基线平均取得+3.2% macro-F1和−61.4%总推理GFLOPs；端到端延迟在GPU/CPU上平均下降44.0%，Android INT8上相对最快基线下降47.2%；在10–40%测试时模态缺失条件下仍在21/24情形匹配或超过最佳基线macro-F1且平均降低14.8%总GFLOPs。

Conclusion: SeMARC为异构设备上的高效多模态推理提供了一条实用路径，通过耦合增量融合与自适应采集避免了不必要的编码与融合开销，同时理论结果（前缀风险与顺序分歧界、近似信息状态保证）支撑了其紧致状态控制设计的合理性。未来工作包括时变部署成本、自适应批处理调度以及跨样本的长程记忆机制。

Abstract: Multimodal systems often encode every available input, even when a subset suffices for prediction. Adaptive acquisition can reduce this cost by using predictions from incrementally fused evidence to decide which modality to encode next and when to stop. However, sequential fusion makes these predictions order-dependent, so decisions based on them may need to distinguish factorially many histories of the same acquired set. We introduce SemARC, which couples a Sequential Modality Aggregator (SeMA) with an Adaptive Runtime Controller (ARC) and uses acquired evidence to select each modality before its encoder runs. SeMA executes only selected encoder and fusion branches, updates a fixed-size state, and predicts after each acquisition without recomputing earlier branches. We supervise every acquisition prefix under randomized modality subsets and orders to encourage consistent predictions across acquisition orders. ARC combines a set-dependent marginal-utility prior with residual fitted-Q learning to select the next available modality or stop, without inspecting unacquired inputs or retaining acquisition order. Across six multimodal classification datasets and eleven baselines, SemARC achieves 3.2% higher macro-F1 and 61.4% lower total inference GFLOPs on average relative to each dataset's most accurate baseline. End-to-end latency falls by 44.0% across GPU and CPU and by 47.2% on Android INT8 relative to the fastest measured baseline, on average. Under varying runtime modality missingness, SemARC still skips available modalities, matching or exceeding the best baseline macro-F1 in 21 of 24 conditions with 14.8% lower total GFLOPs on average. SemARC thus offers a practical path toward efficient multimodal inference across heterogeneous devices.

</details>


### [350] [Adapting to Changes in Agent Behavior via Finite-Depth Policy Sensitivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07475)
*Lan Shi,Daigo Shishika,Xuan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种有限深度（finite-depth）策略灵敏度估计框架，用于将强化学习策略高效适配到交互智能体行为发生变化的环境中。该方法通过结合参考环境采样与基于模型的导数传播来近似策略Hessian和混合导数，并提供了截断误差的理论界，验证了在追逃博弈中的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多智能体交互环境中，交互智能体行为的变化会导致学习智能体所经历的转移动力学改变。当参考策略对新的交互对手不再最优时，重新训练成本高昂。现有的策略灵敏度方法需要二阶导数沿整个轨迹传播，计算昂贵；而基于完整轨迹采样的方法又需要大量数据。本文旨在在两种方法之间找到一种折中方案。

Method: 本文提出有限深度策略灵敏度估计框架。具体包括：(1) 基于Bellman方程的精确导数分解（引理1），将策略Hessian ∇²_θθJ 和混合导数 ∇²_θκJ 分解为有限深度传播项与边界余项；(2) 通过固定深度T处的边界值函数并截断其关于参数θ和κ的导数来构造近似量 Ĥ_old^(T) 和 M̂_old^(T)；(3) 利用隐函数定理 S_old = -H_old⁻¹M_old 估计策略灵敏度并作为目标环境策略适配的初始化；(4) 在理想设置下推导截断误差谱范数上界（定理1和推论1），证明误差界关于传播深度T单调非增，且在T=H时消失。

Result: 在信念驱动的追逃博弈验证场景中：(1) 在隔离截断误差的理想设置下，Ĥ、M̂和Ŝ的相对估计误差均随传播深度T的增加而单调下降，与理论界一致；(2) 在使用PPO评论家估计和N=10⁶初始状态采样的实际设置下，误差在中等深度处接近约10⁻³的稳定水平；(3) 在T=5和T=7时，所提方法的精度一致优于基于轨迹似然比的估计器，且仅需采样初始状态而非完整轨迹；(4) 在大规模场景(20×20网格)中，基于灵敏度初始化（T=1）相比直接迁移在六个迁移任务上将零样本平均回报提升了0.21-0.66，且在微调过程中保持优势。

Conclusion: 有限深度框架为交互智能体行为变化下的策略灵敏度估计提供了一种原则性强、可调节精度-计算权衡的方法。理论分析证明了截断误差随传播深度增加而非递增，并在全视界传播时消失；实验验证了该方法在估计精度和策略适配性能上均优于基线方法。局限性包括：当前分析假设参考转移核及其对κ的导数已知；边界值函数的导数被截断为零，限制了策略与评论家的联合适配；尚未纳入采样误差与值函数逼近误差的理论分析。

Abstract: Adapting a reinforcement learning policy to changes in another agent's behavior typically requires a large amount of new interaction data. Policy sensitivity provides a first-order prediction of how a locally optimal policy changes with a behavioral parameter, but its computation requires second-order derivatives whose effects propagate across future interactions. We develop a finite-depth framework to estimate this sensitivity by approximating the policy Hessian and mixed derivative using information from a reference environment. The method features an adjustable propagation depth which determines where derivative propagation along the trajectory is truncated. We characterize the derivative contributions omitted by finite-depth propagation and derive truncation-error bounds for the approximated derivatives and resulting policy sensitivity. The bounds are nonincreasing with propagation depth and vanish at full-horizon propagation. Using a belief-driven pursuit-evasion game as a validation scenario, the proposed method generally achieves lower derivative-estimation errors as the propagation depth increases and outperforms the baseline methods in both estimation accuracy and policy adaptation. The sensitivity-based initialization improves zero-shot return over direct transfer, and also shows advantages for the subsequent fine-tuning in the target environment.

</details>


### [351] [SpecBraM: What Should an EEG Foundation Model Predict? Masked Band-Power Prediction versus Waveform Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07484)
*Peng Xie,Yequan Bie,Jianda Mao,Kani Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SpecBraM 提出在 EEG 基础模型的掩码预训练中，应将预测目标从波形重建改为固定窄带的带功率（band-power）预测。通过严格的对照实验证明，匹配任务物理量的预测目标在睡眠分期任务上显著优于波形重建，且在标签稀缺时优势更明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 EEG 自监督基础模型主要采用波形重建或离散码预测作为预训练目标，但这些目标可能包含与下游任务（特别是由频谱能量定义的任务）无关的相位等不可预测成分。需要回答的核心问题是：EEG 预训练任务"应该"预测什么？作者提出原则——预测下游读取所依赖的物理量，而非信号的低层代理。

Method: 1. 提出 Masked Band-Power Prediction (MBP)：在标准掩码 patch transformer 上，将波形目标替换为每个被掩码 patch 在 5 个固定窄带（峰值约 4.6/6/10/21/38 Hz）的对数能量；2. 架构：12 层 criss-cross transformer（D=512，51.3M 参数），19 通道，10 秒窗口，patch=200 样本（0.78 s）；3. 损失函数：MSE + SIGReg 各向同性正则；4. 2×2 设计：线性 patch 嵌入 vs. 滤波器组分词器 × 带功率 vs. 波形重建；5. 在 TUEG v2.0.1 的 2,388 小时子集上预训练 16 epoch；6. 理论分析：在理想平稳高斯模型下，证明相位是辅助统计量，log P 具有状态无关的噪声方差。

Result: 1. 在 ISRUC 和 HMC 睡眠分期（严格线性探针）：MBP 比波形重建高 1.6-2.8 个平衡准确率点（全部标签），1% 标签下高 4.7-7.3 点；2. 目标效应大于分词器效应；3. 冻结特征达 0.7916/0.7425（ISRUC/HMC），超过丰富手工频谱特征 (0.7636/0.7227)；4. 微调后达 0.8107/0.7669，超过现有最佳 CSBrain (0.7925/0.7345)；5. 优势不适用于所有具有频谱线索的任务：运动想象、抑郁筛查和警觉度回归上无明显优势或打平。

Conclusion: 匹配下游标签物理量的预训练目标（频谱能量）在睡眠分期上显著优于波形重建，且在标签稀缺时优势最大。但目标还须匹配标签的空间尺度、时间尺度和伪迹暴露程度。该研究为生理信号预训练目标的选择提供了对照比较依据和失败案例分析。

Abstract: Self-supervised EEG models often reconstruct masked waveforms or predict discrete codes. We study a task-aligned alternative: masked band-power prediction (MBP), which predicts fixed narrow-band log spectral energy for masked channel-time patches. This target retains rhythm power relevant to sleep staging while avoiding phase-sensitive waveform reconstruction and a learned codebook. Across three pretraining seeds, we compare band-power and waveform targets with matched backbones, pretraining data (2,388 hours), and training steps, including a 2x2 tokenizer-by-target design. On ISRUC and HMC sleep staging, MBP exceeds raw- and band-waveform reconstruction by 1.6-2.8 balanced-accuracy points with all labels and 4.7-7.3 points with 1% of labels under a strict linear probe; the target effect exceeds the tokenizer effect. Its frozen features reach 0.7916/0.7425 balanced accuracy, versus 0.7636/0.7227 for a matched rich handcrafted spectral baseline, although the gap is about one point with 1% of labels. Full fine-tuning reaches 0.8107/0.7669. The gains do not extend to every task with spectral cues, including motor imagery, depression screening, and vigilance regression. These results support choosing pretraining targets to match the physical quantities and spatial and temporal scales relevant to downstream labels.

</details>


### [352] [Robust Importance Sampling for Rare Events via Constrained Gaussian Mixtures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07485)
*Paweł Lorek,Rafał Nowak,Rafał Topolnicki,Tomasz Trzciński,Maciej Zięba*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于稀有事件概率估计的鲁棒重要性采样框架，核心思想是将问题分为"覆盖"和"拟合"两阶段，并使用约束高斯混合模型（GMM）作为提议分布以保证有限方差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在稀有事件概率估计（I = P(g(X) > γ)，X ~ N(μ,Σ)）中，传统重要性采样方法面临两大障碍：(1) 冷启动问题——在超稀有概率区域，几乎没有训练信号；(2) 方差失控——KL 散度最小化可能导致提议分布产生无限方差的估计器，即使优化表面上成功。本文旨在通过两阶段框架和协方差约束来系统解决这两个问题。

Method: 方法包含三个关键部分：(1) 覆盖优先初始化（CFI）——通过自适应交叉熵序列的中间水平，构建与稀有事件区域有重叠的 GMM 提议分布；(2) 约束 GMM——将协方差参数化为 Σ_k = L_k L_k^T + βΣ（β ≥ 1/2），保证 Σ_k ≻ (1/2)Σ，从而确保 IS 估计器方差有限；(3) 可选的归一化流（RealNVP）精化。理论保证由定理1给出：当每个混合分量的协方差满足 Σ_k ≻ (1/2)Σ 时，IS 估计器方差有限。同时使用自适应 β 退火和平滑参数 τ 的自适应选择。

Result: 在多个基准测试（包括2维多模态问题、Powell函数（d=40）、线性高维问题（d=100）、ResNet基准（d=62和d=174）以及相关对数正态求和金融问题）上的实验表明：(1) CFI-c+RKL-c+F 和 CFI-c+FKL-c+F 在 CoV（变异系数）和对数误差上均优于 CMC、AMS、Subset Simulation、Safe-ICE 及 Hesterberg 防御性 IS；(2) 非约束方法（如 fRKL-u、fFKL-u、CFI-u）在高维和复杂设置中频繁失败；(3) 在 g_7（ResNet，d=174）上，CFI-c+RKL-c 相比 CMC 将 log-err/var_red 降低约4个数量级；(4) CFI 计算成本低（如 g_6 上仅需约8秒），而完整自适应 KL 基线需要约1570秒。

Conclusion: 本文提出的稀有事件重要性采样框架结合了覆盖优先初始化、约束 KL 精化和可选归一化流，在多种基准上实现了优越的精度和稳定性。定理1为约束 GMM 提议分布提供了有限方差保证，但该保证不适用于流精化变体。方法的局限性包括：有限方差保证仅适用于高斯名义分布、约束 GMM；完全协方差混合需要 O(Kd²) 参数；在稀有事件区域难以到达时可能需要许多中间水平。总体而言，该框架在冷启动和协方差坍缩问题占主导时最为有效。

Abstract: We study estimating rare-event probabilities $I = \mathbb{P}(g(\mathbf{X}) > \gamma)$ with $\mathbf{X} \sim \mathcal{N}(\boldsymbol{\mu}, \boldsymbol{\Sigma})$ and general $g : \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}$. We address this problem through importance sampling, and propose a framework that substantially improves efficiency and robustness over baselines such as crude Monte Carlo, adaptive cross-entropy, variational-inference-based methods (including reverse- and forward-KL approaches), as well as Safe-ICE, Subset Simulation, and Sequential Monte Carlo, drawing on ideas from both rare-event estimation and cross-entropy optimization. The key contribution has two parts: first, we separate the problem into coverage, to overcome the cold-start barrier, and fitting, to refine proposals once a meaningful signal is available; second, we constrain the final GMM proposal so that it has finite importance-sampling variance (since coverage alone is not sufficient -- without safeguards, importance sampling may still suffer from infinite variance). Together, these ingredients yield expressive proposals; finite variance does not by itself guarantee practical stability at a fixed sampling budget. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial variance reduction, strong robustness across diverse benchmarks, and favorable cost--efficiency trade-offs, with the proposed approach often outperforming these baselines, particularly in high-dimensional and multimodal settings where competing methods frequently become unstable or fail. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [353] [Source-Learned Reliance for Selective Test-Time Adaptation of Multimodal Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07499)
*Payal Mohapatra,Yueyuan Sui,Haodong Yang,Benjamin Lundell,Stephen Xia,Qi Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CARAT框架，通过在源训练阶段利用窗口化梯度范数估计模态依赖性，并在测试时结合轻量级异常检测器，在丢弃与衰减可疑模态之间进行路由选择，避免候选子集评估。在四个可穿戴数据集、三种骨干网络和八种TTA基线上的实验表明，CARAT在宏F1和平均排名上均达到最优，且计算开销更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态可穿戴系统在传感器流变得噪声较大或不可用时必须保持可靠性。现有多模态测试时间自适应（TTA）方法在线评估可靠性，但跨模态一致性在传感器测量不同物理过程时会产生误导，而评估替代模态配置会增加推理成本。需要一种解耦模型依赖与运行时损坏检测、低开销的方法。

Method: CARAT包含两个阶段。源训练阶段：采用非对称模态丢弃课程，根据窗口化输入投影梯度范数调整各模态的丢弃概率，同时训练对缺失输入具有弹性的骨干网络，并在收敛时将终端丢弃概率作为冻结的依赖性代理。测试阶段：轻量级单类检测器标记异常流，依赖性代理在未标记模态的依赖质量足够时将可疑集替换为缺失符号（模态组合），否则通过可学习标量在融合前衰减其表示（潜在衰减）。仅更新归一化和衰减参数，使用样本加权熵目标。

Result: 在四个可穿戴数据集（DSADS、PAMAP2、DaliaHAR、WESAD）、五种损坏类型、三种骨干网络（MAESTRO、ShaSpec、Flex-MoE）和八种TTA基线（TENT、EATA、READ、SuMi、SoTTA、AeO、PTA、PSDNorm）的12个等权重数据集-骨干网络设置中，CARAT总体宏F1最高（0.66），平均排名最佳（2.42），比最强基线EATA高出1.58个F1点。效率方面，CARAT比EATA少用9.49%的GFLOPs，参数更新量减少47.82%，延迟相比AeO和PTA分别降低71.03%和73.97%。在DsADS数据集-ShaSpec上的提升最大（平均4.39点）。同时发现PTA在IMU主导的同构数据集上具有竞争力，而TENT和EATA在异构数据集上更优。

Conclusion: CARAT通过源训练分摊依赖性估计，将其与运行时损坏检测分离，指导丢弃或衰减，无需子集搜索，是可穿戴TTA的实用默认选项。未来工作将针对慢时尺度先验刷新、不确定性感知自适应和弃权、更细粒度的可疑集选择以及在更广泛任务和架构下自然失效的验证。

Abstract: Multimodal wearable systems must remain reliable when sensor streams become noisy or unavailable. Existing multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) methods often assess reliability online, but cross-modal agreement can be misleading when sensors measure different physical processes, and evaluating alternative modality configurations adds inference cost. We propose CARAT, which decouples model reliance from runtime corruption detection to guide omission or attenuation, amortizing reliance estimation through source training. An asymmetric modality-dropout curriculum prepares a missingness-resilient backbone for omission and derives a frozen, backbone-specific reliance proxy from windowed input-projection gradient norms. At deployment, a lightweight one-class detector flags suspect streams, and the proxy guides a joint choice between replacing the suspect set with the backbone's trained missingness symbol and attenuating its representations before fusion, without candidate-subset evaluation. Across four wearable datasets, five corruption types, three backbones, and eight TTA baselines, CARAT achieves the highest overall macro-F1 and best mean rank (2.42), exceeding EATA, the strongest baseline, by 1.58 F1 points across 12 equally weighted dataset-backbone settings. Across five profiled configurations, CARAT uses 9.49% fewer GFLOPs and updates 47.82% fewer parameters than EATA. A pattern also emerges across sensing regimes: multimodal TTA methods such as PTA are competitive on IMU-dominated homogeneous datasets, whereas unimodal TTA methods like TENT and EATA match or exceed it on heterogeneous datasets. These results position CARAT as a practical default to wearable TTA, offering competitive robustness with modest computational requirements and benefits that vary across backbones and dataset regimes.

</details>


### [354] [Activation Denoising: A Robustness View on Parallel vs Sequential LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07522)
*Yan Scholten,Rachel Lawrence,James Hensman,Stephan Günnemann,Alicia Curth,Riccardo Grazzi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 activation denoising（激活去噪）方法，通过鲁棒性正则化在单次并行量化中恢复大部分序贯量化的精度，同时避免逐层串行调度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 训练后量化存在精度–效率权衡：并行量化独立处理每层、不修正上游量化误差，导致残差流中误差累积；序贯量化逐层校准以修正误差，但串行调度在大模型上成为瓶颈。需要一种能并行执行、又能让每层对上游误差鲁棒从而抑制误差传播的折中方案。

Method: 1) 将上游量化误差建模为噪声，提出 denoising 量化目标（式 2）：对输入加噪 λη、目标加噪 ρη，并加权重邻近正则 α。2) 证明该目标等价于对权重做线性预变换 W̃=WF 后在度量 G 下做度量加权舍入（定理 1）；3) 并行高效实现：一次干净（前向传播）加一次注入噪声的前向传播，估计每层 H、C、N 三个二阶矩，再独立并行舍入，无需串行调度、推理零开销。4) 在去噪区 ρ<λ 下，局部噪声注入等价于加权列向 L2 正则、向缩小后的目标靠拢（定理 2），深度传播噪声形成深度复合平滑惩罚，降低 Frobenius 范数与 Lipschitz 常数。

Result: 在 Llama-3.2-1B/3B、Llama-3-8B、Llama-2-13B 上：3-bit GPTQ 下并行去噪恢复 18–31% 并行–序贯差距；2-bit QuIP# 下在 1B/3B 恢复 38–86% 差距，在 8B/13B 上甚至超过序贯基线。与正交旋转互补（旋转保 Frobenius，量化反之降 Frobenius）。投影到 8 张 A100 上相比单 GPU 序贯加速约 7.1–7.5×。剩余差距可通过短序贯前缀、或仅把 v_proj 提升到 4-bit（平均约 3.03 bit）来弥合。

Conclusion: 将 LLM 量化中上游误差的累积视为鲁棒性问题而非逐层修正问题，为高效并行 LLM 量化提供了一个有原则、可扩展、且与现有旋转方法互补的框架。

Abstract: Post-training quantization is a powerful tool for compressing large language models. The most scalable methods quantize every layer in parallel, but quantization errors then compound through the residual stream, as no layer corrects for the errors of the layers before it. Sequential quantization accounts for this error compounding by re-calibrating each layer on the already-quantized outputs of its predecessors, yielding stronger results but at the cost of a serial schedule that becomes a bottleneck at scale. As a solution, we propose parallel quantization with activation denoising, which recovers much of the sequential benefit while keeping quantization fully parallel. Rather than re-calibrating layer-by-layer, we take a robustness perspective and model the upstream error as noise, regularizing to be robust to it through a preprocessing step followed by metric-weighted rounding. Applied at every layer, this regularization forms a depth-compounding smoothness penalty that dampens how strongly quantization errors amplify through the model. Unlike orthogonal rotations commonly used in quantization, which must preserve the model's function, we multiply the weights by a more general linear transformation. We find that the two are complementary and their effects compound. Empirically, our robustness regularization recovers a significant part of sequential quantization's benefit in a single parallel pass, at a fraction of its time. Overall, by treating compounding quantization errors as a robustness problem, we offer a principled foundation for more efficient and accurate LLM quantization at scale.

</details>


### [355] [Targeted search shows that random-device testing underestimates worst-case error in a simulated wave-based neural operator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07529)
*Samrendra Roy,Jason Yoo,Souvik Chakraborty,Syed Bahauddin Alam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过仿真研究指出，在基于波（如光学）神经算子硬件上，传统的随机器件测试严重低估了最坏情况下的误差。作者提出应将随机测试与有针对性的最坏器件搜索相结合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于波的处理器（如相干4f光学系统）虽有能效优势，但其实际应用受制于制造公差和对齐偏差。在投入使用前，必须了解这些器件在规格范围内的最坏情况误差有多大。然而，现有研究普遍采用随机抽样（蒙特卡洛）来评估硬件可靠性，这种方法估计的是器件超过误差阈值的概率，而非最坏可容许器件的误差大小。对于真实的硬件不确定性，我们需要的是最坏情况下的误差下界，而非统计意义上的失败率。

Method: 研究采用了一个混合傅里叶神经算子（FNO），其四个谱层在模拟的相干4f光学处理器上运行。模型有32个容差旋钮（4个对角自由度刻度，5个种子），共120个模型覆盖四个任务（Darcy流、Navier-Stokes涡量、顶盖驱动腔、热交换器）。对比了：(1) 随机蒙特卡洛测试（200/1000个器件）；(2) 有针对性的最坏器件搜索（差分进化DE + 投影梯度上升PGD + 坐标角点搜索 + CMA-ES）。主要评价指标为搜索器件的留出误差与N个随机器件中最大误差之比 R_N。在确定性仿真配置下，使用冻结的静态误差进行对比。

Result: 在所有120个模型中，搜索器件的误差均超过1000个随机器件中的最大误差，比值 R_200 范围为1.08-3.10（中位数1.79），R_1000 范围为1.06-2.71（中位数1.63）。即使在匹配的搜索预算下，均匀或Sobol采样也无法缩小差距。经过100,000个均匀器件采样后仍无器件达到搜索误差水平。通过Clopper-Pearson区间估计，这种器件的抽取概率上限为0.37%。在训练方法上，混合PGD微调（Mixed-PGD FT）在所有20个任务-种子配对中均产生了最低的搜索误差。在热交换器工程量（如平均压力）评估中，搜索发现在39个模型中均超过了1000个随机器件的最大值，违反了核安全Wilks 95/95容差限。泰勒模型认证在全尺度公差箱上过于保守（界比搜索误差大8.5×10⁸倍）。

Conclusion: 随机器件测试估计的是误差超过阈值的频率，而最坏器件搜索则给出了最坏可容许器件误差的下界。对于波基神经算子硬件的认证，应同时使用这两种方法：随机测试用于估计超阈概率，方向性搜索用于提供最坏情况误差的经验下界。在训练时，混合PGD微调（在随机和搜索器件上微调）可显著降低最坏情况误差。该方法推广至任何具有有界物理旋钮和可评估误差的波基或模拟处理器。未来的工作应将最坏器件搜索融入设计循环，并将公差规格作为设计变量。

Abstract: Wave-based processors promise fast, energy-efficient Fourier layers for neural operators. They are usually validated on randomly sampled devices, but using them requires knowing how large their error can become under fabrication and alignment variation. In a stylised numerical case study, a hybrid Fourier neural operator runs its four spectral layers on simulated coherent 4f processors with 32 toleranced knobs, whose half-widths are representative rather than calibrated. For 120 models (four tasks, six training methods, five seeds), we compared the worst of N random in-spec devices with a searched one. On a deterministic simulator with one frozen draw of the random static errors, the searched device's held-out error was 1.08-3.10 times the maximum over 200 Monte Carlo devices and 1.06-2.71 times that over 1000. With 20 fresh static draws, it still exceeded the maximum over 200 random devices in 116 of 120 models. Under uniform sampling, the probability of drawing such a device is at most 0.37% per model (two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson), which says nothing about how large its error is. The gap persisted with uniform or Sobol' sampling at the search's budget, shared knobs, a second crosstalk model, box scales of 0.25-2 and a pixel-level device model. Models trained only with random static errors reached 3.7-39.9 times their nominal error on searched devices, and fine-tuning on random and gradient-searched devices gave the lowest searched error of the six in all 20 task-seed pairs. For two heat-exchanger quantities, a search targeted at each exceeded the worst of 1000 random devices in all 39 models, and hence the Wilks 95/95 limit (worst of 59). For the mean pressure of 11 models, no random device exceeded a 1% error threshold, but the searched device did. Random testing estimates how often errors exceed a threshold; worst-device search gives a lower bound on how large they can be.

</details>


### [356] [Preserving Unstable Modes Through Inverse Dynamics in JEPA World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07540)
*Leonardo F. Toso,Yann LeCun,James Anderson,Oumayma Bounou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了JEPA世界模型中标准训练目标（下一步预测+反坍缩正则化）的缺陷：无法保证保留开环不稳定系统可控模式，导致无法从隐空间设计镇定控制器。为此提出端点逆动力学损失(EP-IDM)，理论证明精确动作重构使编码器在有限步可达子空间上单射，且有限步可控性Gramian的占优特征子空间随预测步长H趋于可控不稳定子空间。在CartPole、Walker2D、PointMaze等视觉控制任务上验证了控制感知表示学习的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人系统（如四旋翼、腿足机器人）在不稳定平衡点附近运行，需要从高维视觉观测中学习保留不稳定模式的表示以实现反馈镇定。然而，JEPA采用的下一步预测+反坍缩正则化（如SIGReg）虽能避免整体表征坍缩，却可能选择性地丢弃可控不稳定模式——训练损失可以最小化而所有不稳定模式却被丢弃，使得从学习到的表示中进行潜在镇定变得不可能。这一理论与实践之间的鸿沟亟需解决。

Method: 提出端点逆动力学损失(EP-IDM)，从初始和末端隐状态重构整个动作序列。在线性系统中：(1) 证明精确EP-IDM重构使编码器在H步可达子空间上单射，即不能丢弃任何可通过H步动作序列到达的状态方向；(2) 证明有限步可控性Gramian的主导特征子空间随H→∞收敛到可控不稳定子空间。实验采用ViT-Tiny编码器+动作条件Transformer预测器，融合预测损失与EP-IDM损失进行联合训练，在非线性视觉控制任务（CartPole、Walker2D、PointMaze）上评估，使用LQR、CEM、iCEM和GBP等规划器。

Result: 在线性合成系统和线性化CartPole上验证了理论发现：SIGReg训练下潜在LQR控制器无法镇定系统（成功率0%），而EP-IDM使不稳定方向对齐并实现100%成功。在CartPole非线性任务上，1SP+EP-IDM将LQR成功率从0%提升至100%；Walker2D上EP-IDM保留行走极限环并支持iCEM规划达到2.91 m/s速度和9.15 m位移（GT为3.61 m/s和14.43 m），显著优于SIGReg（接近零位移）；PointMaze验证了其在开环稳定系统上仍保持≥90% CEM成功率。还分析了冻结预训练编码器（DINOv2/iBOT）下的表现差异源于其对扰动的敏感度。

Conclusion: 标准JEPA训练目标（预测+反坍缩正则化）不能保证保留反馈镇定所需的控制理论信息，可以选择性地丢弃可控不稳定模式。端点逆动力学(EP-IDM)作为控制感知表示学习的归纳偏置，能保留有限步可达不稳定模式，且不稳定模式因其指数增长成为最易辨识的可达方向。EP-IDM与控制理论的可检测性、潜在可镇定性建立了联系，为从高维视觉观测学习可镇定表示提供了原则性方法。未来工作可与二部模拟等价性和时间拉直等隐空间几何目标结合以实现高效鲁棒规划。

Abstract: Robotic systems often exhibit unstable modes, along which small perturbations and disturbances can cause unbounded growth unless corrected through feedback. Controlling such systems from high-dimensional visual observations requires representations that preserve these modes. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) provide a natural framework for learning such representations and their dynamics from visual data. However, we demonstrate that next step prediction combined with anti-collapse regularization does not guarantee that controllable unstable modes are preserved: the training loss can be minimized while these modes are collapsed, making stabilization from the learned representation impossible. To address this, we augment world-model training with an action reconstruction objective (i.e., an inverse dynamics loss) that encourages control-aware representations, namely, visual representations that preserve crucial features for control. We prove that exact action reconstruction makes the encoder injective on the finite-horizon reachable subspace. Thus, the encoder cannot discard any state direction reachable by an action sequence within $H$ steps. Moreover, we show that, as $H$ grows, the dominant eigenspace of the finite-horizon controllability Gramian converges to the controllable unstable subspace. We establish our theoretical results for linear systems and demonstrate empirically that our findings extend to nonlinear visual control tasks (CartPole, Walker2D, and PointMaze), highlighting the benefits of control-aware representation learning.

</details>


### [357] [Global Transport Couplings for Classifier-Free Guided Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07555)
*Katarina Petrović,Zander W. Blasingame,Danyal Rehman,İsmail İlkan Ceylan,Michael Bronstein,Stephen Y. Zhang,Lazar Atanackovic,Alexander Tong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出Global Transport (GT)，一种全局的、与类别无关的最优传输耦合策略，用于带无分类器引导(CFG)的条件流匹配生成模型。GT在不使用类别标签的情况下构建全局OT分配，虽然在无引导条件下会降低性能，但结合CFG后，在不同领域、模型规模和采样预算下均能稳定提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 条件流匹配模型几乎都采用无分类器引导(CFG)进行采样，但现有的最优传输(OT)耦合设计主要针对无条件生成。类别条件OT虽然自然但在大规模或连续条件空间(如文本到图像)中不实用。作者旨在探索一种适用于CFG条件生成的OT耦合策略。

Method: 1. 提出Global Transport (GT)：计算全局的、忽略类别标签的OT耦合，将不同条件与源噪声的不同区域关联。
2. 提供两种实现：minibatch OT (GT-MB)和semi-discrete OT (GT-SD-OT)，开销均较低(<4%)。
3. 理论分析：证明GT具有最低的耦合成本上界，从而提供最紧的预测间隙(prediction gap)上界。定义并研究"yo-yo效应"——引导轨迹中出现的收缩-再扩张现象。
4. 在多个模型规模(SiT-B/2, L/2, XL/2)、采样预算和任务(类别条件/文本条件图像生成、单细胞数据)上进行实验验证。

Result: 1. ImageNet-256类别条件生成上达到FID 1.91(SiT-XL/2)，优于独立耦合(2.06)。
2. 跨模型规模和NFE设置均一致优于独立和类别条件OT耦合。
3. 文本条件图像生成和单细胞数据生成中均表现最优。
4. 在高引导强度(w)下性能优势更显著，且GT的引导轨迹更稳定，能承受更大的w值。
5. 蒸馏为flow map后仍保持优势。

Conclusion: GT是一种简单、低开销的训练时耦合设计改进，无需改变现有架构、采样器或引导机制。研究表明：耦合选择应在实际推理使用的引导流下进行评估，而非仅基于无引导性能。GT在CFG条件下能降低预测间隙、缓解"yo-yo效应"，从而提升引导生成质量。这为设计耦合策略开辟了新的研究方向。

Abstract: Optimal-transport couplings have been shown to reduce training variance in unconditional flow models, but their role in conditional generation remains unclear. A natural approach constructs separate couplings for each condition, but this is impractical for large or continuous conditioning spaces found in modern image foundation models. We introduce Global Transport (GT), a global class-agnostic optimal-transport coupling, computed without class labels. GT can associate different conditions with different regions of the source noise, and consequently worsens performance without guidance. However, when combined with classifier-free guidance (CFG), GT consistently improves generation across domains, model scales, and sampling budgets. This reversal suggests that couplings for conditional flows should be evaluated both empirically and theoretically under the guided flow used at inference, rather than on unguided generation. We evaluate GT over both discrete class and continuous text conditioned image generation across model scales, and investigate how coupling choice alters guided trajectories. These results identify coupling design in the guided flow setting as a simple training time axis to improve performance without modifying existing architectures, samplers, or guidance mechanisms.

</details>


### [358] [TAFFY: A Task-Adaptive Tabular Foundation Model with In-Context Diversity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07559)
*Zijian Li,Xiangchen Song,Gongxu Luo,Jie Qiao,Ruichu Cai,Zhenhao Chen,Xinshuai Dong,Fan Feng,Guangyi Chen,Kun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TAFFY是一个用于表格数据的任务自适应基础模型，结合了上下文多样性先验和任务条件循环Transformer，通过在多个因果相关环境上预训练，提升模型的上下文学习能力，在多个分类和回归基准测试中取得了最低的平均排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的表格基础模型在从上下文中推断任务特定预测关系方面存在不足，论文旨在通过引入上下文多样性先验和任务条件循环Transformer来增强模型推断任务特定预测关系的能力。

Method: 1. 上下文多样性先验（In-Context Diversity Prior）：在预训练上下文中，通过控制干预和分布偏移从共享因果过程生成多个相关环境，迫使模型从上下文对比中识别预测关系。2. 任务条件循环Transformer（Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer）：迭代地、选择性地应用共享的Transformer块来细化上下文表示，并使用基于支持集统计信息的任务特定门来调节最终的更新。

Result: 在六个分类基准测试（TALENT、BCCO、OpenML-CC18、PFN、TabArena、TabZilla）和五个回归基准测试（TALENT、BCCO、CTR23、PFN、TabArena）中，TAFFY均取得了最低的平均排名，在TALENT分类数据集上排名为3.73，回归数据集上排名为2.45，优于TabPFN3、TabICLv2等现有表格基础模型。消融实验表明，上下文多样性先验和任务条件循环Transformer各自对模型性能都有贡献。

Conclusion: TAFFY通过结合上下文多样性先验和任务条件循环Transformer，有效提升了表格基础模型从上下文中学习和细化预测关系的能力，在多个分类和回归基准测试中取得了最佳性能，为表格基础模型的设计提供了上下文组合和任务自适应迭代细化两个互补的设计方向。

Abstract: Recent progress in tabular foundation models suggests that training on synthetic tasks can substantially improve in-context learning capabilities, with overall performance largely depending on how well models can infer task-specific predictive relationships from the available context during inference. In this paper, we introduce TAFFY, a tabular foundation model with an In-Context Diversity Prior and a Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer that strengthen this ability. Specifically, to construct each synthetic pretraining context, the In-Context Diversity Prior samples from multiple related environments derived via controlled interventions and distribution shifts on a shared causal process. This in-context diversity encourages the model to learn a more comprehensive and task-specific representation. Moreover, the Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer iteratively and selectively applies a shared group of Transformer blocks to refine contextual representations, with a task-conditioned gate modulating the final hidden-state update. This enables task-adaptive iterative refinement. Together, these components encourage the model to identify predictive relationships from contextual contrasts during pretraining and dynamically modulate context integration for each task. Across six classification and five regression benchmark datasets, TAFFY attains the lowest average rank.

</details>


### [359] [Hub for Outliers, Spokes for Inliers: Uniform Latent Space Construction for Dual-Mismatched Semi-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07610)
*Li Yuan,Yaxin Hou,Jiawei Tang,Yongbiao Gao,Yuheng Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对双失配半监督学习（DMSSL）问题，提出了一种基于"轮毂-辐条"（hub-spoke）潜在空间几何结构的方法。该方法通过将已知类均匀分布在中心枢纽周围，并将高不确定性未知类样本引导至枢纽形成的低证据区域，有效缓解了类分布不平衡和标签空间不匹配两大挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有半监督学习方法通常假设标记与未标记数据具有相同的类分布和标签空间，但实际场景中未标记数据往往同时存在类分布不平衡（长尾分布）和未知类样本（开放集）问题。这种双重失配会导致多数类主导潜在空间、未知类被过度自信地误分类，降低特征判别性和伪标签质量。现有方法分别处理长尾SSL（LTSSL）或开放集SSL（OSSL），无法同时应对双重失配的更现实场景。

Method: 方法核心包括三部分：
1. 轮毂-辐条几何构建（HGC）：通过全局结构正则化（类间分离损失L_ig和原型几何损失L_og）和局部结构正则化（类内紧凑损失L_il和径向均匀性损失L_ol），使已知类在中心枢纽周围均匀分布，每类形成紧凑簇。同时引入类自适应重加权策略（CAW），利用整体类原型与标记类原型之间的偏差动态聚焦少数类。
2. 未知类识别与建模（UCIM）：采用基于证据的Dirichlet分类器量化预测不确定性，通过选择每批次中不确定性最高的k个样本作为未知类候选，结合未知类聚类损失L_oc将其特征拉向枢纽。
3. 端到端三阶段训练：预热1（60 epoch）→预热2（20 epoch）→主训练阶段，整合所有损失。
理论分析证明，高不确定性候选样本结合轮毂中心聚类可在枢纽周围诱导出低证据区域。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、SVHN、Food-101和ImageNet-100五个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在多种双失配条件下均优于13个基线（涵盖SSL、LTSSL和OSSL方法），最高提升达3.25%。消融实验验证了各模块（CAW、LSR、GSR、UCIM）的互补累积效果，超参数敏感性分析显示方法对关键参数具有较强稳定性。

Conclusion: 该工作形式定义并攻克了双失配半监督学习这一更现实且更具挑战性的场景。提出的轮毂-辐条几何结合证据基不确定性建模，有效同时解决了类不平衡和未知类问题，理论上证明了枢纽周围低证据区域的形成机制。广泛的实验验证了该方法在多种失配条件下的SOTA表现。

Abstract: Semi-supervised learning typically assumes that labeled and unlabeled data share an identical class distribution and label space. However, this setting is often violated: unlabeled data may be imbalanced and contain unknown class samples, causing mismatches in both class distribution and label space. Such dual mismatch leads to majority classes dominating the latent space and unknown class samples being overconfidently misclassified, degrading feature discriminability and pseudo-label quality. To address this, we propose a hub-spoke latent geometry, where known classes are uniformly distributed around a central hub and each class forms compact clusters around its prototype, while the hub provides an anchor for a low-evidence region specifically designed for high-uncertainty unknown class samples. Integrated with an evidence-based classifier, this geometry ultimately enhances feature discriminability and uncertainty separation by mitigating majority-class domination through structured feature organization and guiding high-uncertainty unknown class samples toward the hub. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with a maximum improvement of 3.25% across various settings.

</details>


### [360] [AFA-BANDIT: Provably Near-Optimal Online Multi-Feature Classification Under Budget Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07615)
*AbdAlRahman Odeh,Teng-Hui Huang,Hesham El Gamal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AFA-BANDIT框架，将在线主动特征获取（Online AFA）问题建模为组合Bandits with Knapsacks（BwK）问题，统一处理特征采集成本与全局预算约束。作者提出维度感知的置信界来获得比经典BwK更紧的遗憾上界（$V^{1/4}$因子改进），并设计LP-Chain变体以线性复杂度构建候选动作链，在合成与真实数据集上优于HEDGE-based BwK和深度RL基线（Opportunistic Learning）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的在线AFA方法存在两个缺陷：(1) 基于深度强化学习的方法缺乏性能保证；(2) 基于bandit的方法通常最大化成本调整后的奖励而非强制全局预算。本文旨在为在线多特征分类问题提供一个具有理论保证且高效求解的框架。

Method: 1. 将Online AFA建模为组合BwK问题：每个特征子集为一个arm，采集消耗全局预算B，奖励为分类正确性。2. 提出维度感知的置信界（Lemma 2）：利用Lipschitz平滑性和子集更新结构。3. 组合设置：采用primal-dual方法，通过OMD更新对偶变量λ。4. LP-Chain：贪心构建成本感知的特征链（$V-V$个嵌套子集），求解每轮LP分配剩余预算。5. 子集更新机制：采集$S_t$后更新所有$S \subseteq S_t$的奖励估计。

Result: 1. 理论：在组合设置下获得遗憾上界 $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{2^V K/\sqrt{V} \cdot OPT_{LP}} + OPT_{LP}\sqrt{1/B})$，相比经典BwK改进$V^{1/4}$因子。2. 实验：在合成高斯混合数据（V=10, K∈{2,4}）和六个真实数据集（CKD, BankMarketing, PhysioNet, Diabetes, MNIST, FashionMNIST）上，LP-Chain在大多数设置下达到最低错误率/高F1，特别是在MNIST上优势突出。4. 复杂度：$V \leq 15$时LP-Chain与完整组合搜索时间相近，$V=20$时LP-Chain快约2.2倍。

Conclusion: 本文成功将在线AFA形式化为预测器耦合的组合BwK问题，利用子集反馈获得比经典BwK更紧的遗憾界。LP-Chain通过线性大小的成本感知链将指数级复杂度降低为线性，并在实验中同时超越BwK基线和深度RL基线（OL）。未来工作包括：(1) LP-Chain的理论分析；(2) 扩展到bandit-label设置（仅返回正确/错误信号而非真实标签）。

Abstract: Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) is a classification problem in which an agent decides which costly features to acquire before predicting each sample's label. Unlike batch AFA, which trains a fixed policy and classifier offline on fully observed data, online AFA updates its predictor from revealed labels as samples arrive. Existing online methods either use deep reinforcement learning (RL) without performance guarantees or maximize cost-adjusted reward rather than enforce a global budget. We formulate online AFA as a combinatorial Bandits with Knapsacks (BwK) problem that couples acquisition and prediction. Unlike prior bandit-based AFA and classical BwK, our setting has combinatorial complexity, evolving rewards, a global budget, and structured side information. We obtain an improved regret upper bound over standard BwK bounds in this framework, leveraging a cardinality-aware confidence bound and the subset update structure. To avoid an exponentially large action space, we propose \emph{LP-Chain}, a variant that searches a cost-aware chain of feature subsets with a size that grows linearly with the number of features. While the regret upper bound is specific to the combinatorial framework, \emph{LP-Chain} empirically achieves comparable predictive performance. On synthetic data, \emph{LP-Chain} outperforms HEDGE-based BwK and deep RL-based online AFA baselines and scales favorably to more features.

</details>


### [361] [Complementary Supervised and Self-Supervised Representations for Out-of-Distribution Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07628)
*Qingying Hao,Zikang Chen,Chuxuan Hu,Jinyuan Jia,Bo Li,Gang Wang,Carl Gunter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对图神经网络（GNN）的分布外（OOD）泛化问题，提出了两种将自监督学习（SSL）表示与监督学习表示互补融合的框架：Co-Train（训练时自适应融合）和 Dual-Space Retrieval（推理时置信度感知融合），在多个基准数据集上验证了SSL表示能提供超越监督表示的互补信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN在面对跨时间或跨域的图分布偏移时性能显著下降。现有图OOD方法多依赖监督学习增强（如构造多环境、不变学习），但监督表示易受标签相关但分布敏感的虚假关联影响。自监督学习（SSL）能从结构和上下文提取与标签解耦的表示，但其表示并非针对下游任务优化。二者目标不同，提供了互补的图表示视角，但现有工作未系统研究如何利用这一互补性提升图OOD泛化。

Method: 1) **Co-Train（训练时融合）**：使用两个独立参数化、不共享架构的监督编码器和SSL编码器（DGI或GRACE），分别提取表示后通过可学习的门控网络（gated fusion）自适应加权SSL表示，并加入MSE对齐损失鼓励两个空间兼容，联合优化监督损失、SSL损失和对齐损失。2) **Dual-Space Retrieval（推理时融合）**：分别训练监督和SSL编码器，构建两个独立的记忆库；测试时在两个空间中独立进行k近邻或类中心非参数检索得到相似度加权类别分数，再通过基于置信度（softmax）的融合机制自适应组合两路预测；当两路预测分歧大时回退为监督主导。两种方法均为骨干网络无关（backbone-agnostic）。

Result: 在Elliptic、OGB-Arxiv、Twitch-Explicit、Facebook-100四个跨时间和跨域基准上，使用GraphSAGE、GAT、GCN、GCNII等多种GNN骨干和DGI/GRACE两种SSL目标进行评测：Co-Train在所有骨干与数据集上一致优于强监督OOD基线（ERM、EERM、LiSA、MARIO），如在Elliptic-GCNII上平均F1提升3.55-4.22pp，在OGB-Arxiv-GraphSAGE上较LiSA提升4.0-4.6pp，在Twitch-GCN上较MARIO提升约2.7pp；Dual-Space Retrieval作为非参数方案也具备竞争力，且通过特征平滑的类中心检索在多类设置中进一步提升。消融实验验证两种表示的互补性；t-SNE与分离度指标显示融合后表示类内更紧凑、类间更分离；Co-Train运行效率最高（43.75s vs ERM 70.83s vs EERM>2h），对SSL骨干选择和检索大小K不敏感。

Conclusion: SSL表示能为图监督学习提供稳定的、与标签解耦的互补信号，系统性地提升跨时间和跨域的OOD节点分类性能。Co-Train在训练阶段融合监督与SSL表示，一致优于强基线且计算高效；Dual-Space Retrieval在推理阶段通过置信度感知融合提供了一种灵活的、骨干无关的非参数替代方案。二者共同表明，将自监督学习作为互补信号融入监督OOD泛化是一条有效且通用的路径。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization remains challenging for graph neural networks (GNNs), as graph distributions can vary substantially across time and domains. Supervised and self-supervised graph representation learning are guided by distinct objectives and offer different perspectives on graph representations. In this work, we study whether self-supervised representations (SSL) can provide complementary signals to improve supervised OOD node classification. We develop two backbone-agnostic frameworks that exploit such information at different stages of learning and prediction. Co-Train jointly learns supervised and SSL representations and adaptively integrates them during training, while Dual-Space Retrieval performs non-parametric prediction in the two representation spaces and combines their predictions through confidence-aware fusion at inference time. The supervised and SSL encoders are separately parameterized and need not share the same GNN architecture. We evaluate multiple GNN backbones and two distinct SSL objectives, DGI and GRACE, on four graph benchmarks spanning temporal and cross-domain distribution shifts. Extensive experiments show that Co-Train consistently outperforms strong supervised OOD baselines, while Dual-Space Retrieval achieves competitive performance as a flexible non-parametric alternative. Results across different backbones and SSL objectives, together with representation analyses and ablations, demonstrate that SSL representations provide complementary information to supervised representations and can improve OOD node classification across diverse settings.

</details>


### [362] [MS-ECG-FM: Towards a More Universal Electrocardiogram Foundation Model for Health Monitoring using Multi-source Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07662)
*Robert A. Lewis,I-Min Chiu,Kyle Verrier,Karthik Jayaraman Raghuram,Francoise Marvel,Salar Abbaspourazad,Anshuman Mishra,Guillermo Sapiro,Andrew C. Miller,Joseph Futoma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MS-ECG-FM，一种通过对比对齐多源临床记录（ECG、超声心动图、胸部X光、出院摘要）训练的通用心电图基础模型，在12导联及少导联配置下全面优于现有SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ECG基础模型的预训练监督信号仅来源于ECG机读报告（ECG-MR），信息覆盖范围有限，无法捕捉结构心脏病、电解质紊乱等更广泛诊断信号，限制了模型的通用性。

Method: 1）使用MIMIC-IV-ECG数据集（720k训练样本）与五种临床报告（ECG-MR、ECG-CR、ECHO-CR、胸部X光、住院小结）进行多源对比对齐预训练；2）采用基于Transformer的导联级token编码器，不对波形做归一化以保留电压信息；3）使用冻结的MedGemma-27B文本编码器提取离线文本嵌入；4）通过随机选择报告类型作为正则化手段学习更广泛的判别特征。

Result: 在扩展的98-127个下游任务基准上，MS-ECG-FM宏平均AUROC达93.6（12导联），全面超越MERL、D-BETA、MELP、ECGFounder等基线；在少导联（单导联I/II/V2及组合）配置下同样表现最佳；在结构心脏病、缺血性心脏病等传统ECG难以诊断的任务上提升尤为显著。

Conclusion: 临床监督信号的多样性（而非单纯扩大模型规模或数据量）是构建更通用ECG基础模型的关键方向；不同类型的临床报告提供互补诊断信息，多源对齐能有效捕获这种互补性，且在部署到少导联场景时仍保持强性能。
